chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 500: Lightning Mink
paragraphs: They arrived at the mouth of the mountain gorge.
Ding Ling stared intently, the bottom was unfathomable, he kicked a stone down, and after a while, he heard the echoing thud.
Such depth, falling would certainly shatter one’s body to pieces.
He saw that the high peak opposite the mountain gorge was several feet away from here.
Such a distance was of no problem at all for Ding Ling.
But for someone like Zhong Ling, a third-rate expert, and Mu Wanqing, a lower-level second-rate expert? Perhaps it was an insurmountable abyss.
Ding Ling had never truly seen how strong Mu Wanqing was, so it was hard for him to judge. But he thought she couldn’t be very strong; otherwise, why couldn’t she even leap over a mere gorge?
Ding Ling grabbed Zhong Ling, and with a single leap, they crossed the deep gorge.

After landing on the other side, Zhong Ling patted her chest, still a bit shaken, glanced at the abyss on one side, then quickly withdrew her head in fear, and looked at Ding Ling with a face full of admiration.
Ding Ling chuckled and asked her to see if she could find any trace of the Lightning Mink here.
"Okay."
Zhong Ling became serious.

She was a Spiritual Beast Tamer, her martial arts skills were mediocre, but her beast-taming techniques were extraordinary. She used a special method to track along the way, and in just a short moment, she actually discovered the trace of the Lightning Mink.
She was very excited.
But looking at the steep valley below, she couldn’t help but frown:
"I can’t go down."
Ding Ling didn’t say much, just motioned to her with his hand.
Zhong Ling’s eyes lit up, and she immediately smiled and placed her hand into Ding Ling’s.
Ding Ling then took her and flew down the mountain.

After acquiring the Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, his body technique became even more graceful, natural, and swift, like a wisp of smoke. In an instant, he landed lightly on a big tree protruding from the steep cliff.

This tree was also stubborn, growing from the cliffside. Ding Ling and the person he was carrying landed lightly on it, without putting much force, so the tree only shook slightly and didn’t move again.
Zhong Ling watched and was full of admiration; her respect for Brother Ding soared to the peak—at such a young age, with such breathtaking Lightweight Skill, who in the world could compare?!

Ling Yanqiu also leapt over the gorge at this moment; her ability to leap several feet was not a problem, coupled with the Breathing Technique and other fortune, her cultivation now was vastly different from the past.
She glanced at Ding Ling, moved inwardly, appearing even younger than her. How old was he exactly to possess such unmatched Lightweight Skill, truly leaving others far behind.
She recalled asking Zhong Ling along the journey, and Zhong Ling’s face full of honor talked about how Ding Ling learned the Cloud Crane Technique in an instant, causing surging waves in her heart.
She thought to herself:

"Does someone who can learn martial arts instantly like Ding Ling actually exist in this world? It’s too incredible. Even if the Martial God descended to the mortal world, he wouldn’t be much different!"
"Brother Ding, over there, I’ve spotted the Lightning Mink’s tracks again, head left."
Zhong Ling’s sweet voice resounded.
Ling Yanqiu interrupted her thoughts, looked in the direction of the voice.
She saw Ding Ling already carrying Zhong Ling, flying down effortlessly like a wild goose, and within moments, they disappeared into the misty depths of the bottomless valley below.
The mist obscured the view.
For the time being, Ling Yanqiu couldn’t tell what was happening below, only vaguely hearing Zhong Ling’s delicate, soft voice.
She glanced at the steep cliffs, the bottomless valley.
In the end, she gave up on flying down.
She felt that if she flew now, she would likely end up as pulp, so she decided to stay put and watch over the Ferghana Horse, lest someone stole it.
This high peak was surrounded by mountains on three sides, covering a vast area.
Below, mist spread, toxic miasma raged.

If some people entered here, the miasma would seep into their bodies without them noticing, and even if they relied on extraordinary Lightweight Skill to climb back up the steep cliffs, the miasma might have already invaded their organs, beyond the help of an immortal.
Ding Ling saw it clearly.
He then transferred some Fusion Qi of the Nine Yang Divine Skill and Medicine King Breathing Technique to Zhong Ling.
Zhong Ling immediately felt her body and mind lighten, the previously oppressive, suffocating feeling disappeared. She gratefully said to Ding Ling, "Thank you, Brother Ding."
She was a bit shy:
"Sorry to trouble you to accompany me to find the Lightning Mink."
"Aren’t we friends?"
Ding Ling responded with a smile.
Zhong Ling’s eyes brightened a bit, but she soon felt a bit uneasy and twisted her body. She didn’t know why, but if it were before, she would definitely be very happy hearing Ding Ling say that.
But now she seemed to want more than just being friends with Ding Ling?
She suddenly realized this point and was startled in her heart, feeling her heartbeat quicken, inadvertently stealing a glance at Ding Ling.
She saw Ding Ling was also looking at her.

Her pretty face blushed scarlet red, spreading over half of the sky. At this moment, her peripheral vision caught sight of the Lightning Mink again, and she immediately suppressed this unusual emotion in her heart and directed Ding Ling.
Ding Ling then carried her and flew forward again.
His Lightweight Skill was truly honed to perfection.

Like smoke, like fog, like a crane, like a roc, with a whoosh, he didn’t know how many miles they had flown. In the end, after winding around, they seemed to have circled the bottom of the high peak several times and came to a deep pool.
Ding Ling looked closely.
He saw green mist drifting over the deep pool, which was clearly highly toxic.
"A pool of poisonous water?!"
Ding Ling continuously transferred Fusion Qi to Zhong Ling to resist the intrusion of toxic miasma.
Zhong Ling was also shocked by this sight, unable to help but whistle.
The next instant.
A small shadow flashed across the void, calling out a few times, suddenly landing not far in front of Ding Ling and Zhong Ling.
Ding Ling looked over.
He saw it was indeed a little gray-white mink, its eyes lively and rolling around, but it was staring unblinkingly at Zhong Ling.
Zhong Ling happily whistled again.
The little mink instantly darted like lightning to Zhong Ling’s shoulder. Zhong Ling used her free hand to capture the little mink and place it into a small pouch at her waist.
She was infinitely delighted, first expressing her gratitude to Ding Ling, then somewhat smugly saying that once they left the valley, she would show her beast taming abilities to Ding Ling.
Jiang Ang!
Jiang Ang!
Just at this moment, Ding Ling suddenly heard two strange, cow-like roars from the direction of the deep pool.
This sound had a hint of shrillness, extremely peculiar.
The sound appeared.
The Lightning Mink, which was previously moving, immediately dared not move.
"Scarlet Venom Toad!"
Ding Ling’s heart was stirred, his eyes gazing keenly, and sure enough, amidst the mist of the deep pool, he saw a toad crouching on the water’s surface of the deep pool.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 501: Scarlet Venom Toad
paragraphs: This toad is no more than two inches long, its entire body a deep crimson surpassing blood; its eyes gleamed with gold as it opened its mouth to let out a sound akin to that of a bellowing bull, producing a thunderous roar echoing with the name Jiang Ang.
"Scarlet Venom Toad!"
Zhong Ling, not lacking in insight, recognized it at a glance, and her expression changed drastically, quietly warning Ding Ling:

"Brother Ding, this is the King of Ten Thousand Poisons! If it gets too close, the poison will penetrate the brain, causing death without cure! If it sprays its original toxic gas at you, even a creature as venomous as the Lightning Mink would have a ninety-nine percent chance of instant death. We certainly can’t resist it, so we’d better retreat while it’s still some distance away."
Ding Ling nodded in agreement.
Now that Zhong Ling had brought him to the dwelling of the Scarlet Venom Toad, she wasn’t afraid of it running away.
It was evident.
This poisonous pool was where the Scarlet Venom Toad resided!

The Lightning Mink, also a highly venomous creature, must have been drawn here by something in this poisonous pool; otherwise, it wouldn’t stray far from Zhong Ling, its mistress, to come all this way.
And precisely because it ran to this peak and valley area,
there were many traces around here that were more apparent.
Other areas were merely fleeting, making it hard to track.
Therefore, even a Spiritual Beast Tamer like Zhong Ling found it difficult to locate it.

At this moment, seeing the poison miasma surge ever more fiercely, Ding Ling knew that it must have been the emergence of the Scarlet Venom Toad that caused the disturbance. Not daring to be negligent, he grabbed Zhong Ling and employed the Spiral Nine Shadows and Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique at full force.
Under the propulsion of Fusion Qi,
he resembled a bolt of lightning, disappearing from the original spot in an instant.
Jiang Ang!

Just as he vanished, the Scarlet Venom Toad suddenly leaped to the spot where he had been standing, spewing out a stream of toxic gas that sizzled the ground, leaving a deep pit after a mere moment of corrosion.
It’s clear that had Ding Ling been any slower, he would have encountered considerable trouble.
Huff, huff!
As Ding Ling sped away, the Jiang Ang sound gradually faded, signifying that the Scarlet Venom Toad had not pursued.
On the way there, they took many detours,
but on the way back, it was much more straightforward, although there were still quite a few winding paths.
Under the peaks, amidst the valleys, were numerous natural caves and snake paths, where common people could easily get lost if they weren’t careful.
Ding Ling silently noted the path.
After escorting Zhong Ling to the top of the peak, he planned to return to capture the Scarlet Venom Toad.
Apparently,

Mu Wanqing and Duan Yu hadn’t been around, indicating they encountered some setbacks! The Scarlet Venom Toad wasn’t accidentally ingested by Duan Yu, which turned out to be good fortune for Ding Ling.
How could Ding Ling miss such an opportunity?
He had Zhong Ling lead him to find the deep ravine and trace the Lightning Mink to locate this Scarlet Venom Toad. Now that his wish had been granted, there was no reason to give up.
Zhong Ling, seeing Ding Ling about to return, couldn’t help but be shocked and worried:
"Brother Ding, the Scarlet Venom Toad’s poison is very potent. Are you really going?"
"Don’t worry. I’m immune to all poisons. Being cautious isn’t harmful."

Recalling how Ding Ling walked through the poison mist with ease and could transfer True Qi to her, allowing her to resist the miasma, Zhong Ling relaxed a bit but still felt tense thinking about the King of Ten Thousand Poisons:
"Then, you should return quickly and don’t force it if you can’t catch it. Safety comes first."
"Rest assured."
Ding Ling soared and leaped down from the peak, like a wild goose spreading its wings, swiftly diving into the depths of Cloud Mist Valley, disappearing in a blink of an eye.
Zhong Ling hurried to the side of the peak, overlooking the valley with furrowed brows, filled with worry.
Upon being asked the reason by Ling Yanqiu, Zhong Ling recounted everything in detail.
Ling Yanqiu gasped quietly, finding it hard to believe that such a poisonous creature still existed in this world. But now, it was too late to say anything, only to pray for Ding Ling’s safety.
Ding Ling returned to the front of the deep pool.

This time, he fully engaged the Nine Yang Divine Skill and Spiral Nine Shadows’ protective barrier, enveloping himself in Gang Qi. The nine figures split and merged, constantly transitioning between dissipation, sometimes activating the Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, making Ding Ling appear like green smoke rising into the sky, nearing the edges of the deep pool in an instant.
Now closer,
Ding Ling could clearly see.
The deep pool was several zhang deep.

The water resembled a scroll of green jade, so clear that the bottom was visible, adorned with a lotus-like strange flower, swaying uncertainly. At the bottom of the flower lay a faint green bead shimmering with radiant light.
The Scarlet Venom Toad lay crouched atop that green bead, inhaling and exhaling, streams of green air currents swirling uncertainly through its nostrils.
It seemed to spot Ding Ling, and its bean-sized green eyes suddenly burst forth with two beams of golden light. It seemed infuriated, opening its mouth wide to let out a roar.
Jiang Ang!
Whoosh!
Like a spring, it propelled itself with its hind legs, instantly leaping several zhang high onto the water’s surface, then bound toward Ding Ling, spewing forth a stream of toxic gas.
This toxic gas was markedly different in color from the water.
It was actually faint red!

Ding Ling’s body technique was superb, his nine figures split and merged within the void. The Scarlet Venom Toad couldn’t lock onto him, and in its rage, continued to spray toxic gas toward Ding Ling.

Seeing the toxic gas corroding the earth it traversed and the cave walls hissing with piercing sounds, being burnt through forming pit holes in mere breaths, Ding Ling was alarmed by the strong poison, unable to underestimate it. Initially, he aimed to capture it alive as it would yield stronger medicinal effects, but now it appeared somewhat challenging.
He would need to injure or kill it, at the very least, incapacitate its ability to consciously spray toxic gas.
Otherwise, Ding Ling wouldn’t dare approach it.
While it’s true he was immune to all poisons, fearing neither ordinary venom,
faced with the King of Ten Thousand Poisons’ toxic gas, he could only be bewildered and helpless.
One Yang Finger!

Ding Ling immediately employed his Finger Technique; arcs of Finger Force shot forth, as Ding Ling’s True Qi surged like a tide, not fearing backlash from excessive use of One Yang Finger. Thus, his One Yang Finger’s Finger Force flooded toward the Scarlet Venom Toad in a dense net-like fashion.
The Scarlet Venom Toad moved with incredible speed.

But in mid-air, it couldn’t easily change direction, getting struck in its abdomen by Ding Ling’s One Yang Finger’s Finger Force, letting out a painful cry and dropped to the ground, where Ding Ling unleashed a Finger-Pointing Divine Technique, whoosh!
A stone shot out like electricity, hitting the Scarlet Venom Toad’s head with a raucous sound, leaving it dazed for a couple of steps before it fainted right away.
Ding Ling was delighted.
Considering the circumstances,
the Scarlet Venom Toad was still alive.
That was perfect!
Given his initial intention to capture it alive, while the outcome was not the most perfect, it was still quite satisfactory.
He took out a furnace he had prepared beforehand.
This furnace he had acquired when seeking antidotes over mountains, left some fragments of gold with mountain sects back then as if paying for the furnace.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 502: Immune to All Poisons
paragraphs: Inside the furnace, there were still some other poisons and herbs, which Ding Ling had gathered from the first mountain stream to mix with the necessary poison ingredients.
As for the herbs.
He had prepared some along the way.
But ultimately, it wasn’t enough.
What surprised him was that there were quite a few herbs in this valley that complemented the Scarlet Venom Toad.
It saved Ding Ling from having to search outside the valley.
Using an iron claw staff, he captured the Scarlet Venom Toad and put it into the furnace, then sealed the furnace and quickly began searching for herbs in the surrounding caves and snake paths.
Where poison resides.
There must be antidotes.
Those words are true.
All things are interdependent and counteract each other; an age-old truth.
Ding Ling, having mastery of the Medical Dao, could discern the medicinal properties of various herbs with his keen perception.

Even if some unfamiliar herbs appeared before him, Ding Ling could roughly understand their properties by using the Medicine King Breathing Technique and the Medical Saint Breathing Technique for a slight sensory check.
You could say.
With two top-tier, full-level breathing techniques from the Medical Dao, along with countless secret manuals that Ding Ling had read, no herb in the Martial World could pose a challenge to him.
After half an hour.
Ding Ling collected enough herbs, wood, etc., returned to the location of the deep pool, and began to kindle a fire and refine pills.
As for how to concoct the Immune to All Poisons Pill, with the Scarlet Venom Toad as the main ingredient.
Ding Ling had long been prepared!
Mentally reviewing the process again, confirming there were no issues, he then activated the Burning Wood Saber Technique to ignite the flames.
The flames from the Flame Saber were too fierce, a bit overbearing for alchemy.
However, those from the Burning Wood Saber Technique were just right.
Once alchemy starts, there’s no reason to stop.
Ding Ling’s refinement.
Lasted for several hours.
After several hours.
Ding Ling opened the furnace, and inside were three emerald-green pills.
He took out one without hesitation and swallowed it.
[Constitution +1]
[Constitution +1]
[Constitution +1]
As soon as the pill entered his stomach, Ding Ling saw a series of notification messages flash across the character panel.
He didn’t pay much attention to them.
Instead, he started to perform the technique and breathing technique to refine the rolling medicinal power of the pill.
Since his technique and breathing technique were full level.
In just a moment.
He completed the refinement.
Ding Ling carefully sensed and found that he was like a fish in water with the miasma here, without any oppressive feeling at all.

Previously, although immune to all poisons, he had to constantly perform techniques to perfectly neutralize the miasma while staying here, but now he didn’t need to operate any cultivation technique and could stand here without concern.
Not only that.
Ding Ling approached the poison pool.
Found that the previously astonishing green poison mist didn’t harm him at all.
"It really enhanced me."
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
[Constitution +6]
[Congratulations to the player for obtaining the Immune to All Poisons constitution.]
[Note: Immune to All Poisons refers to immunity against all toxins in the Historical Plane and Martial Hero Plane!]
It truly succeeded!
Ding Ling rejoiced.
He genuinely didn’t expect just one pill to achieve this.
Not only that, but his constitution had improved by 6 points.
A six-point enhancement.
Making Ding Ling feel that his endurance, vitality, immunity, stamina, etc., were enhanced by more than a notch.
"I never thought I’d be able to refine pills with such miraculous effects now."
Ding Ling glanced at the remaining two pills.
After some thought.
He swallowed another.
[Constitution +1]
As the rolling medicinal power was refined.
Ding Ling’s constitution was enhanced by another point.
"That’s all?!"
Ding Ling was astonished.
He pondered:

"It seems this kind of pill has the strongest transformation effect on the first one. After all, one pill has achieved an immune to all poisons constitution; eating more won’t have any use. This kind of resistance has evidently reached its peak. Perhaps the third pill would be completely wasted."
A single pill had perfected the body.
Eating more can’t transform it further, only improve it slightly.
Clearly.
This pill’s resistance is far beyond that of ordinary pills. But with its explosive effectiveness from just one, there’s no need to consume a second.
Ding Ling promptly put away the third pill.
This pill is likely the last of its kind in the Martial World!
Ding Ling finally surveyed this place, then decisively walked to the front of the deep pool and plucked the strange flower.
After being picked, the strange flower blossomed with emerald-green light throughout.
After careful sensing, Ding Ling understood:

"This is a strange flower capable of neutralizing all poisons. Indeed, everything is interdependent and counteracts each other; in the Scarlet Venom Toad’s dwelling, there exists a flower capable of neutralizing its toxins!"
Now immune to all poisons, Ding Ling didn’t need this flower.
But others might need it.
He placed the flower into the storage pouch.
Then he took off his clothes and leaped into the deep pool; the water here was extremely toxic, but now Ding Ling didn’t feel a thing when drinking the poison water, so why would he fear it?
He dove to the bottom of the pool, picked up that emerald-glowing pearl, and surveyed the surroundings, seeing no other anomalies, before surfacing.
After getting dressed again.
He played with the green pearl, sensing and probing.
"What exactly is this?!"
Ding Ling was astounded.
He found that, with his current capabilities, he was unable to discern the origins of this green pearl.

"Could this thing be akin to the ancient bamboo slip recording the ’Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques’ from the Three Kingdoms World, originating from ancient times? Or even older? Or perhaps simply without a known origin?"
Ding Ling didn’t know.
But he was certain it had a purpose.
Reflecting.
The Scarlet Venom Toad dwelled here, undoubtedly to utilize it!
And after Ding Ling took this green pearl away, the poison mist above the deep pool began to dissipate slowly, and the pool of poisonous water seemed to turn clear.
Clearly, this green pearl was the principal entity here! Its departure immediately changed the scene.
"Perhaps the Scarlet Venom Toad was initially just a regular toad, transformed into the King of Ten Thousand Poisons because of this green pearl?"
Ding Ling speculated:
"If my guess is correct, then the Lightning Mink likely came for this green pearl. I’ll let it try when I return?"
But Ding Ling dared not let the Ferghana Horse try.
This thing is clearly poisonous.
Fearing the Ferghana Horse would drop dead instantly upon trying.
The Lightning Mink, a creature fond of poisonous snakes and venomous things, might favor this pearl with its pure poison; possibly, it would take a liking to it.
Ding Ling could only sense that this green pearl contained a lot of poison gas that could be absorbed by external objects.
Besides poison gas.
This green pearl seemed to harbor something else within.
But what exactly.
With Ding Ling’s shallow cultivation at present, he was unable to discern.

He stored the green pearl in his storage pouch, activated his Fusion Qi, and with the full exertion of the Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, he transformed into a wisp of smoke and exited the snake cave, shooting straight into the sky.
A moment later.
Ding Ling climbed the mountain wall to reach the summit.

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 503: The Plan
paragraphs: Ding Ling just reached the high peak.

He saw Zhong Ling pacing back and forth anxiously, muttering to herself, ’Why hasn’t Brother Ding returned yet?’ ’Could something have happened to Brother Ding?’ ’What should I do?’ ’I must go down to find him!’
Ding Ling felt warmth in his heart.
Innocent and charming like Zhong Ling indeed easily gains people’s affection.
Moreover, Zhong Ling personally led him to find the Scarlet Venom Toad. Ding Ling thought for a moment, and decided that he could give her the pill later.
Who should he keep the pill for?
Even if he descends to the Lower Realm now, he cannot bring anything with him.
Ding Ling looked at the prompt.
It clearly stated:
[Player Ding Ling, do you wish to return to the World of Divine Condor now?]
[Note 1: Only one round-trip opportunity is available. No time limit. Only one set of clothes can be taken to the Lower Realm.]
[Note 2: Choose a fixed location for the exchange. The location for interaction between worlds is fixed, no longer random.]
Although the unlimited time and fixed location are quite eye-catching.
But only being able to bring one set of clothes is even more striking!
Since nothing can be carried.
The pill in Ding Ling’s hand naturally doesn’t need to be kept, and in this current world, Zhong Ling is the only person he has affections for.
Besides, Zhong Ling played a significant part in finding the Scarlet Venom Toad.
Naturally, Ding Ling decides to give the pill to Zhong Ling to consume.
Seeing Zhong Ling so worried about him at this moment, Ding Ling feels his decision is absolutely correct.
’If I obtain Immortal Techniques in the future, I could descend to teach them to Diao Chan, Dragon Girl, and the others, or directly make some Immortal Pills?’
Does the Three Kingdoms World have sufficient herbs to refine Immortal Pills?
For Ding Ling, this is a distant matter, but he knows one thing: the stronger a person is, the more they can transform decay into marvel!
He believes that as long as he is strong enough, all impossibilities can become possible.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling stops overthinking and directly coughs, calling out, "Zhong Ling!"

Zhong Ling shudders, turns around, and upon seeing Ding Ling, her large watery eyes inexplicably become a bit red. She then throws herself into Ding Ling’s arms like a bird returning to its nest, holding him tightly:
"Brother Ding, you really scared me. I thought you wouldn’t come back."
Upon saying this.
She quickly jumps out of Ding Ling’s embrace, looking him up and down anxiously:
"Brother Ding, are you alright?"
"I’m perfectly fine!"
Ding Ling nods and smiles.
At this moment, Ling Yanqiu also comes over.

She had been full of worry before, but compared to Zhong Ling, she was more composed, better at concealing her feelings. Yet, upon seeing Ding Ling, the darkness in her eyes dissipates instantly like clouds receive sunlight, her whole demeanor becoming light and joyful.
"Let me take a look."
Zhong Ling examines Ding Ling repeatedly, confirming he is alright, then asks about the Scarlet Venom Toad.
Ding Ling says he has used it for alchemy.
Zhong Ling is taken aback, exclaiming:
"You managed to catch the Scarlet Venom Toad?!"
Ling Yanqiu is deeply moved as well.
After all, that’s the King of Ten Thousand Poisons. She thought Ding Ling would certainly return without success, but unexpectedly, he managed to refine it.
"That’s right."
Ding Ling takes out a pill and gives it to Zhong Ling:
"This is the pill refined from the Scarlet Venom Toad. You’re frail; eat it quickly."
"I won’t eat it."
Zhong Ling shakes her head:
"Brother Ding, you should eat it."
"I’ve already eaten one."
Ding Ling apologetically looks at Ling Yanqiu.
Ling Yanqiu understands, smiles and says:
"I am highly skilled in martial arts and have a strong physique. Zhong Ling’s skills are low-tier, and her physical condition is even worse; she needs to improve her physique more than I do."
Moreover, ...
You two are a sweet little pair. How could I compete with Zhong Ling for her Brother Ding?
Ling Yanqiu’s heart flashes with a silhouette and she can’t help but sigh. She envies Zhong Ling for having someone who doesn’t hide from her!
Gulp!
Zhong Ling eventually eats the pill.
After consuming it.
The improvement in her physical condition is too obvious; Ding Ling’s physique is extremely strong, so gaining six or seven points isn’t very noticeable.
Zhong Ling, however, is different. After several points.
She seemed to become more energetic and lively!
To help her quickly refine the pill, Ding Ling placed his hand on her back, using Fusion Qi to refine the medicinal power, assisting her in quickly obtaining the Immune to All Poisons physique.
After a period of time.
Zhong Ling exclaimed full of surprise and joy:
"I’m really immune to all poisons?! This is incredible!"
Seeing Ling Yanqiu’s envious expression beside her.
Zhong Ling feels a bit proud and a bit apologetic.
Ling Yanqiu pulls her aside and whispers, saying she’s envious of her for meeting someone like Brother Ding who thinks of her and helps her, instead of avoiding her.
Upon hearing this, Zhong Ling straightens her spine, her pretty face filled with joy and pride.
People praising Ding Ling makes her even happier than praising herself.
She asks Ling Yanqiu about some things.
Knowing the circumstances of the person Ling Yanqiu likes, she feels sad for Ling Yanqiu but ultimately feels even more fortunate to have met a man like Ding Ling.

She secretly glances at Ding Ling and sees that he is also looking at her. This time she doesn’t dodge, just suppresses her bashfulness, blushes and walks over: "Brother Ding, where are we heading now?"
"First to the Infinite Sword Sect to see the Infinite Jade Pendant here."
Ding Ling intends to see whether the opportunity in the valley at the forbidden area behind Infinite Sword Sect has been obtained by Duan Yu.
But judging by the situation, Duan Yu should have already acquired it.
Ding Ling is making this trip.
Thinking it’s fine to take a look since he’s already at Wuliang Mountain.
After looking, then head to Dali Celestial Dragon Temple to see if he can obtain the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
Afterward, proceed to Leigushan to see if he can heal Wuya Zi; even if he can’t, he’ll find a way to learn North Nether Divine Skill and other cultivation techniques.
Ding Ling has made up his mind.
Regarding how to explore this world, he has planned it out.
Follow the steps methodically.
Once his strength is enhanced to a certain extent, he plans to defeat Great Liao and Western Xia, appoint someone as Sovereign, and have them help search for the Jiuzhou Secret Manual.
Then he could stay at the manor and read leisurely.
Experiencing the convenience of becoming a Prince.
Ding Ling becomes tempted.
Thinking of choosing another person to become Emperor by following the same method, so he could reign behind the scenes.
However, this person must have outstanding character and know to repay kindness, or else choosing a treacherous character would be digging his own grave!
He also hopes for this person of outstanding character to be able to assist future Ascenders like Huang the Herbalist and Pan Feng.
Ding Ling and the two others ride northward.
With Zhong Ling guiding the way.
There’s no need to worry about getting lost.

She now seems to be set on Ding Ling, wherever Ding Ling goes, she follows, even ignoring her home. According to her, she can see her parents anytime, but if she doesn’t stick close to Brother Ding and he disappears, where would she find him?!
As they progress to a secluded forest area.
Ding Ling suddenly sees two people and a horse coming out from a side path.
The horse appears extremely majestic!
But is being led by a man.

A woman walks in front, dressed in black, face covered with a black veil, with a graceful figure and eyes as bright as polished black paint. She seems to notice Ding Ling’s group, her eyes showing a hint of wariness and complexity, but quickly, she seems to notice Zhong Ling, her eyes widen in surprise, filled with incredulity.
Zhong Ling also sees the woman, her eyes light up, she sweetly smiles and says:
"Sister Mu!"

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 504: Dragon Gate Flying Armor: Yiu Huatian
paragraphs: "Why are you here?"

Zhong Ling clearly recognized the newcomer, smiling brightly with her dimples showing. Seeing Sister Mu with a horse that she hadn’t ridden, accompanied by a strange man, she was puzzled and was going to ask a few more questions.
But the veiled woman suddenly shouted:
"I don’t know you!"
"Sister Mu!"
Zhong Ling was stunned, barely able to believe that the veiled woman would say such a thing.
"Hmph!"
The man behind the veiled woman had a handsome face and was dressed in resplendent clothing, exuding regal elegance, akin to a sovereign looking disdainfully at defeated remnants:
"So, all acquainted. That makes things easier."
His gaze passed through Ding Ling and Zhong Ling, landing on Ling Yanqiu:
"Unexpected, to meet you here."
"Yiu Huatian. I didn’t expect to encounter you here either. Where is Zhao Huai’an?"
Ling Yanqiu’s face tightened, gripping her sword firmly as she said:
"I chased you up the Celestial Ladder. Now you’re here, where is Zhao Huai’an?!"
"I would also like to know where he is."
Yiu Huatian leisurely drew the long sword from his waist, as gracefully and methodically as a refined diner, noble, elegant, scholarly, yet gentle:
"But it doesn’t matter. Today, I’ll kill you first. When I meet him, I’ll kill him too!"
"With just you, you think you can kill him?"
Ling Yanqiu sneered.
The veiled woman couldn’t hold back any longer, stepping forward, she said:
"Yiu Huatian, you have a grudge against this lady, fine, but can you let my little sister leave first."
"Sister Mu."

Zhong Ling, so perceptive, understood immediately that the scolding from Sister Mu earlier was to protect her, there was no need to say more; Sister Mu must have deep-seated disagreements with Yiu Huatian, otherwise, she wouldn’t be so tense around him.
"That’s not possible."
A frost seemed to settle on Yiu Huatian’s face, and with just a gentle step forward, a chill swept out indiscriminately:
"Anyone mixed up with Ling Yanqiu surely is with the traitors. As the Great Governor, how can I let traitors go? Everyone, stay here!"
Boom!

He suddenly stomped the ground, like a sword breaking through the air, and in a blink, he was before Ding Ling. A flick of his treasure sword sent gleaming stars like lightning towards Ding Ling’s face.
This thrust aimed directly at Ding Ling’s vitals, clearly intending to take Ding Ling’s life.
Ding Ling frowned, casually unleashing an Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
Roar!
Dragon Battle in the Wilderness!

Amidst the dragon’s roar, a dragon-shaped phantom, driven by Fusion Qi, burst from Ding Ling’s palm, a Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing swept away the starlight, striking Yiu Huatian’s treasure sword, causing his hand to tremble violently, and his tiger’s mouth to split open. Unable to hold the sword, it flew several meters away with a clanging sound.

Yiu Huatian, airborne, couldn’t dodge, and was struck in the chest by the strong and unparalleled palm force, immediately spewing a jet of blood, flying diagonally several meters away, landing with a heavy thud beside the sword stuck in the ground.
Just like that.
In an instant.
No one else could react before the battle was over.
The veiled woman’s eyes were filled with fear, unable to believe Ding Ling was so brave and formidable!
Zhong Ling was overjoyed, clapping and cheering ’Brother Ding is amazing!’

Ling Yanqiu secretly took a breath. Yiu Huatian was the Great Governor of the Western Bureau in her world, and with the frenzy of otherworld ascenders and aliens pouring in, Yiu Huatian, leveraging immense power in hand, gained numerous fortunes and opportunities.
His strength was unfathomable.
Zhao Huai’an was forced to retreat to the Celestial Ladder, fleeing in disgrace.
Confronted with this, Ling Yanqiu had no hesitation pursuing.
This led to their meeting in this world.
And yet such a strong person was nearly killed by Ding Ling with a single strike!

Previously, when Ding Ling defeated Cloud Crane, it didn’t feel too significant, but now defeating Yiu Huatian in one move brought immense shock, as if a cyclone swept through her heart, a chaotic mess!

Yiu Huatian himself was equally shocked but being astute, he endured the excruciating chest pain from a broken rib, flipped and leaped up, swiftly drawing the sword beside him, and dashed toward the veiled woman, placing the sword rapidly at her neck:
"If you don’t want her dead. Get lost!"
His voice was incredibly cold, as if it carried autumn frost.
The veiled woman trembled, instinctively glancing towards Zhong Ling and the others.
Zhong Ling was a little scared, gently pulling Ding Ling’s sleeve, whispering:
"Brother Ding, can you save Sister Mu? Please."
Ding Ling sighed.
Running into Yiu Huatian here was unforeseen.
Yiu Huatian? He’s a boss-level character from the Dragon Gate Flying Armor world, and now he’s here.
It seems the Celestial Ladder likely descended to the site of his duel with Zhao Huai’an, otherwise, such coincidence wouldn’t occur.
But what Yiu Huatian shouldn’t ever do is, try to kill him?
Ding Ling coldly glanced at Yiu Huatian and said:
"Let Miss Mu go, you can leave."
Yiu Huatian’s powers are indeed high, quite remarkable.
But only at the Initial Tier Innate level.
With such power, Ding Ling’s Defensive Gang Qi Shield, Yiu Huatian couldn’t even break Ding Ling’s defense!
How could he withstand a strike from Ding Ling’s Fusion Qi without being killed on the spot? Perhaps he had some fortune, or armor protection.
"Hehe."
Yiu Huatian did not believe Ding Ling’s words at all, sneering coldly:
"Don’t leave? Then I’ll kill her!"
He exerted force with his hand, and the masked woman’s neck immediately oozed a trace of crimson blood, leaving Zhong Ling looking pale.
That masked woman merely groaned, yet throughout she hadn’t uttered a word of plea, evidently a tough character.
"Let her go."
Ling Yanqiu leaped off the horse’s back:
"I’ll take her place."
"Are you worthy?"
Yiu Huatian retorted sarcastically:
"Obviously, Miss Mu Wanqing shares a deep relationship with the girl opposite. And that girl is seated behind that expert, embracing him. The closeness between the two is apparent.
And you?
How long have you been in this world?
What makes you think you can replace Mu Wanqing?"
So it’s Mu Wanqing.
Ding Ling also secretly marveled. By rights, Mu Wanqing should either be with Yue the Third or Duan Yu at this moment, unexpectedly held hostage by Yiu Huatian.
It seems there must be some conflict between Duan Yu and Mu Wanqing with Yiu Huatian, otherwise, it wouldn’t have come to this.
Ling Yanqiu was at a loss for words.
Yiu Huatian once again looked at Ding Ling:

"Your palm power is so strong, your palm techniques so high, I have never heard nor seen anything like it. I admit defeat. But I absolutely will not surrender! If you want me dead, I’ll make sure to kill Mu Wanqing first! You don’t believe me, but feel free to try."
"No!"
Zhong Ling couldn’t help but cried out softly.

Yet Yiu Huatian heard it clearly, becoming even more certain of his previous suspicions. He was about to say a few more words, but suddenly felt intense pain in his chest, forcing him to cough painfully, blood oozing from the corners of his mouth.
It was this very moment of cough-induced distraction.
Ding Ling seized the opportunity, pointing a finger towards Yiu Huatian’s Treasure Sword.
One Yang Finger!

A streak of Finger Force pierced through, extremely fast like a flash of lightning, hitting Yiu Huatian’s Treasure Sword with a bang, tilting it aside, Mu Wanqing, being quick-witted, swiftly ran to the side.
"Where are you running!"
Yiu Huatian, both angry and fearful, Ding Ling could actually shoot such Finger Force from afar.

Immediately disregarding his dignity, in order to evade Ding Ling’s oncoming Finger Force, he crouched down and rolled on the ground, simultaneously activating Fusion Qi, bursting forth at ten times speed, bang! Like Xun Wind rolling across the ground, rapidly flipping to Mu Wanqing’s side, then reaching out like lightning to grab Mu Wanqing’s arm.
Mu Wanqing was brave as well.
Realizing she couldn’t outrun Yiu Huatian, she unleashed her palm towards Yiu Huatian, but didn’t expect to be counter-grabbed, looking helplessly as she was about to fall back into his grip.
Ding Ling’s torrent of Finger Force already descended like raindrops upon Yiu Huatian.

Ding Ling initially didn’t want to kill Yiu Huatian, after all, his ability to withstand a single palm suggested his Cultivation Technique must be extraordinary, so Ding Ling thought of heavily injuring him to extract some techniques.
But Yiu Huatian, whenever he grabbed an opportunity, would act ruthlessly.
To avoid being coerced, Ding Ling figured such a ruthless person would hardly be easy to subdue, his extraction plans likely failing, opting instead for the One Yang Finger to end him.
Whish whish whish!
The torrential flood of Finger Force from the One Yang Finger easily pierced through Yiu Huatian’s body.
He was already gravely injured.
This compounded injury left him unable to endure, only able to use his remaining strength to viciously reach for Mu Wanqing’s neck, intending to kill her even in death.
But Mu Wanqing tilted her neck back slightly, and with a smack, he only managed to grab her face veil.
Rip!
The veil was torn off by him.
Revealing her stunningly beautiful face.
"My veil."
Mu Wanqing appeared dazed, lost in spirit.
And Ding Ling’s One Yang Finger’s Finger Force descended again, poof! Hitting Yiu Huatian’s head, and his final struggles dissipated with the blood gushing out.
Bang!
Yiu Huatian kneeled on the ground, body wobbling, before falling sharply, dead on the spot, beyond dead.
He died unwillingly.
His eyes wide open!
His life had just begun. How did it end so soon?!

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 505: Mu Wanqing
paragraphs: Yiu Huatian was very unwilling.
His imperial ambitions had yet to begin, how could he die here?!
In his last remaining consciousness, there was a trace of shock and nine parts regret.

He was accustomed to being invincible and overbearing in his world, and upon suddenly ascending to the Upper Realm, he thought the people here would be stronger, but after easily killing a group of people, his confidence soared again. Considering that the Ascenders from his world were also extremely powerful, he realized that he might also be a top-tier strongman in this world, so he didn’t take the young Ding Ling seriously.
But who would have expected that Ding Ling would be so ridiculously strong!
"As expected of the Upper Realm..."
"If I had known earlier, I would have been more cautious and not chosen to make a move on that young man first. Being prudent and rational might have allowed me to survive this calamity peacefully!"
Yiu Huatian perished completely in his frustration and regret.
The last remaining glimmer in his eyes vanished entirely.
Mu Wanqing looked at Yiu Huatian, then at Ding Ling, her pretty face, radiant like a new moon and with the purity of snow on flower trees, was etched with bewilderment and helplessness.
"Sister Mu."
Zhong Ling flew off her horse, ran to Mu Wanqing’s side, grabbed her, sized her up for a moment, and said with a smile:
"You’re okay, that’s really great."
"How can you be so sure I’m alright?"
Mu Wanqing came back to her senses, her face cold as she said:
She looked at Ding Ling with a complicated expression:
"Just now, the one who saved me was?"
"My Brother Ding."
Zhong Ling’s dimples appeared on her pretty face:
"His name is Ding Ling. We’re quite a match..."
She was chattering away.
But Mu Wanqing felt annoyed and confused, feeling a bit overwhelmed.
She was initially very surprised and shocked to see Zhong Ling being so intimate with a stranger! It was unprecedented!
Even with that bookworm Duan Yu, Zhong Ling was at most friendly and fond.

But seeing her with Ding Ling, the two clearly had feelings for each other, especially Zhong Ling, showing an infatuated look towards Ding Ling. Mu Wanqing saw this, her heart stirring, unable to remain calm.
She listened to what Zhong Ling said.
Feeling both envy and jealousy.
If Zhong Ling was not exaggerating, this Brother Ding of hers was too outstanding, too perfect!
Recalling the scene where Ding Ling easily defeated and killed Yiu Huatian, Mu Wanqing felt a sense of panic, apprehension, and unease. She had initially thought of threatening Ding Ling a bit.
But now she dared not.
She let out a long sigh.
Zhong Ling tilted her head in confusion:
"Sister Mu, what’s wrong?"
"You tell me what’s wrong?"

Mu Wanqing walked to the side, picked up Yiu Huatian’s Treasure Sword, glanced at Zhong Ling, then around at the surroundings, finally looking at Ding Ling and Yiu Huatian, and suddenly placed the sword across her neck.
"Ah!"
Zhong Ling reacted quickly, darting forward, grabbing the sword tightly, her delicate hand bled, her pretty nose wrinkled with pain, as she whimpered:
"Sister Mu, what are you doing!"
"Let me go!"
Mu Wanqing didn’t answer, scolding Zhong Ling:
"Stay out of my business!"
Zhong Ling looked at Mu Wanqing’s face, suddenly realizing:

"Ah! I remember now. Your master said if anyone lifted your veil and saw your face, you had to marry him, and if you couldn’t, you needed to kill yourself! Or kill the other party! Is it because of this?"
Mu Wanqing instinctively glanced at Ding Ling, blushed, and remained silent.
"This, this..."
Zhong Ling took advantage to take the Treasure Sword from Mu Wanqing’s hands, looked at Ding Ling, then at Mu Wanqing, and suddenly, bit her lip, and stomped her foot, saying:
"At worst, I’ll marry Brother Ding with you!"
Mu Wanqing was first stunned, then blushed like fire, saying:
"What are you talking about!"
"I must be with Brother Ding no matter what."
Zhong Ling seemed to see through her inner world, suddenly looked at Ding Ling, and nervously asked:
"Brother Ding, can I marry you?"
Ding Ling’s eye twitched slightly, this came too suddenly.
However, thinking of the ancients’ regard for purity, and the subtle changes in Zhong Ling’s mindset during this time, he slowly nodded under her expectant gaze.
Zhong Ling, a girl, was so brave and proactive, and he already had a fondness for Zhong Ling, how could he have a reason to refuse now?
"Brother Ding agreed!"
Zhong Ling cheered, turned, and hugged Mu Wanqing:
"Sister Mu, you don’t have to kill yourself. Now we can be together again."
Mu Wanqing felt extremely complex and tumultuous.

She was instinctively somewhat jealous of Zhong Ling, but thinking that Zhong Ling knew Ding Ling first, she had no right to be jealous, and couldn’t help but feel a bit aggrieved, yet Zhong Ling was willing to marry Ding Ling with her; such broad and generous mentality she absolutely didn’t have, and couldn’t help but admire.
However...
Mu Wanqing’s mind flashed the image of that bookworm Duan Yu.
She looked again at Yiu Huatian’s body.
Ding Ling hadn’t lifted his veil, but he truly was the first man to have seen her face!
And she couldn’t kill Ding Ling, nor did she want to, so she opted to kill herself.
But now she couldn’t even kill herself.
Was it really necessary to marry Ding Ling, whom she had only met once?!
Her emotions surged, high and low, one moment like terrifying waves, another like a complex labyrinth.
Her heart was in a constant state of turmoil and uncertainty.
There was not a moment of peace.
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have won 100% of Zhong Ling’s affection and deep recognition.]

[Note: Zhong Ling is innocent, simple, and romantic. Initially, she didn’t realize, but after realizing, she fell in love with you. In a moment of urgency, she blurted out her desire to marry you in order to save Mu Wanqing. After realizing, she knew she couldn’t take it back.
Upon receiving confirmation from you, her affection for you overflowed!
She strengthened her resolve to follow you for life.]
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have gained high recognition from Mu Wanqing.]

[Note: On the outside, Mu Wanqing appears fierce, cold, and aloof, but internally she is gentle and delicate. Having lived in seclusion for years, she has rarely interacted with men. Like a blank sheet of paper, she is inexperienced and has clear distinctions between love and hate.
You saved her. Also, you were the first to see her face.

Initially, she was unwilling to marry you and didn’t want to kill you. Unable to kill you, she then intended to kill herself. Now persuaded by Zhong Ling, her emotions are still in turmoil and turbulent!]

Ding Ling paused slightly after hearing this, but didn’t think much, just waited for Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing to finish talking, then dismounted voluntarily, letting the Ferghana Horse be shared by the two of them.
His Lightweight Skill was high, and True Qi flowed continuously. Traveling with Lightweight Skill was much better than riding a horse.
Mu Wanqing was still unsure, thinking Ding Ling was showing her special care, her heart softened, and her thoughts of suicide faded a little.

Zhong Ling seemed to see through her inner world, suddenly looked at Ding Ling, and nervously asked:
"Brother Ding, can I marry you?"
Ding Ling’s eye twitched slightly, this came too suddenly.
However, thinking of the ancients’ regard for purity, and the subtle changes in Zhong Ling’s mindset during this time, he slowly nodded under her expectant gaze.
Zhong Ling, a girl, was so brave and proactive, and he already had a fondness for Zhong Ling, how could he have a reason to refuse now?
"Brother Ding agreed!"
Zhong Ling cheered, turned, and hugged Mu Wanqing:
"Sister Mu, you don’t have to kill yourself.
Now we can be together again."
Mu Wanqing felt extremely complex and tumultuous.

She was instinctively somewhat jealous of Zhong Ling, but thinking that Zhong Ling knew Ding Ling first, she had no right to be jealous, and couldn’t help but feel a bit aggrieved, yet Zhong Ling was willing to marry Ding Ling with her; such broad and generous mentality she absolutely didn’t have, and couldn’t help but admire.
However...
Mu Wanqing’s mind flashed the image of that bookworm Duan Yu.
She looked again at Yiu Huatian’s body.
Ding Ling hadn’t lifted his veil, but he truly was the first man to have seen her face!
And she couldn’t kill Ding Ling, nor did she want to, so she opted to kill herself.
But now she couldn’t even kill herself.
Was it really necessary to marry Ding Ling, whom she had only met once?!
Her emotions surged, high and low, one moment like terrifying waves, another like a complex labyrinth.
Her heart was in a constant state of turmoil and uncertainty.
There was not a moment of peace.
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have won 100% of Zhong Ling’s affection and deep recognition.]
[Note: Zhong Ling is innocent, simple, and romantic.
Initially, she didn’t realize, but after realizing, she fell in love with you.
In a moment of urgency, she blurted out her desire to marry you in order to save Mu Wanqing.
After realizing, she knew she couldn’t take it back.
Upon receiving confirmation from you, her affection for you overflowed!
She strengthened her resolve to follow you for life.]
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have gained high recognition from Mu Wanqing.]
[Note: On the outside, Mu Wanqing appears fierce, cold, and aloof, but internally she is gentle and delicate.
Having lived in seclusion for years, she has rarely interacted with men.
Like a blank sheet of paper, she is inexperienced and has clear distinctions between love and hate.
You saved her.
Also, you were the first to see her face.
Initially, she was unwilling to marry you and didn’t want to kill you.
Unable to kill you, she then intended to kill herself.
Now persuaded by Zhong Ling, her emotions are still in turmoil and turbulent!]

Ding Ling paused slightly after hearing this, but didn’t think much, just waited for Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing to finish talking, then dismounted voluntarily, letting the Ferghana Horse be shared by the two of them.
His Lightweight Skill was high, and True Qi flowed continuously.
Traveling with Lightweight Skill was much better than riding a horse.
Mu Wanqing was still unsure, thinking Ding Ling was showing her special care, her heart softened, and her thoughts of suicide faded a little.

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 506: Duan Yu
paragraphs: "Sister Mu, come up quickly."
Ever since Zhong Ling received Ding Ling’s affirmative response, her face has been radiant like a blooming flower. Now, she was warmly inviting Mu Wanqing to mount the horse.
Mu Wanqing’s Black Rose was also a magnificent horse.
But it was gravely injured.
Unable to be ridden.
Mu Wanqing would rather die than give it up, so Yiu Huatian didn’t kill it.
Instead, he took the initiative to lead the Black Rose, asking Mu Wanqing to guide them to get the antidote.
Along the way, Zhong Ling inquired Mu Wanqing in detail.
That’s when she learned.

After being intimidated and driven away by Mu Wanqing that day, Mu Wanqing and Duan Yu had a fierce conflict with the Shennong Sect’s people. She and Duan Yu rode the Black Rose to escape, fleeing in panic. Suddenly seeing someone blocking the way ahead, Mu Wanqing thought it was someone sent by the Shennong Sect or Suzhou to kill her, so she shot the person with a poisoned arrow.
She caught the person off guard.
And that person was Yiu Huatian.

Yiu Huatian clearly didn’t expect to be injured by her. Realizing the arrow was poisoned, he flew into a rage and attacked them directly, stabbing the Black Rose with a sword and knocking it to the ground with a slap.
Then she and Duan Yu accidentally rolled onto the ground.
At this time, the Shennong Sect people also arrived.
Yiu Huatian didn’t say much and directly killed all the Shennong Sect people.
After that, he demanded the antidote from them.
Mu Wanqing didn’t have the antidote on her; she could only get it by going home.
Yiu Huatian wanted to kill Duan Yu, forcing her to lead the way. Mu Wanqing threatened with her life, so Yiu Huatian didn’t kill Duan Yu, he only knocked him unconscious...
"...That’s the situation."
Mu Wanqing sighed deeply:
"I don’t know how Duan Yu, that bookworm, is doing now. I hope he hasn’t been captured by the envoy from Lingjiu Palace."
Ding Ling, leaping through the air with keen hearing, heard it all clearly and felt a stir in his heart, thinking:
"Duan Yu probably has the North Nether Divine Skill, Ripple Step hidden on him. And now he’s so easily knocked out, it seems he hasn’t learned any martial arts."
He immediately changed his mind.
And asked Mu Wanqing to lead the way to find Duan Yu.
Mu Wanqing was taken aback but nodded and guided Ding Ling and his group to the place where Duan Yu had fainted.
Unfortunately.
Other than a field of dead bodies, there was nothing.
"Duan Yu."
Mu Wanqing couldn’t help but call out loudly a few times.
She didn’t expect to call Duan Yu back, but just as her voice fell, a head poked out from behind a large tree—a handsome young man dressed as a scholar, who waved happily at Mu Wanqing:
"Miss Mu. I’m here!"
"You really are here?!
Mu Wanqing was stunned.
"Yes."
Duan Yu smiled, coming out from behind the large tree, jogging to Mu Wanqing’s front, and upon seeing Zhong Ling sitting behind Mu Wanqing, his eyes lit up slightly. He smiled and greeted:
"Sister Zhong Ling, you’re here too!"
"Brother Duan, such a coincidence."
Zhong Ling giggled and said:
"I heard Sister Mu say that Yiu Huatian knocked you out. How did you wake up so quickly?"
"I just woke up not long ago."

Duan Yu scratched his head and, smiling, said: "I suddenly heard the sound of hoofbeats and thought it was the killers or some envoy, so I hurriedly hid myself. Didn’t know it was you guys. By the way, where is Yiu Huatian?"
He stood on tiptoe, looking behind the Ferghana Horse, seeing only Ling Yanqiu, Black Rose, and a youth of noble bearing standing leisurely atop a tree.
His pupils involuntarily contracted, and he took a deep breath:
"What remarkable Lightweight Skill. Who is that?!"
"That’s my Brother Ding."
Zhong Ling said with a proud smile:
"My Brother Ding is unmatched in martial arts, with few who can rival him in the world. Yiu Huatian wanted to kill Sister Mu but was killed by Brother Ding!"
"A figure like Yiu Huatian is dead!"
Duan Yu, after his initial surprise, went into a bit of a daze, about to say something like ’saving a life is better than building a seven-story pagoda’ or ’killing too much is ominous’.
Mu Wanqing, knowing Duan Yu well enough, interrupted him and said:
"Since you’re alright, we should be leaving."
"Where are you going?"
"Where to?"
Mu Wanqing was momentarily stunned, instinctively looking towards Ding Ling’s position.
"Naturally, I’m following Brother Ding."
Before Ding Ling could answer, Zhong Ling had already jumped in, saying:
"Sister Mu and I are already Brother Ding’s wives. Naturally, we follow wherever he goes."
"That’s how it is."
Duan Yu inexplicably felt a bit lost.
Seeing Mu Wanqing again, he was once astonished.

Having grown up in Dali, he had seen countless beauties, but few were as delicate and stunning as Mu Wanqing. Perhaps only his mother in her youth could compare, but among everyone he had seen lately, only his beloved Immortal Sister and Zhong Ling could rival Mu Wanqing.
Everyone else was mediocre.
Such two stunning women were both going to marry Ding Ling.
After his astonishment, Duan Yu unfathomably felt a bit envious and bitter.
Ding Ling, observing this, floated gracefully down in front of Duan Yu, saying:
"Are you Duan Yu, the Heir of the Southern King of Dali?"
"I am."
Duan Yu was taken aback:
"How did you know?!"
"Hehe."
Ding Ling chuckled without answering, simply saying:
"Have you seen your Immortal Sister in the Wuliang Mountain Forbidden Area?"
"How do you know that?!"
This time, Duan Yu’s pupils inevitably widened, his scalp tingling as he spoke.
Ding Ling chuckled without answering, simply saying:
"I know where your Immortal Sister is. Do you want to know?"
"Really?!"
After a moment of surprise, Duan Yu was ecstatic, unable to hide his excitement:
"Where is she?"
Ever since seeing his Immortal Sister, her appearance and silhouette filled his mind, impossible to forget.
"I can take you to find her. What do you think?"
"Alright!"
Duan Yu was a bit eager:
"Let’s go now!"
Mu Wanqing observed, previously admiring Duan Yu, but now found herself a bit dazed. This was still the bookish Duan Yu?! Why was he so obsessed with that Immortal Sister?!
She thought she had misunderstood Duan Yu!
"Good."
Ding Ling initially planned to go to the Wuliang Mountain Forbidden Area, but having met Duan Yu, it was no longer necessary. He frankly said:
"Did you find a Martial Arts Secret Manual in the Langhuan Blessed Land?"
"Yes."
Duan Yu nodded:
"Brother Ding, you’re truly incredible to know even that."
"Let me have a look."
Ding Ling smiled and said:
"Is it the North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step?"
"You even know the name of the secret manual."
Duan Yu was even more shocked, taking the secret manual out from his arms, hesitating for a moment, finally handing it to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s martial arts were unparalleled, he wouldn’t be able to resist if Ding Ling wanted to take it by force.

Besides, Ding Ling seemed to know everything, as if he had some connection with the Immortal Sister in the Langhuan Blessed Land; perhaps even the North Nether Divine Skill was closely related to Ding Ling?

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 507: North Nether Divine Skill at Full Level
paragraphs: Of course, the fact that Ding Ling is still considered the husband of Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing is part of the reason behind this. To Duan Yu, how could anyone capable of being their husband possibly be a bad person?
And to win over Ding Ling, as well as to have him meet the Immortal Sister soon.
Also, because he has self-awareness.
And he is not interested in Martial Arts at all.
Duan Yu then voluntarily handed over the Secret Scroll.
Upon receiving it, Ding Ling, to avoid delays and possibly losing it, immediately opened the Secret Scroll to read.
Opening the scroll, there were four striking characters in an elegant script.
North Nether Divine Skill!
Indeed, it is the North Nether Divine Skill.
Ding Ling felt delighted in his heart.
This is rumored to be a Supreme Divine Skill not at all weaker than the Nine Yang Divine Skill!
He spread it out carefully, not avoiding Duan Yu.

Duan Yu, however, glanced at it and quickly averted his eyes, his face flushed and heart racing, not daring to look more. The female figures on the scroll were quite captivating, but Ding Ling was oblivious and read rapidly, ten lines at a glance.
Just a cursory look.
Ding Ling realized the high difficulty in cultivating the North Nether Divine Skill.
First, one must dissipate the entirety of their Inner Power.
Next, one must completely forget everything learned in the past, with their mind clear of any other Martial Arts Heart Techniques or distractions, focusing solely on this skill.
Just these two points.
Are enough to dissuade countless Martial Arts Experts.

Even if some manage to achieve the first point, the second is likely insurmountable, for those who cultivate Martial Arts invariably have some Heart Methods or Mantras lingering in their minds. How could one completely forget?!
Thus, these two barriers exclude countless Martial Dao talents.
Seeing this, Ding Ling also understood why Duan Yu succeeded while Ding Chunqiu and others could not!
Moreover, the North Nether Divine Skill consists of a total of thirty-six illustrations!
In the original work, it seems that Duan Yu only practiced the first and second illustrations, yet he was able to dominate one side.
If all thirty-six illustrations are cultivated to full level, the power would be unimaginable!
Ding Ling finished reading.
A brief recollection in his mind.
In an instant.
[North Nether Divine Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Whooosh!
A surge of Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi rushed from all directions, engulfing Ding Ling’s figure in an instant.
Ding Ling operated the Nine Yang Divine Skill in an attempt to absorb and refine the Primordial Qi.
However, it was in vain.
Once these Qi entered the body, like the Nine Yang Divine Skill and Nine Yin Scripture, they automatically condensed into a profound, mysterious, and boundless North Nether True Qi!
"It’s done!"
Ding Ling rejoiced inside, experiencing a profound understanding, and sighed with endless wonder.
This North Nether Divine Skill has the marvelous effects of Transformation, Absorption, and Storage Skills.
Transformation can dissolve the opponent’s power.
Absorption can absorb the opponent’s power.
Storage can perfectly convert absorbed Inner Power into North Nether True Qi!
Now with Ding Ling’s North Nether True Qi protecting him, as long as he absorbs other Inner Power, the North Nether True Qi can rapidly grow!
Not only that.
The North Nether Divine Skill, when reaching full level, has almost no side effects! In practice, it operates smoothly and allows for the construction of a very strong shield!
The shield can neutralize the opponent’s attacks and counter.
When combined with the Gang Qi Shield of Nine Yang Divine Skill.
It can be said that Ding Ling’s Defense has surged significantly in an instant.
And this is with only one North Nether True Qi; if it grows, the Defense will naturally rise!
’Very good!’
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
The North Nether True Qi encompasses Yin and Yang, can be both rigid and flexible, stored in the Dantian without clashing with other True Qi, which is a significant advantage.
Mu Wanqing and Duan Yu were stunned.

Duan Yu was indeed better off, but being from the Dali Duan Family, he naturally understands the difficulty of cultivating Martial Arts. Ding Ling seemingly just read through it once, and it appears he has mastered the North Nether Divine Skill. This... is genius!

Mu Wanqing, reflecting on how Zhong Ling was always speaking highly, chattering endlessly about Ding Ling along the journey, couldn’t help but have her gaze with a transformation towards Ding Ling, adding a bit of admiration and apprehension. The admiration is self-explanatory, but the apprehension lies in whether Ding Ling, being so exceptional, would accept her?
And Zhong Ling? Ding Ling has already responded to her.
But he hasn’t to her.
Mu Wanqing couldn’t help feeling a bit bitter, yet formed a thought in her heart:
"Master said the first man to see my face is one I must marry. En route, hearing many things from Zhong Ling, I roughly understand Ding Ling’s temperament.
This man’s cultivation and talent are fearsome to an extreme, yet he is decent and upright, with a beauty in front, he doesn’t engage in disgraceful acts, evidently a reliable man.
Marrying such a man isn’t necessarily a bad thing."
Thinking this way.
Mu Wanqing’s pretty face was flushed, yet she couldn’t voice any words out, just stared fixedly at Ding Ling, somewhat lost in thought for a moment.
"Brother Ding, you’ve mastered it?"
Zhong Ling decided to become Ding Ling’s wife, so she dared to speak, ask, candidly.
"Indeed.
"Brother Ding, is this how you’ve been cultivating all the way?"
"Pretty much."
"Really enviable."
Zhong Ling longed: "If only I had such talent."
Ling Yanqiu chuckled, thinking: "Your Brother Ding’s talent is exceedingly rare, possibly the Martial God descended; we mere mortals had better not compare with him."
After finishing North Nether Divine Skill, Ding Ling moved on to Ripple Step.
Quickly finished reading.
Brief recollection.
[Ripple Step Body Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.2]
[Ripple Step Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This is evidently a top-notch Lightweight Skill not weaker than Spiral Nine Shadows.
Based on the 64 Hexagrams of the Book of Changes, it becomes a Body Technique.

Ding Ling slightly shifted his body, moving his feet lightly, he seemed like a gust of wind swiftly moving in four directions, discovering this Ripple Step each cycle of running accelerates special inner breath to complete a cycle, also bringing a few benefits to Inner Power.
This is clearly a Supreme Skill integrating Inner Power and Body Technique.
Heart Technique embedded within.
Ordinary people practicing Ripple Step cannot perceive, only when reaching a certain level can there be awareness that Ripple Step actually is a Technique cultivating Inner Power as well.
Only it differs from other Inner Power Skills.
It is an Active Skill.
Meaning requiring constant practice of Ripple Step running, the faster you run, the more cycles complete, the more Inner Power strengthens.
Ding Ling’s eyes brightened slightly.
Extremely satisfied.
Especially when he discovered the inner power generated by Ripple Step was all absorbed relentlessly by North Nether True Qi, causing him to glance at North Nether True Qi.
Sure enough.
The waves of Primordial Qi absorbed after Ripple Step Heart Technique reached full level were devoured, absorbed, refined by North Nether True Qi; now North Nether True Qi transformed into two Qi.
Just need one more to become North Nether True Water!
"Not surprising for the top-tier Body Technique, Inner Power of the Carefree Sect."

"Master said the first man to see my face is one I must marry.
En route, hearing many things from Zhong Ling, I roughly understand Ding Ling’s temperament.
This man’s cultivation and talent are fearsome to an extreme, yet he is decent and upright, with a beauty in front, he doesn’t engage in disgraceful acts, evidently a reliable man.
Marrying such a man isn’t necessarily a bad thing."
Thinking this way.
Mu Wanqing’s pretty face was flushed, yet she couldn’t voice any words out, just stared fixedly at Ding Ling, somewhat lost in thought for a moment.
"Brother Ding, you’ve mastered it?"
Zhong Ling decided to become Ding Ling’s wife, so she dared to speak, ask, candidly.
"Indeed.
"Brother Ding, is this how you’ve been cultivating all the way?"
"Pretty much."
"Really enviable."
Zhong Ling longed: "If only I had such talent."
Ling Yanqiu chuckled, thinking: "Your Brother Ding’s talent is exceedingly rare, possibly the Martial God descended; we mere mortals had better not compare with him."
After finishing North Nether Divine Skill, Ding Ling moved on to Ripple Step.
Quickly finished reading.
Brief recollection.
[Ripple Step Body Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.2]
[Ripple Step Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This is evidently a top-notch Lightweight Skill not weaker than Spiral Nine Shadows.
Based on the 64 Hexagrams of the Book of Changes, it becomes a Body Technique.

Ding Ling slightly shifted his body, moving his feet lightly, he seemed like a gust of wind swiftly moving in four directions, discovering this Ripple Step each cycle of running accelerates special inner breath to complete a cycle, also bringing a few benefits to Inner Power.
This is clearly a Supreme Skill integrating Inner Power and Body Technique.
Heart Technique embedded within.
Ordinary people practicing Ripple Step cannot perceive, only when reaching a certain level can there be awareness that Ripple Step actually is a Technique cultivating Inner Power as well.
Only it differs from other Inner Power Skills.
It is an Active Skill.
Meaning requiring constant practice of Ripple Step running, the faster you run, the more cycles complete, the more Inner Power strengthens.
Ding Ling’s eyes brightened slightly.
Extremely satisfied.
Especially when he discovered the inner power generated by Ripple Step was all absorbed relentlessly by North Nether True Qi, causing him to glance at North Nether True Qi.
Sure enough.
The waves of Primordial Qi absorbed after Ripple Step Heart Technique reached full level were devoured, absorbed, refined by North Nether True Qi; now North Nether True Qi transformed into two Qi.
Just need one more to become North Nether True Water!
"Not surprising for the top-tier Body Technique, Inner Power of the Carefree Sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 508: Lingjiu Palace Envoy
paragraphs: Ding Ling secretly nodded.
This combination of body technique and inner power is an achievement!
It’s truly perfect!
"Is it done already?!"
Duan Yu was somewhat dumbfounded.

He knew there were martial arts in the secret scroll, but he never had the mind to learn them. But thinking that it was the Immortal Sister’s martial arts secret manual, it should be extremely powerful.
From the body technique Ding Ling just demonstrated, it was indeed profoundly mysterious, fully displaying the wonders of the Eight-Trigram Zhou Tian from the Book of Changes. Duan Yu was mesmerized:
"Is it really that easy?"
"Why don’t you try to learn and see for yourself?"
Ding Ling handed the secret scroll back to Duan Yu.

Duan Yu, flustered, caught it, opened it to take a look, and was immediately flushed with excitement upon seeing the North Nether Divine Skill scroll. He hurriedly unfolded it to study the Ripple Step. After a long time looking, he gained some understanding, but achieving Ding Ling’s effortless mastery was absolutely beyond his reach. Envy and admiration for Ding Ling’s unparalleled talent filled his heart, as he thought to himself:

"No wonder Zhong Ling and Miss Mu chose to marry Brother Ding. His attractiveness and noble bearing aside, his martial dao talent and martial arts cultivation are extraordinarily formidable! I fear not even my father or my uncle could compare to him.
Brother Ding, being so young and possessing such cultivation and fortune, really invokes envy."
Though Duan Yu didn’t like practicing martial arts, thinking it goes against the natural order.
He believed that reasoning prevailed everywhere, as long as there’s reason, one can travel the world.

But since leaving home, experiencing numerous life-threatening crises, Duan Yu has come to understand one thing: this Jianghu is not like home. At home, there are people who will listen to his reasoning, but outside, it’s common for danger to strike out of nowhere.
Like not too long ago.
If it weren’t for Miss Mu stopping him, Duan Yu might have been killed by Yiu Huatian.
Thinking of this, an uneasy feeling stirred his heart. Seeing Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling looking at Ding Ling with such tender affection, his admiration for Ding Ling only grew.
Winning the affection of such two beautiful girls, what kind of fortune would it take to achieve that?
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling grabbed Duan Yu and soared through the air:
"First, let’s head to Celestial Dragon Temple!"
"Why are we going to Celestial Dragon Temple?"

Duan Yu yelled, having just asked the question and realizing he was in mid-air, watching the scenery whirl by under him. He felt dizzy and shouted, ’Brother Ding, can you fly lower and slower? I can’t take this.’
Seeing this, Ding Ling descended, bringing Duan Yu to the ground, and used Ripple Step to sprint wildly.
Even carrying someone, he was faster than a Ferghana Horse.
Mu Wanqing clicked her tongue while urging her horse to follow closely behind Ding Ling.
Under Duan Yu’s guidance, Ding Ling smoothly emerged from Wuliang Mountain’s domain.
Not far beyond Wuliang Mountain’s domain.
Two graceful women in green robes, veiled faces, suddenly appeared, blocking the way, and shouted:
"Lingjiu Palace business. No one may leave Wuliang Mountain! You must go back."
"Lingjiu Palace?"
Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows but ignored them, simply flicking his fingers twice in the air toward the women.
One Yang Finger!
Snap snap!

The two women were immediately struck, immobilizing them. Shocked, they realized the person before them was unfathomably skilled, beyond their capabilities. They then invoked the name of Heavenly Mountain Granny, the palace master of Lingjiu Palace, trying to intimidate Ding Ling.
However, Ding Ling didn’t care about some Heavenly Mountain Granny.
But he wasn’t one to harm innocent people either.

After Mu Wanqing, Ling Yanqiu, their Ferghana Horses, and the critically injured Black Rose passed through, he again flicked his fingers in the air, releasing the women’s immobilization points. He then carried Duan Yu and, using Ripple Step, left gracefully like a gust of wind.
The two women were deeply moved:
"Such strong lightweight skill, such formidable finger force! We had no way to resist him at all. He doesn’t even look that old. Who on earth is he?!"

"If I’m not mistaken, he was just using the One Yang Finger of the Dali Duan Clan, but as for the stepping technique, it’s beyond my understanding, truly incredible. Since when did such a genius emerge from the Dali Duan Clan?!"
Whoosh!
Ding Ling carried Duan Yu, using Ripple Step, quickly catching up to the girls, allowing Duan Yu to continue leading the way.
Duan Yu was full of admiration, being carried by Ding Ling, flying through the air, feeling as if he was weightless. Reflecting on the scenes he had just witnessed, he blurted out:
"Brother Ding, was that One Yang Finger just now?"
"Yes."
"Brother Ding, your surname is Ding, how do you know the One Yang Finger of my Duan Family?!"
Duan Yu was stunned, puzzled:
"And watching Brother Ding’s One Yang Finger cultivation, it’s so enigmatic and unguardable, even more wondrous than when my father uses it. To what grade have you cultivated?"
"First Grade."
This was not something to hide, and Ding Ling answered truthfully.
"First Grade?!"
Duan Yu was deeply moved; his heart was stirred, asking thoughtfully:
"Brother Ding, are you possibly an illegitimate child of some prince or emperor from my Duan Family?!
"Brother Duan, don’t overthink it."
Before Ding Ling could respond, Zhong Ling, sitting behind Mu Wanqing and holding her waist, couldn’t help but interject:
"Brother Ding says his surname is Ding, so it’s Ding; how could his father be surnamed Duan?"
She looked at Ding Ling:
"Brother Ding, am I right?"
"Yes."
"You see."
Zhong Ling raised her chin slightly, grinning at Duan Yu:
"So, Brother Duan, you’d better not claim kinship casually."
Duan Yu was troubled, smiling awkwardly:
"I just find it unbelievable. How could Brother Ding know the One Yang Finger, a secret of my Dali Duan Family, and cultivate it to such a terrifying First Grade?!"
He paused, then continued:

"As far as I know, in our Duan Family, no one has cultivated One Yang Finger to the First Grade in this generation. My father’s One Yang Finger cultivation seems only to have reached the Fifth Grade, my uncle’s should be at Fourth Grade. They’ve spent decades to reach the Fourth and Fifth Grades, while Brother Ding, you’ve reached the First Grade! If my father knew this, he’d be shocked to death and likely share the same thoughts I have.
Thinking you’re surely a lost descendant of the Dali Duan Family.
Otherwise, how could you have learned the One Yang Finger of the Dali Duan Clan?!"
Ding Ling smiled without speaking.
Before obtaining the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture,
Ding Ling didn’t plan on revealing his identity lightly.
Perhaps his First Grade One Yang Finger would be the key to gaining the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture.
Thinking this, Ding Ling conversed with Duan Yu about astronomy, geography, and various martial arts of the Duan Family.
Although Duan Yu wasn’t interested in martial arts, his extraordinary memory and talent surpassed ordinary people, making him proficient in various pieces of knowledge.
While discussing historical and cultural topics with Ding Ling, he was eloquent about music, chess, calligraphy, and painting.
However, Ding Ling, having mastered skills from several worlds, had already achieved the pinnacle of expertise in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting!
How could Duan Yu be a match for him?
Merely on theoretical aspects, Duan Yu was overwhelmed and dizzy from Ding Ling’s supremacy on every topic.
