chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 509: Celestial Dragon Temple
paragraphs: Duan Yu was unconvinced.

Feeling that his martial arts were inferior to Ding Ling’s was normal, as he had never practiced martial arts. But for Ding Ling to surpass him in Buddhism, Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting was unbelievable.

Stirred by youthful arrogance, he immediately thought of competing with Ding Ling in these areas, yet the various Buddhist scriptures and theories were easily countered by Ding Ling, leaving him almost ’defeated’.
In Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, during breaks for meals and barbecues, he was completely crushed with not a scrap left to show.
Duan Yu was disheartened, frustrated, and incredulous:
"Brother Ding, you’re not much older, how are you so versatile! Impressive!"
Mu Wanqing, Ling Yanqiu, and Zhong Ling watched in awe, deeply shaken.
Zhong Ling, naïve and innocent, admired Ding Ling even more.
Mu Wanqing’s expression grew increasingly complicated; her heart fluttered uneasily, fearing Ding Ling might be taken away by other women.
But thinking of Zhong Ling by her side, Mu Wanqing felt somewhat more at ease.
Since settling things with Ding Ling in terms of naming, her cold and proud heart seemed to find its place, making her calm, charming, quiet, and gentle.
She no longer spoke harshly nor lashed out.

Duan Yu observed, marveling at Ding Ling’s prowess; thinking: "Brother Ding is not only proficient in Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, and Buddhism, but also martial arts and body technique; he even managed to tame Miss Mu, so fierce before, now gentle and compliant—truly remarkable."
With this thought, he couldn’t help but think of his Immortal Sister, his heart heated and anxious, subconsciously glancing at Ding Ling, pondering:
"If I meet the Immortal Sister, I wouldn’t know how to approach her. I should ask Brother Ding for advice, let him teach me."
Duan Yu found Ding Ling easy to talk to.
His recognition of Ding Ling rose significantly.
Now being overshadowed by Ding Ling in every aspect, Duan Yu was endlessly enamored, witnessing the drastic change in Mu Wanqing’s attitude left him astounded, stirring other thoughts in his heart.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You’ve earned Duan Yu’s high recognition.]
[Note: Your knowledge and talent have completely convinced him, winning his admiration completely.]
Upon hearing the prompt sound, Ding Ling turned slightly, thinking how martial arts couldn’t impress this bookish Duan Yu!
While chatting with Duan Yu.
Ding Ling sensed that although Duan Yu was courteous, noble, generous, and tolerant, he was overly rigid, clearly a sheltered child inexperienced with society’s harsher realities.
Unknown to Ding Ling, Duan Yu had changed significantly since first setting out, that earlier version wouldn’t have sparked Ding Ling’s interest in conversing further.
Upon arriving at Celestial Dragon Temple.
The moon was already high in the sky.
To travel faster.

Ding Ling specifically picked suitable herbs on the way, using Nine Yang Divine Skill and Medicine King Breathing Technique’s Fusion Qi to evoke One Yang Finger, applying simultaneous internal and external force, completely healing Black Rose’s injury.
Once Black Rose recovered, her speed rivaled that of the Ferghana Horse. Duan Yu adamantly refused to let Ding Ling carry him like a monkey, insisting on horse riding.
Ding Ling let him ride the horse.
He followed behind, traveling using Ripple Step.
While traveling, inner breath spontaneously generated merging into North Nether True Qi, strengthening it, Ding Ling constantly sensed himself growing stronger.
He marveled silently, thinking Ripple Step truly is a supreme skill.
And due to Full Level, the speed at which inner breath was generated was far beyond Entry Level and Great Success levels. Clearly, the enhancement in his inner breath was immense.
With daily practice, eventually, he would definitely generate another North Nether True Qi.
"Neigh!"
Duan Yu reined in his horse, turning to Ding Ling: "Brother Ding, we’ve reached Celestial Dragon Temple. Should I knock on the door?"
Ding Ling remained noncommittal.
Duan Yu immediately dismounted, heading to the temple.
Being the Heir of the Southern King, he maintained his dignity while stating his purpose, prompting the monk guarding the door to open it, allowing them entry into the temple.

Celestial Dragon Temple covered a vast area; even under the moonlit night, one could vaguely sense its grandeur and solemnity! Being the Royal Temple of the Dali Kingdom, it was elegantly nicknamed the National Temple and Buddhist Capital. Truly deserving of its reputation.
Clop, clop!
The group led their horses forward.
Several monks guided the way ahead.
After some time.
They arrived at a side hall of the temple.
The monk asked Duan Yu and others to wait a moment.
He went to fetch someone.
Before long.
An elderly man, with benevolent eyebrows, a ruddy complexion, and some white beard under his chin, entered.
Upon seeing him, Duan Yu’s eyes brightened, smiling as he greeted:
"Duan Yu greets the Abbot."
"Does the Heir know your father and uncle are searching for you?"
The Abbot’s face darkened:
"So young, yet learning nothing good, running away from home! You must go back and apologize to them."
Duan Yu’s mouth turned bitter.
If not for wanting to see the Immortal Sister, he wouldn’t have come here with Ding Ling to ’walk into the trap’.
But since he was here.
Duan Yu pointed at Ding Ling, reluctantly saying:
"I’m accompanying Brother Ding here. He has important matters with you."
"Brother Ding?"

The Abbot glanced at Ding Ling, under the candlelight, Ding Ling stood tall, upright, exceptionally distinguished, and heroically vibrant; from his appearance alone, he was truly an extraordinary person.
The Abbot dared not underestimate him, joining his palms together in a gesture of Amitabha Buddha before speaking:
"What brings Donor Ding to Celestial Dragon Temple?"
Ding Ling didn’t speak; he simply extended his index finger, pointing forward, and poof! An extremely potent finger force easily punctured a wooden door nearby.
The Abbot’s pupils contracted:
"One Yang Finger?!"
Duan Yu immediately followed:
"Indeed. Master Abbot, Brother Ding’s One Yang Finger has reached the First Grade Realm!"
"What?!"
The Abbot was stunned:
"First, First, First Grade?!"
He was incredulous:
"How is this possible?!"
"If Master Abbot doesn’t believe, you can take a closer look."
Duan Yu glanced at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling silently praised Duan Yu; this was a brilliant assist, then demonstrated One Yang Finger.
The Abbot carefully observed and analyzed, sighing after a long while:

"My cultivation power is limited; my understanding of One Yang Finger only reaches Fourth Grade, far from First Grade, probably unattainable in my lifetime, unable to truly comprehend Donor Ding’s One Yang Finger Realm."
Embarrassed, he blushed:
"Perhaps Master Kuru should assess it, may gain clarity."
The Abbot paused, looking at Ding Ling with a strange expression:
"Your surname is Ding, not Duan?!"
"Indeed."
"Did you change your name?"
"No."
"How do you know the Dali Duan Family’s secret One Yang Finger?!"

"What brings Donor Ding to Celestial Dragon Temple?"
Ding Ling didn’t speak; he simply extended his index finger, pointing forward, and poof!
An extremely potent finger force easily punctured a wooden door nearby.
The Abbot’s pupils contracted:
"One Yang Finger?!"
Duan Yu immediately followed:
"Indeed.
Master Abbot, Brother Ding’s One Yang Finger has reached the First Grade Realm!"
"What?!"
The Abbot was stunned:
"First, First, First Grade?!"
He was incredulous:
"How is this possible?!"
"If Master Abbot doesn’t believe, you can take a closer look."
Duan Yu glanced at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling silently praised Duan Yu; this was a brilliant assist, then demonstrated One Yang Finger.
The Abbot carefully observed and analyzed, sighing after a long while:

"My cultivation power is limited; my understanding of One Yang Finger only reaches Fourth Grade, far from First Grade, probably unattainable in my lifetime, unable to truly comprehend Donor Ding’s One Yang Finger Realm."
Embarrassed, he blushed:
"Perhaps Master Kuru should assess it, may gain clarity."
The Abbot paused, looking at Ding Ling with a strange expression:
"Your surname is Ding, not Duan?!"
"Indeed."
"Did you change your name?"
"No."
"How do you know the Dali Duan Family’s secret One Yang Finger?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 510: Master Kuru
paragraphs: The abbot was puzzled:

"Furthermore, you have actually mastered the One Yang Finger to such a Supreme Realm of First Grade! It’s unbelievable! In my lifetime, I have struggled to reach this level, yet Donor Ding has achieved it. I can’t help but suspect that you started practicing this art from a young age."
Ding Ling remained silent.
Duan Yu couldn’t resist:
"Abbot, since Brother Ding says he’s not part of the Duan family, then he must not be. Why do you need to doubt?"
"I have no reason not to doubt."
The abbot pondered for a moment, gazing intently at Ding Ling, and asked:
"Exactly which high master of my Duan family did you acquire the One Yang Finger from?"

"I can only say that the origin of the One Yang Finger is entirely legitimate and aboveboard, without any trace of filth. So, Master Abbot need not worry about my harboring any hostility toward the Celestial Dragon Temple."
Ding Ling said.
"It is entirely legitimate and aboveboard..."

The abbot fell into a sea of thoughts, considering that Ding Ling might be a remnant of the former Crown Prince Duan Yanqing’s line, or perhaps a ’seed’ left outside by Duan Zhengchun, or maybe a descendant from another branch of the Duan family that survived by luck years ago...
With so many thoughts swirling, the abbot’s gaze towards Ding Ling naturally softened a lot.
Obviously, with his imagination, the abbot had already categorized Ding Ling as a member of the Duan family. Otherwise, how could someone cultivate the One Yang Finger to the First Grade level!
This is a secret never passed on outside!
If you’re not part of the Duan family, you’re absolutely not qualified to practice it, let alone achieve the First Grade at such a young age!

Thinking of such a talent emerging among the Duan family, the abbot was elated, yet felt a tinge of regret for Ding Ling having changed his name. Without a doubt, Ding Ling’s life experiences must be very complicated and tumultuous; otherwise, why would he need to change his name?
On this matter, he refrained from asking much, only saying warmly:
"Donor Ding, you didn’t come here just to exhibit the One Yang Finger, did you? Is there something important you need to tell me?"
"I heard that the Great Wheel Ming King Jiu Mozhi from Tubo plans to seize the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture. Is this true?"
"Even you know about this."
The abbot’s pupils slightly contracted, then he relaxed and sighed:

"Indeed. Jiu Mozhi, under the pretense of a Buddhist debate challenge, intends to snatch the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture. This is something I absolutely cannot allow him to accomplish. The Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture is an unpassed secret of our Duan Clan, and outsiders absolutely have no possibility of cultivating it!"
"I am willing to ward off Jiu Mozhi for the Celestial Dragon Temple."
Ding Ling solemnly said:
"But I wish to take a look at the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture."
At this point,
Duan Yu and the others suddenly realized.
They finally understood why Ding Ling came all the way to the Celestial Dragon Temple.

Duan Yu’s expression was complex; he opened his mouth as if to say something, but ultimately didn’t. To him, it was merely a martial art, not something significant. His mind was entirely occupied by the thought of finding and meeting the Immortal Sister, leaving him uninterested in matters he didn’t care much about.

Moreover, Ding Ling is proficient in the First Grade One Yang Finger, showing close ties with the Duan Clan! Given this, what’s the harm in letting Ding Ling learn the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture?
In any case, learning one unpassed secret is learning, learning two is still learning!
That’s how Duan Yu thought.

The abbot, although not as generous, was moved by Ding Ling’s extraordinary talent and probable connection to the Duan lineage. Considering Ding Ling would shield them from Jiu Mozhi, the abbot couldn’t help but say:
"I can’t decide on this matter; I must consult Master Kuru."
"Please go ahead, Abbot."
Ding Ling said.
"Please wait for a moment."
The abbot said:
"I will consult Master Kuru right now."
With that, the abbot hurried off.
A quarter of an hour later.
The abbot returned, bringing Ding Ling and others to another side hall to meet Master Kuru.
He had his back to the people.
After Ding Ling’s group paid their respects, he turned around.
Ding Ling and his companions were then able to see his true appearance, an old man with a rather ferocious, ugly visage.
His left face was rosy and glossy, like a baby’s skin;
Yet his right face was like dried bones, with a sallow skin hanging over it as if no muscles were supporting it, looking quite frightening.
Duan Yu and others had never seen such a person, inevitably got startled, each instinctively diverted their gaze, not daring to look too much.

However, Ding Ling was different; having been through battles in several worlds and having killed many, he had long reached the point of seeing floating corpses and remains as nothing; thus, when gazing directly at Master Kuru, his expression and eyes were extremely calm, without any peculiar changes.
Master Kuru had his back to the people to avoid frightening them.
Now turning around, he intended to see the unparalleled genius Ding Ling mentioned by Abbot Benyin!
Upon seeing him, he immediately recognized Ding Ling, saying ’Amitabha’ before continuing:
"Are you?"
"Junior Ding Ling meets the master!"
Ding Ling proactively extended his greetings.
"You don’t need to call yourself a junior."
Master Kuru’s eyes gleamed with divine light, examining Ding Ling closely:
"To be able to face me without showing any change, you are indeed exceptional and extraordinary. Let me see the Finger Force of your One Yang Finger."
Ding Ling executed as instructed.
Master Kuru, seeing clearly and understandingly, was overwhelmed with shock and awe, even though he had mentally prepared himself, he still couldn’t maintain calm upon witnessing it firsthand:
"Indeed, it is the One Yang Finger of our Dali Duan Clan. And it has certainly reached the legendary First Grade Realm. Truly remarkable, utterly remarkable."
Master Kuru’s One Yang Finger had reached the Second Grade.
However, compared to Ding Ling’s, it was far inferior.
Thus concluding Ding Ling had reached the First Grade.
In the midst of shock, he couldn’t help but secretly be astonished:
"I didn’t expect that someone in our Duan lineage could actually cultivate the One Yang Finger to the First Grade!"
Zhong Ling very much wanted to say, ’Master, you’ve got it wrong! My husband is surnamed Ding!’
But in the end, she didn’t say it.
And just quietly watched from the side.
Duan Yu, however, was distracted, his mind full of ’When will Brother Ding take me to see Immortal Sister?’
"Can you tell me the names of your parents?"
Master Kuru asked.
Ding Ling told him.
Master Kuru was confused and asked Ding Ling to speak of the names of three generations of ancestors.
Ding Ling could only speak of his grandfather’s generation, and beyond that, he didn’t know.
He was speaking of his deceased parents and grandparents from this lifetime, not about his identity before his reincarnation.
Master Kuru naturally didn’t understand, but he was secretly amazed, confused, bewildered, yet this did not affect his certainty that Ding Ling was definitely closely related to the Duan lineage!
He listened carefully to what Abbot Benyin had to say.
After hearing Master Benyin’s analysis.
Master Kuru wholeheartedly agreed.
He also felt that Ding Ling must be associated with a branch of the Duan lineage.
Now Ding Ling had come on his own initiative, wanting to learn the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture.
Master Kuru was tempted, saying:
"It’s not impossible for you to learn the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture."
Ding Ling looked delighted.
Master Kuru noticed this and thought he’s still a young man, but he said:
"But you must join my Celestial Dragon Temple and become a monk."
As soon as these words came out.
Mu Wanqing instinctively stopped him: "No way!"
Zhong Ling even said crisply:
"Master, Brother Ding is my husband! We haven’t even gotten married or had children yet, how can he become a monk!"
"You don’t have children?"
Master Kuru glanced sideways.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling also looked intently.
Ding Ling shook his head.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling synchronized their sighs of relief; having no children signified something obvious.
"In this case, it’s inappropriate to force you to become a monk."
Master Kuru regretted:

"The Duan lineage has ancestral teachings. The One Yang Finger and Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture can only be passed down to Duan family members. And the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture can only be passed on to Duan members who have become monks at the Celestial Dragon Temple."
"Master."
Ding Ling said:
"I want to make a bet with you."
"Please say."
Master Kuru’s expression was kind.
Ding Ling was such a genius, the Finger Force from the One Yang Finger was unmatchable!
He could be certain.

As long as Ding Ling was stationed at the Celestial Dragon Temple! With his unparalleled martial arts! It would ensure a hundred years of stability for the Celestial Dragon Temple and a hundred years of peace for the Dali Duan Clan!
And he was already old, it was rare to find a suitable successor.
Ding Ling’s arrival was timely! It tempted even Master Kuru to think of enticing Ding Ling.

After all, Ding Ling was related to the Duan lineage, most likely a lost branch of the family. Even if he wasn’t a family member, his Cause and Effect with the Duan lineage was profound! Naturally, efforts must be made to win him over.
"I’ll bet that I can look at the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture just once and immediately cultivate the Six Meridian Divine Sword to the Realm of Perfect Fulfillment!"
"How is that possible?!"
Master Kuru was shocked:
"This is a bet you are destined to lose!"
"The stakes are simple."
Ding Ling continued:

"If I can’t accomplish seeing the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture once and immediately mastering and using it freely, I will not only become a monk, stay at the Celestial Dragon Temple for life, guard the Celestial Dragon Temple, protect the Duan family, but also do my utmost to thwart any enemies that invade the Celestial Dragon Temple!"
"Are you serious about this?!"
Abbot Benyin’s eyes brightened.
Master Kuru was moved.
This is a bet destined to lose! Is this young man Ding Ling trying to return to the Duan family indirectly? Protect the Duan family?
It seems his relationship with the Duan family is indeed deep.
Thinking like this, Master Kuru said:
"What if you change your mind?"
"Can write a contract. Everyone present can testify. If I go back on my word, may lightning strike me!"
Ding Ling solemnly said.
Master Kuru was moved:
"Alright. I’ll let you see the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture, I just hope that after looking at it, you will indeed do as you said, become a monk, and not regret later."

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 511: Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture at Full Level
paragraphs: Master Kuru thought that if Ding Ling became a monk after reading it, he would become part of the Celestial Dragon Temple, thus not violating any rules.

He was broad-minded and of noble character, never holding on to outdated practices and always open to progress. Sometimes he would even take the initiative to break some ’decayed’ and ’stubborn’ rules.
From the original story, it’s apparent from his willingness to show Duan Yu the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture.
Now that Ding Ling has spoken as such.
Reflecting on Ding Ling’s genius and the likelihood of a cause and effect relationship with the Duan Clan.
The most important thing is that this is a sure-win bet for Celestial Dragon Temple!
How could Master Kuru refuse?
The two parties reached an agreement immediately.
An agreement was drawn up on the spot.

Mu Wanqing felt somewhat worried about this. Although Ding Ling was indeed a genius, from the discussions, it was clear that the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture was not ordinary. If he couldn’t learn and use it immediately and ended up becoming a monk, what would she do?! Where would she go?!
Zhong Ling, however, was very optimistic. She had complete confidence in her Brother Ding.
Ling Yanqiu, Duan Yu, Master Benyin, and others had their own thoughts.
Some time later.
Master Kuru emerged solemnly from a small door.
It was evident that he had hidden the sword manual of the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture very securely.
"Take a look."
Master Kuru handed Ding Ling a scroll containing several pages filled with text and engraved diagrams of the human body.
"At most, half an hour."
Master Kuru said:
"You should be able to finish reading it once within half an hour. This is the rule, just letting you know in advance."
"Rest assured. Half an hour is sufficient."
Ding Ling replied.
Master Kuru became even more convinced that Ding Ling was here to return to the Duan family and the Celestial Dragon Temple.
What can be done in half an hour?!
Memorizing the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture alone would already qualify someone as a genius! Let alone mastering it.
Abbots and other masters of the Celestial Dragon Temple shared this view.
Ding Ling didn’t think too much about it.
He spread open the sword manual and began to study it carefully.
He read quickly.
Ten lines at a glance, a hundred lines at a time.
In just a few dozen breaths, he finished reading and closed his eyes to recall.
As soon as a new book appeared on the library shelf.
Immediately afterwards.
[Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture Sword Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
[Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This was clearly a technique of unity of inner and outer.
The sword techniques practiced were Shaoshang Sword, Shangyang Sword, Zhongchong Sword, Guanchong Sword, Shaochong Sword, and Shaoze Sword!
Each sword technique differed, be it with powerful routes or expansive and vigorous, with imposing might, or clumsy and ancient, or light and quick.
After Ding Ling reached full level with the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture.
He immediately began to practice.
The sky was filled with Sword Qi, cutting across and sweeping through, coming and going, with such subtle transformations that it would make hearts skip a beat and eyes unable to take it all in!
Whoosh whoosh!
A great amount of Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi gathered in the void. Ding Ling simultaneously absorbed the Primordial Spirit while practicing sword techniques.
It seemed as if a Sword God was dancing on the clouds;
Like a Martial God flying like an immortal over mountains and rivers!
Every move, every sword, captured the soul, leaving everyone present with an overwhelming sensation not daring to challenge the sharpness!
Because everyone could clearly sense the unparalleled sharpness of this Sword Qi.
Whoosh whoosh!
After Ding Ling finished practicing, he retracted the Sword Qi, carefully comprehending his own body, indeed much stronger now.

The most crucial thing is that the Primordial Qi generated by the sword formulas and heart method of the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture had been absorbed by the North Nether True Qi, transforming into a strand of North Nether True Qi, now combining three strands into one drop of North Nether True Water.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
[True Power Value 12 points]
Indeed it had increased by a point.
Although it was only by one point, the enhancement in strength was substantial.
At Ding Ling’s current level.
Even a one-point increase equated to a roughly ten percent boost in strength. The gap was evident.
One-tenth of a Grandmaster! With Fusion Qi activation, a tenfold increase is equivalent to a Grandmaster!
"The North Nether True Qi and the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture complement each other well."

The North Nether True Water activating the Six Meridian Divine Sword makes the Six Meridian Divine Sword both rigid and flexible, unpredictable, and incredibly fast, resembling a rain of electric arrows! Even compared to modern firearms, its might is significantly greater.
Especially when wielded by a Grandmaster like Ding Ling, the power is unimaginable!
Splitting mountains and rocks!
Penetrating viscera, as easily as eating and drinking.
Moreover...
The power of the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture far surpasses the One Yang Finger!
The One Yang Finger releases only Finger Force, while the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture releases Sword Qi! Entirely incomparable!
"Senior, please guide me."
Ding Ling returned the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture to Master Kuru and saluted.
Master Kuru’s face trembled with shock, as he took the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture sword manual in a daze, overcome with an intense surge of astonishment and unable to speak.
Abbot Benyin also found it unbelievable:
"This, this, this is the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture!!"
"And it’s already been mastered?!"

Duan Yu was initially stunned but then overjoyed, thinking ’Now that Brother Ding has mastered the Six Meridian Divine Sword, there’s no reason for him to stay at the Celestial Dragon Temple. I’ll need to discuss with him soon to quickly leave the Celestial Dragon Temple, or else if my father and others come after me, I won’t be able to escape! How will I meet Immortal Sister then?’
Zhong Ling was delighted, full of small pride, thinking ’As expected of my Brother Ding!’
Mu Wanqing breathed a sigh of relief. Ding Ling didn’t have to become a monk!
But she quickly realized and blushed deeply, wondering if her anxiety over Ding Ling meant she had fallen for him? But how could that be? How long have they known each other?
Then, recalling an oath and with Zhong Ling’s persuasion, she silently accepted being Ding Ling’s wife, her heart now pounding like a drum.
She secretly observed Ding Ling.
At this moment.
The more she looked, the more she found Ding Ling exceptionally attractive, truly a great man!
"Ah."
Master Kuru regained his senses, sighing deeply, speaking in disbelief:

"I, along with Benyin, Ben Guan, Ben San, have been practicing the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture for a long time. Yet, not one of us has mastered even one sword to the realm of Perfect Fulfillment. You only observed for a few dozen breaths, not even a moment, and have already mastered the Six Meridian Divine Sword to the Great Perfection Innate Ability stage!
It is truly fantastical and inconceivable!
Have you previously studied the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture?"
"Master. If I had studied it, why would I challenge you with this bet?"
"Indeed."
Master Kuru, reflecting on his prior countless speculations, found himself at a loss and embarrassed.
Turns out it was all his fantasy!
Ding Ling came truly prepared, extremely talented, naturally unafraid of this bet. Whereas he had naively indulged in wishful thinking!

sentences.text: Master Kuru thought that if Ding Ling became a monk after reading it, he would become part of the Celestial Dragon Temple, thus not violating any rules.
He was broad-minded and of noble character, never holding on to outdated practices and always open to progress.
Sometimes he would even take the initiative to break some ’decayed’ and ’stubborn’ rules.
From the original story, it’s apparent from his willingness to show Duan Yu the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture.
Now that Ding Ling has spoken as such.
Reflecting on Ding Ling’s genius and the likelihood of a cause and effect relationship with the Duan Clan.
The most important thing is that this is a sure-win bet for Celestial Dragon Temple!
How could Master Kuru refuse?
The two parties reached an agreement immediately.
An agreement was drawn up on the spot.
Mu Wanqing felt somewhat worried about this.
Although Ding Ling was indeed a genius, from the discussions, it was clear that the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture was not ordinary.
If he couldn’t learn and use it immediately and ended up becoming a monk, what would she do?!
Where would she go?!
Zhong Ling, however, was very optimistic.
She had complete confidence in her Brother Ding.
Ling Yanqiu, Duan Yu, Master Benyin, and others had their own thoughts.
Some time later.
Master Kuru emerged solemnly from a small door.
It was evident that he had hidden the sword manual of the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture very securely.
"Take a look."
Master Kuru handed Ding Ling a scroll containing several pages filled with text and engraved diagrams of the human body.
"At most, half an hour."
Master Kuru said:
"You should be able to finish reading it once within half an hour.
This is the rule, just letting you know in advance."
"Rest assured.
Half an hour is sufficient."
Ding Ling replied.
Master Kuru became even more convinced that Ding Ling was here to return to the Duan family and the Celestial Dragon Temple.
What can be done in half an hour?!
Memorizing the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture alone would already qualify someone as a genius!
Let alone mastering it.
Abbots and other masters of the Celestial Dragon Temple shared this view.
Ding Ling didn’t think too much about it.
He spread open the sword manual and began to study it carefully.
He read quickly.
Ten lines at a glance, a hundred lines at a time.
In just a few dozen breaths, he finished reading and closed his eyes to recall.
As soon as a new book appeared on the library shelf.
Immediately afterwards.
[Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture Sword Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
[Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This was clearly a technique of unity of inner and outer.
The sword techniques practiced were Shaoshang Sword, Shangyang Sword, Zhongchong Sword, Guanchong Sword, Shaochong Sword, and Shaoze Sword!
Each sword technique differed, be it with powerful routes or expansive and vigorous, with imposing might, or clumsy and ancient, or light and quick.
After Ding Ling reached full level with the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture.
He immediately began to practice.
The sky was filled with Sword Qi, cutting across and sweeping through, coming and going, with such subtle transformations that it would make hearts skip a beat and eyes unable to take it all in!
Whoosh whoosh!
A great amount of Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi gathered in the void.
Ding Ling simultaneously absorbed the Primordial Spirit while practicing sword techniques.
It seemed as if a Sword God was dancing on the clouds;
Like a Martial God flying like an immortal over mountains and rivers!
Every move, every sword, captured the soul, leaving everyone present with an overwhelming sensation not daring to challenge the sharpness!
Because everyone could clearly sense the unparalleled sharpness of this Sword Qi.
Whoosh whoosh!
After Ding Ling finished practicing, he retracted the Sword Qi, carefully comprehending his own body, indeed much stronger now.

The most crucial thing is that the Primordial Qi generated by the sword formulas and heart method of the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture had been absorbed by the North Nether True Qi, transforming into a strand of North Nether True Qi, now combining three strands into one drop of North Nether True Water.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
[True Power Value 12 points]
Indeed it had increased by a point.
Although it was only by one point, the enhancement in strength was substantial.
At Ding Ling’s current level.
Even a one-point increase equated to a roughly ten percent boost in strength.
The gap was evident.
One-tenth of a Grandmaster!
With Fusion Qi activation, a tenfold increase is equivalent to a Grandmaster!
"The North Nether True Qi and the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture complement each other well."

The North Nether True Water activating the Six Meridian Divine Sword makes the Six Meridian Divine Sword both rigid and flexible, unpredictable, and incredibly fast, resembling a rain of electric arrows!
Even compared to modern firearms, its might is significantly greater.
Especially when wielded by a Grandmaster like Ding Ling, the power is unimaginable!
Splitting mountains and rocks!
Penetrating viscera, as easily as eating and drinking.
Moreover...
The power of the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture far surpasses the One Yang Finger!
The One Yang Finger releases only Finger Force, while the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture releases Sword Qi!
Entirely incomparable!
"Senior, please guide me."
Ding Ling returned the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture to Master Kuru and saluted.
Master Kuru’s face trembled with shock, as he took the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture sword manual in a daze, overcome with an intense surge of astonishment and unable to speak.
Abbot Benyin also found it unbelievable:
"This, this, this is the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture!!"
"And it’s already been mastered?!"
Duan Yu was initially stunned but then overjoyed, thinking ’Now that Brother Ding has mastered the Six Meridian Divine Sword, there’s no reason for him to stay at the Celestial Dragon Temple.
I’ll need to discuss with him soon to quickly leave the Celestial Dragon Temple, or else if my father and others come after me, I won’t be able to escape!
How will I meet Immortal Sister then?’
Zhong Ling was delighted, full of small pride, thinking ’As expected of my Brother Ding!’
Mu Wanqing breathed a sigh of relief.
Ding Ling didn’t have to become a monk!
But she quickly realized and blushed deeply, wondering if her anxiety over Ding Ling meant she had fallen for him?
But how could that be?
How long have they known each other?
Then, recalling an oath and with Zhong Ling’s persuasion, she silently accepted being Ding Ling’s wife, her heart now pounding like a drum.
She secretly observed Ding Ling.
At this moment.
The more she looked, the more she found Ding Ling exceptionally attractive, truly a great man!
"Ah."
Master Kuru regained his senses, sighing deeply, speaking in disbelief:
"I, along with Benyin, Ben Guan, Ben San, have been practicing the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture for a long time.
Yet, not one of us has mastered even one sword to the realm of Perfect Fulfillment.
You only observed for a few dozen breaths, not even a moment, and have already mastered the Six Meridian Divine Sword to the Great Perfection Innate Ability stage!
It is truly fantastical and inconceivable!
Have you previously studied the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture?"
"Master.
If I had studied it, why would I challenge you with this bet?"
"Indeed."
Master Kuru, reflecting on his prior countless speculations, found himself at a loss and embarrassed.
Turns out it was all his fantasy!
Ding Ling came truly prepared, extremely talented, naturally unafraid of this bet.
Whereas he had naively indulged in wishful thinking!

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 512: Jiu Mozhi
paragraphs: Master Kuru, feeling embarrassed and ashamed, couldn’t help but feel a sense of shock and awe:
"How could someone like you, Ding Ling, exist in this world? It truly feels like a tale from Arabian Nights."
He did not consider himself a frog in a well.
Simply because of his vast knowledge, he knew that perhaps in this era, there might only be one like Ding Ling!
Unexpectedly, he encountered him!
Thinking of his earlier declaration that Ding Ling would surely lose, Master Kuru and Abbot Benyin could not help but let out a long sigh in their hearts.
At this moment, Abbot Benyin also understood why Ding Ling’s One Yang Finger could reach the First Grade Realm.
Even the more difficult Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture had reached such a marvelous Great Perfection Realm, let alone the One Yang Finger!
At this moment, the group couldn’t help but envy Ding Ling’s talent.
"Amitabha, amitabha,"
Master Kuru clasped his hands together and said:
"Now this bet, our Celestial Dragon Temple has lost. Donor Ding, you do not need to become a monk. What do you plan to do next?"
"I plan to drive Jiu Mozhi away from the Celestial Dragon Temple before leaving,"
Ding Ling thought of Martial Fanatic Jiu Mozhi’s Small Faceless Skill and other techniques.
He wanted to try and see if he could acquire these heart techniques.
Apart from that, driving away Jiu Mozhi was something agreed upon from the beginning, Ding Ling felt obliged after seeing the Six Meridian Divine Sword Manual.
"In that case, I’ll trouble you, Donor Ding."
Master Kuru knew it was impossible for Ding Ling to stay and become a monk at the temple, so he spoke to Ding Ling with more courtesy.
Ding Ling saw this and did not point it out.
Little did he know that, beside him, Duan Yu was dumbfounded, and once they exited the side hall, Duan Yu immediately inquired about when they would search for the Immortal Sister.
Mu Wanqing looked on and became more convinced she had misjudged this bookworm, unexpectedly another lustful fellow!
"We’ll discuss it after we drive away Jiu Mozhi."
Duan Yu was becoming anxious:
’My father and them...’
"Don’t worry."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Since you are so worried, you can leave with Ling Yanqiu and hide somewhere. Once I resolve this crisis at the Celestial Dragon Temple, I’ll meet up with you."
"That’s a good idea."
Duan Yu immediately looked at Ling Yanqiu eagerly:
"Sister Ling."
"All right, let’s go."
Ling Yanqiu said:
"After I settle Duan Yu, I’ll wait for you near the Celestial Dragon Temple..."
After both sides agreed on how to meet again.
They temporarily parted ways.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling naturally followed Ding Ling.
At night, they also stayed in the guest room of the Celestial Dragon Temple with Ding Ling.
The three shared one room.
Initially, Ding Ling suggested sleeping separately, but Zhong Ling refused, saying, ’We’re already Brother Ding’s wives, how can we sleep apart?’
So she pulled Mu Wanqing and Ding Ling together to sleep.
Ding Ling, being a man, naturally couldn’t act coy and went along with it.
Thus several days passed.
During these several days.

In the name of sparring and instructing others in the cultivation of the One Yang Finger, Ding Ling successively defeated Abbot Benyin of the Celestial Dragon Temple, Ben Guan, Ben Xiang, Ben Can, and Master Kuru.
Task 1 Progress.
Including Cloud Crane.
There are six people.
Only 14 people are left to complete the task.

This time, Ding Ling prepared for Task 1, trying to defeat as many first-class or above experts as possible. This way, the honor bonus would be more significant! Perhaps he could buy another pill to enhance his bone structure.
After the enhancement of his bone structure,

Ding Ling felt that whether absorbing Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi, or refining Primordial Qi, had become much faster, especially the speed of absorbing Primordial Qi and Spiritual Mechanism doubled compared to before!
The benefits of enhancing his bone structure are self-evident.
Apart from Task 1,
Ding Ling also obtained 6 Achievement Medals.
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have received high recognition from Abbot Benyin]
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have received high recognition from Ben Guan.]
[E-level Achievement Medal Earned: You have received high recognition from Master Kuru.]
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have impressed Master Kuru.]
[Note: With excellent martial arts cultivation and extensive Martial Dao knowledge, you benefited Master Kuru greatly in your exchanges, earning heartfelt praise and acclaim from him.]
Master Kuru is an Innate Expert.
Here, Ding Ling got two medals.
Including those from several others, he obtained 6.
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 74, E-level 8]
This was all Ding Ling’s ’saving’.
This afternoon,
Abbot Benyin came, mentioning that Jiu Mozhi had arrived.
Ding Ling immediately went over.
Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing immediately followed.
With close interactions over these few days, Mu Wanqing’s feelings for Ding Ling shifted subtly from nothing to something.
From how she voluntarily helped Zhong Ling prepare Ding Ling’s bed and meals, one could see a hint.
She genuinely had started heading toward the path of a virtuous wife with great enthusiasm.
Ding Ling saw Jiu Mozhi in the main hall of the Celestial Dragon Temple.
He was a monk in a yellow cassock, around fifty years old.
Even though he wore plain clothes and hemp shoes, and appeared simple, his face radiated brilliance, as if jewels and jade had natural shine, lending his plain clothes extra splendor.
He was debating Buddhism with Ben Guan and others.
Ben Guan’s group was no match, rendered speechless and embarrassed by Jiu Mozhi’s arguments.
Jiu Mozhi laughed heartily:
"The Celestial Dragon Temple of the Dali Kingdom, is merely so!"
He looked around, and his eyes suddenly fixed on Ding Ling:
"They say there’s a young fellow who excels in Buddhism, far superior to you all. Could it be this one?"
"Indeed."

Abbot Benyin’s heart was filled with rage, but he couldn’t act on it, only feeling thoroughly frustrated and stifled, having studied Buddhism for decades, yet they were collectively defeated by Jiu Mozhi!
At this moment, he could only pin all his hopes on Ding Ling:
"Donor Ding’s accomplishment in Buddhism is unmatched by us. I believe that against the Great Wheel Ming King, you are no match either."
"Ridiculous!"
Jiu Mozhi glanced at Ding Ling twice, dismissively saying:

"Since my birth, I have never lost a debate on Buddhism. How could this young Donor Ding defeat me? Are you just grasping at straws? Since you can’t win in debates, are you ready to give up? Instead, why not just make a direct deal with me?"
"There’s been no debate yet. How can the Great Wheel Ming King be so certain?"
Abbot Benyin said:
"If you lose the debate, what will you do?"
"If I lose, you may do as you wish. But this time, you will lose. I hope you will lend me the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture to read."
As he spoke,
Jiu Mozhi’s eyes were filled with unabashed fervor:

"I have long heard that the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture is the world’s number one unparalleled sword scripture. I have not had the chance to see it. Now, having traveled a long way to Dali, if I defeat your Celestial Dragon Temple twice, what reason do you have to refuse?"
"This..."
Abbot Benyin looked at Ding Ling, saw Ding Ling nod, and then followed suit:
"Fine. As you say!"
"Haha..."
Jiu Mozhi laughed happily three times, then his eyes brightly fixed on Ding Ling, saying:
"I originally did not intend to bully a young fellow, but since it involves the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture, there is no way I won’t give it my all."
"Please."
Ding Ling did not dilly-dally with Jiu Mozhi, saying:
"Master, you go first."
Then,
The two began a verbal duel in a debate on Buddhism.
Ding Ling’s Buddhist studies had been refined through numerous worlds.
And each one was at full level.
Plus, in the past few days, he had read all the Buddhist Secret Manuals in the Scripture Pavilion of the Celestial Dragon Temple and reached full level.
It can be said.
Not only has his Buddha Qi increased by a level.
His understanding of various Buddhist classics has also entered the Transformation Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 513: Victory or Defeat
paragraphs: At this moment, Ding Ling and Jiu Mozhi were debating on Buddhism, initially appearing evenly matched, going back and forth fiercely.
But as time went on.
Ding Ling’s profound background fully revealed its advantage.
Various Buddhist principles flowed from his mouth like a lotus flower, leaving Jiu Mozhi in more and more cold sweat.
This continued for half an hour.
Jiu Mozhi was left speechless, struggling to find words to counter, he sighed deeply, clasped his hands together, and said to Ding Ling with great admiration:
"Donor Ding, your Buddhist attainments are so high that ordinary monks cannot match them. Even I, a high monk, cannot reach or surpass you! I admit defeat."
[E-level Achievement Medal: You have won Jiu Mozhi’s great admiration.]

[Note: Jiu Mozhi possesses great wisdom, proficient in Buddhism; his Buddhist study is unmatched by many, and he considered himself unrivaled in the world, but unexpectedly he was defeated by you, making him feel a sense of reverence for the Central Plains for the first time! He curbed his arrogant personality.]
Ding Ling heard the notification sound and smiled slightly.
Abbot Benyin then aptly said at the right moment:
"Since Great Wheel Ming King admits defeat. Do we have the authority to handle this matter?"
"Hehe."
Jiu Mozhi restrained his expression of admiration, raised his eyebrows, and said:

"Although I lost to Donor Ding in Buddhist attainments, I consider my martial arts cultivation to be unparalleled at the moment. I won’t claim to be the world’s number one, but I think capturing your Celestial Dragon Temple is more than enough.
If you are not convinced.
You can spar with me, Jiu Mozhi."
"Great Wheel Ming King."
Abbot Benyin was infuriated:
"You go back on your words, don’t you feel shameful?"
"Amitabha Buddha."
Jiu Mozhi clasped his hands together and said:

"Did I lose? My loss would mean I was defeated in all aspects by you. But now it’s only a Buddhist loss, how can it count as my defeat? If you can defeat me comprehensively, then I’ll let you handle it as you please!"
"Shameless scoundrel!"
Ben Guan and others could not hold back any longer, all loudly scolding.
Jiu Mozhi wasn’t angry, just smiled and said:
"I, Jiu Mozhi, have come from thousands of miles away, just to witness the Six Meridian Divine Sword. For this, I even specifically prepared three supreme skills from Shaolin Temple.
As he spoke.
He spread the Formless Tribulation Finger, Flower-picking Finger, and Dorayaki three Secret Manuals out on the table, clasped his hands together, and looked at Abbot Benyin’s party with burning eyes:

"Everyone, please see, these are three finger techniques from the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills, each with incredible power. I am exchanging these three for one Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture, my sincerity is sufficient, I hope you will agree."
As he spoke, he even demonstrated the extraordinary aspects of the three finger techniques.
Abbot Benyin’s party watched, and indeed, each of them showed signs of being moved, with expressions of interest.

In the end, it was Master Kuru who reminded them: ’How is your cultivation and transformation of the One Yang Finger? If you haven’t even reached Donor Ding’s level with the One Yang Finger, how could you want to learn Dorayaki? Handling two things at once, how can you reach the highest realm of the One Yang Finger?’
These words were enlightening, shaking the hearts and spirits of Abbot Benyin’s group, and they stopped considering the exchange.
Jiu Mozhi was furious, looking at Master Kuru who was facing away from him, and said:
"Since Master is unwilling to exchange, then let me experience your Celestial Dragon Temple’s Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture!"
As he spoke, he suddenly acted, pointing a finger at Abbot Benyin.
Abbot Benyin had been watching Jiu Mozhi, and upon seeing this, immediately countered with the One Yang Finger.
Bang!
The Finger Force of both sides clashed like two rays of light in mid-air, colliding for less than a breath of time, a bang sounded.
Abbot Benyin’s One Yang Finger was shattered, and he involuntarily retreated a few steps.
While Jiu Mozhi’s Dorayaki Finger Force continued forward, nearly striking Abbot Benyin.
Ben Guan and others also started to act.
However, in a one-on-one fight, not a single one was Jiu Mozhi’s match; they all collapsed at a touch, completely unable to withstand Jiu Mozhi.
Benyin and others were shaken.
They couldn’t help but look towards Ding Ling.
Master Kuru had already turned around, and seeing this scene, was also greatly shaken, clasped hands saying:
"Donor Ding, please assist us."
"This was discussed long ago. I will certainly help without hesitation."
Ding Ling stepped forward, looked at Jiu Mozhi:
"Master. You said if defeated comprehensively, you would let us handle this matter, is that true?"
"Of course!"
Jiu Mozhi raised his chin slightly, with an arrogant expression:
"I, Jiu Mozhi, keep my words, there is no reason to go back on them."
Regarding this.
Mu Wanqing and others showed strange expressions. As if seeing for the first time a high monk so shameless and brazen! Everyone was indeed eye-opening.
Ding Ling didn’t mind, he had seen too many shameless people, what counted was an extra Jiu Mozhi, he just smiled slightly and said:
"Since Master says so, then let me experience your high skill."
"Haha..."
Jiu Mozhi laughed loudly:

"Young brother, it’s not that I look down on you. You are young, even if you started cultivating from the womb, it’s impossible for your cultivation to be more profound than mine. But since you’re here, I’ll let you see what a true master is!"
With that said.
He already flicked his finger towards Ding Ling:
"Watch my Formless Tribulation Finger!"
A fierce and powerful Finger Force shot towards Ding Ling’s thigh from the air.
Evidently, Jiu Mozhi didn’t have the intention to kill, just wanted to repulse Ding Ling, making him retreat in difficulty.
Ding Ling saw this and also didn’t speak, just similarly sent a domineering Finger Power towards Jiu Mozhi.
Bang!

The Finger Force of both sides collided violently in the air for less than a breath of time when Jiu Mozhi’s Formless Tribulation Finger was easily disintegrated by Ding Ling’s Finger Power, which continued with lightning speed towards Jiu Mozhi’s arm.
"Dorayaki!"

Jiu Mozhi clearly saw it, his heart shook, exclaiming ’how can you know Dorayaki,’ but his hands didn’t slow, continually unleashing Formless Tribulation Finger, Flower-picking Finger strikes at Ding Ling’s Dorayaki Finger Force.
Thus trying his best, he used ten bouts of Finger Force barely to dissipate Ding Ling’s Dorayaki Finger Force completely.
Jiu Mozhi was astonished, incredulous, retreated several feet, and looked at Ding Ling vigilantly:
"Donor Ding’s Dorayaki is already at the Transformation Realm, but I don’t know who taught you? How do you know the Shaolin Temple’s supreme skills?!"
It wasn’t just Jiu Mozhi who didn’t understand.

Even Master Kuru and the others felt their hearts and spirits tremble, and for the first time began to doubt earlier assumptions. Ding Ling had trained Shaolin Temple’s Dorayaki to such an unbelievable level.
It was hard to say that Ding Ling’s One Yang Finger didn’t come from some other reason!

Moreover, with the information mysteriously appearing in their minds a few days ago about an Alien, they all began to suspect that Ding Ling was actually an Alien, and one who ascended, breaking the void.
Thus, there was only one possibility.
Ding Ling learned his techniques from the Lower Realm!

sentences.text: At this moment, Ding Ling and Jiu Mozhi were debating on Buddhism, initially appearing evenly matched, going back and forth fiercely.
But as time went on.
Ding Ling’s profound background fully revealed its advantage.
Various Buddhist principles flowed from his mouth like a lotus flower, leaving Jiu Mozhi in more and more cold sweat.
This continued for half an hour.
Jiu Mozhi was left speechless, struggling to find words to counter, he sighed deeply, clasped his hands together, and said to Ding Ling with great admiration:
"Donor Ding, your Buddhist attainments are so high that ordinary monks cannot match them.
Even I, a high monk, cannot reach or surpass you!
I admit defeat."
[E-level Achievement Medal: You have won Jiu Mozhi’s great admiration.]

[Note: Jiu Mozhi possesses great wisdom, proficient in Buddhism; his Buddhist study is unmatched by many, and he considered himself unrivaled in the world, but unexpectedly he was defeated by you, making him feel a sense of reverence for the Central Plains for the first time!
He curbed his arrogant personality.]
Ding Ling heard the notification sound and smiled slightly.
Abbot Benyin then aptly said at the right moment:
"Since Great Wheel Ming King admits defeat.
Do we have the authority to handle this matter?"
"Hehe."
Jiu Mozhi restrained his expression of admiration, raised his eyebrows, and said:
"Although I lost to Donor Ding in Buddhist attainments, I consider my martial arts cultivation to be unparalleled at the moment.
I won’t claim to be the world’s number one, but I think capturing your Celestial Dragon Temple is more than enough.
If you are not convinced.
You can spar with me, Jiu Mozhi."
"Great Wheel Ming King."
Abbot Benyin was infuriated:
"You go back on your words, don’t you feel shameful?"
"Amitabha Buddha."
Jiu Mozhi clasped his hands together and said:
"Did I lose?
My loss would mean I was defeated in all aspects by you.
But now it’s only a Buddhist loss, how can it count as my defeat?
If you can defeat me comprehensively, then I’ll let you handle it as you please!"
"Shameless scoundrel!"
Ben Guan and others could not hold back any longer, all loudly scolding.
Jiu Mozhi wasn’t angry, just smiled and said:
"I, Jiu Mozhi, have come from thousands of miles away, just to witness the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
For this, I even specifically prepared three supreme skills from Shaolin Temple.
As he spoke.
He spread the Formless Tribulation Finger, Flower-picking Finger, and Dorayaki three Secret Manuals out on the table, clasped his hands together, and looked at Abbot Benyin’s party with burning eyes:
"Everyone, please see, these are three finger techniques from the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills, each with incredible power.
I am exchanging these three for one Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture, my sincerity is sufficient, I hope you will agree."
As he spoke, he even demonstrated the extraordinary aspects of the three finger techniques.
Abbot Benyin’s party watched, and indeed, each of them showed signs of being moved, with expressions of interest.
In the end, it was Master Kuru who reminded them: ’How is your cultivation and transformation of the One Yang Finger?
If you haven’t even reached Donor Ding’s level with the One Yang Finger, how could you want to learn Dorayaki?
Handling two things at once, how can you reach the highest realm of the One Yang Finger?’
These words were enlightening, shaking the hearts and spirits of Abbot Benyin’s group, and they stopped considering the exchange.
Jiu Mozhi was furious, looking at Master Kuru who was facing away from him, and said:
"Since Master is unwilling to exchange, then let me experience your Celestial Dragon Temple’s Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture!"
As he spoke, he suddenly acted, pointing a finger at Abbot Benyin.
Abbot Benyin had been watching Jiu Mozhi, and upon seeing this, immediately countered with the One Yang Finger.
Bang!
The Finger Force of both sides clashed like two rays of light in mid-air, colliding for less than a breath of time, a bang sounded.
Abbot Benyin’s One Yang Finger was shattered, and he involuntarily retreated a few steps.
While Jiu Mozhi’s Dorayaki Finger Force continued forward, nearly striking Abbot Benyin.
Ben Guan and others also started to act.
However, in a one-on-one fight, not a single one was Jiu Mozhi’s match; they all collapsed at a touch, completely unable to withstand Jiu Mozhi.
Benyin and others were shaken.
They couldn’t help but look towards Ding Ling.
Master Kuru had already turned around, and seeing this scene, was also greatly shaken, clasped hands saying:
"Donor Ding, please assist us."
"This was discussed long ago.
I will certainly help without hesitation."
Ding Ling stepped forward, looked at Jiu Mozhi:
"Master.
You said if defeated comprehensively, you would let us handle this matter, is that true?"
"Of course!"
Jiu Mozhi raised his chin slightly, with an arrogant expression:
"I, Jiu Mozhi, keep my words, there is no reason to go back on them."
Regarding this.
Mu Wanqing and others showed strange expressions.
As if seeing for the first time a high monk so shameless and brazen!
Everyone was indeed eye-opening.
Ding Ling didn’t mind, he had seen too many shameless people, what counted was an extra Jiu Mozhi, he just smiled slightly and said:
"Since Master says so, then let me experience your high skill."
"Haha..."
Jiu Mozhi laughed loudly:
"Young brother, it’s not that I look down on you.
You are young, even if you started cultivating from the womb, it’s impossible for your cultivation to be more profound than mine.
But since you’re here, I’ll let you see what a true master is!"
With that said.
He already flicked his finger towards Ding Ling:
"Watch my Formless Tribulation Finger!"
A fierce and powerful Finger Force shot towards Ding Ling’s thigh from the air.
Evidently, Jiu Mozhi didn’t have the intention to kill, just wanted to repulse Ding Ling, making him retreat in difficulty.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - 514: The Little Monk
paragraphs: In this contemplation.
Master Kuru and several others were relieved.
This also proved that the technique Ding Ling acquired was indeed reasonable and legitimate. Ding Ling did not lie.
It’s just that they thought too much before, resulting in a misjudgment.
However, Ding Ling has practiced Shaolin Temple’s Dorayaki to such an incredible level, which is truly remarkable.
"You know Dorayaki, so I am not allowed to know it?"
Ding Ling smiled and said:
’Master, how do you find my finger power?’
"Domineering and extraordinarily strong, I am far inferior."
Jiu Mozhi, being straightforward, said very frankly:
"This time, I lost."
"Now both your Buddhist techniques and martial arts have been bested by my husband. Jiu Mozhi, are you going to deny it again?"
Zhong Ling said crisply:
"You are a master, remember."
"Amitabha Buddha."
Jiu Mozhi’s eyes darted around, suddenly retreated two steps, and laughed awkwardly:
"Ladies and gentlemen, let’s part ways here."
While speaking.
Suddenly exerting his Heart Technique and Lightweight Skill at full force, he soared upward, about to flee.
Ding Ling saw it and without hesitation, struck mid-air with a Dorayaki.
Bang!
It hit Jiu Mozhi in mid-air, causing him to fall to the ground, yet he was extraordinary, landing and continuing to run without turning back.
Ding Ling merely smiled slightly, and shouted loudly:
"Master, if you run again, next time I won’t aim for your legs, but your head."
Jiu Mozhi paused in his steps, turned back to look at Ding Ling with an awkward smile:
"Donor Ding, I’ve already conceded, why keep pressing me?"
"The bet before was stated clearly, is the master trying to cheat?"
Jiu Mozhi twitched at the corners of his eyes, clasped his palms together resolutely:

"I stand by my words. But I suddenly remembered there are urgent matters at home that need handling. I must say farewell to Donor Ding for now, deal with the affairs, and then come to fulfill the agreement!"
Abbot Benyin and others were so infuriated they laughed! They all scolded Jiu Mozhi for being shameless.
Jiu Mozhi turned a deaf ear, with an earnest and sincere look towards Ding Ling.
His acting skills are admirable, his face thick.
It couldn’t be clearer.
Ding Ling, with the Observing People Skill at full level, naturally saw through Jiu Mozhi’s lies, his face darkened, stepping forward:
"Master, if you dare deceive me again, do you believe I’ll kill you this instant!"
Jiu Mozhi was speechless, forced a bitter smile:
"What does Donor Ding wish me to do then?"
He even started calling himself a humble monk!
Clearly he admitted his cultivation and martial prowess were far inferior to Ding Ling’s.
He was indeed shocked to the core during the finger power contest, realizing the gap between his cultivation and Ding Ling’s was beyond measure!
Between them, it was like a celestial abyss, an abyss.
Yet Ding Ling was so young? He truly didn’t know how Ding Ling trained! Too terrifying!
"Stand over to the side first."
Ding Ling said sternly:
"If I see you attempt to run, I will show no mercy next time."
"Haha."
Jiu Mozhi laughed dryly, clasped his palms together, solemnly said: "A humble monk dares not!"
Ding Ling immediately started bidding farewell to Master Kuru and others one by one.
Master Kuru felt infinite emotion.
To them, it was an almost unsolvable problem.
In Ding Ling’s hands.
However, it was effortlessly resolved perfectly!
This is the difference!
"Donor Ding, your future is limitless."
Master Kuru said:
"I entrust Duan Yu to Donor Ding for some care."
Master Kuru evidently already knew about Duan Yu’s small actions.

He simply didn’t point it out, nor inform Duan Zhengchun, his intentions were self-evident, naturally impressed by Ding Ling’s astonishing talent and martial prowess, adhering to the principle of close association, wanting Duan Yu to follow Ding Ling for a while to see if he could learn and improve.
Ding Ling nodded.
Then he bid farewell to Abbot Benyin and others one by one.
After some time.
Ding Ling led Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling to ’step’ out of Celestial Dragon Temple.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling rode on the Ferghana Horse.

Ding Ling utilized Ripple Step to travel, which while used could also increase inner strength, truly remarkable, Ding Ling’s stamina was inexhaustible, finding Ripple Step convenient, thus had little interest in riding a horse.
At this moment he walked ahead, seeing Ling Yanqiu from afar, upon meeting with them, he said to Jiu Mozhi who followed alongside:
"How do you find my inner strength?"
"A humble monk has never seen or heard of such!"
Jiu Mozhi said very respectfully.
"Do you want to learn my skills?"
Ding Ling asked.
After a moment’s surprise, Jiu Mozhi became overjoyed, extremely excited, bowed down:
"If Donor Ding allows a humble monk to learn such Supreme Technique, a humble monk couldn’t repay enough! Willing to follow sincerely!
Ding Ling didn’t believe Jiu Mozhi’s nonsense.
Currently, Jiu Mozhi is obsessed with martial arts, resorting to shamelessness for the sake of martial arts.
Though he hasn’t harmed lives, his actions aren’t acknowledged.
Only later after enlightenment did he become a renowned monk. Right now, he is still far from that stage of enlightenment.
Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill triggered, seeing clearly, without exposing him, he just said:
"Exchange your martial arts for my true skills. How about it?"
"No problem."
Jiu Mozhi replied decisively and plainly:
"I practice martial arts to climb the supreme path of Martial Dao. To me, Martial Arts Secret Manuals are merely a step on the way to high places, lending them to others after use poses no issue."
In this regard, Jiu Mozhi’s understanding is quite high.
As he willingly exchanged Seventy-Two Skills for the Six Meridian Divine Sword Scripture, rather than forcibly taking.
Later he also willingly gave the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic to Duan Yu.
These points are evident.
Though he holds martial arts in high regard, he doesn’t hoard them selfishly.
"Very good."

Ding Ling didn’t hold back, directly imparted Flying Bear Breathing Technique to Jiu Mozhi, a Secret Manual from the Dong Zhuo Clan, with many knowing it, thus Ding Ling shared it without psychological burden.
Jiu Mozhi was a genius, with photographic memory, his wisdom, comprehension, and innate talent reached the pinnacle level.
Ding Ling knew Bone Touching.
On the way, tested Jiu Mozhi’s talent level, silently shocked, this was a mighty person whose talent was definitely not inferior to Huang the Herbalist! His future was undoubtedly bright!
"It truly is Supreme True Skill!"
Under Ding Ling’s high-level guidance and precise insights.
Jiu Mozhi quickly practiced the Breathing Technique to entry level.
The speed of his cultivation was astonishing for ordinary people!
Of course, reaching perfection level would take years.

Even so, after Jiu Mozhi mastered entry-level Breathing Technique, his Vigorous Qi and Inner Strength fused, their power increased fivefold! If exerted fully, a tenfold increase could be occasionally achieved.
He experimented several times.
Witnessing the fusion’s power, joy overwhelmed him, laughing skyward.
He looked at Ding Ling with sparkling eyes, eager to proceed, his intentions clear.
Ding Ling casually delivered a Splitting Sky Palm, effortlessly knocking him to the ground.
Jiu Mozhi was deeply shocked, instantly quelling the thought of competing with Ding Ling, seeing the subtle Splitting Sky Palm, he understood Ding Ling could easily kill him.
Thinking about it.
His mind itched.
Clearly.
He coveted the Splitting Sky Palm technique, finding its power unmatched, truly unparalleled.
Ding Ling didn’t expose him, simply said:
"Now it’s your turn. First, reveal your Small Faceless Skill."
"How does Donor Ding know a humble monk practices Small Faceless Skill?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 515: Small Faceless Skill at Full Level
paragraphs: Jiu Mozhi was shaken, finding it hard to believe.
Apart from a few close individuals who passed on the Technique to him, few knew about this matter. How did Ding Ling know?
Who exactly is he?!
"Don’t worry about how I know it. As a sign of sincerity, I’ll first teach you the Breathing Technique. You shouldn’t be playing tricks on me again, right?"
Ding Ling said with a serious face.
Jiu Mozhi’s heart trembled, not daring to be negligent or dismissive towards Ding Ling.
Immediately, he narrated the mantras of the Small Faceless Skill in detail, and actively explained some essential truths.
Obviously intending to elucidate for Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling didn’t listen much to these.
He only slightly recalled the Heart Technique.
Instantly, a new book appeared on the library shelf.
At that moment.
[Small Faceless Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Whoosh!

Rushing spiritual mechanism and primordial qi flooded over Ding Ling, who then operated the North Nether Divine Skill, absorbing and refining the primordial qi. Shortly, there was another North Nether True Qi in the dantian.
As long as he condenses three, naturally another drop of North Nether True Water will appear.
And Small Faceless Skill and North Nether Divine Skill are really closely related.
Now, they’re both at full level.

With the Small Faceless Skill mastered, Ding Ling rotated his wrist slightly, exhibiting various moves freely without using corresponding Heart Techniques, merely relying on the Small Faceless Skill, he could perfectly mimic nine-tenths of the essence of these Techniques.
The nine-tenths essence of Great Perfection! Already surpassing martial arts of the Perfect Realm.

Now Ding Ling employs the Small Faceless Skill to activate these Techniques, in the eyes of others, it’s as if Ding Ling is using those Techniques, and he’s achieved a remarkably high level of proficiency!
Invisible, formless!
No signs of mimicry!
Not only outsiders, even insiders find it hard to comprehend.
Only Jiu Mozhi, who had trained in Small Faceless Skill himself, could discern somewhat, feeling shocked, losing his composure and finding it hard to believe:
"Ding, Ding, Donor Ding, you, you, you this..."
"The Master’s Small Faceless Skill is indeed remarkable."
Ding Ling smiled and said:
"There’s also trouble, Master, please continue to pass on the seventy-two skills of the Shaolin Temple to me."
Jiu Mozhi was stunned, his gaze towards Ding Ling once again underwent subtle changes as he now felt he understood why Ding Ling was so extraordinary at such a young age!
Turns out he is someone even more phenomenal, ten times, a hundred times than him, Jiu Mozhi!
Ending up in such a person’s hands.
How dare Jiu Mozhi play tricks.

At present, thinking it’s fair exchange, and considering those seventy-two skills were obtained in exchange, now using them to exchange for one or two of Ding Ling’s true skills, it’s really worth it. After all, it’s just switching hands, what’s the harm?
The Seventy-Two Shaolin Skills.
They were never exclusive to Jiu Mozhi himself.
Now being subdued by Ding Ling, considering Ding Ling also taught him the Breathing Technique, immediately he recited in detail all the seventy-two skills he mastered.
Ding Ling listened intently one by one.
On the library shelf, new books appeared accordingly.
[Flower-Picking Finger Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Formless Tribulation Finger Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
[Worry-removing Finger Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Great Wisdom Unsettled Finger Full Level]
[Moksha Finger Full Level]
[Prajna Palm Full Level],
[Great Vajra Fist Full Level][Alms Bowl Palm Full Level]
[Shadow-Following Leg Full Level][Silent Extinction Grasp Full Level]
Subtracting previously mastered Dorayaki, Shaolin Tiger Claw Hand, Dragon Claw Grappling Hand, Burning Wood Saber Technique, Flower-Picking Grasp, and some duplicate Techniques.
There were nearly twenty of the Seventy-Two Skills!
Jiu Mozhi unexpectedly mastered over thirty Shaolin Temple skills.
Of course, he hadn’t truly mastered most of them, only able to utilize Small Faceless Skill to activate surface moves.
Now Ding Ling reaped the benefits.
All at once mastering twenty Shaolin Temple skills to full level.
Ultimately adding in three attribute points:
[Strength +3.1]
[Agility +2.8]
[Constitution +2.8]
Increasing several points of strength, etc., at once.
Such a large increase in attribute points.
Elevated Ding Ling’s physical qualities significantly.
His agility rose; life resilience and longevity increased substantially.
Now Ding Ling’s endurance battle power and explosiveness grew stronger significantly.
Jiu Mozhi was utterly dumbstruck.

Simply because he finished narrating each Technique one by one, Ding Ling would instantly achieve Great Perfection Innate Ability, demonstrating flawlessly, naturally, smoothly, leaving him unable to point out a single flaw.
At first, he was skeptical.
Thinking perhaps Ding Ling already learned these seventy-two skills.
But once he finished narrating all Techniques at once.
With Ding Ling reaching Great Perfection Innate Ability in each, he was bewildered, his gaze towards Ding Ling full of bewildered doubt;
"Donor Ding, did you perhaps already learn these Techniques?"
"If I had learned them, why would I need you to tell me? That’d be superfluous, wouldn’t it?"
"That’s true."
Jiu Mozhi was relieved yet unable to be at ease.
Suddenly encountering a genius a hundred times more extraordinary than himself, the sense of impact was truly fatal!
It used to be him, Jiu Mozhi, who dominated and overran ’ordinary people.’
Now it was his turn to be dominated by Ding Ling.
That feeling was oppressing, unbearable.
At this moment, Jiu Mozhi profoundly felt the sentiment of those masters whom he impacted greatly!
It’s indescribable.
Only the bitter sea can self-cross!
"Besides, are there any other Techniques?"
"Only one: Flame Saber."
Jiu Mozhi sighed:
"But this is the Esoteric Nyingma Sect’s sect-preserving Divine Skill, I dare not rashly pass it on to others."
Ding Ling wasn’t concerned. He had learned Flame Saber in the previous world.
Thus, he immediately said:
"If that’s the case. Master, let’s part ways here."
"You’re letting me go?!"
Jiu Mozhi was taken aback, thinking about Ding Ling’s mastery of various mysterious divine skills, feeling reluctant, he pondered, earnestly said:

"Donor Ding, as a monk, I don’t speak lies. Since I pledged to let you decide, and follow you, naturally, I must keep my word. I’m a person of the Buddhist Sect. Donor Ding, you mustn’t make me a person who breaks promises."
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling glanced sideways, gaining a deeper understanding of Jiu Mozhi’s audacity, never seeing someone like him!
"If you wish to follow, then follow."
Ding Ling warned:
"But I’ll tell you beforehand. Since you plan to follow me, if I ask you to do something, you must do it. If there’s a single aspect you can’t fulfill, don’t blame me for being unsympathetic."
Now it was Jiu Mozhi’s turn to be nervous, pondering for a moment, he solemnly pressed his palms together, saying:

"As long as it doesn’t violate the monk’s principles, the monk will exert all efforts to carry out Donor Ding’s orders. Just hope Donor Ding will see my dedication and teach me some true skills, so my power can ascend further, not asking to stand shoulder to shoulder with Donor Ding, but hoping to climb further up."
Ding Ling shook his head silently.
Jiu Mozhi bit off more than he could chew.
Without mastering Great Perfection of Breathing Technique, yet wanting to learn something else.
If this continues.
Someday he’ll end up with a fate identical to TV series or novels.
Ding Ling didn’t enlighten him.
Jiu Mozhi was entrapped in martial fanaticism, only mindful of martial arts, other matters couldn’t catch his attention, more discussion would merely be auto-filtered by him.
Ding Ling’s group headed north.
Mu Wanqing, Zhong Ling, Ling Yanqiu, Duan Yu rode horses.
Ding Ling used Ripple Step for travel.
Jiu Mozhi employed Shaolin Temple’s Dragonfly Water-landing Lightweight Skill and Shadow-Following Leg Body Technique, following closely all the way.
Occasionally encountering a few new players.
Ding Ling didn’t recognize them.
But they recognized Ding Ling.
