chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 516: Lifespan
paragraphs: Occasionally, players seeing Ding Ling will shout loudly, ’Whoa! It’s Ding Ling!" ’Idol! Look here! Look here!
Players keep waving their hands and shouting at Ding Ling, afraid he’ll miss them.
Ding Ling already sensed his high popularity.
Each time he logs off to survey online, he sees his name topping the hot search lists of game forums worldwide!
In today’s age, though it’s not an era where everyone is in the game.
It’s pretty close.
The hot search lists in game forums.
Often represent global renown.
In game forums around the world, Ding Ling always ranks first, making his popularity unparalleled and dominating his time!
Precisely because of this.
He gained many fans, and people have a tendency to admire strength, creating a clustering effect.
As more people grow to like and worship Ding Ling, others inadvertently get swept up in it, or with some intentional promotion, Ding Ling has undoubtedly become the number one in the game world!
He also became the world’s genuine top influencer!
Countless people adore him.

Most of these people see him as a goal, aiming to master top-level martial arts, roam the Jianghu with pride, dominate one area, or even if they can’t achieve these, enhancing physical fitness and living longer is great.
Thus, many wish to find Ding Ling and ask him to be their master. Some vendors and merchants, prioritizing profit, wish to collaborate with him to earn money.
When Ding Ling goes online and notices these, he is quietly moved, realizing that as these businesses intentionally extend ’olive branches’ to him, his fame will only grow bigger.
Looking at it now, indeed!
There’s almost nobody among players who doesn’t know him!
It shows that his image must have spread across households!
"Donor Ding seems quite famous."

Jiu Mozhi, on his journey, noticed that whenever he reached crowded places, there’d definitely be someone recognizing Ding Ling, leading to shouting, running up to ask to be taught - everyone came, really broadening Jiu Mozhi’s horizons!
"I already checked it out."
On this day, resting at an inn, Duan Yu smiled and said to everyone:
"While I waited for you near the Celestial Dragon Temple, I heard some aliens talking about Brother Ding. I know Brother Ding is a prince in the lower realm."
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling couldn’t help but perk up their ears.
With Duan Yu sharing stories about Ding Ling.
Everyone had mixed feelings.
Yet without exception, emotions turned intense.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling felt dark when they learned Ding Ling had a wife in the lower realm, but knowing Ding Ling is a first-rank prince, they couldn’t help but click their tongues, pondering:
"An emperor with three palaces, six courtyards, seventy-two concubines. Brother Ding, a prince equivalent in status, only has one wife in the lower realm. It shows he’s not one to mess around."
Thinking so.
The mood improved quite a bit.
At the same time, hearts grew more tense, feeling they had to keep an eye on Brother Ding so other women wouldn’t snatch him away.
The deeper they understood Ding Ling, the more they could perceive the absolute disparity between them.
This made the optimist Zhong Ling slightly apprehensive.
Mu Wanqing, needless to say.

Now knowing Ding Ling’s true identity made her anxious and fretful, feeling inadequate for Ding Ling while feeling lost about how she could improve her standing in Ding Ling’s eyes, making him like her more.
For this.
Mu Wanqing could only silently do what she could for Ding Ling. Let Ding Ling once again enjoy that attentive immortal life.
He didn’t want to be served like this. Mu Wanqing insisted and stubbornly did it.
Seeing her expression, Ding Ling knew what she was thinking, so he let her be.
Zhong Ling, seeing Mu Wanqing do this, followed suit.
Duan Yu, in the side, inadvertently watched, feeling secretly envious, greatly lamenting ’Brother Ding’s lucky position, it’s really enviable!’
On this day.
Everyone traveled to a sparsely populated small town.
Due to the late hour.
The group saw an inn up ahead and chose to stay temporarily, continuing the journey the next day.
This journey to Suzhou Yanzimu.
Long and arduous.
Reaching it is not possible in a short time.
Ding Ling wasn’t in a rush either, with new players flooding in, the Celestial Dragon storyline is doomed to chaos.
Whether he could meet Wuya Zi at Leigushan was uncertain.
Plus, thinking of the two great libraries of Gusu Yanzimu:
Returning Water Pavilion at Canhe Manor.
Langhuan Jade Cave at Mantuo Manor.
If he could just read through these two libraries.
The increase in four-dimensional attributes would be unimaginable!
To this day, his personal attribute points:
[Root Bone: 5 (ordinary person is 1 point), Intelligence: 5, Strength: 63.8, Agility: 64, Constitution: 70.5, Defense: 60, Charm: 12.4, True Power Value: 12 points]
His constitution once again broke the barrier.
Surpassing 70 points!
Ding Ling feels his current life span is immensely long! Living three to four hundred years should be no significant issue.
This refers to his reality self.
In the Three Kingdoms World.
With the help of Celestial Might’s power, his vitality is boundless, almost immortal.
But that’s just in the Three Kingdoms World.
In the real world, his life at most is several decades or hundreds of years longer than ordinary people! If he dies in reality, his Three Kingdoms self would surely die!
As his constitution continually grows now, naturally, his vitality rapidly rises, extending his lifespan, which is a reasonable development.

Upon returning to reality last time, Ding Ling already sensed this, with his lifespan lifted to a new tier due to surpassing the 70-point barrier, entering a new realm, different from ordinary people.
"Three to four hundred years of life...

Ding Ling contemplated: "With such longevity, in ordinary people’s eyes, it’s equivalent to being an immortal. But that’s not enough, my goal is eternal life, invincibility across the heavens... Besides, I want to achieve eternal life with my wife!"
How could Ding Ling be satisfied with a mere few hundred years!
He seeks to constantly break past limitations!
Enter higher-dimensional worlds, continually ascend!
"Looks like the four-dimensional attribute point limit of Celestial Dragon World should be around 80 or 90?"
Ding Ling mulled over it, finding no answer, and didn’t dwell on it further.
After dining with everyone.
He went to sleep.
Still, Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling made his bed, with the two girls sharing a room with him.
Although they hadn’t married nor accomplished the marital ritual.
Yet they slept in the same large bed.
To Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling, they are legitimately Ding Ling’s wives!
Everyday intimate actions and motions weren’t concealed from Duan Yu and the others, making Duan Yu feel nauseous and greatly longing for his immortal sister.

At this moment, Duan Yu was tossing and turning with sleeplessness in the adjacent room, thinking of Ding Ling with two beauties sleeping close daily, while he is lonely night after night, so uncomfortable!
Yet thinking of Immortal Sister, his heart grew inexplicably warm and fiery.
"At that time, I’ll ask Brother Ding to teach me a few moves, so I can approach Immortal Sister better."
In Duan Yu’s view.
Mu Wanqing was fiercely headstrong and stubbornly tough.
She beat him quite badly.

But she was incredibly gentle and delicate towards Ding Ling, making Duan Yu feel sour, yet also find it hard to belie Mu Wanqing’s aggressive and cold demeanor changed dramatically, and along the journey, she grew increasingly gentle towards Ding Ling, proving it wasn’t just a fleeting impulse but a sincere transformation for Ding Ling.
Thinking of this.
He couldn’t help but envy and covet.
But believing jealousy is unwelcome, he quickly extinguished this thought, leaving only pure admiration:
"Brother Ding’s means are so impressive. I wonder how he made Miss Mu so understanding and compliant?"
Throughout the journey, Duan Yu sought opportunities to consult.
All went unasked since Mu Wanqing followed Ding Ling closely, out of concern for hurting Mu Wanqing’s pride, he found it inappropriate to ask.
So, this matter got shelved.
Leaving Duan Yu feeling restless!
"What’s that smell?"
Duan Yu suddenly smelled something strange, and the next second, buzzing bees invaded the room.
"Oh no!"
He got stung a few times, his vision blackening, losing control and falling down:
"There’s poison! Who wants to harm me, Duan Yu!"

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 517: Intoxicating Bee
paragraphs: The inn was devoid of any light.

Even the bedroom where Ding Ling and the others rested had oil lamps that lasted less than half an hour. After that, because of the dimness of the lamps, everyone thought it best to get some early sleep and went to bed.
Unexpectedly,
a strange scent and bees suddenly attacked.
The loud cry of Duan Yu instantly woke Ding Ling in the neighboring room.
How extraordinary he was!
Even in the dark, his vision was astonishingly sharp; he instantly unleashed a strike of Six Meridian Divine Sword, breaking through the window, letting the moonlight illuminate the room.

Immediately, he flipped over, picked up Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling, leaped through the window, and utilized Spiral Nine Shadows and Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique. Like a wisp of smoke, he swiftly soared to the rooftop diagonally opposite the inn.
"What happened?"
Zhong Ling, who had just fallen asleep, rubbed her drowsy eyes, confused.
Mu Wanqing was in a similar state.
Yet being tightly embraced by Ding Ling, a delightful blush involuntarily appeared on her face.
"Stay here for now."
Ding Ling shot back to the inn. The room he was just in was already swarming with bees.

He activated North Nether Divine Skill and Nine Yang Divine Skill, enveloping himself in Gang Qi, ignoring the bee stings as he swiftly arrived at Duan Yu’s bedroom, where he faced an old woman with a face full of wrinkles, seemingly in her seventies or eighties.
The old woman was dragging Duan Yu’s body, muttering to herself:
"So many men. Well, they make fine flower fertilizer."
Unexpectedly looking up, she saw Ding Ling, who was already striking with a palm.
Smack!
He hit the old woman’s shoulder and immediately applied North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill!
Whoosh!
The old woman’s inner strength was instantly absorbed by him completely.
Storage Skill!
Transformation Skill!
In just a moment, the full-level North Nether Divine Skill converted all that inner strength into North Nether True Qi.

Ding Ling’s Dantian now had a newly emerged stream of North Nether True Qi.

The bees, seemingly afraid of fire, scattered away.

"Master Jiu Mozhi’s skills are so high, how could he be stung by mere bees?!"
"These aren’t ordinary bees."
Ding Ling examined one bee closely and then said,
"It should be the Intoxicating Bee. Even those immune to all poisons find it hard to resist."
Ding Ling woke one of the old women and interrogated her.
At first, the old woman wouldn’t confess.
Ding Ling used a special method of One Yang Finger, making her endure pain akin to Cloud Crane, and she couldn’t stand it anymore, hastily confessing everything.
"...Manor Master’s order is to bring both men and women back, use men as flower fertilizer, torment the women a bit, and then kill them."
"Which manor are you from? Who is the Manor Master?"
"Mantuo Manor. Li Qingluo."
Upon hearing this,
Ding Ling understood and confirmed.
These bees were indeed Intoxicating Bees.
Typically, even martial arts experts would faint immediately upon being stung, proving difficult to defend against.
In the original story, Duan Yu, immune to all poisons, was also stung and knocked out, showing the potency of the poison.
It was fortunate the bee venom did not cause death; otherwise, Duan Yu’s group might have succumbed immediately.
Ding Ling asked a few more detailed questions.
Indeed.
The main component of the Intoxicating Bee poison is paralysis, which directly paralyzes and knocks people out, leaving them unconscious for four or five days.

Ding Ling, proficient in the Medical Dao, understood the source of the Intoxicating Bee venom and, based on its characteristics, came up with a way to detoxify it. After all, this poison wasn’t lethal but merely paralyzed and intoxicated people.
Thus, calling it poison doesn’t really make it poison.
It’s simply a complex toxin.

Ding Ling frowned secretly, thinking: It seems that being immune to all poisons isn’t entirely safe; such strange complex toxins, neither deadly nor like scorpion venom, just intoxicating and paralyzing, if caught off guard, even I might ’pass out.’
With such thoughts, Ding Ling remained cautiously vigilant, realizing that even with immunity to all poisons, one should not be too complacent.
"Brother Ding, I’m sorry."
Mu Wanqing expressed her embarrassment.
She knew that this time the Mantuo Manor’s old women mainly aimed to assassinate her and capture Prince Duan Yu of the Dali Duan Clan!
There was a player’s advice.
The old woman had recognized Duan Yu early on.
Moreover, a spy report also enabled them to recognize Mu Wanqing!
They naturally intended to capture all of them and take them back to the Manor Master.
Unexpectedly, they encountered a formidable opponent in Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was also curious if they knew about him.
And indeed, they did.
With players spreading information everywhere, how could they not know?
Thus, their knowledge was quite comprehensive.
Coupled with their full confidence in the Intoxicating Bees, they believed that a surprise attack in the dark, when no lights were present, would leave Ding Ling with no chance to escape and acted.
Unfortunately,
They underestimated Ding Ling’s vigilance and body technique.
Ding Ling’s Lightweight Skill was exceptionally adept.
In a flicker, he flew out of the room.
Although the Intoxicating Bees were numerous and dense, and fast, they were ultimately a fraction of a second too slow, but that brief moment was enough for Ding Ling to defend himself!

chapters.title: Chapter 519 - 518: Jianghu Transformation
paragraphs: "Knowing that I’m here, they still dared to make a move. Moreover, they even want to turn me into fertilizer. Truly audacious, utterly absurd."
Ding Ling shook his head.
He didn’t know what to say.
Should he call them overestimating oneself or frogs in a well?
Or perhaps they won so many similar encounters before and became overly confident?
These questions were asked.
And sure enough.
Whenever the Intoxicating Bee acted, being thoroughly prepared, it was nearly unstoppable!
No matter how skilled in martial arts, one would be rendered unconscious for several days, unable to move, left at the mercy of others!
These old women had too many successful endeavors.
Although they heard from players about Ding Ling’s prowess and fearsome nature, they couldn’t believe anyone could resist the Intoxicating Bee in this world.
Now they saw.
But it was too late for regrets.
They didn’t know, Ding Ling now had tough skin and thick flesh. Even without the defense of Divine Skill’s Gang Qi, his skin alone was as defensive as wearing six layers of armor!
No matter how formidable the Intoxicating Bee was, how could it break through his defense?
This was why Ding Ling dared to charge and break through.
Most martial arts experts in this world only cultivated inner power, but did not refine their bodies; truly encountering the Intoxicating Bee meant certain paralysis!
Just by looking at Jiu Mozhi paralyzed on the ground, you can infer as much.
At this moment.
After Ding Ling comprehended the root of the matter, he heard Mu Wanqing’s words, seeing her apologetic expression, he comforted her:
"We are heart and soul as one, for we are family, no need to be an outsider."
Mu Wanqing treated him so well.
Being a man, Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t deny responsibility.
Upon hearing this, Mu Wanqing lifted her head abruptly to look at Ding Ling, her face full of joy, tentatively calling:
"Hus-husband?"
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded with a smile.
Mu Wanqing grew even more delighted, her face radiant with jubilation, excitement, and thrill, like crescent undimmed, snow among blossoms.
Zhong Ling on the side also felt happy for Mu Wanqing, gleefully saying:
"Sister Mu, now you can stop worrying, right? From now on we can be together forever!"
Mu Wanqing was a bit bashful, just shook Zhong Ling’s arm, signaling her to say no more.
Zhong Ling giggled, her face showing two shallow intoxicating dimples.
Mu Wanqing had followed the words of her master, who was actually her mother, Guest of the Deep Valley Asura Saber Qin Hongmian, to kill Wang Yuyan’s mother, Li Qingluo, at Mantuo Manor, but failed.
Then she was chased.
She had encountered it once in Dali before, didn’t expect to meet here again.
Ding Ling, however, didn’t dwell on it, just thinking:
"Since they dared to provoke me, wanting to turn me into fertilizer. Then don’t blame me for being merciless."
These old women were ruthless, killing without batting an eye.
Not immediately ending Duan Yu, Jiu Mozhi.
Was because they wanted to take them back and cut their limbs alive for fertilizer.
Their cruelty is imaginable.
If this happened to someone else, Ding Ling could ignore it, but they should never have messed with Ding Ling.
Ding Ling originally planned to visit Mantuo Manor’s library.
Now his resolve was even stronger.
He killed several old women.
[Received Achievement Medal: Intimidating Granny Rui.]
[Received Achievement Medal: Intimidating Granny Ping]

[Note: Granny Rui and her group of five came full of confidence, thinking they were fully prepared this time and would surely win. Never did they expect to be so effortlessly crushed and defeated by you. Their dying thoughts were of confusion, bewilderment, and fear.]
Three achievement medals were obtained.
Evidently, only three of them met the requirements for an achievement medal.
It goes without saying that the other two might not even have names in the book, just extras among extras.
Ding Ling didn’t mind this.
Getting the achievement medals was just a pleasant surprise for him.
He went outside the forest to gather some herbs, concocted them, and gave them to Duan Yu and the others to take, allowing them to slowly wake up leisurely.
They were initially confused.
Until Jiu Mozhi exclaimed, ’Amitabha Buddha, what happened?! How did I fall unconscious here?!’
Duan Yu was as if doused in cold water, instantly waking up, saying:
"Aiyah! I remember now. I seemed to have been poisoned."
He glanced at Ding Ling:
"Was it Brother Ding who saved me?"
"Hehe."
Zhong Ling giggled and said:
"Brother Duan, as long as you know. Who else but my husband has the ability to save you here?
She too began calling him husband like Mu Wanqing.
Duan Yu heard this, feeling somewhat overwhelmed and envious, but quickly got up, solemnly bowing to thank Ding Ling.
Ling Yanqiu, Jiu Mozhi also did the same.
Especially Jiu Mozhi, who was full of lingering fears, sighed:
"Indeed, the Central Plains is unfathomable. This monk considered himself highly cultivated. Yet, I have repeatedly stumbled here in the Central Plains! Truly ashamed, ashamed."
Jiu Mozhi became even more determined to seek Divine Skill from Ding Ling.
From Ding Ling being unharmed and easily defeating his enemies, it was evident his Divine Skill was extraordinary.
And just one Breathing Technique could amplify his power fivefold, tenfold!
If there were a few more such techniques.
Wouldn’t Jiu Mozhi ascend to heaven?!
Just thinking about it, Jiu Mozhi’s heart was excited, fervent beyond measure.
"Get some rest, we’ll continue on the road in the morning."
After Jiu Mozhi and the others proactively cleaned up the bodies and bloodstains, everyone returned to their rooms for a rest.
Such went the night.
The next day was clear and bright.
Everyone resumed their journey.
From here on, things went much smoother.
Although occasionally encountering some minor troubles, Jiu Mozhi leading the way was like bringing lambs to the slaughter.
That day at noon.
They arrived at Suzhou Yanzi Dock.
Ding Ling had logged off the previous evening and, after going online, understood the recent major events happening in the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World.
The chaos at Leigushan, with an endless stream of players flocking in, all aiming to solve the Zhenlong Chessboard.

Yet Su Xinghe’s standards were too high, ordinary players couldn’t catch his eye. Only a few exceptionally talented and handsome players were retained, while others were promptly sent down the mountain. No one knew whether those who stayed obtained Wuya Zi’s heritage.
Qiao Feng, owing to a massive player leak, had already become Xiao Feng. And he had actively sought out his biological father. The two teamed up to hunt down Murong Bo and his son.

Players wanting to join Lingjiu Palace under the Heavenly Mountain Granny were all marked with the Life and Death Talisman, couldn’t seek life or death, only self-extermination to break free, after rebirth, dared not go again.
Story after story.
Greatly eye-opening.

Ding Ling always knew that the massive influx of players into the Celestial Dragon Eight Books world would make this Jianghu cloudy and impure, but didn’t expect it to become so turbulent in just half a month.
This Jianghu had become so turbulent, completely different from the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - 519: Battle on the Lake
paragraphs: The players’ ability to stir things up is evident.
Qiao Feng has turned into Xiao Feng.
Who knows how the subsequent storyline will develop?
Ding Ling has no idea.
However, perhaps it is because Xiao Feng and Xiao Yuanshan went madly chasing after Murong Bo and Murong Fu that there are so many players at Yanzi Dock.
It’s quite obvious.
There are no shortage of players trying to take advantage of Murong Fu’s absence to enter Yanzi Dock and Canhe Manor to catch a glimpse of the secret manuals inside.
Ding Ling had already seen detailed maps online on how to enter Yanzi Dock and Canhe Manor.
One has to admit.
After players swarmed into the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World,
though it distorted the storyline beyond recognition, with them paving the way, Ding Ling’s map exploration work had become considerably simpler.
At the moment, Ding Ling was following the map to the letter.
Along the way, he avoided quite a few players.
But he was still blocked by dozens of small boats on Lake Tai.
On the small boat leading them, an elderly woman with a wrinkled face and slightly hunched back walked out.
Her eyes narrowed slightly, emitting a chilling gleam like a venomous snake. After scanning Ding Ling and his party, she suddenly shouted:
"It’s them!"
"Fire arrows!"
At her shout, the hundreds of strapping men on the dozens of small boats around, all drew their bows and aimed at Ding Ling and his party.
Jiu Mozhi was shocked. With so many people shooting arrows, wouldn’t they be shot like a sieve? He had just opened his mouth to shout, ’Excuse me, is there some misunderstanding?’
Before he could finish speaking.
Whoosh, whoosh!

The sound of bowstrings snapping suddenly arose, followed by the whistling of arrows. Countless arrows, at least seven to eight hundred, rained down densely as if capable of destroying and piercing everything.
Ling Yanqiu, Jiu Mozhi, and the others were all terrified.

Yet Ding Ling only frowned slightly, stepping forward as he simultaneously unleashed Spiral Nine Shadows, Ripple Step, and Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique. With Fusion Qi spurring him on, Ding Ling transformed into nine figures, alternately merging and separating, revolving around Zhong Ling and Duan Yu, protecting them airtight!
Bam bam bam!
With his palms, Ding Ling repeatedly slapped in all directions. Splitting Sky Palm showed its power, each tumultuous palm strike sent arrows flying back! Some even shattered into pieces mid-air!
After one wave of the arrow rain passed.
Ding Ling’s side remained unscathed.
Jiu Mozhi and the others were ecstatic, moved, horrified, and impressed. It was the first time they saw Ding Ling using his full strength, and they finally realized how formidable Ding Ling was!
Jiu Mozhi was particularly relieved of the choice he made earlier. If he had dared to be a bit more headstrong, he might have died without a burial place!
"What?!"
The old woman couldn’t believe it.
The seven to eight hundred strapping men were also left open-mouthed, as if witnessing such a remarkable master from Jianghu for the first time.
But Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered to waste time with them.
He directly unleashed the Six Meridian Divine Sword!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

As all six fingers moved simultaneously, spurred by Fusion Qi, streaks of Sword Qi surged through the void, resembling lightning, thunder, and lasers. Amid the whooshing sound, they shot through the air towards the strapping men and the old woman!
Crackle!
Splatter!
Splatter!
Clearing everything along the way.
Like a machine gun sweeping across the heroes, wherever the Sword Qi passed, patches of strapping men fell dead on the boats and into the water!
A single streak of Sword Qi could easily pierce through five to six bodies and organs.
If grouped tightly, a single streak of Sword Qi could even pierce through more than ten bodies!
It was visible to the naked eye.
As dozens of shining, dazzling streaks of Sword Qi burst forth, the strapping men all fell down.
Either dead on the spot, severely injured and unable to stand, or shot through in the limbs, unable to fight.
In just less than two blinks of an eye.
The seven to eight hundred strapping men were rendered useless!
Jiu Mozhi was stunned: "What kind of skill is this?!"
"So powerful."
Duan Yu was both excited and shocked:
"Is this the Six Meridian Divine Sword, the supreme skill of my Dali Duan family? I want to learn it too!"
As they continued their journey.
There were continuous disturbances.

Duan Yu’s reluctance to learn martial arts was diminishing, especially after being rescued by Ding Ling today and witnessing Ding Ling’s grand display of power. Observing Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing’s expressions of awe, Duan Yu seemed enlightened, with a flash of insight, thinking:

"If the Immortal Sister were present now and saw how amazing Brother Ding is, would she be moved by him?! After all, since ancient times, beauties love heroes, and heroes love beauties, nothing more than this.
If there were a few more incidents of heroes saving beauties, it wouldn’t be unusual for a beauty to fall for them.
If I don’t have any skills, how can I catch the attention and affection of the Immortal Sister?"
Understanding it clearly.

Duan Yu couldn’t help but feel regretful and remorseful. If he had learned martial arts earlier, even if not as good as Ding Ling, he would surely have been a high-level master and could have shown off in front of the Immortal Sister instead of being helpless and facing threats incapable of doing anything.
This sense of helplessness was simply unbearable for him.
Swish!
Ding Ling flew across the air, instantly reaching the old woman and pressing a palm towards her.
The old woman shouted, and with her cane, she struck heavily at Ding Ling. Ding Ling casually waved his hand and sent her cane flying, then printed a palm on her shoulder.
North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
As the inner strength surged into the Dantian, a large amount of inner strength transformed into North Nether True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +30]
Indeed, she was someone nearing second-class level.
But her inner skill paled in comparison to North Nether Divine Skill. Being able to refine a strand of essence and increase the Inner Power Value by 30 was at least better than nothing.
It was hardly any different from the effect of ordinary Great Medicine.
"Transformation Technique!"
The old woman screamed.
Ding Ling directly grabbed her and tossed her onto their boat, instructing Jiu Mozhi to interrogate her.
Afterward, he leapt onto another boat, reaching out to grab one of the men.
Humph!

This man, looking like a scholar, was obviously the leader of the strapping men. Shot through the shoulder by the Six Meridian Divine Sword, he was still vigorous and lively. Now seeing Ding Ling charging over, knowing he couldn’t escape, he let out a shout, viciously thrusting a sword at Ding Ling.
This sword strike adopted a mutually fatal approach.

Ding Ling completely ignored the thrust of the sword, directly slapping at the sword’s edge, sending the sword flying, then grabbed the scholar’s shoulder, directly unleashing North Nether Divine Skill!
Whoosh!
A surge of exceptionally strong inner strength flooded into the Dantian, swiftly refined by North Nether Divine Skill.
Within just two blinks.
[Inner Power Value +90]
Another streak of North Nether True Qi was added.
Subsequently, three streaks merged, forming a drop of North Nether True Water.
[True Power Value: 13 points]
The True Power Value increased once again.
Unnoticed, Ding Ling’s strength increased by about a tenth, with the tenfold boost from Fusion Qi, it was equivalent to gaining the strength of an ordinary grandmaster!
He hadn’t anticipated that the inner strength of the person before him was so powerful, far exceeding that of the old woman, reaching the level of an ordinary first-class!
"Transformation Technique, who, who are you?!"
The scholar looked at Ding Ling with a face full of shock and horror.

chapters.title: Chapter 521 - 520: Murong Fu’s Four Great Generals
paragraphs: Ding Ling paid no attention to the scholar.
Instead, he flew to other boats, utilizing the North Nether Divine Skill to absorb the inner strength of others.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +2]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Seven or eight hundred people, more than half of them died.
The rest were also on the brink of death.
Being absorbed by Ding Ling like this!
Those whose inner strength was exhausted instantly died in large numbers.
But unfortunately.
The inner power heart method of these people was even worse than that of the old woman.
Although quite a few had reached the level of third-rate.
Their inner power values only increased by about 5 points.
And the vast majority didn’t even reach third-rate!
Only able to contribute 1 point. 2 points.
But still better than nothing.
After going through a few hundred people.
[Inner Power Value +226]
In an instant, two more strands of North Nether True Qi were added to the Dantian.
Another strand could soon gather into a drop of North Nether True Water.
This situation.
Was faster than taking Great Medicine.
Ding Ling sighed secretly: It truly deserves to be the full-level North Nether Divine Skill! Absolutely remarkable!
And precisely because it was at full level.
The speed of refinement was so fast that it took less than a moment to resolve one! And there were no side effects!
Such divine skill is comparable to a cheat device!
And these hundreds of people had actually all practiced inner power heart methods.
It was clear they were not ordinary bandits.
Ding Ling looked at the scholar:
"Who are you?"
"Hmph!"
The scholar’s inner strength had completely vanished, his heart as dead as ashes. Hearing Ding Ling’s question, he snorted coldly and said:
"Grandfather by name or sitting does not change name! Manor Master of Chixia Manor, Gongye Qian!"
"One of the four great generals of Gusu Murong?"
"That’s right!"
"Why do you want to kill me?"
"You killed people from Mantuo Manor. I was formally invited by Madam Wang to assist in the fight, how could I sit idly by?!"
"Li Qingluo?"
"Hmph."
Gongye Qian snorted and said:

"Madam Wang’s Mantuo Manor and our Canhe Manor are closely allied, we should look out for and help each other. It’s no big deal that you defeated my Chixia Manor. But under my Canhe Manor there are three more Manor Masters, and under the command of our two manors, there are countless spies and foot soldiers. Our Patriarch Murong Fu is even a renowned figure in the Jianghu!
What you do to me now, don’t expect a good outcome."
"Do you not know that Murong Bo, Murong Fu are being hunted down by someone?
Gongye Qian was speechless. Suddenly realizing this, his face turned even more ghastly and his stance appeared withered!
He would say everything.
Seeing that the old woman could definitely not withstand torture, he decided to be straightforward and reveal everything, hoping the opponent would retreat in the face of difficulties.
But now it seems, his hopes are small.
Ding Ling shook his head, casually landed a palm strike, slap!
It directly hit Gongye Qian’s heart, causing it to collapse inward, and he died on the spot.
Having intended to kill Ding Ling.
Why would Ding Ling leave any chance?
Furthermore, since they were already at odds, there was absolutely no reason for Ding Ling to stop and leave!
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidate Gongye Qian.]

[Annotation: Gongye Qian was invited by Madam Wang to kill. He was confident, but unexpectedly encountered such an extraordinary expert as you. In shock and disbelief, he died in confusion, regret, and remorse!]
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidate Mrs. Yan.]
Another 3 Achievement Medals were collected.
So many people.
Yet only 3 met the requirements for Achievement Medals.
Ding Ling didn’t think much about it, jumped onto the boat, glanced at the old woman, and asked:
"Did you confess?"
"All confessed."

Jiu Mozhi became increasingly respectful to Ding Ling, having personally witnessed Ding Ling’s great display of divine techniques, his heart was overturned, and he was profoundly impressed, admiring him to the utmost. He coveted Ding Ling’s divine skills more and more, but alas, the gap between them was too large, he was completely no match for Ding Ling, so he could only hope to be diligent and conscientious enough to earn Ding Ling’s approval.
And then, seeing him ’pitiful’ and ’capable’, reward him with one or two supreme techniques. That would be excellent.
"Let’s hear it."
Jiu Mozhi immediately spoke up.
After Ding Ling listened, she straightforwardly had the old woman lead the way to find the forces of the other three great manors.
This was because all three great manors were preparing an ambush against Ding Ling.
Evidently.
This time, Madam Wang joined forces with Canhe Manor to set up a Celestial Net and Earth Net trap for Ding Ling.
Surrounded on all sides.
No matter which direction Ding Ling chose, she would be attacked by seven to eight hundred divine archers.
And this was on the lake.
Ding Ling had nowhere to run or hide; no matter how formidable her martial prowess, she would definitely be killed!
That was their belief.
After all, in their understanding, no matter how strong a person is, they couldn’t defend against such a massive number of divine arrows on the lake!
"I’ll go with her alone. If you follow, remember to keep your distance."
Ding Ling grabbed the old woman and directly stepped onto the waves, moving like the wind or electricity, and in the blink of an eye, disappeared into a green forest-covered corner.
Jiu Mozhi sighed, acknowledging:
"Such lightweight skill is truly rare in the world. I wonder if Hero Ding would teach it to this humble monk?"
He looked at Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing, smiling to ingratiate:
"Ladies Madam Ding. I hope you can put in a good word for this monk in front of Hero Ding."
He began to change his tone, calling Ding Hero instead.
This shows the impact of the lake battle.
The immense impact it had on Jiu Mozhi!
It made him realize for the first time that a person could be so powerful as to ignore the barrage of arrows! Able to crush thousands of troops!
His heart was filled with feverish excitement!
Duan Yu, however, was somewhat pale, and after reciting the Rebirth Spell several times for the dead, he still felt it was too brutal and cruel.
Ling Yanqiu said:
"They want to kill you. If you don’t kill them, likely you, I, Miss Zhong, and Miss Mu will all die. Do you want us to die?"
Duan Yu, after all, was not an inexperienced novice in Jianghu.
During this time traveling with Ding Ling,
he had broadened his horizons considerably.
He was no longer as pedantic and stubborn as at the start.
He just thought:

"This Jianghu is filled with incessant fighting. If I don’t learn some divine skills to protect myself, if someone wants to harm my Immortal Sister in the future, wouldn’t I just be standing by helplessly?"
Duan Yu was quite remarkable.
No matter what he did or said, he could quickly link it back to his Immortal Sister.
To call him an ’infatuated child’ would be an understatement!
Ding Ling arrived west of Lake Tai.
Here, too, there were a hundred small boats lined up across the lake.

The leading man was tall and burly, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, an imposing eight-foot Great Han. He held a large knife, his eyes coldly watching ahead. When he suddenly saw Ding Ling coming with the old woman, he was surprised, and upon seeing the old woman was Mrs. Yan from Mantuo Manor, his shock increased.
He instantly realized that Gongye Qian’s ambush plan must have failed.
For a moment.
He was both saddened and enraged:
"Shoot the arrows!"
He roared, pointing at Ding Ling:
"Shoot him dead!"
He didn’t care for Mrs. Yan’s life anymore.
In the man’s eyes, Mrs. Yan had betrayed them, so she no longer needed to exist!
She deserved to be eliminated!
Whiz, whiz!
With the man’s order, the sound of bowstrings twanged, turning into a rain of arrows pouring down on Ding Ling. Ding Ling’s gang qi protected him, his hands blocking left and right.
However, not a single arrow could break his defense.
His palm power shattered many arrows, even sending some flying back.
Whiz!
Ding Ling charged forward relentlessly, the arrow rain unable to hinder his steps at all!
The man was shocked and couldn’t help but roar in anger:
"Shoot again!"
Whiz, whiz!

Yet, just as the second wave of arrows shot out, Ding Ling’s speed suddenly surged, boom! Driven by fusion qi, his speed was like a ghost, flashing like lightning, nine figures splitting and merging, changing unpredictably in the void, making it difficult for ordinary people to distinguish which figure was real and which was fake!
Amidst this ever-changing scene, as everyone looked on in bewildered shock,
Ding Ling had already leaped onto a boat, and then, opening his right hand, unleashed the Six Meridian Divine Sword!
The mighty and strong Shaoshang Sword! The skillful and flexible Shangyang Sword! The open and grand Zhongchong Sword! The archaic and ponderous Guanchong Sword! The light and swift Shaoshong Sword!
Were all unleashed by Ding Ling in one breath.
As he opened his right hand, five Sword Qi beams shot out from his fingertips.
Where the Sword Qi passed.
Everything was pierced, destroyed, shattered!

With the man’s order, the sound of bowstrings twanged, turning into a rain of arrows pouring down on Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s gang qi protected him, his hands blocking left and right.
However, not a single arrow could break his defense.
His palm power shattered many arrows, even sending some flying back.
Whiz!
Ding Ling charged forward relentlessly, the arrow rain unable to hinder his steps at all!
The man was shocked and couldn’t help but roar in anger:
"Shoot again!"
Whiz, whiz!
Yet, just as the second wave of arrows shot out, Ding Ling’s speed suddenly surged, boom!

Driven by fusion qi, his speed was like a ghost, flashing like lightning, nine figures splitting and merging, changing unpredictably in the void, making it difficult for ordinary people to distinguish which figure was real and which was fake!
Amidst this ever-changing scene, as everyone looked on in bewildered shock,
Ding Ling had already leaped onto a boat, and then, opening his right hand, unleashed the Six Meridian Divine Sword!
The mighty and strong Shaoshang Sword!
The skillful and flexible Shangyang Sword!
The open and grand Zhongchong Sword!
The archaic and ponderous Guanchong Sword!
The light and swift Shaoshong Sword!
Were all unleashed by Ding Ling in one breath.
As he opened his right hand, five Sword Qi beams shot out from his fingertips.
Where the Sword Qi passed.
Everything was pierced, destroyed, shattered!

chapters.title: Chapter 522 - 521: Sword Qi to Execute the Enemy
paragraphs: The Six Meridian Divine Sword, driven by Fusion Qi, is too domineering, sharp, and unrivaled!
It easily penetrated through a cluster of more than a dozen people!
Five fingers fired in succession!
Ding Ling flew through the air, his right palm spread open, pointing forward!
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
Five strands of Sword Qi shot out, followed by a series of miserable cries!
Ding Ling moved like the Death God on earth, cutting down each person like mowing grass!
And to facilitate absorbing Inner Qi later.
Ding Ling even controlled the Six Meridian Divine Sword to severely injure their organs, leaving them temporarily unable to die!
Swoosh, swoosh!

Ding Ling unleashed Sword Qi repeatedly, and in just a moment, he had dealt with everyone. Then he grabbed the bewildered Mrs. Yanl, who was completely dumbfounded, and flew onto the lead ship, flipping his palm toward the tall man with an imposing stature.
He recognized this person as the leader at a glance.
And through Mrs. Yanl’s introduction,
Ding Ling also knew this person wasn’t anyone else but the head of the Four Great Manors, Deng Baichuan!
A person with extraordinarily high martial arts skills.

However, even such a capable individual, despite exerting all his strength, couldn’t withstand Ding Ling’s casual Splitting Sky Palm, getting knocked down and unable to rise. Ding Ling swiftly advanced beside him using Ripple Step, grabbing his arm!
North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill! Transformation Skill! Storage Skill!
In just a moment.
[Inner Power Value +100]
Compared to Gongye Qian’s power, the North Nether True Qi had removed many impurities, still leaving 100 Inner Power Value points!
And as another North Nether True Qi was generated.
The three North Nether True Qi converged into a drop of North Nether True Water.
[True Power Value: 14 points.]
All cultivation and transformation became even stronger! If Fusion Qi was driven tenfold, an additional amount of Grandmaster’s Power would be added!
Swoosh!

Ding Ling threw Mrs. Yanl onto another ship, rapidly maneuvering Spiral Nine Shadows, Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, and Ripple Step, seeming like a phantom, quickly darting to each ship, absorbing Inner Qi from the figures not dead yet.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +2]
Occasionally, a [Inner Power Value +5] would appear.
This was about third-class experts.
But the Inner Power Heart Method was too weak, with North Nether Divine Skill’s Transformation Skill removing more than ninety percent of impurities!
The remaining thread was barely worthwhile.
Yet the ancient saying goes, gather sand to form a tower, collect fur to make a cloak, accumulate water to form a pond!
When there are many people.
The final effect is also evident.
[Inner Power Value +230]
"This is faster than swallowing pills and refining. North Nether Divine Skill truly is a cheat code in the Martial World."
Ding Ling secretly marveled.
"If someone, like me, has cultivated North Nether Divine Skill to full level, over time, absorbing the Inner Qi of all under heaven for personal use, they would truly be invincible.
But I estimate that ordinary people absolutely can’t achieve this.
Ding Ling’s progress is like a cheat, so he can reach full level.
Ordinary people managing to cultivate North Nether Divine Skill is already very impressive! Let alone reaching full level.
Regarding One Yang Finger, this skill, the members of the Dali Duan Family have the experience of predecessors, practicing for decades, yet unable to reach full level!

And North Nether Divine Skill is much harder than One Yang Finger! How easy is it to attain full level? Without decades of painstaking effort, unless one is a peerless genius, how could it be possible?
So Ding Ling estimates that this cheating-like cultivation method might only be achievable by himself.
Original character Duan Yu couldn’t achieve it, suffering from the torment of various Inner Qi, only later possibly integrating it?
The actual situation.
Perhaps when Duan Yu has cultivated it, and Ding Ling has close contact, can he truly perceive his level of talent?

"Moreover, I have Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Tai Chi Scripture, Small Faceless Skill, etc., with Qi harmoniously settling in the center, also making North Nether Divine Skill’s refinement smooth."
Ding Ling’s Eight Meridians are connected, with each divine skill’s success opening up other meridians.
Now, as he employs Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill, it’s extremely swift, unmatched by anyone.
[Achievement Medal Earned: Intimidating Deng Baichuan.]

[Annotation: Deng Baichuan originally thought this intercept at the lake would catch you off guard! Unexpectedly, he completely underestimated your power, leaving him remorseful and frustrated! If he could do it over, he absolutely wouldn’t cooperate with Madam Wang to intercept and kill you!]
Ding Ling heard the prompt.
His steps paused slightly.
But he did not hesitate.
Instead, he leapt to a ship, grabbed Mrs. Yanl, followed by a Shangyang Sword shot out, thud! Right in Deng Baichuan’s heart meridian, ending him in an instant.
Since they are enemies already.
Why would Ding Ling show mercy?
He then, under Mrs. Yanl’s guidance, found Fengg Bo’e intercepting from the north.
This is the Manor Master of Xuanshuang Manor, his face bearing the marks of hardship, yet his eyes are astonishingly bright!
He too was leading a hundred small boats, with seven to eight hundred people preparing there, each and every one without exception had their bows drawn, evidently well-prepared.
Ding Ling charged forward.
It triggered Fengg Bo’e’s nerves.
Like Deng Baichuan, his first thought was that Gongye Qian might have been defeated, which filled him with sorrow and anger:
"Shoot him to death!"
People of the Jianghu.
Killing is commonplace.
And the Gusu Murong Family was the overlord in this generation, the number of people they had killed was not few.
Fengg Bo’e was evidently a decisive killer as well, with an angry shout, he also followed the others, drawing his bow and aiming an arrow at Ding Ling, whoosh!

An arrow faster than ordinary ones shot fiercely towards Ding Ling’s face, Ding Ling neither dodged nor blinked, as it was about to hit him in the face, Fengg Bo’e couldn’t help but reveal a cold smile.
But quickly, his cold smile froze on his face.
It was because Ding Ling actually grabbed the incoming arrow with his hand, then reversely threw it heavily back towards his position.
The speed of the arrow being thrown back by Ding Ling was even faster.
Whoosh!

Like thunder and lightning, Fengg Bo’e only had time to instinctively lower his head slightly, swoosh! The arrow grazed his scalp, taking with it a small tuft of hair, leaving slight bloodstains, puff!
Ah!
A scream came from behind.

Fengg Bo’e, suppressing the discomfort on his scalp, instinctively turned his head, unable to refrain from his pupils contracting, seeing that the confidant behind him had an arrow through his neck, which had also shot through three more people, finally carrying one person off the small boat!
The power of one arrow!
It was unbelievably formidable to such an extent!
"Be careful!"
Fengg Bo’e roared.
"Don’t let him get close! Circle around him, shoot him!"
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Especially when the rain of arrows apparently couldn’t harm Ding Ling one bit, Fengg Bo’e’s scalp went numb. When had he ever seen such a person?
The young master of their family, how much inferior must he be compared to this person!
Both are young people!
Why is he so terrifying?!
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
The boatmen were all skilled hands, speeding rapidly away from Ding Ling.
Ding Ling laughed heartily, stepping on the waves at high speed, constantly deflecting or slicing arrows and arrow rain as he got closer, he spread his palm!
Six Meridian Divine Sword!
Shaoshang Sword, Shangyang Sword, Zhongchong Sword, Guanchong Sword, Shaochong Sword!
Once again displayed their might!
The sword qi blazed through the sky! Shooting like thunderbolts!
In just an instant, it could pierce through a wide area!
If people gathered together, they would be swiftly crushed, destroyed, and annihilated in seconds!
"What kind of sword skill is this!"

Fengg Bo’e was extremely shocked, for the first time feeling regret and remorse in his heart. Had he known Ding Ling was so formidable and terrifying, he would never have participated in this encirclement battle.
No.

He had long heard from some aliens of a mighty person like Ding Ling, but unfortunately, he hadn’t taken it to heart, thinking it must be exaggerated, believing that no matter how strong someone was in the world, they could never withstand the combined archers of the Four Great Manors!
However...
He ultimately underestimated Ding Ling! Ding Ling was even more terrifying than what the aliens had described!
Is this person a god?
How old is he?!
Why so terrifying!
"Retreat!"
Fengg Bo’e roared! But he had decided on a temporary strategic retreat!
"Think you can escape? It’s not that easy."
Ding Ling’s speed was unparalleled, his nine forms quickly splitting and merging, ghost-like and extremely swift! In just a few flashes, he advanced over a hundred meters, arriving before Fengg Bo’e.
And in his shock, with a casual Splitting Sky Palm, he struck out.
Pa!

Hit right on Fengg Bo’e’s rapidly approaching palm. The two palms clashed for less than half a breath, Fengg Bo’e’s hand was crushed, he screamed in pain, Ding Ling ignored him, seizing the opportunity to activate the North Nether Divine Skill.
In another instant.
Fengg Bo’e’s entire skill was utterly absorbed!
In the Grandmaster Realm using the full-level North Nether Divine Skill, it truly only takes an instant to absorb the inner strength of a common first-class expert!
[Inner Strength +92]
Very evidently.
Fengg Bo’e was slightly inferior to Deng Baichuan, yet slightly stronger than Gongye Qian.
In terms of inner strength, they might be comparable.
However, the inner power heart techniques they cultivated varied in strength, hence the impurities also varied in quantity.

chapters.title: Chapter 523 - 522: Annihilation
paragraphs: The North Nether True Qi transformed by the North Nether Divine Skill naturally has varying amounts.
[True Power Value: 15 points]
After absorbing Feng Bo’e’s inner strength, unexpectedly, another stream of North Nether True Qi emerged, forming a unity of three, adding a point of North Nether True Water!
True Power Value increased once again!
Ding Ling copied the technique meticulously.
He swiftly moved to other small boats and began to rapidly absorb using the North Nether Divine Skill.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +2]
[Inner Power Value +1]
In just a short moment.
Ding Ling’s figure moved unpredictably, sometimes forward, sometimes backward, sometimes left, sometimes right, truly like a ghostly illusion, at times becoming too fast for the naked eye!
Feng Bo’e was dumbfounded.
He could clearly sense Ding Ling’s aura continuously rising.
"This, this is not, not the Transformation Technique?!"
"It seems it can absorb others’ inner strength for one’s own use?!"
"What kind of divine skill is this?! How can there be such a miraculous technique under heaven?!"
Feng Bo’e gasped in shock, his gaze toward Ding Ling changing again and again.
At this moment, he seemed to suddenly realize why Ding Ling, though young, possessed such deep and overwhelming inner power!
With such a divine skill.
Even a pig could become an absolute expert!
But he was wrong; Ding Ling’s power did not have much to do with one North Nether Divine Skill.
[Inner Power Value +180]
Many people have died.
Even though Ding Ling had controlled it very well.
However, with his power continuously rising, the Six Meridian Divine Sword’s might grew stronger, often with one sword shot out, it’s hard to say how many would be wounded or die!
Some of the injured, even if they could hold out for a while, probably wouldn’t last long.
This is also the reason why Ding Ling speeds up absorbing their inner strength.
If he doesn’t absorb.
These people probably wouldn’t last long before dying.

The power of the Six Meridian Divine Sword is too great; once it enters the body, strands of sword qi continually roam around a person’s wounds, causing them to rush headlong towards Death God’s territory.
This point Ding Ling couldn’t help.
He’s already done the best he could to control the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
Can only say once the Six Meridian Divine Sword emerges!
Under his Grandmaster level power’s activation, it truly sweeps apart all in its path, leaving few alive.
Ding Ling also thought of using other techniques to kill the enemy.
But there were seven to eight hundred of them.
Using other methods to kill would be inefficient.
Rely on Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms?
Probably one palm down.
A whole boat of people would be knocked into the lake!
Then, heavily injured, they’d all sink to the lake bottom; Ding Ling couldn’t possibly go down one by one to absorb inner strength, could he?
Not to mention the likelihood is low.
Even if he went to the lake’s bottom, he’d probably encounter corpses. Heavily injured, what good outcome would there be from sinking into the lake?
Therefore, Ding Ling uses the Six Meridian Divine Sword to kill or wound the enemy.
Directly heavily injuring them on the boat, unable to move!
Convenient, fast, and swift!
It’s truly like a lawnmower!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidation of Feng Bo’e]
Upon hearing the notification sound.
Ding Ling’s steps slightly paused, then turned back, executed a Shaoze Sword, ended Feng Bo’e, grabbed Mrs. Yan and moved south of Lake Tai.

His speed was like the wind and lightning, as his strength soared, his Ripple Step and Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique came into play, even faster and swifter, his speed at least improved by one or two percent!
An improvement of one or two percent is no small matter.
Ding Ling was already extremely fast; now it’s just a moment, under Mrs. Yan’s guide, he found Bao Butong’s fleet.
This fleet’s numbers were about the same as before.
Leading them was Bao Butong, a man with a stubborn expression, over seven feet tall, slightly chubby body.

Upon seeing Mrs. Yan, and recalling the signal flares sent earlier from afar, he couldn’t help but feel a jolt, pondered a possibility, and his heart surged with killing intent, couldn’t help but shouting loudly:
"Who goes there!"
"Your killer!"
Ding Ling’s voice was powerful, akin to the tremor of swords clanging, filled with a voice of iron-blooded slaughter.
"Fire arrows!"
Bao Butong’s pupils shrank, he no longer said ’Not True, Not True,’ gave a loud shout, and from all directions his men drew bows, shooting arrows toward Ding Ling’s direction furiously.
In an instant, arrows rained down!
Completely enveloping Ding Ling; with this situation, how could Ding Ling not die?
Bao Butong had just relaxed.
But in the next moment.
He couldn’t help but his pupils shrinking.
Only to see Mrs. Yan already shot into a sieve, but Ding Ling remained unscathed, and couldn’t help but feel a shock in his heart, and shouted angrily:
"Keep shooting! Don’t stop!"
Ding Ling discarded Mrs. Yan’s corpse, having found everyone, Mrs. Yan was no longer needed, so he straightforwardly grabbed her to block a wave of arrow rain.
Now the second wave of arrow rain was about to arrive, Ding Ling chose to ignore it, advancing rapidly, speed unparalleled, ding, ding, dang, dang!
Arrows struck his body, making crisp sounds, unable to break his Gang Qi Defense Shield.
Frightened Bao Butong cried out, ’Are you human or ghost!’
In his view, how could people in the world possibly ignore the rain of arrows! What a shocking martial arts cultivation this is!

With a burst of speed, under the stimulation of Fusion Qi, Ding Ling’s figure became indistinct, as if he turned into a flash of lightning and rushed to Bao Butong’s front. Then, with a twist of his figure, he fiercely grabbed Bao’s shoulder.
North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill! Transformation Skill! Storage Skill!
It was just a moment.
[Inner Power Value +93]
[True Power Value 16 points.]
In just a moment, a strand of North Nether True Qi emerged again, thus three merged into one drop of North Nether True Water, and the True Power Value naturally rose again!
Clank! Clank! Clank!
After the boost in strength.
Ding Ling spread his two palms.
Right hand Shaoshang Sword, Shangyang Sword, Zhongchong Sword, Guanchong Sword, Shaoshong Sword, left hand Shaoze Sword!
Six swords manifested together!
Wherever they passed.
One by one, the sturdy ruffians toppled over on the boat.
Screams, muffled groans, and howls were unending.
Some even attempted to jump into the water to escape for their lives.
But no matter how fast they were.
They were not faster than Ding Ling’s Six Meridian Divine Sword.
Indeed, it felt like thunder, one moment they were ready to jump, the next, they were struck down heavily injured onto the boat by the Six Meridian Divine Sword, almost unable to move!
He was extraordinarily efficient at killing and injuring enemies, a rarity in the world.
Bao Butong was dumbstruck, momentarily forgetting the fact that his inner strength had been completely absorbed.
He possessed high skill.
Yet, Ding Ling’s skill far surpassed his by fifty times, a hundred times even?

Especially with the current enhancement of skill, his ghostly figure was difficult to see with the naked eye, Bao Butong even merely struck, Ding Ling had already circled behind him, grabbed his shoulder, and drained his inner strength!
So fast it was impossible to react.
Puff! Puff!
Sword Qi filled the skies, dazzling and blinding!
After a short while, the sword Qi stopped, then Bao Butong saw Ding Ling flying over each small boat, reaching out to touch one person after another who was on the brink of death from the estate.
And as Ding Ling continuously made contact, his aura continuously surged and grew.
Bao Butong looked amazed, muttering to himself:
’What is this divine skill?! It can absorb others’ power for oneself?!’
Puff!
A strand of sword Qi suddenly shot across the air, directly hitting Bao Butong’s forehead, and Bao fell dead on the boat instantly.
At the time of death.
He was unwilling and regretful!
Such a formidable foe!
Why provoke him?!
Moreover, attempting to ambush him, which was simply foolish beyond belief!
But the great mistake was already made, and it couldn’t be changed!
[Inner Power Value +150]
[Achievement Medal Obtained: Intimidating Bao Butong.]
Adding to the previous Inner Power Value.
Two more strands of North Nether True Qi emerged in Ding Ling’s Dantian.
Just one more, and he could condense another drop of North Nether True Water.
Progressing at such a speed.
It’s just like riding a rocket.
"If this continues, perhaps in not long, I might reach the realm of Grandmaster Level."
Ding Ling pondered.
This was beyond his expectations.
He originally thought he would need to overwhelm a country, gain a large amount of Great Medicine, only then he could cultivate to the Grandmaster Level.
Now it seems.
With North Nether Divine Skill, he might be able to reach the Grandmaster Level much earlier.
"Brother Ding!"
Duan Yu’s voice came, and Ding Ling looked in the direction, seeing Duan Yu and his party already sailing towards him, he then leaped, soaring tens of zhang, lightly landing on the bow of the ship:
"It’s resolved. Let’s continue the journey."
Jiu Mozhi scanned the scene, his heart trembling, speechless, just clasped his hands together, and respectfully said:
"Hero Ding, your divine skill is unrivaled. I, a humble monk, am truly in awe! If there’s anything you need of me, Hero Ding, please speak, I will exert my full effort!"
Ding Ling nodded unfazed, and immediately the party continued their journey.
Along the way, witnessing the tragic state of Bao Butong and others.

Duan Yu felt a sense of unease, for Ding Ling’s methods, he unconsciously developed a sense of awe, making him less inclined to joke around casually. He never thought that Brother Ding, who usually seemed so amicable, turned out to be so decisive and formidable in battle! It really frightened him!
However, Ling Yanqiu admired Ding Ling greatly. She understood the principle that hesitation harms oneself and others. To enemies, naturally, decisive and lethal actions are necessary.

As for Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling, they didn’t think much of it; to them, Ding Ling’s safety was the ultimate good. Those who wanted to kill them naturally deserved death, Ding Ling was avenging them, so how could they take the side of outsiders?
The waters of Lake Tai were clear.
Yet, with the death of thousands.
Blood soaked into the wooden boats, flowed into Lake Tai, and the original lake gradually turned scarlet.
Many players and natives who inadvertently witnessed this scene lost their color.
Some turned their boats around and fled, some moved forward to investigate...
Human behaviors varied greatly, in numerous ways.
But undeniably, as news spread of Ding Ling’s slaughter across Lake Tai, the day Ding Ling’s name shook the world was not far off.

sentences.text: The North Nether True Qi transformed by the North Nether Divine Skill naturally has varying amounts.
[True Power Value: 15 points]
After absorbing Feng Bo’e’s inner strength, unexpectedly, another stream of North Nether True Qi emerged, forming a unity of three, adding a point of North Nether True Water!
True Power Value increased once again!
Ding Ling copied the technique meticulously.
He swiftly moved to other small boats and began to rapidly absorb using the North Nether Divine Skill.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +2]
[Inner Power Value +1]
In just a short moment.
Ding Ling’s figure moved unpredictably, sometimes forward, sometimes backward, sometimes left, sometimes right, truly like a ghostly illusion, at times becoming too fast for the naked eye!
Feng Bo’e was dumbfounded.
He could clearly sense Ding Ling’s aura continuously rising.
"This, this is not, not the Transformation Technique?!"
"It seems it can absorb others’ inner strength for one’s own use?!"
"What kind of divine skill is this?!
How can there be such a miraculous technique under heaven?!"
Feng Bo’e gasped in shock, his gaze toward Ding Ling changing again and again.
At this moment, he seemed to suddenly realize why Ding Ling, though young, possessed such deep and overwhelming inner power!
With such a divine skill.
Even a pig could become an absolute expert!
But he was wrong; Ding Ling’s power did not have much to do with one North Nether Divine Skill.
[Inner Power Value +180]
Many people have died.
Even though Ding Ling had controlled it very well.
However, with his power continuously rising, the Six Meridian Divine Sword’s might grew stronger, often with one sword shot out, it’s hard to say how many would be wounded or die!
Some of the injured, even if they could hold out for a while, probably wouldn’t last long.
This is also the reason why Ding Ling speeds up absorbing their inner strength.
If he doesn’t absorb.
These people probably wouldn’t last long before dying.

The power of the Six Meridian Divine Sword is too great; once it enters the body, strands of sword qi continually roam around a person’s wounds, causing them to rush headlong towards Death God’s territory.
This point Ding Ling couldn’t help.
He’s already done the best he could to control the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
Can only say once the Six Meridian Divine Sword emerges!
Under his Grandmaster level power’s activation, it truly sweeps apart all in its path, leaving few alive.
Ding Ling also thought of using other techniques to kill the enemy.
But there were seven to eight hundred of them.
Using other methods to kill would be inefficient.
Rely on Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms?
Probably one palm down.
A whole boat of people would be knocked into the lake!
Then, heavily injured, they’d all sink to the lake bottom; Ding Ling couldn’t possibly go down one by one to absorb inner strength, could he?
Not to mention the likelihood is low.
Even if he went to the lake’s bottom, he’d probably encounter corpses.
Heavily injured, what good outcome would there be from sinking into the lake?
Therefore, Ding Ling uses the Six Meridian Divine Sword to kill or wound the enemy.
Directly heavily injuring them on the boat, unable to move!
Convenient, fast, and swift!
It’s truly like a lawnmower!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidation of Feng Bo’e]
Upon hearing the notification sound.
Ding Ling’s steps slightly paused, then turned back, executed a Shaoze Sword, ended Feng Bo’e, grabbed Mrs.
Yan and moved south of Lake Tai.

His speed was like the wind and lightning, as his strength soared, his Ripple Step and Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique came into play, even faster and swifter, his speed at least improved by one or two percent!
An improvement of one or two percent is no small matter.
Ding Ling was already extremely fast; now it’s just a moment, under Mrs.
Yan’s guide, he found Bao Butong’s fleet.
This fleet’s numbers were about the same as before.
Leading them was Bao Butong, a man with a stubborn expression, over seven feet tall, slightly chubby body.
Upon seeing Mrs.
Yan, and recalling the signal flares sent earlier from afar, he couldn’t help but feel a jolt, pondered a possibility, and his heart surged with killing intent, couldn’t help but shouting loudly:
"Who goes there!"
"Your killer!"
Ding Ling’s voice was powerful, akin to the tremor of swords clanging, filled with a voice of iron-blooded slaughter.
"Fire arrows!"
Bao Butong’s pupils shrank, he no longer said ’Not True, Not True,’ gave a loud shout, and from all directions his men drew bows, shooting arrows toward Ding Ling’s direction furiously.
In an instant, arrows rained down!
Completely enveloping Ding Ling; with this situation, how could Ding Ling not die?
Bao Butong had just relaxed.
But in the next moment.
He couldn’t help but his pupils shrinking.
Only to see Mrs.
Yan already shot into a sieve, but Ding Ling remained unscathed, and couldn’t help but feel a shock in his heart, and shouted angrily:
"Keep shooting!
Don’t stop!"
Ding Ling discarded Mrs.
Yan’s corpse, having found everyone, Mrs.
Yan was no longer needed, so he straightforwardly grabbed her to block a wave of arrow rain.
Now the second wave of arrow rain was about to arrive, Ding Ling chose to ignore it, advancing rapidly, speed unparalleled, ding, ding, dang, dang!
Arrows struck his body, making crisp sounds, unable to break his Gang Qi Defense Shield.
Frightened Bao Butong cried out, ’Are you human or ghost!’
In his view, how could people in the world possibly ignore the rain of arrows!
What a shocking martial arts cultivation this is!
With a burst of speed, under the stimulation of Fusion Qi, Ding Ling’s figure became indistinct, as if he turned into a flash of lightning and rushed to Bao Butong’s front.
Then, with a twist of his figure, he fiercely grabbed Bao’s shoulder.
North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
It was just a moment.
[Inner Power Value +93]
[True Power Value 16 points.]
In just a moment, a strand of North Nether True Qi emerged again, thus three merged into one drop of North Nether True Water, and the True Power Value naturally rose again!
Clank!
Clank!
Clank!
After the boost in strength.

Right hand Shaoshang Sword, Shangyang Sword, Zhongchong Sword, Guanchong Sword, Shaoshong Sword, left hand Shaoze Sword!
Six swords manifested together!
Wherever they passed.

He was extraordinarily efficient at killing and injuring enemies, a rarity in the world.

He possessed high skill.

So fast it was impossible to react.

Puff!
Sword Qi filled the skies, dazzling and blinding!

Puff!
A strand of sword Qi suddenly shot across the air, directly hitting Bao Butong’s forehead, and Bao fell dead on the boat instantly.
At the time of death.
He was unwilling and regretful!
Such a formidable foe!
Why provoke him?!
Moreover, attempting to ambush him, which was simply foolish beyond belief!
But the great mistake was already made, and it couldn’t be changed!

[Achievement Medal Obtained: Intimidating Bao Butong.]
Adding to the previous Inner Power Value.
Two more strands of North Nether True Qi emerged in Ding Ling’s Dantian.
Just one more, and he could condense another drop of North Nether True Water.
Progressing at such a speed.
It’s just like riding a rocket.
"If this continues, perhaps in not long, I might reach the realm of Grandmaster Level."
Ding Ling pondered.
This was beyond his expectations.
He originally thought he would need to overwhelm a country, gain a large amount of Great Medicine, only then he could cultivate to the Grandmaster Level.
Now it seems.
With North Nether Divine Skill, he might be able to reach the Grandmaster Level much earlier.
"Brother Ding!"
Duan Yu’s voice came, and Ding Ling looked in the direction, seeing Duan Yu and his party already sailing towards him, he then leaped, soaring tens of zhang, lightly landing on the bow of the ship:
"It’s resolved.
Let’s continue the journey."

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - 523: Crane Controlling Art Full Level
paragraphs: Ding Ling changed his route temporarily, giving up on going directly to Mantuo Manor and instead heading to Canhe Manor at Gusu Yanzimu.
The Returning Water Pavilion was located here.
Various martial arts secret manuals were hidden inside.
Having killed the Four Great Manor Masters, Ding Ling knew Canhe Manor would be empty, presenting the perfect opportunity to visit the secret scrolls of the Returning Water Pavilion.
Splash!
The boat sailed swiftly through the waves, propelled by Ding Ling’s Fusion Qi.
Before long.
He arrived at Canhe Manor.
Ding Ling led the way onto the shore.
His vision was exceptionally keen, allowing him a glimpse of many people inside the manor.

Most of these individuals were young women, either watering flowers, engaging in various chores, or simply reading and playing guqin, harmonizing with the unique and beautiful scenery of the manor, creating an almost idyllic paradise.
The intrusion of Ding Ling and his party shattered this tranquility.
A delicate-featured woman, fair as jade and dressed in green, put down her guqin, gracefully approached, first saluting Ding Ling’s group before softly speaking:
"I wonder what business brings you to Canhe Manor? Our master is not here, so it is inconvenient to host such esteemed guests."
Her voice, sweet and lilting in the soft Wu dialect, felt like a warm current passing through the heart.
Ding Ling paused and asked:
"Who are you?"
"My name is Abi."
The woman replied softly:
"And you are?"
"We have come this time to view the secret scrolls of the Returning Water Pavilion."
Recognizing her as Abi, Ding Ling sighed inwardly and did not conceal the truth, frankly saying:

"The Four Great Manor Masters under your Canhe Manor, such as Bao Butong and Fengg Bo’e, tried to kill me and I killed them. I am here now to visit the Returning Water Pavilion. I do not wish to kill anymore. So, could you please lead the way?"
"You, you, you..."
Abi was taken aback, her face colorless, as she staggered back two steps, gazing at Ding Ling’s group with disbelief: "You, you, this, this..."
"Forget it."
Ding Ling snapped his finger.
One Yang Finger!
He hit Abi’s Sleeping Acupoint.
Abi immediately let out a soft groan, collapsing to the ground, unconscious.
Ding Ling had a fondness for Abi.
Whether in TV series or novels, Abi was always a gentle, kind-hearted, and pure young woman.
Yet, such a girl was wholeheartedly devoted to Murong Fu, unwavering in her loyalty.
Ding Ling had no intention of killing her.
After all, this matter had nothing to do with her from start to finish.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling motioned for Ling Yanqiu to settle Abi.
Then the group continued forward.
This time Ding Ling captured another old servant and demanded he lead the way.

This person, appearing to be in his sixties or seventies, possessed some martial power, but when Ding Ling used the North Nether Divine Skill to absorb him, his inner strength was almost completely depleted.
[Inner Power Value +5]
He was nonetheless a third-rate expert.
But unfortunately, his inner strength was rife with impurities.
More than ninety percent was transformed away.
He tried to attack Ding Ling, but how could Ding Ling be courteous? Just in need of a guide, he captured him and let him lead the way.
This old man, fearing for his life, after his inner strength was drained, despite his horror and shock, he became timid and obedient, doing whatever Ding Ling instructed.
Twisting and turning along the way.
They reached a secret library.
The door was tightly locked.
A plaque hanging above the door read: "Returning Water Pavilion"
Ding Ling was delighted and casually struck with a Splitting Sky Palm. Bang! The door shattered, and Ding Ling waved his hand, sweeping aside the scattered wood chips.
Once inside the library.
He looked around.
Indeed. Rich and abundant, a dazzling array of books all around.
There were several dozen bookshelves.
Each was filled with secret scrolls.
Ding Ling walked straight to the first bookshelf, picked up a book "Five Tigers Breaking Gate Blade Technique"
Quickly skimmed through it.
[Five Tigers Breaking Gate Blade Technique Full Level]
The four-dimensional attribute points remained unchanged.
Ding Ling perceived briefly, knowing it was merely a third-rate martial arts secret manual.
He didn’t think much of it.
With so many martial arts secret manuals here, certainly the vast majority were second-rate and third-rate.
A first-class secret manual would truly be remarkable.
Ding Ling picked up another book "Eighteen Woodcutter Techniques"
Splash!
Reading swiftly with eyes like lightning, the book was finished in a few breaths.
[Eighteen Woodcutter Techniques Full Level!]
Ding Ling continued to read on.
One by one, all were quickly read by him.
Everything was maxed out.
But the secret scrolls on the first bookshelf were evidently all third-rate.
He read them all.
His foundation deepened considerably, the Martial Arts Melting Furnace body became clearer.
He moved on to the second bookshelf.
Took up another book.
"Back Mountain’s Three Ultimate Techniques"
Quickly finished reading.
[Back Mountain’s Three Ultimate Techniques Full Level]
Also a second-rate Cultivation Technique.
It held no benefit for Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attribute points enhancement.
Now, only the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills and other high-tier martial arts could improve Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attribute points.
Continued to flip through.
Soon another bookshelf’s secret scrolls were finished.
All second-rate, third-rate Cultivation Techniques.
Over a hundred books in total.
Completing the readings, his foundation grew stronger, the furnace body of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace became clearer, and his control over Vigorous Qi became more natural and skillful.
Ding Ling swiftly flipped through the bookshelves, examining the booklets.
Jiu Mozhi, among others, also began perusing the secret scrolls on the bookshelves Ding Ling had already reviewed.

Jiu Mozhi was overjoyed. He hadn’t expected to have such fortune by following Ding Ling! This only confirmed his resolve to cling to this opportunity. As for his old friendship with Murong Bo? Sorry, Murong Bo was dead, and Jiu Mozhi, being a sensible and rational Martial Fanatic, naturally knew to adapt to the times! Thus, he turned wholly towards Ding Ling!

Ling Yanqiu also looked around but was not particularly interested. For her, all the Breathing Techniques and martial arts she mastered had not yet been cultivated to full level, practicing more would only lead to biting off more than one could chew. She also had no time to practice these Techniques.
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing were mostly curious.
Duan Yu, on the other hand, was preoccupied with the thought ’When will Brother Ding take me to meet the Immortal Sister?’

Seeing Ding Ling so engrossed in martial arts, he couldn’t help but reflect, ’Brother Ding is already so powerful and is still exhausting himself to improve. I spend every day in leisure, wasting my youth, is this really okay?’

Thinking about whether the Immortal Sister might despise him for being a Martial Dao failure in the future, he felt a tightness in his heart, walked to one side, drew out the secret scrolls of North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step from his bosom, and began to read.
He had good discernment, knowing these two martial arts were certainly top divine skills worth learning.
Jiu Mozhi, however, did not recognize this, now lost in various third-rate and second-rate secret scrolls, unable to extricate himself.
After a period of time.
Ding Ling finished reading all seven or eight hundred of the third-rate and second-rate secret scrolls.
Came to the last bookshelf. Where he saw the first-class secret scrolls.
"Crane Controlling Art"
Ding Ling quickly finished reading.
[Crane Controlling Art Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This unexpectedly was a superior high-tier Technique.
Once mastered, it could control some objects from a distance.
It had some similarities with Xiao Feng’s ’Dragon Capturing Skill’ from the TV.
