chapters.title: Chapter 525 - 524: Full Level Star Shifting
paragraphs: Ding Ling never expected to learn such a Divine Skill here and felt quite joyful about it.
This Divine Skill, which he had never learned before, promised to effortlessly enhance his ability to grab and handle objects from a distance.
After testing it out, he found, indeed, that he could easily seize a chair ten meters away by wielding the Vigorous Qi of the Crane Controlling Art, quickly pulling it to his side.
Such a miraculous Technique was indeed extraordinary.
Ding Ling nodded to himself.
He placed the Technique of the Crane Controlling Art into the Storage Pouch, planning to leave it for Mu Wanqing and others to cultivate.
No need to say more.
This Technique had an extremely high cultivation difficulty.
The threshold for cultivation required at least First-class Inner Power level!
Otherwise, it would be impossible to grab objects in the air.
The higher the cultivation of Inner Strength, the heavier the things that could be seized.

Moreover, there were various harsh requirements for this Technique, which could bewilder even an Innate Expert without guidance. Only someone like Ding Ling, with his superior Grandmaster insights, could pinpoint issues and suggest solutions, helping others break through and reach the cultivation threshold.
"Originally, I could also release Qi Force to grab objects, but never this effortlessly and freely."
Ding Ling’s spirits lifted, and he continued to flip through.
Soon, he finished another book.
[Returning Wind Willow Saber Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was also a High Tier Saber Technique.
Continuing.
[Demon Suppression Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
One book after another finished.
Most of them were First-class Secret Manuals.
Totaling over twenty books.

Over thirty books were barely entering the First-class threshold, and after Ding Ling read them, they all reached full level, though these Secret Manuals no longer provided him with Four-dimensional Attribute Points.
At last.
Ding Ling’s Four-dimensional Attribute Points increased to:
[Strength +2.1]
[Agility +2.1]
[Constitution +2.1]
Very balanced.
Even though most of these Secret Manuals were High Tier First-class, they were quite inferior compared to superior Techniques like the Crane Controlling Art.
However, being able to increase so many attribute points was excellent for Ding Ling.
He glanced at the Character Panel:
[Bone Structure 5 (ordinary people have 1 point), Wisdom 5, Strength 66, Agility 66.3, Constitution 72.7, Defense 60, Charm 12.4, True Power Value: 16 points]
Strength and Agility were close to climbing to 70 points.
Now Ding Ling didn’t need Breathing Technique or Inner Power, relying solely on brute force to make some First-class Experts bleed profusely!
Utilizing Breathing Technique.
No need to say more.
With Breathing Technique and Inner Power combined, few in the world could match him!
"Strange. Where are Star Shifting and Canhe Finger?"
Ding Ling began activating the ’Stargazing Skill,’ ’Array-Related Skills,’ and ’Mechanical Skill’ abilities.
Under the ’Eyes of Golden Flame.’
Before long.
He discovered something peculiar.
Immediately walked to the southeast corner, crouched down slightly, and knocked on the floor tile, indeed it was different!

Afraid that using Martial Arts like Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms would damage the Secret Manuals, he took out the Giant Que Sword and pried the floor tile up with the tip of the sword, his strength undeniable.
Easily prying up piece by piece of floor tile.

Then digging some earth, two feet under, he indeed touched a metal box, speeding up, he dug out all the soil from two feet below, then reached down, pulled out a metal box, wiped off the dirt on the box with his hands, and gently pointed with his index finger at the lock side of the box, Shangyang Sword Qi shot out, clang!
The iron lock broke.
Ding Ling opened the metal box.
Sure enough, he saw several Secret Manuals inside, along with several Treasure Beads emitting radiant light.
"What is this?!"
Jiu Mozhi, hearing the commotion, had already hurried over to watch, now finally seeing the treasures inside the metal box, couldn’t help but feel a bit excited.
He truly hadn’t expected Ding Ling to be so defiant of heaven.
Even capable of uncovering treasures hidden deeply by the Murong Clan!
If he were to try, he’d be groping in the dark! Treasures before him, unaware!
"Star Shifting!"
Ling Yanqiu’s eyes shone brightly, immediately recognizing the name of the top Secret Manual.
"It’s Star Shifting!"
Jiu Mozhi’s breathing became labored.
Compared to other Martial Arts.
This Star Shifting was truly the Unparalleled Martial Arts worth cultivating!
He looked imploringly at Ding Ling, hoping that Ding Ling would have mercy!
Ding Ling ignored him, continuing to browse on his own.
He usually did this to avoid prolonged delays and unexpected events, starting to read immediately once he got a Secret Manual, anyway with cheat skills, reading led to full level in no time!
Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t leave it for later.
Rustle!
Reading books like flipping through pages.
Soon.
As the library added another book.
[Star Shifting Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.3]
In an instant, Star Shifting reached the Great Perfection Innate Ability level.
Ding Ling savored the feeling carefully.
Discovering this Star Shifting indeed extraordinary.

Using power to counter power, no matter what martial arts the opponent uses, it can deflect the force back onto the opponent! Whether it’s inner strength, weapons, or fists and feet, they can all be redirected by the Star Shifting, causing the opponent to suffer the consequences!
Especially Ding Ling.
After reaching full level.
The force coming from the opponent can be bounced back as long as it does not exceed his!
Especially since Ding Ling has mastered the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts, any attack within them can be easily countered and bounced back by him!
As long as the opponent’s cultivation does not surpass his, he can stand still and let others hit him without getting hurt!
"Truly remarkable."
Ding Ling nodded in secret.
This Star Shifting is akin to the Tai Chi Scripture!
Except Tai Chi focuses on using little to move much, using stillness to control movement, and softness to counteract hardness!
While Star Shifting focuses on reflection!
Both have extremely high defense! Once executed, it’s difficult for others to break through the defense, but the nuances differ.
Especially after reaching full level.
This difference becomes relatively apparent.
But Ding Ling estimated that mastering Star Shifting to full level would take decades of grinding effort.
Only upon reaching the full level can one feel the power and unrivaled might of this technique!
The Great Perfection stage of Star Shifting can’t freely reflect the opponent’s attacks, only full level can!
Ding Ling finished reading Star Shifting.
He then picked up the next.
And quickly finished it as well.
[Canhe Finger Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
After reaching full level.
Ding Ling also realized the power of this finger technique, its air attacks being no less potent than the One Yang Finger.
Moreover, the Qi Force unleashed by this finger technique is invisible and formless, making it difficult for ordinary people to detect.
It’s just that the difficulty of mastering this finger technique is similar to that of the One Yang Finger!
Reaching full level is as hard as reaching the heavens! Even for a peerless genius, it’s impossible to reach full level without diligently studying for decades!
Yet Ding Ling reached full level in an instant.
He extended his index finger, pointing invisibly towards a wall, and where the finger wind passed, there was a whizzing sound!
The walls, several feet thick, were instantly pierced through!
The walls of the Returning Water Pavilion where the secret manuals are stored are specially made, extremely wide and thick.
Yet they were pierced by the invisible Qi Force of Canhe Finger!
Jiu Mozhi looked stupefied.

Duan Yu was envious, thinking: "I read North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step for so long, and only gained a little. Yet Brother Ding not only read all the secret manuals, but it seems he has also practiced Murong Clan’s Star Shifting and Canhe Finger to an extraordinary level!
This kind of innate talent is truly out of reach for me.
If I, Duan Yu, could have such talent, how wonderful it would be. Then I wouldn’t have to study diligently. I would only need to spend a little time, and I might become a peerless expert."

Ling Yanqiu, Zhong Ling, and Mu Wanqing were equally moved, but having frequently seen Ding Ling succeed quickly in learning various divine skills, they were much more composed, almost as if accustomed to it, feeling it normal for Ding Ling to master things rapidly.
Jiu Mozhi, though having seen it a few times, still couldn’t remain calm. He just looked at Ding Ling with wide eyes, with a clear meaning.
Ding Ling picked up a Treasure Bead and looked at it for a couple of moments, was it a Luminous Pearl?
It’s not necessarily worth as much as a city, but it’s definitely significant.
Ding Ling put it away, placing it into his Storage Pouch.
To Jiu Mozhi, Ding Ling’s Storage Pouch seemed like a divine object, and seeing Ding Ling put away treasure and secret manuals now led to regret, but he dared not entertain such thoughts.
Ding Ling’s gaze was like a torch, penetrating people’s minds, a fact that Jiu Mozhi had long been aware of, hence he dared not harbor any ulterior motives in Ding Ling’s presence.
"There are two more secret manuals."
Ding Ling picked them up and examined them carefully.
[Murong Clan’s Inherited Sword Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Just a superior high-tier sword technique.
Compared to ordinary first-class secret manuals, though much stronger, it pales compared to Star Shifting and Canhe Finger.
The second one.
[Murong Clan’s Inherited Inner Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Whoosh whoosh!
Endless Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi surged forth.
Engulfing Ding Ling.
Seeing this scene.
Jiu Mozhi and Duan Yu couldn’t help but feel a twinge in their teeth.
This state is obvious.
Ding Ling undoubtedly cultivated an inner power to an extremely profound level, otherwise, it wouldn’t induce such a rush of Heaven and Earth’s Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi!
"Truly enviable. Such talent is truly unmatched, rarely seen through the ages!"
Jiu Mozhi was filled with envy.
His heart was extremely sour.
Comparing himself to Ding Ling.
He felt like a worthless person! The longer he followed Ding Ling, the more evident this feeling became.
He was deeply moved by it.

Especially seeing Ding Ling, despite his great talent, still diligently cultivating martial arts and never speaking arrogantly, he even considered him a role model, feeling that he must learn to be as humble, brave, and fierce as Ding Ling in the future.
[True Power Value: 17 Points]
In Ding Ling’s Dantian, a stream of North Nether True Qi instantly appeared, merging together, forming North Nether True Water, and the True Power value rose again.
"I have grown stronger again."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, thinking:
"If this continues, becoming a Grandmaster is truly just within reach."
Ding Ling felt he was leveling up extremely fast.
But this was also normal.
Because he was cheating.
"Time to leave."
At Canhe Manor’s Returning Water Pavilion, all the secret manuals had been read by Ding Ling.
Even the iron box buried deep underground was dug up by him.

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - 525: Wang Yuyan
paragraphs: No need to say.
This Treasure Bead is definitely the most precious item of the Murong Clan.
Unfortunately, it ended up in Ding Ling’s hands.
Earlier, Ding Ling had also obtained a Treasure Bead at the bottom of the deep pool in Wuliang Mountain.
That was the Green Pearl.
Extremely mystical.
Ding Ling couldn’t understand it thoroughly, but over the past half month, the Green Pearl had been held by the Lightning Mink, and as time passed, the Lightning Mink seemed to have evolved.
Different from its previous grayish-white color.
Its entire body turned golden.
Glittering like a small sun!
At that time, Ding Ling looked and was certain that the Green Pearl could indeed cause such a mythical beast as the Lightning Mink to evolve!
And needless to say, the Scarlet Venom Toad was probably also evolved successfully through this Green Pearl!
After the Lightning Mink evolved.
Its intelligence seemed to have increased significantly, becoming extremely affectionate and reliant on Ding Ling.
Obviously, there are two reasons, Ding Ling is the husband of its mistress, so naturally, he’s the master; and also that Ding Ling gave it the Green Pearl, allowing it to obtain this fortune.
The Lightning Mink becoming more intelligent and affectionate towards Ding Ling was only natural.
Ding Ling and his group left Canhe Manor.
Along the way, Ding Ling saw Abi again.
She was already awake.
Ding Ling had only used a little power to hit her Sleeping Acupoint, and it wouldn’t last too long. He wasn’t surprised she woke up at this time.
Abi just watched from afar as Ding Ling and his group boarded the ship and left, her face full of confusion and helplessness about the future.
Azhu was not by her side.
Thinking about the players’ frantic leaks.
Azhu was likely searching for her biological mother.
Ding Ling pondered, stopped worrying about this matter, and went straight to Mantuo Manor.
The time spent at Canhe Manor wasn’t long.
Upon leaving.
Jiu Mozhi’s arms were full of secret manuals, and when he saw Ding Ling, his face flushed slightly, he put his hands together and solemnly said:

"Although this humble monk has a photographic memory, I’m not as capable as Hero Ding. Since I’m leaving now, I didn’t have time to read many manuals, so I could only grab some at random. I hope Hero Ding doesn’t mind."
Ding Ling shook his head, saying nothing more.
After all, if Jiu Mozhi didn’t take these manuals, they’d likely be taken by some players.
Ding Ling didn’t take them.
There were too many secret manuals.
They took up space!
The storage pouch has limited space; Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer and other items were already inside. Adding a pile of useless third-rate or second-rate manuals would be impractical.
Besides, he had already completely learned and mastered them to the full level, so why carry those manuals?
Ding Ling only put a few select manuals, like the Crane Controlling Art, Star Shifting, and Canhe Finger, into his storage pouch, leaving the rest behind.
Splash!
The ship moved quickly.
Moments later.
They arrived at Mantuo Manor.
On the shore, over a hundred people had already formed a sword array, ready and waiting.
Ding Ling glanced over and didn’t waste words, just opened his right hand, whoosh! Six Meridian Divine Sword!
Sword Qi swept across, piercing through the void.
Amidst cries of agony.
The rivers of blood flowed on the shore.
Ding Ling leaped forward, activating the North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill! Transformation Skill! Storage Skill!
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Moments later, he drained everyone’s inner strength.
[Inner Power Value +80]
Although he acted quickly, many still couldn’t hold up against his absorption and died.
Jiu Mozhi watched, feeling his scalp tingle, deeply sensing Ding Ling’s killing intent!
Duan Yu began reciting the Rebirth Spell again.
Before he could finish.
Seeing Ding Ling already lifting his leg to walk forward, he hurriedly stopped and ran to Ding Ling’s side, grabbing his arm and softly pleading:
"Brother Ding, this is the residence of the Immortal Sister, could we avoid further bloodshed? I’m afraid we’ll disturb her, and if she dislikes us, I... I’ll lose my chance."
Ding Ling nodded.
His eyesight was sharp, clearly seeing.
Apart from the men and old women on the shore.
Most of the people inside Mantuo Manor were young, beautiful girls.
For such girls, Ding Ling had no desire for slaughter, merely using the One Yang Finger to hit their Sleeping Acupoint as he passed by.
Duan Yu breathed a sigh of relief.
Thus.
Walking through patches of flowers.
They finally reached a pavilion.
Sitting there was a person.

She wore a lotus-colored gauze, her back to the crowd, her face turned towards Canhe Manor, with a graceful figure. Even showing just half of her side profile, she exuded the ethereal beauty of a fairy veiled in morning mist. At a glance, Ding Ling couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows, secretly moved.
Duan Yu was even more astonished, exclaiming, ’Immortal Sister!’
He could recognize her just by the side profile!
Clearly, Duan Yu had been so infatuated with his Immortal Sister, it bordered on obsession.
The woman heard the voices, shuddered slightly, and turned her head.
As soon as she turned, her entire face appeared in everyone’s view.
Instantly, everyone present felt as though the world around them brightened a hundredfold. The woman possessed almond-shaped eyes and brows like willow leaves, her beauty beyond words.
Besides Ding Ling, who quickly regained his composure after a brief reaction, everyone else was captivated.
Especially Duan Yu, who appeared infatuated, murmuring, ’It’s truly the Immortal Sister!’
"Who are you?"
The woman cast a glance around, her posture mesmerizing, her voice like pearls dropping on a jade plate, crisp and pleasing to the ear.
Even with her brows slightly knitted, she was a sight to behold.
Ding Ling had only seen such unparalleled elegance in Little Dragon Girl and Diao Chan!
She was indeed a peerless beauty, no less in charm than Little Dragon Girl.
More beautiful than Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing by threefold.
But having had the long companionship of Little Dragon Girl and Diao Chan, Ding Ling, although appreciating her beauty, wasn’t mesmerized. After a pause, he said:
"Are you Wang Yuyan?"
"That’s right."
The woman’s face was full of puzzlement:
"I’ve never met you. How do you know my name?"
"It’s enough that it’s you."
Ding Ling flicked his fingers.
A Finger Force shot through the air.
Wang Yuyan’s Sleeping Acupoint was hit, and she immediately closed her eyes and fell softly to the ground.
Duan Yu exclaimed in shock and rushed forward to support Wang Yuyan. After calling her a few times and seeing no response, he anxiously looked at Ding Ling, calling out Brother Ding.
Ding Ling said:
"Didn’t you want to see your Immortal Sister? Now that you’ve seen her, spend some more time with her. We’ll go ahead and take a look."
Ding Ling lifted his foot and continued walking forward.
Duan Yu was a bit at a loss, more so bewildered.
So simple and straightforward?
But seeing Wang Yuyan’s face made Duan Yu’s heart inexplicably happy, excited, and thrilled. For a moment, he forgot what he was going to say to Ding Ling.
He just stared foolishly, staring dumbfoundedly at Wang Yuyan.
Ding Ling shook his head.
He hoped Duan Yu could ’move’ Wang Yuyan’s heart.
He absolutely couldn’t do such fawning things.
Wang Yuyan’s affection for her cousin was almost unwavering. Changing her mind would be as difficult as ascending to heaven.
Ding Ling would never do anything fawning, so although he appreciated Wang Yuyan, he didn’t have any intentions.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling, seeing this, let out a sigh of relief and were secretly delighted, thinking:

"Brother Ding is indeed a righteous gentleman, not sparing more than a glance at such unparalleled beauty. Unlike Duan Yu, the bookworm, who is now captivated and enchanted by Wang Yuyan. Comparing the two, Brother Ding is indeed more remarkable! No wonder he’s our husband!"
Both were somewhat smug.
After all, Ding Ling was their husband!
Tap, tap!
The group moved swiftly.
Upon entering the Main Hall, they saw the lady of the house.

He wasn’t surprised she woke up at this time.
Abi just watched from afar as Ding Ling and his group boarded the ship and left, her face full of confusion and helplessness about the future.
Azhu was not by her side.
Thinking about the players’ frantic leaks.
Azhu was likely searching for her biological mother.
Ding Ling pondered, stopped worrying about this matter, and went straight to Mantuo Manor.
The time spent at Canhe Manor wasn’t long.
Upon leaving.
Jiu Mozhi’s arms were full of secret manuals, and when he saw Ding Ling, his face flushed slightly, he put his hands together and solemnly said:
"Although this humble monk has a photographic memory, I’m not as capable as Hero Ding.
Since I’m leaving now, I didn’t have time to read many manuals, so I could only grab some at random.
I hope Hero Ding doesn’t mind."
Ding Ling shook his head, saying nothing more.
After all, if Jiu Mozhi didn’t take these manuals, they’d likely be taken by some players.
Ding Ling didn’t take them.
There were too many secret manuals.
They took up space!
The storage pouch has limited space; Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer and other items were already inside.
Adding a pile of useless third-rate or second-rate manuals would be impractical.
Besides, he had already completely learned and mastered them to the full level, so why carry those manuals?
Ding Ling only put a few select manuals, like the Crane Controlling Art, Star Shifting, and Canhe Finger, into his storage pouch, leaving the rest behind.
Splash!
The ship moved quickly.
Moments later.
They arrived at Mantuo Manor.
On the shore, over a hundred people had already formed a sword array, ready and waiting.
Ding Ling glanced over and didn’t waste words, just opened his right hand, whoosh!
Six Meridian Divine Sword!
Sword Qi swept across, piercing through the void.
Amidst cries of agony.
The rivers of blood flowed on the shore.
Ding Ling leaped forward, activating the North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Moments later, he drained everyone’s inner strength.
[Inner Power Value +80]
Although he acted quickly, many still couldn’t hold up against his absorption and died.
Jiu Mozhi watched, feeling his scalp tingle, deeply sensing Ding Ling’s killing intent!
Duan Yu began reciting the Rebirth Spell again.
Before he could finish.
Seeing Ding Ling already lifting his leg to walk forward, he hurriedly stopped and ran to Ding Ling’s side, grabbing his arm and softly pleading:
"Brother Ding, this is the residence of the Immortal Sister, could we avoid further bloodshed?
I’m afraid we’ll disturb her, and if she dislikes us, I...
I’ll lose my chance."
Ding Ling nodded.
His eyesight was sharp, clearly seeing.
Apart from the men and old women on the shore.
Most of the people inside Mantuo Manor were young, beautiful girls.
For such girls, Ding Ling had no desire for slaughter, merely using the One Yang Finger to hit their Sleeping Acupoint as he passed by.
Duan Yu breathed a sigh of relief.
Thus.
Walking through patches of flowers.
They finally reached a pavilion.
Sitting there was a person.
She wore a lotus-colored gauze, her back to the crowd, her face turned towards Canhe Manor, with a graceful figure.
Even showing just half of her side profile, she exuded the ethereal beauty of a fairy veiled in morning mist.
At a glance, Ding Ling couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows, secretly moved.
Duan Yu was even more astonished, exclaiming, ’Immortal Sister!’
He could recognize her just by the side profile!
Clearly, Duan Yu had been so infatuated with his Immortal Sister, it bordered on obsession.
The woman heard the voices, shuddered slightly, and turned her head.
As soon as she turned, her entire face appeared in everyone’s view.
Instantly, everyone present felt as though the world around them brightened a hundredfold.
The woman possessed almond-shaped eyes and brows like willow leaves, her beauty beyond words.
Besides Ding Ling, who quickly regained his composure after a brief reaction, everyone else was captivated.
Especially Duan Yu, who appeared infatuated, murmuring, ’It’s truly the Immortal Sister!’
"Who are you?"
The woman cast a glance around, her posture mesmerizing, her voice like pearls dropping on a jade plate, crisp and pleasing to the ear.
Even with her brows slightly knitted, she was a sight to behold.
Ding Ling had only seen such unparalleled elegance in Little Dragon Girl and Diao Chan!
She was indeed a peerless beauty, no less in charm than Little Dragon Girl.
More beautiful than Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing by threefold.
But having had the long companionship of Little Dragon Girl and Diao Chan, Ding Ling, although appreciating her beauty, wasn’t mesmerized.
After a pause, he said:
"Are you Wang Yuyan?"
"That’s right."
The woman’s face was full of puzzlement:
"I’ve never met you.
How do you know my name?"
"It’s enough that it’s you."
Ding Ling flicked his fingers.
A Finger Force shot through the air.
Wang Yuyan’s Sleeping Acupoint was hit, and she immediately closed her eyes and fell softly to the ground.
Duan Yu exclaimed in shock and rushed forward to support Wang Yuyan.
After calling her a few times and seeing no response, he anxiously looked at Ding Ling, calling out Brother Ding.
Ding Ling said:
"Didn’t you want to see your Immortal Sister?
Now that you’ve seen her, spend some more time with her.
We’ll go ahead and take a look."
Ding Ling lifted his foot and continued walking forward.
Duan Yu was a bit at a loss, more so bewildered.
So simple and straightforward?
But seeing Wang Yuyan’s face made Duan Yu’s heart inexplicably happy, excited, and thrilled.
For a moment, he forgot what he was going to say to Ding Ling.
He just stared foolishly, staring dumbfoundedly at Wang Yuyan.
Ding Ling shook his head.
He hoped Duan Yu could ’move’ Wang Yuyan’s heart.
He absolutely couldn’t do such fawning things.
Wang Yuyan’s affection for her cousin was almost unwavering.
Changing her mind would be as difficult as ascending to heaven.
Ding Ling would never do anything fawning, so although he appreciated Wang Yuyan, he didn’t have any intentions.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling, seeing this, let out a sigh of relief and were secretly delighted, thinking:
"Brother Ding is indeed a righteous gentleman, not sparing more than a glance at such unparalleled beauty.
Unlike Duan Yu, the bookworm, who is now captivated and enchanted by Wang Yuyan.
Comparing the two, Brother Ding is indeed more remarkable!
No wonder he’s our husband!"
Both were somewhat smug.
After all, Ding Ling was their husband!
Tap, tap!
The group moved swiftly.
Upon entering the Main Hall, they saw the lady of the house.

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 526: Dragon Capturing Skill Full Level
paragraphs: Li Qingluo.
Looking at the woman in front of him, who looked identical to Wang Yuyan, Ding Ling immediately deduced that she was Li Qingluo.
Without wasting any words.
He delivered a One Yang Finger strike.
Bang!
It hit Li Qingluo’s acupoint, and her body went limp, collapsing involuntarily. Ding Ling made a sudden advance, placed his hand on her shoulder, and activated the North Nether Divine Skill.
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
[Inner Power Value +70]
Li Qingluo’s inner power cultivation was not high, barely at second-class level.
But her inner power was extremely pure, produced from cultivating the Small Faceless Skill, hence almost seventy percent of it could be directly utilized by Ding Ling’s North Nether Divine Skill.
Unlike others, who can only preserve ten percent of their inner strength, which is considered incredible.
"You, you..."
Li Qingluo realized her power had been absorbed, couldn’t help but widen her eyes, full of horror and fear.
But inside her heart was boiling!
She recalled the description of the alien, quickly recognized Ding Ling, and amidst the surging intent to kill, she thought:

"It seems the flare signal warning was true! The Four Great Manors, Canhe Manor, have all been conquered by this guy! Such powerful martial arts! Ordinary methods seem ineffective against him. My martial arts have been destroyed now. How can I kill him?!"
If I don’t kill him, how can I calm my anger?
I, Li Qingluo, have never suffered such a big loss or faced such an embarrassing situation!
Is his name Ding Ling?
Humph! If I, Li Qingluo, don’t capture and kill all your relatives and make them fertilizer, then I am not the Manor Master of Mantuo Manor!"
Li Qingluo generally disliked martial arts.
She wasn’t particularly concerned about her martial arts being destroyed. She didn’t care much about people or things.
After Ding Ling treated her this way, after the fear, came fury, frustration, and a wild urge to kill!
But to prevent Ding Ling from noticing anything unusual, she looked at him blankly and fearfully:
"Who are you?!
Ding Ling didn’t pay much attention to her, merely repeating the technique on the seven or eight elderly women behind Li Qingluo.
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +5]
Eventually, Inner Power Value +60
After resolving everyone here, Ding Ling asked the elderly woman to lead the way to Langhuan Jade Cave.
The elderly woman wanted to refuse, but after suffering through Ding Ling’s One Yang Finger torment, she naturally complied.
"Clop clop!"
The group prepared to head to Langhuan Jade Cave.
Leaving only Li Qingluo with corpses scattered around.
"Won’t kill her?"
Jiu Mozhi followed him out of the main hall, watching Ding Ling surprisingly show mercy, he couldn’t help but be perplexed.
"Do you think she should be killed?"
"This...
Jiu Mozhi was speechless.
Ding Ling had a moment of thought, turned back and delivered a One Yang Finger strike, poof! It hit Li Qingluo’s heart, eliminating her instantly.
Jiu Mozhi was somewhat shocked, bringing his hands together in prayer, uttering ’Amitabha Buddha’, unsure whether he regretted reminding Ding Ling or felt what Ding Ling did was too ruthless.
Ling Yanqiu, Zhong Ling, and Mu Wanqing saw Ding Ling was willing to ruthlessly destroy such beauty, they understood that the allure of beauty hardly had a decisive effect on Ding Ling.
As his wives, Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing were naturally very pleased, feeling they picked the right man. Men who truly aren’t swayed by beauty are rare under the heavens.
How little did they know?
Ding Ling killed Li Qingluo entirely because his Observing People Skill and acting skill were full level, instantly discerning Li Qingluo’s intent to kill him.
Previously, Li Qingluo had dispatched people to intercept and kill him.
For Duan Yu’s sake, Ding Ling originally intended to spare her, as killing Li Qingluo would complicate matters between Duan Yu and his Immortal Sister.
But after Jiu Mozhi’s reminder, Ding Ling realized that leaving such an exceedingly beautiful woman plotting against him in Jianghu would be incredibly bothersome.
To eliminate future troubles, Ding Ling chose to kill her.
As he, Ding Ling, has traveled, there’s no one he dared not kill!
If you want to kill him, you must be prepared to be killed by him.
Thinking thus.
Ding Ling felt relieved, walked even faster.
[Achieved Achievement Medal: Intimidating Li Qingluo.]

[Note: Li Qingluo is vicious and merciless. She has a determination to kill you! She thought she could use all her resources to eliminate you—but didn’t expect you to come straight to her door and kill her!]
Upon hearing the prompt.
Ding Ling increasingly felt he hadn’t killed wrongly, with mortal enemies, there’s no reason to spare them.
Arriving at Langhuan Jade Cave.
Ding Ling directly broke in.
Casually threw the elderly woman, delivering a Six Meridian Divine Sword strike to finish her.
Then moved to a bookshelf to start reading.
Took out a secret manual.
"City Character Eighteen Breaks"
Quickly flipping through it.
[City Character Eighteen Breaks Full Level]
It’s a second-class martial arts secret manual.
Had no effect on enhancing four-dimensional attributes.
Ding Ling didn’t mind, speeding up to read.
Finished reading over a hundred secret manuals on a bookshelf.
His foundation rose again.
The furnace body of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace became a bit clearer.
Control over vigorous qi increased significantly.
Ding Ling moved to the second bookshelf.
Finished reading a book.
[Ruan Family’s Eighty-One Strokes of the Three-Section Staff Full Level]
An equally second-class secret manual.
[Cyan Nine Strikes Full Level]
Nearing first-class, but cultivation did not enhance four-dimensional attribute points.
Yet it did boost his foundation.
Ding Ling read through one book after another.
Soon saw the last bookshelf.
Picked up a book.
"One-Character Wisdom Sword"
Ding Ling quickly finished reading.
[One-Character Wisdom Sword Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was evidently a high-tier sword technique.
Though inferior to the likes of Dugu Nine Swords.
Still, it added 0.1 attribute points.

Judging from the description, this sword technique should be the One-Character Wisdom Sword Sect’s revered sword technique. Once displayed, it’s mysterious and unfathomable, the sword’s trajectory is hard to capture, yet strikes like lightning, hence the One-Character Wisdom Sword!
Ding Ling picked up another book and started reading.
On looking, he couldn’t help but slightly narrow his eyes.
It was none other than the renowned Dragon Capturing Skill!
He quickly flipped through it.
Instantly.
[Dragon Capturing Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
This was a skill more domineering and forceful than the Crane Controlling Art, for long-range grabbing and controlling objects.
Crane Controlling Art was more elegant.
Dragon Capturing Skill was more intense!
Both executed simultaneously, fast and strong yet smoothly fluid as water, harmonizing water and fire, blending hardness and softness.
"Such a divine skill."
Ding Ling silently nodded.
The Langhuan Jade Cave contained far more martial arts secret manuals than the Returning Water Pavilion.
But there were many duplicate manuals between the two.
It goes without saying.
Surely Murong Fu copied Langhuan Jade Cave’s manuals to the Returning Water Pavilion; how was it copied?
With Wang Yuyan, the martial arts encyclopedia, it’s easily done.
Ding Ling continued to read downwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - 527: Strength Advances Again
paragraphs: [Swallow Gathering Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
This is the ultimate skill of South Sea Yehua Island, gathering swallow nests from steep cliffs as easily as retrieving from a pouch!
Vigorous Qi is displayed from a distance, the wonder of Void Capture is similar to Dragon Capturing Skill and Crane Controlling Art!
However, compared to the fierce Dragon Capturing Skill and the graceful Crane Controlling Art, the Swallow Gathering Skill is more light and agile.
All three long-distance control supreme skills are at full level.
Ding Ling feels that controlling objects ten zhang away is probably not difficult.
He experimented for a while, and sure enough, he could easily open and close large doors ten zhang away, just like an invisible arm was closing the doors.
Jiu Mozhi watched in amazement, stunned as if witnessing a celestial being!
His heart burned with excitement, and he couldn’t help but step forward to observe the Swallow Gathering Skill.
Ding Ling considered that many knew this Martial Arts, so he gave it to him.
Jiu Mozhi joyfully took it and eagerly studied it, but after some time of pondering, he could understand the principle of this cultivation technique, but mastering it required considerable time.
Thinking that Ding Ling mastered it to the Great Perfection Innate Ability level just by seeing it once, Jiu Mozhi was extremely envious!
[Golden Hook Ice-Breaking Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
Ding Ling continues watching.
[Five-Peck Divine Skill Full Level]
[Golden Needle Tribulation Skill Full Level]
[Feather Robe Saber Technique Full Level]
[Soul-Seizing Finger Full Level]
First-class secret manuals.
There are over thirty books.
Some barely entering the first-class threshold secret manuals have over fifty books.
Without exception, once read, immediately reach full level!
Newly thresholded first-class secret manuals cannot provide Four-dimensional Attribute Points.
But even if only considering the other thirty or more books.
The final growth of Four-dimensional Attribute Points is:
[Strength +3.7]
[Agility +3.6]
[Physique +3.7]
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Bone Structure 5 (1 point for ordinary people), Wisdom 5, Strength 70.2, Agility 70.5, Physique 77, Defense 60, Charm 12.4, True Power Value: 17 points]
As expected.
Strength and agility both break the threshold of 70.
At this level.
Agility paired with the full-level Spiral Nine Shadows, saying it’s like an illusion or phantom is not an exaggeration!
"Physique reached 77. Feels close to the world’s limit point."
’It seems the limit points of this world should be around 80.’
Ding Ling pondered.
The increase in physique boosted his vitality, lifespan, endurance, immunity, etc., dramatically.
He could live longer.
But the journey to immortality is still far away.
Effort is still needed.
"Leave here."
"Go to Leigushan!
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate much and chose the route to Leigushan.
"Why go to Leigushan?"
Jiu Mozhi was puzzled.
"You don’t have to go."
Jiu Mozhi thus stopped questioning.
He wanted to follow Ding Ling to learn other Divine Skills and inquire how to practice Swallow Gathering Skill and other Martial Arts.
Helplessly.
Although Jiu Mozhi prided himself on having exceptional intelligence, Ding Ling was already like an immortal; how could he compare to him?
When in need of guidance, one must still seek advice!
The gap is vast!
Like a Celestial Abyss, akin to an Abyss!
He truly couldn’t declare himself the world’s most intelligent anymore.
In front of Ding Ling, he had neither the courage nor the face to say so!
Click, click!
The group moved quickly.
Upon reaching the previous courtyard.
Ding Ling saw Duan Yu still holding Wang Yuyan and laughing foolishly. Watching him, it seemed he would hold her forever, and likely remain willing and joyful extremely.

Mu Wanqing was stunned for a moment seeing this; for the first time, it seemed she truly saw Duan Yu’s appearance. Originally thinking he was just a clueless bookworm, now it appeared she had overthought.
She couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling, and in comparison, she found Ding Ling more pleasing.
Unavoidably she thought:
"My husband sees such a celestial beauty and remains unfazed! Utterly unmoved! In contrast, Duan Yu seems lost, like possessed. In this aspect, a clear distinction is made!"
Reflecting further on Duan Yu, Jiu Mozhi, and others, none compared to Ding Ling.
Mu Wanqing couldn’t help but straighten her back, she must work harder, so she wouldn’t embarrass her husband outside! She should make her husband proud!
"Duan Yu."
Ding Ling called out.
"Brother Ding."
Duan Yu came to his senses and reluctantly, with difficulty, shifted his gaze from Wang Yuyan’s face to Ding Ling and said:
’What’s the matter?’
"We have to leave. What are you going to do?"
"Leaving already?"
Duan Yu was very reluctant:
"I, I, this..."
"If you really can’t bear it, just stay here with your Immortal Sister."
Zhong Ling couldn’t stand it anymore and said tenderly:
"But you have to be careful. Too many people have died in this manor. I fear your Immortal Sister might hold you accountable later."
"Someone died again?!"
Duan Yu’s expression slightly changed.
Ding Ling didn’t hide it from him, directly stating that he had killed Wang Yuyan’s mother.
Duan Yu’s face turned as pale as paper, and he muttered:
"This is terrible. What should I do now?!"
"You didn’t kill the person."
Ding Ling casually comforted him:
"I killed her, not your concern. Just say that."
Ding Ling lifted his leg to leave, paying no heed to Duan Yu:
"You should cultivate the Divine Skill well. Perhaps you can protect Wang Yuyan. Take care.
Mu Wanqing glanced at Duan Yu, then hesitantly followed closely behind Ding Ling.
Ling Yanqiu shook her head, seemingly quite disappointed in Duan Yu.
Zhong Ling instinctively followed Ding Ling for a few steps, then seemed to think of something, turned back to Duan Yu and said:
"Brother Duan, I am leaving with my husband. We’ll meet again if fate allows."
"Brother Ding, Miss Zhong, Miss Mu..."
Duan Yu called out a few times, got up to bid farewell to everyone:
"I can’t leave my Immortal Sister. We’ll meet again if fate allows!"
Ding Ling had predicted he would make this choice, so he left swiftly and decisively.
The moment he saw Wang Yuyan.
Duan Yu’s heart was completely captivated.
His lifetime of infatuation is probably starting from this moment.
Ding Ling understood this very clearly. As long as Duan Yu had the North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step, with his destiny-like incredible luck,
his future development might be difficult to achieve effortlessly, but he is likely to climb to the peak of the Martial Dao.
Heading to Leigushan.
The journey is long and difficult.
The reason for going.
Ding Ling wanted to see if any players had solved the Zhenlong Chessboard and inherited all of Wuya Zi’s Inner Strength.
He looked it up online but found no such news.
Either the Zhenlong Chessboard remains unsolved,
or the player who benefited remains in Divine Concealment!
Of course.
The recent changes in the leaderboard might provide some clues.
But with so many worlds being developed, players who gain good fortune and benefits will occasionally appear, rapidly climbing the leaderboard!
The leaderboard cannot accurately determine if someone accomplished something; it’s uncertain if they gained other good fortune.
However, it is possible to lock onto some players based on recent changes in the leaderboard.
Ding Ling didn’t bother with such things.
He has always been at the top of the leaderboard, looking down on the ’masses’, worshipped by countless players!
If he stayed in the Player Plaza for long periods, it would definitely cause a frenzy.
Ding Ling had done this once before.
It was so packed he couldn’t move.
He didn’t know how many people screamed into his ears!
Since then.
Ding Ling would log in and out of the Player Plaza at lightning speed, never lingering long.
Of course.
Ding Ling could also lock onto players who got this opportunity through analysis from players online.
But this is indeed difficult.
Because online information is complicated, every world has a bunch of players, especially in the historically chosen planes for initial development, the most players exist!
All the game forums have the most posts about historical planes.
Leigushan is just a small part of this; after receiving some attention, it was quickly drowned out by other posts, making it difficult to find specific information.
Ding Ling had searched and, unable to find anything, stopped looking further.
After all, he had to go north.
It’s a good opportunity to visit Leigushan.
One day.
The group rode swiftly through.
They reached a vast forest.
Just dismounted, ready to cook.
Suddenly, cold arrows flew out from the forest.

sentences.text: [Swallow Gathering Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
This is the ultimate skill of South Sea Yehua Island, gathering swallow nests from steep cliffs as easily as retrieving from a pouch!
Vigorous Qi is displayed from a distance, the wonder of Void Capture is similar to Dragon Capturing Skill and Crane Controlling Art!
However, compared to the fierce Dragon Capturing Skill and the graceful Crane Controlling Art, the Swallow Gathering Skill is more light and agile.
All three long-distance control supreme skills are at full level.
Ding Ling feels that controlling objects ten zhang away is probably not difficult.
He experimented for a while, and sure enough, he could easily open and close large doors ten zhang away, just like an invisible arm was closing the doors.
Jiu Mozhi watched in amazement, stunned as if witnessing a celestial being!
His heart burned with excitement, and he couldn’t help but step forward to observe the Swallow Gathering Skill.
Ding Ling considered that many knew this Martial Arts, so he gave it to him.
Jiu Mozhi joyfully took it and eagerly studied it, but after some time of pondering, he could understand the principle of this cultivation technique, but mastering it required considerable time.
Thinking that Ding Ling mastered it to the Great Perfection Innate Ability level just by seeing it once, Jiu Mozhi was extremely envious!
[Golden Hook Ice-Breaking Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
Ding Ling continues watching.
[Five-Peck Divine Skill Full Level]
[Golden Needle Tribulation Skill Full Level]
[Feather Robe Saber Technique Full Level]
[Soul-Seizing Finger Full Level]
First-class secret manuals.
There are over thirty books.
Some barely entering the first-class threshold secret manuals have over fifty books.
Without exception, once read, immediately reach full level!
Newly thresholded first-class secret manuals cannot provide Four-dimensional Attribute Points.
But even if only considering the other thirty or more books.
The final growth of Four-dimensional Attribute Points is:
[Strength +3.7]
[Agility +3.6]
[Physique +3.7]
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Bone Structure 5 (1 point for ordinary people), Wisdom 5, Strength 70.2, Agility 70.5, Physique 77, Defense 60, Charm 12.4, True Power Value: 17 points]
As expected.
Strength and agility both break the threshold of 70.
At this level.
Agility paired with the full-level Spiral Nine Shadows, saying it’s like an illusion or phantom is not an exaggeration!
"Physique reached 77.
Feels close to the world’s limit point."
’It seems the limit points of this world should be around 80.’
Ding Ling pondered.
The increase in physique boosted his vitality, lifespan, endurance, immunity, etc., dramatically.
He could live longer.
But the journey to immortality is still far away.
Effort is still needed.
"Leave here."
"Go to Leigushan!
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate much and chose the route to Leigushan.
"Why go to Leigushan?"
Jiu Mozhi was puzzled.
"You don’t have to go."
Jiu Mozhi thus stopped questioning.
He wanted to follow Ding Ling to learn other Divine Skills and inquire how to practice Swallow Gathering Skill and other Martial Arts.
Helplessly.
Although Jiu Mozhi prided himself on having exceptional intelligence, Ding Ling was already like an immortal; how could he compare to him?
When in need of guidance, one must still seek advice!
The gap is vast!
Like a Celestial Abyss, akin to an Abyss!
He truly couldn’t declare himself the world’s most intelligent anymore.
In front of Ding Ling, he had neither the courage nor the face to say so!
Click, click!
The group moved quickly.
Upon reaching the previous courtyard.
Ding Ling saw Duan Yu still holding Wang Yuyan and laughing foolishly.
Watching him, it seemed he would hold her forever, and likely remain willing and joyful extremely.
Mu Wanqing was stunned for a moment seeing this; for the first time, it seemed she truly saw Duan Yu’s appearance.
Originally thinking he was just a clueless bookworm, now it appeared she had overthought.
She couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling, and in comparison, she found Ding Ling more pleasing.
Unavoidably she thought:
"My husband sees such a celestial beauty and remains unfazed!
Utterly unmoved!
In contrast, Duan Yu seems lost, like possessed.
In this aspect, a clear distinction is made!"
Reflecting further on Duan Yu, Jiu Mozhi, and others, none compared to Ding Ling.
Mu Wanqing couldn’t help but straighten her back, she must work harder, so she wouldn’t embarrass her husband outside!
She should make her husband proud!
"Duan Yu."
Ding Ling called out.
"Brother Ding."
Duan Yu came to his senses and reluctantly, with difficulty, shifted his gaze from Wang Yuyan’s face to Ding Ling and said:
’What’s the matter?’
"We have to leave.
What are you going to do?"
"Leaving already?"
Duan Yu was very reluctant:
"I, I, this..."
"If you really can’t bear it, just stay here with your Immortal Sister."
Zhong Ling couldn’t stand it anymore and said tenderly:
"But you have to be careful.
Too many people have died in this manor.
I fear your Immortal Sister might hold you accountable later."
"Someone died again?!"
Duan Yu’s expression slightly changed.
Ding Ling didn’t hide it from him, directly stating that he had killed Wang Yuyan’s mother.
Duan Yu’s face turned as pale as paper, and he muttered:
"This is terrible.
What should I do now?!"
"You didn’t kill the person."
Ding Ling casually comforted him:
"I killed her, not your concern.
Just say that."
Ding Ling lifted his leg to leave, paying no heed to Duan Yu:
"You should cultivate the Divine Skill well.
Perhaps you can protect Wang Yuyan.
Take care.
Mu Wanqing glanced at Duan Yu, then hesitantly followed closely behind Ding Ling.
Ling Yanqiu shook her head, seemingly quite disappointed in Duan Yu.
Zhong Ling instinctively followed Ding Ling for a few steps, then seemed to think of something, turned back to Duan Yu and said:
"Brother Duan, I am leaving with my husband.
We’ll meet again if fate allows."
"Brother Ding, Miss Zhong, Miss Mu..."
Duan Yu called out a few times, got up to bid farewell to everyone:
"I can’t leave my Immortal Sister.
We’ll meet again if fate allows!"
Ding Ling had predicted he would make this choice, so he left swiftly and decisively.
The moment he saw Wang Yuyan.
Duan Yu’s heart was completely captivated.
His lifetime of infatuation is probably starting from this moment.
Ding Ling understood this very clearly.
As long as Duan Yu had the North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step, with his destiny-like incredible luck,
his future development might be difficult to achieve effortlessly, but he is likely to climb to the peak of the Martial Dao.
Heading to Leigushan.
The journey is long and difficult.
The reason for going.
Ding Ling wanted to see if any players had solved the Zhenlong Chessboard and inherited all of Wuya Zi’s Inner Strength.
He looked it up online but found no such news.
Either the Zhenlong Chessboard remains unsolved,
or the player who benefited remains in Divine Concealment!
Of course.
The recent changes in the leaderboard might provide some clues.
But with so many worlds being developed, players who gain good fortune and benefits will occasionally appear, rapidly climbing the leaderboard!
The leaderboard cannot accurately determine if someone accomplished something; it’s uncertain if they gained other good fortune.
However, it is possible to lock onto some players based on recent changes in the leaderboard.
Ding Ling didn’t bother with such things.
He has always been at the top of the leaderboard, looking down on the ’masses’, worshipped by countless players!
If he stayed in the Player Plaza for long periods, it would definitely cause a frenzy.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 528: Duan Yanqing! South Sea Crocodile God
paragraphs: Swoosh swoosh!
Cold arrows rained down like a storm, 99% of which were aimed directly at Ding Ling’s head, while the rest shot towards Jiu Mozhi and others.

Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, instantly releasing his Protective Gang Qi. The Vigorous Qi from the Star Shifting technique spread all over his body. The Dragon Capturing Skill, Crane Controlling Art, and Swallow Gathering Skill were all deployed simultaneously in mid-air. With just one grasp into the void, he forcibly grabbed hundreds of densely fired arrows.
Then, as if a giant hand was grabbing those arrows mid-air, Ding Ling exerted force, causing the arrows to all change direction!
"Go!"
Ding Ling swiftly flicked them away.
Under the infusion of Fusion Qi!
The Full Level Divine Skills of Dragon Capturing Skill, Crane Controlling Art, and Swallow Gathering Skill demonstrated their might together, swoosh swoosh swoosh!
Hundreds of arrows shot back into the dense forest at an even faster speed than before, thud thud! As the sound of arrows piercing flesh resonated, screams arose one after another, incessantly.
In an instant, it was unclear how many were killed or wounded.

With Spiral Nine Shadows, High Agility, and under the propulsion of Fusion Qi, Ding Ling moved like lightning or thunderbolt. In the void, he shifted up and down, left and right, capturing the exploding arrows in mid-air, and then flicking them back again, swoosh swoosh swoosh!
The arrows shot back across the sky like meteors again!
Ding Ling’s speed was extremely fast, and his reactions even faster!
Almost at the same moment the cold arrows were fired.
He launched a swift counterattack.
So much so that Jiu Mozhi and others hadn’t even reacted before realizing that the sky full of arrows had vanished into nothing.
Jiu Mozhi looked at Ding Ling as if he were a god.
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing wore expressions of admiration.
Ling Yanqiu was full of reverence.
Swoosh swoosh!

Ding Ling took a step forward, charging into the dense forest like a cannonball. Swoosh swoosh swoosh, spreading his arms, he activated the Six Meridian Divine Sword! Streams of Sword Qi shot out from his fingertips.
Ding Ling’s vision was extraordinary, and with his incredible speed, every assassin and archer he passed fell onto the ground.
Ding Ling did not immediately kill them.
Instead choosing to severely wound them!
But for the sake of a quick victory.
Sometimes he couldn’t help it; a stream of Sword Qi would directly kill two or three people!
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling swept through the assassins like the Xun Wind over the ground, and appeared before three people in an instant.
One dressed in a blue robe, bald-headed, with a hideous and ugly face, sat in a wheelchair;
Another was eight feet tall, with short mustaches and tiny eyes, holding a large pair of scissors;
The third was handsome and vigorous, wielding an exotic weapon resembling a snake.
All three were struck dumb.
Upon seeing Ding Ling charging towards them, the three shivered and shouted together.
The hideous bald one pointed at Ding Ling first, shooting a Finger Force from the One Yang Finger!
The eight-foot tall man with the mustaches ran desperately at Ding Ling, brandishing his scissors, intending to cut Ding Ling into pieces.
The handsome man, moving like a swimming snake and a loosed arrow, swung his sword as if it were a giant python capable of devouring everything.
All three exerted their power simultaneously.
Ding Ling took one look and roughly knew who two of them were.
Without thinking further.
He opened his arms towards them.
The Six Meridian Divine Sword instantly shot out!

Six streams of Sword Qi were both fast and urgent! Under Ding Ling’s control and propulsion of Fusion Qi, they resembled ribbons, like flashes of lightning, undefendable and sudden; one moment in front, the next over the head.
It was due to Ding Ling’s Spiral Nine Shadows and Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique making his form unpredictable, shifting up and down!
With the assistance of his superior Lightweight Skill.
In less than an instant.
Bang bang bang!
Three crisp sounds.
Accompanied by three muffled groans, almost all three fell backward onto the ground.
Ding Ling, flashing swiftly, approached the bald man like a whirlwind with his Ripple Step, placing a hand on his shoulder and activating the North Nether Divine Skill.
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
In just two blinks of the eye.
The man’s surging Inner Strength was fully absorbed by Ding Ling.
[Inner Power Value +160]
This man was undoubtedly a master infinitely close to Initial Tier Innate!
His overwhelming Inner Strength surpassed people like Bao Butong and Fengg Bo’e several fold!
But there were impurities when refined by the North Nether Divine Skill.
Yet even so, an excess stream of North Nether True Qi was added to the Dantian.
Combined with previous accumulations.
The North Nether True Qi converged to form a drop of North Nether True Water.
[True Power Value 18 points]
With enhanced strength.
Ding Ling’s North Nether Divine Skill grew even stronger.
Quickly advancing to the scissor-wielding man’s side, ignoring the palm strikes coming at him, he placed a hand on the man’s shoulder, activating the North Nether Divine Skill!
Whoosh whoosh!
In just an instant.
[Inner Power Value +100]
This person was also a First-class Supreme expert.
Ding Ling swiftly moved to the other handsome man’s side, sticking close to him and using the North Nether Divine Skill.
This man, knowing he couldn’t escape, adopted a mutual destruction tactic, stabbing heavily towards Ding Ling.
Unfortunately, Ding Ling’s Star Shifting was fully active.
His sword was perfectly diverted elsewhere, and if Ding Ling hadn’t feared for his life, the reverse hit from this deflection would have killed him.
The man was severely injured by the Six Meridian Divine Sword. If struck again, how could he not die?
Ding Ling wasn’t afraid of him dying.
He was worried that if he died, his Inner Power Value would be wasted.
He approached him and placed his hand on him.
[Inner Power Value +110]
Two more streams of True Qi emerged in his Dantian.
Ding Ling let out a long breath.
Only at this moment.
Did he begin to scan the three people, and asked:
"Are you people from the Western Xia First-Grade Hall?"
The bald elder looked grim.
The handsome man was filled with despair and gloom.
The one holding scissors was quick to speak, saying:
"That’s right. Your grandfather here is the South Sea Crocodile God, Yue the Second, among the Four Great Evils!"
"So it really is you."
Ding Ling glanced at the bald man:
"You must be Duan Yanqing?"
No wonder the Inner Strength is so deep and powerful!
The bald man didn’t speak, just sighed repeatedly.
Just at this moment.
[Achievement Medal attained: Intimidate Duan Yanqing.]
[Achievement Medal attained: Intimidate Yue the Third]

[Notes: As two of the top figures among the Four Great Evils, both are fierce and ruthless, killing countless people. They came to kill you under Li Qiushui’s command, bringing with them ninety percent of the First-Grade Hall’s elite! Usually, with such a large deployment of elites, there would be no one they couldn’t kill. Yet today, they were swiftly crushed and swept away like fallen leaves in autumn by you! They were left in shock, disbelief, and horror, unable to comprehend the existence of such an extraordinary master as you!]
As expected, it’s Duan Yanqing.
And hearing this notification, Ding Ling also roughly inferred the whole story.
As the massacre at Lake Tai fermented.
Li Qingluo’s death would certainly be known to Li Qiushui!
And since Li Qingluo was Li Qiushui’s daughter, her rage and grief, seeking revenge for Li Qingluo, is only normal.
Given that...
Ding Ling casually struck Duan Yanqing down with a flick of the Canhe Finger.
Thinking:
"I might as well change my course and head to Western Xia then."
Ding Ling had been planning to head to the Northern Lands and shatter the Liao Kingdom. Also to visit Leigushan along the way.
But since Li Qiushui had acted first.
Ding Ling had the idea of changing his course.
One can only say.
Plans often can’t keep up with changes.
Most of the time, the plans he made.
Had to be altered because of certain events.
To this.
Ding Ling was indifferent.
Destroying Western Xia first has greater benefits.
He could also seize Li Qiushui’s Supreme Skill or capture her to trade her with the Heavenly Mountain Granny for Martial Arts?
Ding Ling was in thought.
He glanced at Yue the Third, pointed at the handsome man, and said:
"Who is he?"
Yue the Third seemed to know he was doomed and, closing his mouth, said nothing.
Ding Ling then looked at the handsome man.
The handsome man also said nothing.
Ding Ling shook his head, too lazy to ask again, and with two successive strikes of the Canhe Finger, he ended the two of them.
And just at this moment.
Jiu Mozhi, along with Mu Wanqing and others, arrived.

Jiu Mozhi glanced at the three, seemingly recognizing Duan Yanqing, and couldn’t help but be slightly surprised; he didn’t expect that such a master had organized nearly a thousand assassins, only to be handled so easily by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling, however, ignored Jiu Mozhi, his form like the wind as he flew towards the others he had killed.
North Nether Divine Skill operated continually.
[Inner Power Value +3]
[Inner Power Value +4]
Without a doubt.
These dying individuals were all elites who had cultivated Inner Power!
And each was much stronger than those Lake Tai ruffians.
Yet, in Ding Ling’s eyes, even first-class experts were merely beings he could kill with a single Canhe Finger, and they existed to be easily exterminated.
However strong, to Ding Ling, they were merely experience bags.
[Inner Power Value +3]
[Inner Power Value +2]
A full thousand people.
Were mostly killed by the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
The power of the Six Meridian Divine Sword was too strong, and generally, people couldn’t withstand it; even if they could, they wouldn’t last long.
In the end, Ding Ling’s gains.
[Inner Power Value +423]
Many didn’t even hold on until Ding Ling arrived to absorb their inner strength and died beforehand.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 529: Yuan Chengzhi and the Golden Snake Sword
paragraphs: Otherwise, he would definitely be able to absorb more.
But in one breath.
Four more streams of North Nether True Qi emerged in the Dantian.
Adding to the previous few streams.
[True Power Value 20 points]
There were a full 20 drops of True Water in the Dantian!

Nine Yang True Water and North Nether True Water were clearly distinct, yet under the integration of the Vigorous Qi from the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and the Tai Chi Scripture, they slowly rotated in the Dantian like a Tai Chi.
"Grandmaster Great Perfection!"
Upon reaching the 20-point True Water Realm.
Ding Ling felt particularly clear.
He was just one step away from a breakthrough!
"I didn’t expect to reach the grandmaster so quickly. It seems I won’t stay in this world for long."
Ding Ling pondered with some understanding, glancing at Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing, the only two attachments he had in this world.
He needed to prepare everything before leaving.
"Let’s go."
After absorbing all the inner strength, Ding Ling flashed like a drifting maple leaf and lightly landed beside everyone:
"Leave here."
"Husband."
Mu Wanqing picked up a few weapons from the ground:
"Aren’t we taking these?"
Ding Ling reached out to take them, glancing at them.
Yue the Third’s large scissors were made of superior material, evidently an excellent weapon, but compared to Ding Ling’s Giant Que Sword and Drumming Golden Hammer, they fell far short.
Ding Ling casually tossed it aside, turning his gaze to the snake-shaped weapon in his hand.
This weapon was quite heavy, though in Ding Ling’s hand it felt light as a feather, yet compared to ordinary weapons, it was considered very heavy.
The sword was entirely golden, its blade formed from a coiled snake, with the snake’s tail as the hilt and the snake’s head as the tip, the snake’s tongue split, with two prongs at the tip.
Such a weapon was truly rare.
Ding Ling examined it carefully, noticing three twisting characters on the blade:
Golden Snake Sword!
"It’s actually the Golden Snake Sword!"
Ding Ling suddenly realized.
That explained why he felt such a strange yet familiar sensation with this weapon, it was actually the top Divine Weapon from the Green Blood Sword — the Golden Snake Sword!
Ding Ling’s skill in material research had also reached full level.

With a slight perception, he knew this sword was forged from gold and five other metals. While gold was nothing special, the other five metals were extremely rare. Ding Ling sensed these five metals weren’t the commonly known gold, silver, copper, iron, and tin, but rather five rare and uncommon metals from the world of Green Blood Sword.
Even with Ding Ling’s material distinction skill at full level, determining these metals was difficult. Perhaps they were unique metals to the Green Blood Sword world?
Ding Ling pondered, casually performing two sword techniques, the sword gleamed golden, Sword Qi sweeping around, like a serpent devouring the skies, like a strange snake howling!
Even the most vigorous sword techniques, when executed with this Golden Snake Sword, became bizarre, varied, and fierce.
"Truly a top-notch Divine Weapon."
Ding Ling immediately pocketed the Golden Snake Sword, for how could such a Divine Weapon be missed? He glanced at the handsome man on the ground, already dead, pondering:
"The bearer of the Golden Snake Sword. Either the Golden Snake Young Master Xia Xueyi, or the disciple of Divine Sword Immortal Ape Mu Renqing, Yuan Chengzhi."
Judging by the man’s condition.
It’s highly likely to be Yuan Chengzhi.
"I didn’t expect to encounter him here."
Ding Ling shook his head.

Gui Xinshu had given up on avenging Mu Renqing, yet Yuan Chengzhi still thought of revenge. It seemed he either ascended from another world, or had never seen his mighty powers, and thus felt fearless.

Ding Ling no longer dwelled on it, casually grabbing a longsword from the ground with the Dragon Capturing Skill, the sword tip flicked, tearing the shirts of Yuan Chengzhi, Yue the Third, and others.
Revealing some secret manuals, bottles, and jars.
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill, grabbing them into his palm.
The secret manual in Duan Yanqing’s arms included the Jade-Breaking Fist, Iron Finger Technique, and Golden Snake Swordsmanship manuals.
In Yuan Chengzhi’s arms was a half-scroll of the One Yang Finger manual.
In Yue the Third’s arms, there was Divine Transformation.
Ding Ling picked up these secret manuals and began to peruse them.
[Jade-Breaking Fist Full Level]
[Iron Finger Technique Full Level]
Both were barely first-class and couldn’t provide four-dimensional attribute points.
But after reaching full level.
Ding Ling understood their origins, if guessed correctly, Yuan Chengzhi cooperated with Duan Yanqing and their Western Xia First-Grade Hall for revenge.
And offered his own cultivation technique as a gesture of sincerity.
He certainly didn’t expect to die so swiftly and decisively!
[Golden Snake Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
The Golden Snake Swordsmanship, truly a high-tier cultivation technique, when paired with the Golden Snake Sword, revealed its supreme power!
[Divine Transformation Full Level]
Similarly, it couldn’t increase Ding Ling’s attribute points.
However, this lightweight skill was slippery, like a swimming fish, very agile, with a rather simple entry level.
After reading it, Ding Ling handed it to Mu Wanqing and the others, thinking it necessary for them to learn a few simple and easy-to-learn lightweight body techniques.
"Let’s go."
"To Western Xia."
The slaughter here was excessive, the scent of blood too strong.
No one had the appetite to eat, and they all followed Ding Ling, mounting their horses, heading directly towards Western Xia.
Jiu Mozhi was speechless, shaken, once more moved and envious by Ding Ling’s rapid mastery of the Golden Snake Swordsmanship and other scenes.
He had been watching the secret manuals like Golden Snake Swordsmanship by Ding Ling’s side.
While he could remember the content of these manuals with photographic memory, learning them so quickly was impossible.
For a moment, he felt an itch in his heart, wishing to immediately ask Ding Ling for guidance. He was also attracted by the wonder and extraordinariness of these martial arts.
But thinking back along the journey.
He had seen countless secret manuals.
His expression involuntarily changed slightly.
In extreme distress!
Secret manuals from the Langhuan Jade Cave and Returning Water Pavilion inside.
Just these secret manuals were enough for him to study for hundreds of years!
Furthermore...
For the first time, Jiu Mozhi realized life was so brief! There wasn’t even enough time left for him to learn martial arts!
Mu Wanqing and others didn’t know why Ding Ling suddenly changed direction to Western Xia instead of going to Leigushan.
But they didn’t ask much, just silently followed along the way.
On this day.
The group reached the vicinity of Wudang Mountain.
Seeing a burly man about nine feet tall, holding a Tiger-Headed Gold-Inlaid Spear, charging towards their direction, Ding Ling frowned and chose to avoid him.
As the man brushed past him, he left without turning back.
However, after walking a while.
The man couldn’t help but look back at Ding Ling, his eyes showing a complex expression.
Clearly.
He knew Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling didn’t recognize him.
Ding Ling didn’t notice this scene, as he was anxious to hurry to Western Xia.
As he journeyed.
He went quite smoothly.
Encountering many strange individuals.
The burly man just now, though seemingly a mighty general on the battlefield, didn’t catch Ding Ling’s particular attention.
But the next two people he saw made him stop in his tracks.
In the distance, on a deserted mountain path.
Two people were locked in battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - 530: Murong Fu
paragraphs: The first person is well-built, with thick brows, big eyes, a high nose, and a wide mouth, commanding respect without anger;
The other has a face like jade, graceful and elegant, with a regal air, like a prince;
But at this moment, the elegant man is somewhat battered, being pursued and violently attacked by the burly man!
Roar!

The burly man moved with the sound of dragons, sending dragon-shaped shadows shooting out from his palms, with maneuvers like Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing, Flying Dragon in the Sky, Dragon Battle in the Wilderness, precisely the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!

The elegant man repeatedly used a wondrous technique to divert the dragon-shaped Qi Force of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms out of himself, causing it to collide with the dragon-shaped Qi Force. Boom!
Whenever they exchanged palms, it invariably triggered earth-shaking sounds!
Their battle raged on, splitting rocks and shattering thorns, with palm winds rolling thunderously, pressing plants to bow down!
"Star Shifting!"
Jiu Mozhi, with extraordinary insight, saw through the scene with a glance and pressed his palms together:
"If my guess is correct, these two should be Xiaoo Feng and Murong Fu."
The enmity between Xiaoo Feng and Murong Fu has long spread across the world!
True to the old saying, bad news travels fast.
Murong Bo schemed against Xiaoo Feng’s family, breaking his home apart, costing Xiaoo Feng his mother from a young age, and only able to see his father after decades, such blood feud?
How can it be ignored?
The crazed leak from players.
Let’s not mention Xiaoo Feng’s family.
Even the Abbot of the Shaolin Temple had long died within the Buddhist Sect, accompanied in death by Ye Erniang!
Ye Erniang did not follow Duan Yanqing to ambush Ding Ling.

Of course, she had learned the true identity of her son, Xuzhwu. Unfortunately, she was viciously evil, killing people by the thousands, finding pleasure in killing children, truly inhuman. After players embellished her deeds, the Abbot accepted her but knew they could not coexist under heaven, leaving him no face to stay in Shaolin Temple.
Thus, not mounting a defense, allowing himself to be executed, severely injured alive, ultimately dying from untreated injuries.
Similar to what happened in the original TV series.
But Xuzhwu’s fate was completely changed.
He didn’t have a string of extraordinary encounters, thus no reason for Martial Arts to advance. Now, it appears he remains in the Shaolin Temple, serving as a young monk.
"Murong Fu."
Ding Ling suddenly shouted.
Murong Fu reacted uncertainly, heavily exchanging a palm strike with Xiaoo Feng before retreating ten zhang, scanning Ding Ling’s group with some suspicion:
"Who might you be?"
He saw Ding Ling’s group was either exquisite like flowers, or resembled grand monks, or immeasurably mighty, unfathomable.
How dare he underestimate them, his eyes flickered as he pointed at Xiaoo Feng:
"This man is a Khitan person, Xiaoo Feng. Trying to kill us from the Central Plains Martial Arts, I need you to lend me some support. I’d be endlessly grateful."
Xiaoo Feng leaped, landing not far from Ding Ling, facing Murong Fu with a resolute face:
"Murong Fu, we share a feud as deep as the sea, why involve others?"
He glanced at Ding Ling’s group, his gaze fixed on Ding Ling, as he discerned Jiu Mozhi and others defer to Ding Ling:

"Brother, I, Xiaoo Feng, may be Khitan, but I’ve sworn to never kill a Han person. As for Murong Fu, he’s not a Han person; he’s from the Murong Clan of the Xianbei, entering the Central Plains during the Sixteen Kingdoms, establishing the Yan Kingdom! He’s Xianbei! Killing him is my life’s vow. Please, don’t stop me."
"Oh?
Ding Ling raised his brows, suddenly thrusting a palm towards Murong Fu.
Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, Time Riding Six Dragons!

With a single palm strike, six dragon-shaped shadows shot out, amidst the deafening dragon roar, as dragon-shaped Qi Force darted like lightning to Murong Fu’s front, Murong Fu was struck with terror, immediately roaring in fury, running Star Shifting to try to divert the dragon-shaped Qi Force of Time Riding Six Dragons back at Ding Ling!
But Ding Ling’s dragon-shaped Qi Force contained Grandmaster Great Perfection’s energy.
Murong Fu had not yet reached mastery in Star Shifting; how could he move it?
Once the dragon-shaped Qi Force entered his body, it instantly blasted him dozens of zhang away, spewing blood arrows furiously in mid-air.
Xiaoo Feng was shocked and bewildered.
Murong Fu was even more terrified, lost, and panic-stricken.
He couldn’t fathom how this sudden newcomer knew the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, and how his Star Shifting couldn’t divert the opponent’s attack!
It was clearly the same Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
He could even divert Xiaoo Feng’s, why not this person’s?!
Bang!
Murong Fu slammed heavily onto the ground, unable to move.
His five viscera and six bowels were critically injured and decayed!
Near death.
He mustered the last bit of True Qi, shouting furiously:
"Who exactly are you?"
Xiaoo Feng also couldn’t help but look sideways.
"Ding Ling!"
When this name was uttered.
Murong Fu’s pupils widened.
Xiaoo Feng inhaled sharply, his tiger-like eyes glowing fiercely:
"Are you the one who destroyed the Western Xia First-Grade Hall, single-handedly blood-washed Canhe Manor, Ding Ling the Hero Ding?!"
"Yes."
Ding Ling said nothing, but Jiu Mozhi interjected:
"Xiaoo Feng, before you is the world’s unrivaled, peerless, world’s number one person, Hero Ding!"
"Indeed, Hero Ding in person."
Xiaoo Feng respectfully greeted:
"I haven’t yet thanked Hero Ding for avenging me."
"Just a small effort."
Ding Ling pointed towards Murong Fu:
"He’s close to death. You decide how to deal with him.
This move to kill Murong Fu.
Ultimately because.
He and Murong Fu are mortal enemies.
He overturned Canhe Manor’s subordinate Four Great Manors, killing the four great generals.
How could Murong Fu and Murong Bo let it go?
If Ding Ling ascended and left.
If these two run rampant in this world, wouldn’t it be troublesome?
Encountering Murong Fu and doing nothing is fine, but having encountered him, how could Ding Ling allow him to leave?
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You intimidated Murong Fu]
[Annotation: Murong Fu is proud and arrogant. Apart from acknowledging Xiaoo Feng somewhat, among the younger generation, he belittles everyone!
Even among the older generation, few earn his respect.
Your appearance was like a bolt of lightning striking into his world, making him truly realize supreme cultivation! Absolute disparity!
Facing you, he felt insignificant, a sense of ants shaking trees! He was shocked, incredulous that someone like you exists in the world! He regretted, lamenting not fleeing earlier.]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You earned Xiaoo Feng’s high regard.]
[Annotation: You intercepted Murong Fu for him, gravely injuring the opponent with a palm strike. He was amazed by your Dragon Subduing Palm Power and grateful for your assistance.]
In only moments.
Xiaoo Feng returned.
He had killed Murong Fu.
Xiaoo Feng was decisive in killing, with a blood feud against Murong Fu, how could he spare him?
"Hero Ding, I can’t thank you enough. If you ever need me, Xiaoo Feng, feel free to ask."
Xiaoo Feng stood before Ding Ling, speaking.
Ding Ling smiled, noncommittal, only asking:
"Where does Hero Xiaoo intend to go next?"
"I’m going after that villain, Murong Bo."
Xiaoo Feng’s eyes narrowed, seemingly recalling something, his voice heavy:
"Not killing him would not suffice to console my mother’s spirit."
"Where are you headed?"
"Western Xia."
"We are heading to Western Xia too."
Jiu Mozhi said:
"Hero Xiaoo, if you don’t mind, let’s go together."
"...In that case, it’s better to accept than to decline."
Xiaoo Feng hesitated briefly, then decisively agreed.
