If you ever need me, Xiaoo Feng, feel free to ask."
Xiaoo Feng stood before Ding Ling, speaking.
Ding Ling smiled, noncommittal, only asking:
"Where does Hero Xiaoo intend to go next?"
"I’m going after that villain, Murong Bo."
Xiaoo Feng’s eyes narrowed, seemingly recalling something, his voice heavy:
"Not killing him would not suffice to console my mother’s spirit."
"Where are you headed?"
"Western Xia."
"We are heading to Western Xia too."
Jiu Mozhi said:
"Hero Xiaoo, if you don’t mind, let’s go together."
"...In that case, it’s better to accept than to decline."
Xiaoo Feng hesitated briefly, then decisively agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 531: Ding Ling vs. One Hundred Thousand Elites
paragraphs: This journey to Western Xia.
It took several days.
During these days of interaction.
Ding Ling and Xiaoo Feng had already become friends.
The two naturally no longer called each other "Hero" politely, but directly referred to each other by name.
For this.
Xiaoo Feng exclaimed more than once that Ding Ling surprisingly did not mind his identity as a Khitan person, and was willing to be friends with him!
Of course.
He was most astonished that Ding Ling’s Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms had been cultivated to the level of Great Perfection Innate Ability in the Transformation Realm!
Moreover, Ding Ling’s power was so high, it was something Xiaoo Feng could not hope to match!
This made Xiaoo Feng feel a sense of insignificance and vulnerability, like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
Xiaoo Feng felt such overwhelming and terrifying pressure from a peer for the first time.
He was very curious about how Ding Ling trained, so he directly asked.
Ding Ling replied, saying he trained normally.
Xiaoo Feng was momentarily at a loss for words, then asked how many years he’d practiced.
Ding Ling replied, less than ten years.
This shocked Xiaoo Feng’s heart to the core, filled him with admiration for Ding Ling.
He had been pursuing Murong Fu during this period.

But he occasionally heard news of Ding Ling from some Jianghu people, naturally knowing Ding Ling had shattered the void and emerged from the Lower Realm. After exchanging insights with Ding Ling over a few days, they also sparred.
The result was as expected.
He was easily overwhelmed and subdued by Ding Ling.

Regarding this, Xiaoo Feng could only express that Ding Ling was indeed the first person of the Lower Realm. Now, seeing this situation, becoming the first person of this realm was undoubtedly within reach.
Ding Ling smiled and said nothing.
He glanced at the task progress.
[1: Defeat more than 20 plane experts: 15/20.]
Previously, it was 6 people.
Subsequently, he defeated Jiu Mozhi, the four family generals of the Murong Family, Duan Yanqing, Yue the Third, Murong Fu, and Xiaoo Feng.
The progress bar of Task 3 also increased considerably.
But to truly complete it, more time was needed.
Ding Ling decided to act swiftly.
"I think that once I crush Western Xia and Liao Kingdom, the progress bar for Task 3 should quickly reach 100%."
Ding Ling had experience in this.
Naturally, he wouldn’t go out of his way to find absolute experts in the world to spar with.
That would be too troublesome.
Besides, the Sweeping Monk was known to be in Shaolin Temple.
Other experts might not necessarily hide in one place, and Ding Ling could not chase them across various places.
The best method was to unify Jiuzhou!
He had done this in the previous world.
This time doing it, Ding Ling had no psychological burden at all.
Moreover, at the moment he saw Xiaoo Feng.
He already had an idea in mind.
During the days of interacting with Xiaoo Feng.
Ding Ling engaged in deep conversations with Xiaoo Feng, discovering that indeed he was a man with great passion, courage, insight, deep feelings, and gratitude.
Ding Ling was looking for just this kind of person.
Especially after discovering Xiaoo Feng’s abilities to govern a country were good as well, he nodded silently in approval.

He thought of Xiaoo Feng’s experiences as the Southern Court King and Beggar Gang Leader, imagining that with capable people assisting Xiaoo Feng, he could potentially become an emperor without much issue.
With this in mind.
Ding Ling’s heart was settled.
This day.
Everyone finally reached the lands of Western Xia.
Welcoming Ding Ling was Western Xia’s hundred thousand armored warriors!
Troops in rows and columns, densely packed upon the land.
Clearly visible from afar.
Jiu Mozhi, startled, felt fear:

"Amitabha Buddha, it seems Western Xia was already prepared. Hero Ding, a wise man doesn’t fight when disadvantaged. Should we retreat for now, come back another day, and strategize slowly, wouldn’t that be better?"
Xiaoo Feng also saw and his brows leapt in fear, saying cautiously:

"I am not afraid of them, but with so many strong warriors, if thousands of arrows were to be fired at once, even if I had ten lives, it wouldn’t be enough to survive. Master Jiu Mozhi’s words make sense. We should retreat or bypass them altogether. It might be better."
Ding Ling responded:
"You all stay here. I will go alone."
"Husband."
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling were startled, hastened forward to hold Ding Ling’s arm:
"These are ten thousand elites!"
"Don’t worry. You’ve heard my stories, you must have heard about how I alone crushed the Mongol Kingdom’s million-strong army. Merely ten thousand troops is nothing worth mentioning."
Ding Ling’s cultivation compared to the Lower Realm had increased tenfold!
He truly did not consider Western Xia’s elite forces a threat.
"This..."
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling hesitated.
Ding Ling directly freed his hand from their grasp, flying skyward, stepping into the void, sweeping towards the distance like a gust of wind:
’Stay put, don’t move, just watch me act.’
Xiaoo Feng initially wanted to follow.
But Jiu Mozhi held him back:
"Xiaoo Feng, since Hero Ding says it’s no problem, then it must indeed be no problem. We have encountered several surprise attacks along the way, each resolved by him alone effortlessly."
"Even if he doesn’t crush the ten thousand troops, he can surely retreat safely."
Jiu Mozhi had immense admiration and respect for Ding Ling:
"No one in this world can kill Ding Ling. If we follow, we’ll only be a burden."
Xiaoo Feng was speechless.
He was told for the first time that he would be a burden.
Also, for the first time, he could only be a spectator, watching others display their prowess!
This sense of disparity left him somewhat bewildered and dazed.
But he was ultimately not comparable to ordinary people, soon regaining clarity, his eyes gazing intensely into the distance.

Ding Ling was like a bolt of lightning, charging into the hundred thousand troops. He fought unarmed, one-handedly deploying the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, dragon shapes flying chaotically in the sky, with each strike of palm power, he could shatter and send hundreds flying!
"Terrifying!"
Xiaoo Feng was moved.
When Ding Ling struck down Murong Fu before, he felt the strength and dominance of Ding Ling’s Dragon Subduing Palm Power.
But watching now, he realized he had underestimated Ding Ling, who was tenfold, hundredfold more fierce than he had imagined.
"Roar!"
A roar, tearing through the four sides.
Like a Lion’s Roar.
More like a Hellish Ghost Roar, even from afar, Xiaoo Feng felt enveloped by cold frost, a chilling trepidation creeping upon him.
"Such powerful Sound Wave Skill."
Jiu Mozhi’s heart burned immensely.
"If only this monk could learn such a Sound Wave Skill, that would be wonderful."
He saw clearly, as Ding Ling roared once.
No less than hundreds, a thousand screamed and fell to the ground.
Ding Ling charged swiftly.

Like a whirlwind sweeping across the earth, no one could stop him, for even a moment! His rush through the troops was like tempestuous waves crashing against a small boat, more like the Celestial River pouring down onto the Mortal World, unstoppable and unavoidable!

Wherever he went, devastation followed, like autumn leaves swept by the wind, he alone emulated the rage of a thousand Iron Cavalries crossing the Frozen River to drive deep into the enemy camp with surging force!
Making one’s blood boil, deeply shaken!
"No wonder Ding Ling said there was no need for us to go."
Xiaoo Feng became clear and relieved, his heart burning intensely:
"Unbelievable that when martial cultivation reaches its peak, one person can topple an entire country! Incredibly fierce!"
"Husband."
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling heard, couldn’t help but exchange glances, clearly seeing the pride in each other’s eyes!
Someone praised Ding Ling.
It pleased and excited them even more than flattering them.
Rumble!
Roar!

Roars echoed in waves, Dragon Subduing Palm Power striking in all directions, Ding Ling alone, like an autumn wind sweeping fallen leaves, obliterated no less than tens of thousands, rapidly storming to the middle command location of Western Xia’s great general, and with one palm struck, ventured!
Countless dragon-shaped illusions shot out from his palm, flipping and flinging away the blocking warriors!
Just one palm.
Easily sending hundreds flying!
The sight left the great general Helian Tieshu with a face of panic and fear, turning to leap onto his horse fleeing.
He had wanted to flee earlier.
But was intimidated by Ding Chunqiu, so dared not escape recklessly.
Now, even Ding Chunqiu had slipped away, how could Helian Tieshu choose to stay and wait to die.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - 532: Invincible! Li Qiushui
paragraphs: Helian Tieshu’s horse is a Ferghana Horse, it runs very fast.
But no matter how fast it is, it’s not as fast as Ding Ling!
Whoosh!

Ding Ling propelled the Ripple Step with Fusion Qi, the Gang Qi from the North Nether Divine Skill and Nine Yang Divine Skill spread all over his body, with the Vigorous Qi from Star Shifting roaming around the Gang Qi, he charged forward wildly, wherever he went, cavalry, shield soldiers, sword soldiers, spear soldiers, generals, without exception, were all knocked flying by him.
He was like a quickly moving mountain; more like a terrifying wave rolling into the sky!
As he passed through.
No matter how others defended or countered, their attacks would automatically rebound, the harder the sword soldiers attacked Ding Ling, the stronger the force of the rebound!
Countless generals and soldiers were severely injured or killed on the spot by the rebounding force.
More people simply couldn’t escape in time and were brutally knocked out or killed by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was clearly just one person.
But in the eyes of the Western Xia soldiers, he seemed like a charge of ten thousand elephants, rumbling towards them, that momentum was unstoppable, that aura was boundlessly surging to the extreme!
Just looking at him, their legs went soft.
And upon slight contact.
They felt like they were trampled by galloping horses, a sharp pain shot into their brains, and then they knew nothing.
At the moment of death, they had only one thought:

"Is this person man or ghost or god! How can a mere mortal possess such terrifying power! If he were a ghost, why could we see him clearly? If he were a god, why would our general dare to ambush or besiege him?!"
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
Like a hundred thousand thundering cavalry stomping the ground, leaving a trail of devastation! Rivers of blood flowing!
A mere human, roaming like a god amidst a hundred thousand elite warriors!
Helian Tieshu was scared out of his wits, his soul almost departed!
He knew only to desperately urge the Ferghana Horse to run faster.
Boom!
Ding Ling quickly caught up, displayed the Dragon Capturing Skill, and with a sweep of his hand in the air, Helian Tieshu found himself captured and dragged beside Ding Ling, bang!
Ding Ling slapped him, instantly causing Helian Tieshu’s right cheek to swell.

Helian Tieshu shivered, instantly snapping out of his daze, before Ding Ling could speak, he knelt down to beg for mercy, shouting ’It’s all not my fault. I was just following orders, spare me, hero, spare me!’
Totally lacking the demeanor of a general.
"Tell them to surrender."
Ding Ling said indifferently.
"Yes, yes, yes!"

Helian Tieshu was not tall, nor handsome, but he was quite imposing, his inner strength at a first-class level, although terrified by Ding Ling, he was still commanding and majestic in front of ordinary soldiers:
"Everyone, hear my command."
At Ding Ling’s indication, he got up again, walked to the front of the central army, and with a resounding roar, as if venting the fear and panic in his heart hysterically, his voice was hoarse:
"Surrender to Hero Ding!"
"Kneel with me!"
Helian Tieshu was the first to kneel to Ding Ling.
The remaining soldiers looked at each other, and someone in the shadows threw down their weapon, which seemed to trigger a chain reaction, clatter!
Weapons were thrown to the ground one after another.
Each soldier drooped their heads, their faces full of despair and fear, knelt to the ground!
They had heard from some aliens about Ding Ling’s terrifying prowess.
They had dismissed it as exaggeration, after all, this is the human world! How could a god arise!
But today they witnessed and experienced this terrifying battle.
From the bottom of their hearts, they feared Ding Ling! They thoroughly believed the words of the aliens.
"Gather the great army, and surround the Western Xia Imperial City for me."
Ding Ling glanced at Helian Tieshu:
"You better not run. Or I’ll annihilate your whole family!"
"This humble general wouldn’t dare!"
Helian Tieshu, seeing Ding Ling not killing him, heaved a sigh of relief, feeling a weight lifted from his heart, immediately swore with a righteous, sonorous voice:
"This humble general will definitely stand by the lord’s command, even if the lord commands me to die, I would not dare to resist at all!"
"I hope you keep your word."
Ding Ling said: "Go ahead."
"Yes. I shall obey!"
Helian Tieshu instinctively responded, preparing to lead the army to surround the city, but thinking of someone, couldn’t help but say:

"That Ding Chunqiu is of the current Imperial Consort’s faction. His skills are high, and his use of poison is indefensible. This humble general was previously ensnared by him. If he uses this to threaten me again, I worry..."
Ding Ling frowned at him for a moment.
Helian Tieshu dared not continue speaking, he gritted his teeth and said:
"This humble general will certainly complete the task to the death!"
Helian Tieshu clearly was a coward.
Ding Ling glanced at him, noticed the poison indeed affected him, and took out a strange flower he acquired earlier from the deep pool beneath Wuliang Mountain.
He casually plucked a small leaf and gave it to Helian Tieshu to ingest.
Helian Tieshu dared not refuse, after consuming it, he spat out a mouthful of thick, dark blood.
In an instant, he felt refreshed, joyfully, repeatedly knelt to thank Ding Ling, who waved him off, signaling him to stop wasting time and hurry with the task.
Helian Tieshu respectfully bowed a few times, then mounted his horse, commanding the remnants of tens of thousands of the army towards the direction of the Imperial City.
Ding Ling waited a short while at his position.
Xiaoo Feng and others arrived on horseback.
"Husband."

Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling, with faces full of joy, dismounted, rushed to Ding Ling, examining him from head to toe, seeing he was indeed unharmed, they were shocked, but more so joyful and full of admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - 532: Unstoppable! Li Qiushui (Part 2)
paragraphs: This man, invincible in the world, turns out to be their husband!
’So explosive.’
Xiaoo Feng followed the Alien and learned some new vocabulary. At this moment, he skillfully used it, looking at Ding Ling with a face of reverence as if gazing at a Divine Being:
"I, Xiaoo Feng, can’t even match half of Ding Ling!"
"Indeed."
Jiu Mozhi deeply agreed:

"One hundred thousand troops were smashed by Hero Ding alone. Unprecedented in history! Up and down through several thousand years, this may be the only example! Just this battle, Hero Ding is enough to be recorded in history and worshipped by future generations!"
Ling Yanqiu was dumbfounded and did not say much at the moment, just looked at Ding Ling with increasingly admiring eyes.
Ding Ling smiled ambiguously and gave a brief instruction to everyone.

He then operated the Spiral Nine Shadows, Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, transforming into a wisp of blue smoke straight into twenty yards of void, then flew toward the direction of the Imperial City!
His speed was extremely fast.
Indeed later surpassed others.
Arrived at the Western Xia Imperial City before Helian Tieshu’s Great Army.
"Stop ahead!"

Above the city gate tower, a General saw Ding Ling, his pupils contract involuntarily, face filled with shock, hardly able to believe that such a high-level Lightweight Skill exists in the world, he said timidly and fiercely:
"Or don’t blame me for being rude."
Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered with him, casually waved an Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms down.
Time Riding Six Dragons!
Roar!
Six Dragon-shaped Qis, like six Divine Dragons, broke into the city gate tower. Listening to the rumbling sound of explosions, but in an instant, everything quieted down.
As Ding Ling’s Cultivation gets higher.
The explosive power of Fusion Qi becomes increasingly terrifying.
One palm of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
Can easily blow away, and kill hundreds of ordinary elite soldiers clustered together.
The soldiers on the city gate tower happened to be clustered together.
All were killed by one palm of Ding Ling.
Seeing this, the General, who originally wanted to stop Ding Ling, shut up immediately, pretending not to see, quietly slipping away to one side.
They secretly wiped cold sweat, thankful for their slow response, if they reacted a bit faster and insulted Ding Ling, would they be dead now?
Ding Ling ignored these people, flew straight to the direction of the Imperial Palace.
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling’s speed was fast.
With a single leap, he covered over twenty yards, rapidly advancing, quickly bringing the Imperial Palace into his field of vision.
He saw many Guards here as well.
These Guards might be loyal to the Emperor, or fearless of death, as Death Warriors.
Each saw Ding Ling and started firing, attacking him frantically.
Ding Ling unleashed the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Lines of Sword Qi can easily penetrate through the carcasses of five or six people.
He flew forward just like this.
The Six Meridian Divine Sword was like a grass-cutting machine, wherever it passed, a swath of Imperial Palace experts and guards fell dead on the ground.
Ding Ling flew over the outer city of the Imperial Palace, reached the inner city.
There were few guards here.
Many eunuchs.
Ding Ling grabbed a eunuch leader, asking him to lead the way to find Li Qiushui.
Ordinary eunuchs might not know exactly where Li Qiushui, the Imperial Consort, went today.
But this leader happened to know where she went today.
He led Ding Ling, turning and twisting all the way, reaching a Phoenix Pavilion.
"She’s right there."
Ding Ling casually hit his acupoint.
The leader collapsed on the ground.
Ding Ling ignored him, flew into the Phoenix Pavilion, scanned it with one glance.
The layout and arrangement here were extremely luxurious, bright, and majestic.
Listening attentively.
Could vaguely hear the sound of a woman speaking.
Coming from...

Ding Ling’s eyes turned, looked toward the inner room on the left, and activated the Ripple Step, whoosh! Like a breeze sweeping by, in the blink of an eye, arrived at the entrance of the inner room, click.
Ding Ling pushed open the door.
Saw a woman dressed in white, with an elegant figure, her face masked in light gauze, torturing a handsome young man.
Seeing Ding Ling suddenly break in.
The woman’s expression changed drastically, angrily saying:
"How bold, daring to intrude into my Phoenix Pavilion. You’re courting death!"
She didn’t ask why Ding Ling broke in, nor did she ask who Ding Ling was.
Raised her hand, a slap towards Ding Ling’s direction printed over, suddenly, palm wind surged, transformed into an imprint that seemed to crush everything, covered down towards Ding Ling’s head.
Ding Ling ignored this palm imprint, body flashed, directly collided with the imprint, Star Shifting exerted its power, boom!
The palm imprint flew back at ten times the speed it came, toward the woman’s face!
The woman’s expression changed.
Instinctively grabbed the man on the ground and blocked him in front of herself.
Bang!
A heavy sound.
The man’s body split open, from beginning to end, didn’t even have time to let out a scream.
"Such strong rebound force."
The woman was shocked and cautiously asked:
"Who exactly are you?!"
She was usually high and mighty, accustomed to killing at will.
Also no one dared to defy her.
Unexpectedly encountering a tough character today!
"Li Qiushui?"
Ding Ling instead asked.
"Who exactly are you!"
Seeing Ding Ling dare to openly call her name in the Imperial Palace, Li Qiushui frantically operated the power of Small Faceless Skill, warning:
"This is the Western Xia Imperial City. If you do not wish to die, you’d better not act rashly."
"It really is you."
Ding Ling ignored Li Qiushui’s warning, activated Ripple Step, whoosh! Like a wisp of smoke, in an instant surged into Li Qiushui’s face, reached out to grab her shoulder.
"Ripple Step!"

Li Qiushui’s pupil shrunk, frantically retreating while operating the equally exquisite Ripple Step under her feet, like a gentle breeze against a willow, brushing past Ding Ling, leaping to one side.
This moment was extremely dangerous, nearly caught by Ding Ling.
Li Qiushui broke out in a sweat, thinking luckily she learned the Breathing Technique half a month ago, gaining tenfold explosive power, otherwise just now, she would have been finished!

’So explosive.’
Xiaoo Feng followed the Alien and learned some new vocabulary.
At this moment, he skillfully used it, looking at Ding Ling with a face of reverence as if gazing at a Divine Being:
"I, Xiaoo Feng, can’t even match half of Ding Ling!"
"Indeed."
Jiu Mozhi deeply agreed:
"One hundred thousand troops were smashed by Hero Ding alone.
Unprecedented in history!
Up and down through several thousand years, this may be the only example!
Just this battle, Hero Ding is enough to be recorded in history and worshipped by future generations!"

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - 532: Sweeping All Before Him! Li Qiushui_3
paragraphs: How could she not see Ding Ling’s terrifying prowess? She looked around, not finding any help, her heart sank to the bottom of the valley. Yet she refused to give up so easily, and advised:

"I don’t care who you are. If you kill me, do you think the Emperor of Western Xia will let you go?! At that time, no place in the world will have room for you, do you want to be a wanderer, hunted everywhere, having a meal could be poisoned? Is this really good?!"
"Your mouth is quite sharp."
Ding Ling had just used ten percent of his power, surprisingly Li Qiushui escaped. He then decided not to waste words with her, immediately unleashing Grandmaster Great Perfection Energy, swoosh!
In an instant, he transformed into a flash of lightning, grasping Li Qiushui, who was ready to flee with Ripple Step!
Li Qiushui had no time to react, and fell into Ding Ling’s hands.
Her heart was shocked and terrified to the extreme, instinctively she struck a heavy White Rainbow Palm Force towards Ding Ling’s forehead.
Ding Ling ignored.
Started activating North Nether Divine Skill!
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
Whoosh whoosh!
The surging inner power in Li Qiushui’s Dantian began to pour madly into Ding Ling’s Dantian.
[Inner Power Value +230]
In one breath, Ding Ling increased by two North Nether True Qi!
The purity of her inner strength was evident!
"North, North, North Nether Divine Skill!!"
The White Rainbow Palm Force that Li Qiushui struck had not yet reached Ding Ling’s forehead, her power was nearly drained dry, causing her extreme shock, bewilderment, fear, and helplessness:
"Who, who exactly are you, why can you use Ripple Step and North Nether Divine Skill!"
"By now, do you still not know who I am?
Ding Ling absorbed ninety-nine percent of Li Qiushui’s power.
Left her with a little bit.
He sensed that if he drained this person dry, she might not survive.
Ding Ling planned to use her to trade with Heavenly Mountain Granny, hence was not willing to kill her now.
"You, you are..."
A flash of lightning crossed Li Qiushui’s mind, suddenly, she shivered, her pupils enlarged, horrified:
"You, you are Ding, Ding, Ding Ling?!"
Ding Ling smiled nonchalantly.
Casually asked:
"Where is the Cultivation Secret Manual you practice?"
Li Qiushui did not answer.

Her mind was in chaos, filled with ’impossible’ ’this is absolutely impossible’ ’ten thousand elite troops blocked the path to the Imperial City, how could Ding Ling possibly enter the Imperial City now!’
Clearly, in her perception, worldview.
Being human, it is absolutely impossible to achieve super-god feats!
Of course, she had heard some aliens speak of Ding Ling’s feats, but only as rumors and stories.
She had contact with aliens.
Knowing most of them prioritize interests, flatter, and like to boast!
How could she take their words seriously?
Yet how could she know?

Those players knew she was Li Qiushui and thought of all the Divine Skill Secret Manuals on her body, naturally, they tried to please her, thus, naturally fell short, making Li Qiushui look down on aliens, naturally, she did not believe them.
"How did you get in?!"
Li Qiushui was an extremely resilient character, after her daze, she immediately regained composure, staring at Ding Ling:
"The ten thousand elites I dispatched, not to mention a martial arts master, even a hundred, a thousand can be killed absolutely. How could you have broken through?"
"That’s you looking at the sky from a well, ignorant and uninformed."
Ding Ling had no interest in wasting words with Li Qiushui.
Started using Stargazing Skill, Dao of Array, Mechanical Skill to observe this Phoenix Pavilion.
Soon.
He discovered something peculiar.
He walked towards a table with camellia placed on it, pressed the base of the camellia, twisting hard, crack crack!
Three meters away, the floor surprisingly slowly ’opened a mouth’, revealing an earth dao.
The earth dao was deep, leading to unknown directions.
Li Qiushui’s view became increasingly frightened, dazed:
"This, this earth dao I have never told anyone about! How did you know?!"
Her gaze at Ding Ling became increasingly astonished, puzzled, beaten, helpless.
Ding Ling did not explain, merely walked over, grabbed Li Qiushui, heading towards the earth dao.
"It’s useless."
Li Qiushui realized she couldn’t escape, she gave up.

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - 533: Grandmaster! White Rainbow Palm Force
paragraphs: At this moment, Li Qiushui’s heart felt ashen, her martial arts power drained completely.
Even the specially crafted hidden passage had been discovered by someone.
One must know that the artisans, palace maids, and others who knew about this hidden passage at the time had been secretly executed by her!
Unexpectedly, it was discovered by Ding Ling now!
How on earth did Ding Ling detect something abnormal about that tea table?!
Li Qiushui was utterly perplexed, even to the point of asking again.
However, Ding Ling showed no intention of answering her.
Seeing this, Li Qiushui wisely refrained from asking, her face growing increasingly bleak.

She had imagined dying of old age, dying at the hands of Heavenly Mountain Granny, dying amidst the struggle for imperial power, but never imagined dying at the hands of Ding Ling, who stormed alone into the Imperial Palace!
This was too absurd, like something out of a fairy tale, beyond her imagination!
[E-level Achievement Medal earned: You have shocked Li Qiushui.]

[Note: Li Qiushui is as beautiful as a celestial immortal, with a ruthless and capricious nature. In her worldview, there is virtually no one she cannot kill! Even the Palace Master of Lingjiu Palace, whom she values greatly, she is confident she can kill!
And you are the only one who has come against the wind, easily subdued and crushed her. She has never seen a master like you, causing her to lose composure, bewildered, astonished, and stunned.]
Li Qiushui’s martial arts cultivation was clearly at the Innate Middle Tier.
Quite remarkable.
If she worked a bit harder, reaching High Tier Innate, or even Grandmaster Tier, would not be difficult.
Simply because Ding Ling noticed her exceptional potential, a natural martial arts prodigy.
Unfortunately, he and she were enemies.
Tap, tap!
Stepping on the stone steps of the earth passage, with crisp echoing sounds, he walked further and further away, making a turn in the middle, finally arriving at a secret chamber.
Inside, it was filled with various gold and silver jewelry and treasures, even in this dark underground chamber it shone brightly, saying that they were worth a fortune would not be an exaggeration.
Ding Ling moved towards the next secret chamber.
This one was open too.
Yet, several handsome, elegant, with divine appearances like jade trees from remote forests were imprisoned inside.
Most of these men were shackled with heavy chains, under the dim yellow light, their expressions were either indifferent, ashen-faced, or simply lying on the bed holding a book, reading...
There were as many as six.
Different in temperament and demeanor.
But all were incredibly handsome men.
Ding Ling saw them.
They saw Ding Ling too, especially when they noticed Li Qiushui standing behind Ding Ling, one by one they stood respectfully and bowed:
"Greetings to the Imperial Consort."
They glanced at Ding Ling, eyes showing vigilance and hostility.
Ding Ling was initially puzzled.
But quickly came to a realization.
No doubt.
These men must have mistaken him for a competitor, thinking he was the newly recruited ’male concubine’ of Li Qiushui?
Ding Ling glanced at Li Qiushui.
The light veil on her face had already been knocked off.

Though the sword scars on her face were quite obvious, her appearance seemed no more than forty years old, still graceful with strong charm, her features were identical to those of Wang Yuyan and Li Qingluo.
Except her temperament leaned more towards cold arrogance and wantonness.
Seeing this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but marvel at how formidable Li Qiushui’s genes were!

That Duan Yu who saw the jade statue in the stone cave of Wuliang Mountain became entranced, fell into a daze as if possessed, even uttered the words ’Immortal Sister, to see your beauty today makes dying without regret’, although the jade statue carved was not of Li Qiushui, yet their appearance was identical, this clearly shows how high Li Qiushui’s allure was, and how beautiful her looks were.
Moreover, counting by age, Li Qiushui was already over eighty, her face bore several conspicuous scars, but she still resembled the Gushe Fairy.
Through three generations, their features and figures were almost identical, such genetics are rare throughout history.
Tap, tap.
Ding Ling ignored these men and headed for the next room.
Li Qiushui, grasped by Ding Ling’s Formless Qi from the Dragon Capturing Skill, followed without her own volition.
Leaving the handsome men to look at each other, unsure what to do.
For a good while.
One of them spoke softly:
"The Consort seems to be in a strange state. Her complexion, her gaze, both are odd. It’s as if she is filled with fear and helplessness toward that man."
"Unbelievable. I’ve never seen the Consort in this manner before! She used to look down on us, treat us like servants. Who would have thought she herself would fall into the same fate as us."
Although the handsome men had been confined here for some time.
They evidently understood Li Qiushui well enough.
It shows that both parties were extremely close normally.
What perceptive eyes Ding Ling has?
He easily discerned that these men had a relationship with Li Qiushui beyond mere physical intimacy.
Could not help but shake his head secretly, Li Qiushui’s capricious nature was beyond his imagination, a woman raising a bunch of handsome men.
Moreover, she had taken a handsome man to play with earlier.
But from her casually using men as a shield, it can be seen, she certainly killed many of these men.
A real deviant!
Ding Ling stopped overthinking.
After all, he only considered Li Qiushui as a tool, would not have much interaction with her.
Reaching the third room.
Ding Ling saw rows upon rows of bookshelves.
The bookshelves were crammed with various secret manuals.
Ding Ling’s heart was filled with joy.
Immediately stepped forward.
Randomly picked one up.
Netherworld Ghost Claw
Ding Ling quickly skimmed through it.
Reading ten lines at a glance.
Finished in ten breaths.
[Netherworld Ghost Claw Full Level]
[Power +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was clearly a superior claw technique.
After condensing into a claw, it became invincible and extremely fierce.
Picked up the next one.
"White Rainbow Palm Force"
This is Li Qiushui’s supreme skill.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
Quickly flipped through.
Soon.
[White Rainbow Palm Force Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This palm technique is a top-tier Splitting Sky Palm Technique.
It’s much more powerful than Huang Laoxie’s Splitting Sky Palm.
The Splitting Sky Palm cannot make turns, but this palm technique can bend and straighten at will, the palm force unleashed can actually curve!
After reaching full level with White Rainbow Palm Force.

Ding Ling couldn’t resist testing it out; as he slapped out a palm, a palm print condensed in the void, controlled by Ding Ling’s palm force, moving up and down, suddenly left and right, swinging unpredictably!
"It really works!"
Ding Ling was delighted.
This is the first time he encountered such a palm technique!

Not only can it split through the air, but it can also remotely control the palm force, and because he had already reached full level with extremely profound power, this White Rainbow Palm Force executed by him was truly flawless and exceptionally distinct.
Li Qiushui was completely stunned.
She cultivated White Rainbow Palm Force for decades but couldn’t reach Ding Ling’s level of mastery.
She confirmed her White Rainbow Palm Force reached Great Perfection Innate Ability, there was only one possibility, Ding Ling’s power far surpassed hers by manyfold!
Realizing Ding Ling just looked for a moment and reached Great Perfection with White Rainbow Palm Force.
Li Qiushui was bewildered, unable to suppress the tumultuous waves within her heart, she asked:
"You know North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step. How do you know my White Rainbow Palm Force too? Where did you learn it from?"
She was certain.
The Secret Manual of North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step are known to be in the stone cave at Wuliang Mountain.
But White Rainbow Palm Force, she certainly never passed it on to anyone else!
How did Ding Ling learn it?!
Ding Ling ignored her and picked up the next Secret Manual to read.
Soon after.
[Cold Sleeve Brushing Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is a Martial Arts technique that can unleash supreme power using a sleeve.
Next one.
[Turtle Breath Skill Full Level]
[Transformation Technique Full Level]
[Corpse Rot Skill Full Level]
Each Secret Manual Ding Ling finished reading instantly reached full level.
His aura was continuously growing.

Especially when Transformation Technique reached full level, visible Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi swarmed him and overwhelmed him, a scene Li Qiushui witnessed clearly, leaving her utterly shocked.
At this moment.
How could she not understand?
Ding Ling was truly an unimaginably supreme martial arts prodigy!
These techniques, he mastered and reached Great Perfection just by glancing at them.
She witnessed it clearly.
The Transformation Technique is a peerless evil skill, most can’t even reach entry level, let alone perfection and Great Perfection.
Ding Ling achieved Great Perfection instantly, his ability, talent.
Just thinking about it.
Li Qiushui couldn’t help but tremble in her heart, sweat on her forehead, experiencing for the first time feelings of regret and remorse.
If she knew Ding Ling was such a defiant and unrivaled talent, she would definitely not have opposed him.
Unfortunately.
There’s no regret medicine in this world.
[True Power Value 21 points]
After full level Transformation Technique.
Ding Ling absorbed Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi, instantly adding a strand of North Nether True Qi to his dantian.
Along with previous strands,
Three in one.
Another drop of North Nether True Water emerged.
Reaching this step.
Ding Ling unexpectedly stepped into the realm of Grandmaster!
In terms of True Qi Cultivation.
He had reached the world’s shackles, unable to advance further.
To make progress.
He must break the world’s shackles, shatter the void, and move to higher realms.
’Didn’t expect to become a Grandmaster so quickly.’
Ding Ling keenly perceived.
Upon reaching Grandmaster.
His strength drastically differed from before.
Can easily crush Initial Tier Grandmasters.
An Initial Tier Grandmaster alone can face dozens of Initial Tier Grandmaster characters, no problem at all!
This is the absolute crushing of higher realms!
If Grandmasters were like ordinary mountains, then Grandmasters were like towering peaks, the two are not of the same level at all.

sentences.text: At this moment, Li Qiushui’s heart felt ashen, her martial arts power drained completely.
Even the specially crafted hidden passage had been discovered by someone.
One must know that the artisans, palace maids, and others who knew about this hidden passage at the time had been secretly executed by her!
Unexpectedly, it was discovered by Ding Ling now!
How on earth did Ding Ling detect something abnormal about that tea table?!
Li Qiushui was utterly perplexed, even to the point of asking again.
However, Ding Ling showed no intention of answering her.
Seeing this, Li Qiushui wisely refrained from asking, her face growing increasingly bleak.

She had imagined dying of old age, dying at the hands of Heavenly Mountain Granny, dying amidst the struggle for imperial power, but never imagined dying at the hands of Ding Ling, who stormed alone into the Imperial Palace!
This was too absurd, like something out of a fairy tale, beyond her imagination!
[E-level Achievement Medal earned: You have shocked Li Qiushui.]
[Note: Li Qiushui is as beautiful as a celestial immortal, with a ruthless and capricious nature.
In her worldview, there is virtually no one she cannot kill!
Even the Palace Master of Lingjiu Palace, whom she values greatly, she is confident she can kill!
And you are the only one who has come against the wind, easily subdued and crushed her.
She has never seen a master like you, causing her to lose composure, bewildered, astonished, and stunned.]
Li Qiushui’s martial arts cultivation was clearly at the Innate Middle Tier.
Quite remarkable.
If she worked a bit harder, reaching High Tier Innate, or even Grandmaster Tier, would not be difficult.
Simply because Ding Ling noticed her exceptional potential, a natural martial arts prodigy.
Unfortunately, he and she were enemies.
Tap, tap!
Stepping on the stone steps of the earth passage, with crisp echoing sounds, he walked further and further away, making a turn in the middle, finally arriving at a secret chamber.
Inside, it was filled with various gold and silver jewelry and treasures, even in this dark underground chamber it shone brightly, saying that they were worth a fortune would not be an exaggeration.
Ding Ling moved towards the next secret chamber.
This one was open too.
Yet, several handsome, elegant, with divine appearances like jade trees from remote forests were imprisoned inside.
Most of these men were shackled with heavy chains, under the dim yellow light, their expressions were either indifferent, ashen-faced, or simply lying on the bed holding a book, reading...
There were as many as six.
Different in temperament and demeanor.
But all were incredibly handsome men.
Ding Ling saw them.
They saw Ding Ling too, especially when they noticed Li Qiushui standing behind Ding Ling, one by one they stood respectfully and bowed:
"Greetings to the Imperial Consort."
They glanced at Ding Ling, eyes showing vigilance and hostility.
Ding Ling was initially puzzled.
But quickly came to a realization.
No doubt.
These men must have mistaken him for a competitor, thinking he was the newly recruited ’male concubine’ of Li Qiushui?
Ding Ling glanced at Li Qiushui.
The light veil on her face had already been knocked off.

Though the sword scars on her face were quite obvious, her appearance seemed no more than forty years old, still graceful with strong charm, her features were identical to those of Wang Yuyan and Li Qingluo.
Except her temperament leaned more towards cold arrogance and wantonness.
Seeing this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but marvel at how formidable Li Qiushui’s genes were!

That Duan Yu who saw the jade statue in the stone cave of Wuliang Mountain became entranced, fell into a daze as if possessed, even uttered the words ’Immortal Sister, to see your beauty today makes dying without regret’, although the jade statue carved was not of Li Qiushui, yet their appearance was identical, this clearly shows how high Li Qiushui’s allure was, and how beautiful her looks were.
Moreover, counting by age, Li Qiushui was already over eighty, her face bore several conspicuous scars, but she still resembled the Gushe Fairy.
Through three generations, their features and figures were almost identical, such genetics are rare throughout history.
Tap, tap.
Ding Ling ignored these men and headed for the next room.
Li Qiushui, grasped by Ding Ling’s Formless Qi from the Dragon Capturing Skill, followed without her own volition.
Leaving the handsome men to look at each other, unsure what to do.
For a good while.
One of them spoke softly:
"The Consort seems to be in a strange state.
Her complexion, her gaze, both are odd.
It’s as if she is filled with fear and helplessness toward that man."
"Unbelievable.
I’ve never seen the Consort in this manner before!
She used to look down on us, treat us like servants.
Who would have thought she herself would fall into the same fate as us."
Although the handsome men had been confined here for some time.
They evidently understood Li Qiushui well enough.
It shows that both parties were extremely close normally.
What perceptive eyes Ding Ling has?
He easily discerned that these men had a relationship with Li Qiushui beyond mere physical intimacy.
Could not help but shake his head secretly, Li Qiushui’s capricious nature was beyond his imagination, a woman raising a bunch of handsome men.
Moreover, she had taken a handsome man to play with earlier.
But from her casually using men as a shield, it can be seen, she certainly killed many of these men.
A real deviant!
Ding Ling stopped overthinking.
After all, he only considered Li Qiushui as a tool, would not have much interaction with her.
Reaching the third room.
Ding Ling saw rows upon rows of bookshelves.
The bookshelves were crammed with various secret manuals.
Ding Ling’s heart was filled with joy.
Immediately stepped forward.
Randomly picked one up.
Netherworld Ghost Claw
Ding Ling quickly skimmed through it.
Reading ten lines at a glance.
Finished in ten breaths.
[Netherworld Ghost Claw Full Level]
[Power +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was clearly a superior claw technique.
After condensing into a claw, it became invincible and extremely fierce.
Picked up the next one.
"White Rainbow Palm Force"
This is Li Qiushui’s supreme skill.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
Quickly flipped through.
Soon.
[White Rainbow Palm Force Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This palm technique is a top-tier Splitting Sky Palm Technique.
It’s much more powerful than Huang Laoxie’s Splitting Sky Palm.
The Splitting Sky Palm cannot make turns, but this palm technique can bend and straighten at will, the palm force unleashed can actually curve!
After reaching full level with White Rainbow Palm Force.

Ding Ling couldn’t resist testing it out; as he slapped out a palm, a palm print condensed in the void, controlled by Ding Ling’s palm force, moving up and down, suddenly left and right, swinging unpredictably!
"It really works!"
Ding Ling was delighted.
This is the first time he encountered such a palm technique!

Not only can it split through the air, but it can also remotely control the palm force, and because he had already reached full level with extremely profound power, this White Rainbow Palm Force executed by him was truly flawless and exceptionally distinct.
Li Qiushui was completely stunned.
She cultivated White Rainbow Palm Force for decades but couldn’t reach Ding Ling’s level of mastery.
She confirmed her White Rainbow Palm Force reached Great Perfection Innate Ability, there was only one possibility, Ding Ling’s power far surpassed hers by manyfold!
Realizing Ding Ling just looked for a moment and reached Great Perfection with White Rainbow Palm Force.
Li Qiushui was bewildered, unable to suppress the tumultuous waves within her heart, she asked:
"You know North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step.
How do you know my White Rainbow Palm Force too?
Where did you learn it from?"
She was certain.
The Secret Manual of North Nether Divine Skill and Ripple Step are known to be in the stone cave at Wuliang Mountain.
But White Rainbow Palm Force, she certainly never passed it on to anyone else!
How did Ding Ling learn it?!
Ding Ling ignored her and picked up the next Secret Manual to read.
Soon after.
[Cold Sleeve Brushing Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is a Martial Arts technique that can unleash supreme power using a sleeve.
Next one.
[Turtle Breath Skill Full Level]
[Transformation Technique Full Level]
[Corpse Rot Skill Full Level]
Each Secret Manual Ding Ling finished reading instantly reached full level.
His aura was continuously growing.

Especially when Transformation Technique reached full level, visible Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi swarmed him and overwhelmed him, a scene Li Qiushui witnessed clearly, leaving her utterly shocked.
At this moment.
How could she not understand?
Ding Ling was truly an unimaginably supreme martial arts prodigy!
These techniques, he mastered and reached Great Perfection just by glancing at them.
She witnessed it clearly.
The Transformation Technique is a peerless evil skill, most can’t even reach entry level, let alone perfection and Great Perfection.
Ding Ling achieved Great Perfection instantly, his ability, talent.
Just thinking about it.
Li Qiushui couldn’t help but tremble in her heart, sweat on her forehead, experiencing for the first time feelings of regret and remorse.
If she knew Ding Ling was such a defiant and unrivaled talent, she would definitely not have opposed him.
Unfortunately.
There’s no regret medicine in this world.
[True Power Value 21 points]
After full level Transformation Technique.
Ding Ling absorbed Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi, instantly adding a strand of North Nether True Qi to his dantian.
Along with previous strands,
Three in one.
Another drop of North Nether True Water emerged.
Reaching this step.
Ding Ling unexpectedly stepped into the realm of Grandmaster!
In terms of True Qi Cultivation.
He had reached the world’s shackles, unable to advance further.
To make progress.
He must break the world’s shackles, shatter the void, and move to higher realms.
’Didn’t expect to become a Grandmaster so quickly.’
Ding Ling keenly perceived.
Upon reaching Grandmaster.
His strength drastically differed from before.
Can easily crush Initial Tier Grandmasters.
An Initial Tier Grandmaster alone can face dozens of Initial Tier Grandmaster characters, no problem at all!
This is the absolute crushing of higher realms!
If Grandmasters were like ordinary mountains, then Grandmasters were like towering peaks, the two are not of the same level at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 534: Power Reaches Its Limit! Princess of Western Xia
paragraphs: "This Qi!"
Li Qiushui’s pupils enlarged, her scalp tingled.

Previously, Ding Ling had already given her a sense of heart palpitations akin to facing a mountain. Now, Ding Ling’s aura suddenly surged, becoming increasingly unfathomable and vast, making her instantly feel a sense of insignificance against the backdrop of the galaxy and universe.
If there had been any strength left to counterattack before.
Now there was none at all.
Ding Ling continued flipping through the secret manuals.
He read faster and faster.
One by one, the books on the shelves were finished by him.

These books encompass astronomy, geography, music, chess, calligraphy, painting, strange mechanisms, Eight Trigrams, mechanical skills, Medical Dao, miscellaneous schools, and everything you could imagine.
Ding Ling finished each book; each book reached full level.
The mysterious aura around him grew thicker.
His foundation grew deeper.
The progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace instantly advanced by 2 percentage points.
Previously, the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body had reached 5%.
Now it jumped to 7% in one go.
It is clear that the richness of the library here surpasses that of the library in the Valley of Heartless where Gongsun Zhi resides.
Not only does the richness of the books surpass it, but many books also exceed in quality.
The library here indeed contains the finest of the fine.
It cannot be compared to the library of Gongsun Zhi.
Clearly, ordinary books and secret manuals won’t catch the eye of Li Qiushui.
The secret manuals that can catch her eye are naturally extremely rare.
Ding Ling’s Medical Dao skills reached new heights, becoming extraordinary.
The Medical Dao books here are likely to be the collection of the Carefree Sect, and the Medical Dao secret manuals of the Carefree Sect have cultivated top divine doctors like Xue Muhua!
You can understand from this!
Having extracted the essence of various schools around the world, Ding Ling’s skills became increasingly refined and remarkable.
The last few books he saw.
Were stored in a wooden box.

Ding Ling, with ’Eyes of Golden Flame’, having reached full level in Mechanical Skills, Stargazing Skill, etc., now absorbed the Mechanical Skill, Array Skill here, and easily saw where the mechanisms were hidden.
He walked to the right wall, knocked and tapped a few times, and heard a series of clicks.
The wall slowly recessed, and a wooden box emerged.
Ding Ling reached out, took hold of it, and opened it.
Inside, it surprisingly contained several secret manuals.
Small Faceless Skill.
North Nether Divine Skill.
Ripple Step.
Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm!
Seeing the last secret manual, Ding Ling’s eyes brightened, and he picked it up to read.
Soon after.
[Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm full level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a fiercely powerful palm technique!
There are nine styles in total, each one, when executed, harmonizes Yin and Yang Qi, blending hardness and softness, and is unstoppable!
Moreover, it’s written very clearly on it.
This palm technique can also resolve the Life and Death Talisman!

After Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm reached full level, Ding Ling felt relieved. No wonder Li Qiushui wasn’t afraid of Heavenly Mountain Granny; with this Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm by her side, what was there to fear?
Why does she have the secret manual of Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm?
There’s no doubt, it must have been taken from Wuya Zi!
It’s likely the same with North Nether Divine Skill. If she can take North Nether Divine Skill, why not Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm?

However, it seems Li Qiushui didn’t learn this palm technique, simply because it requires Yin Yang Qi in the Dantian to cultivate it. Ding Ling naturally possesses these two types of Qi in the Dantian, allowing him to perfectly unleash the power of this divine skill at full level.
Carefully sensing and experiencing it.
Ding Ling found this palm technique no less powerful than the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms! Truly remarkable!
Li Qiushui on the side was already stunned.
Seeing this.

How could she not know that Ding Ling’s accomplishments in Mechanical Skills and others must have reached the Transformation Realm, able to easily identify the mechanisms, something that even general Mechanical Masters couldn’t do, yet Ding Ling achieved.
Thinking of the scenes of Ding Ling flipping through books as if flipping pages.
Li Qiushui gasped, feeling somewhat toothy, and her heart was filled with deep envy and jealousy.
If only Li Qiushui had such talent...
Tap tap!
Ding Ling put away the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm and other secret manuals and walked out of the secret room, continuing to proceed further.
Deep inside, there was another secret room.
It was filled with a large amount of medicinal wine and other supplements beneficial for training.
Ding Ling was delighted.
He walked over, picked up a jar of medicinal wine, removed the lid, and began drinking it in large gulps.
After finishing a jar.
Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attributes increased:
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
"Great wine!"
The medicinal Qi within the wine was extremely dense, and having been aged for many years, the aroma was intoxicating!
As soon as it entered his belly.
His entire body felt like stepping on clouds, utterly pleasant.
Upon seeing that the medicinal wine had such good effects.
Why would he hold back?
He immediately began drinking jar after jar.
Li Qiushui watched from the side, feeling a heartache, thinking: If I had known it would come to this, I would have taken this medicinal wine out and drunk it myself.
She originally planned to wait another year or two, letting the medicinal wine ferment to become more fragrant and mellow,
but now it’s all been taken by Ding Ling.
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
With just one jar down, all attributes can increase by 0.2.
He drank three jars like this.
The effect began to weaken.
But it could still increase the four-dimensional attributes by 0.5 with three jars.
Previously, after Ding Ling reached full level in all the Secret Manuals, his four-dimensional attributes increased as follows:
[Strength 71.9, Agility 72.3, Constitution 78.5, Defense 60]
After drinking six jars of medicinal wine.
[Strength 73, Agility 73.4, Constitution 79.6, Defense 61.1]
Drank three more jars.
[Strength 73.5, Agility 73.9, Constitution 80, Defense 61.6]
Constitution reached the limit value.
No longer increased.
Ding Ling could feel his vitality, lifespan, etc., had improved significantly.
Ding Ling didn’t think much of it.
He continued to drink.
With the Six Meridian Divine Sword, the medicinal power he consumed was fully refined, and the wine could flow out through cleared meridians, so he didn’t worry about getting drunk.
He finished all the medicinal wine.
Which amounted to over a hundred jars.
Strength and Agility both reached 80 points.
Defense also rose to 72.
However, by the end, the medicinal effect was diminishing, nearly non-existent. Otherwise, Defense would undoubtedly be higher.
After Ding Ling finished the medicinal wine.
He started taking Great Medicine.
There wasn’t much Great Medicine here.
Probably because most of it was used for soaking in wine.
Ding Ling consumed a hundred-year-old one, but found no effect.
So he stopped.
And switched to a two-hundred-year-old one.
This time after consuming.
[Defense +0.1]
Clearly.
In the lower realm, a 200-year Great Medicine almost had no effect on Ding Ling, but in this world, it was still effective.
It’s naturally because the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi in this world’s Great Medicine far surpass those of the lower realm.
Ding Ling finished all ten of the two-hundred-year Great Medicine.
[Defense +0.8]
However, as he kept consuming it, drug resistance developed.
He then consumed three of the three-hundred-year-old ones.
[Defense +0.5]
There was only one four-hundred-year-old.
[Defense +0.3]
So thirty of the hundred-year-old Great Medicine were left.
He ate up everything else that could be consumed.
Finally, Defense reached 73.7
At this level, just the skin’s Defense is like wearing seven layers of armor!
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
This trip to Western Xia was indeed a huge gain.
Now he had reached the Grandmaster realm.
The Four-dimensional Attribute Points were also nearing the world’s limit.
Ding Ling estimated that he wouldn’t be able to stay long in this world.
So he prepared for a quick and decisive battle.
To unite Jiuzhou!
Afterward.
Ding Ling put the Great Medicine and some jewelry and such into the Storage Pouch.
Then he carried Li Qiushui and rushed out of the tunnel, heading for the Imperial Study where the Emperor was.
The Emperor was Li Qiushui’s son, an ambitious individual.
Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered to exchange words with him, directly using a One Yang Finger to disable him.
Li Qiushui was terror-stricken, hurriedly kneeling to beg Ding Ling.
Just at that moment, someone walked in from the entrance of the Imperial Study.
This person was as beautiful as a country in distress, like morning dew, and her presence warmed the world like a ray of sunlight, catching Ding Ling’s attention.
"Father..."
She exclaimed in surprise.
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill to draw her in, examining her closely, noticing she indeed resembled both Li Qiushui and Wang Yuyan.
He couldn’t help but be moved.
Li Qiushui glanced over and quickly said:
"Qinglu, quickly kneel and pay respects to Hero Ding!"
"Grandmother..."
The woman looked at Li Qiushui in a bit of a daze.
Clearly, the situation before her was beyond her understanding or imagination.
"Kneel for me."
Li Qiushui glared at the woman.
The woman’s legs gave way, and she knelt down to the ground.
Li Qiushui looked at Ding Ling flatteringly, fawningly saying:

"Qinglu is my granddaughter. She is the Princess Yinchuan of Western Xia. Hero Ding, you can see it too. Qinglu completely inherits the beauty, figure, and temperament of our Li family. She is an exceedingly rare beauty in the world.
I now present Qinglu to you, Hero Ding.
I just ask you to spare my son’s life, do not kill him."
Although Li Qiushui was ruthless.
But now it seems.
The fierce tiger does not eat its cubs.
She really valued her son highly.
Beside, the Emperor was made mute by Ding Ling and couldn’t speak, he could only desperately signal to Princess Yinchuan with his eyes.
The Princess was dumbfounded.
She was only here to pay her respects.

Li Qiushui glanced over and quickly said:
"Qinglu, quickly kneel and pay respects to Hero Ding!"
"Grandmother..."
The woman looked at Li Qiushui in a bit of a daze.
Clearly, the situation before her was beyond her understanding or imagination.
"Kneel for me."
Li Qiushui glared at the woman.
The woman’s legs gave way, and she knelt down to the ground.
Li Qiushui looked at Ding Ling flatteringly, fawningly saying:
"Qinglu is my granddaughter.
She is the Princess Yinchuan of Western Xia.
Hero Ding, you can see it too.
Qinglu completely inherits the beauty, figure, and temperament of our Li family.
She is an exceedingly rare beauty in the world.
I now present Qinglu to you, Hero Ding.
I just ask you to spare my son’s life, do not kill him."
Although Li Qiushui was ruthless.
But now it seems.
The fierce tiger does not eat its cubs.
She really valued her son highly.
Beside, the Emperor was made mute by Ding Ling and couldn’t speak, he could only desperately signal to Princess Yinchuan with his eyes.
The Princess was dumbfounded.
She was only here to pay her respects.

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - 535: Ascension to Emperor! Empress and Imperial Consorts
paragraphs: Why did she suddenly face this situation?!
The princess was quite at a loss.
Ding Ling frowned.
Li Qiushui was already intimidated by Ding Ling, upon seeing this, her heart skipped a beat, and she immediately said:
"Hero Ding, I will definitely cooperate well with you. Please spare my son’s life, I will do anything you ask, as will Qinglu, she will surely serve you well."
She glanced at the princess, her eyes cold:
"Qinglu, if you don’t serve Hero Ding well..."
"Enough."
Ding Ling interrupted Li Qiushui.
He said:
"If the emperor wants to live, he must abdicate voluntarily to me."
"No problem."
Li Qiushui said resolutely.
She clearly saw through the current situation.

Even ten thousand elites couldn’t stop Ding Ling; although Western Xia was not small in the West, how could it possibly withstand the exceptionally high combat power and extraordinarily talented Ding Ling?
In the secret passage, Ding Ling flipped through the secret manual, and scenes of Great Perfection were deeply imprinted in Li Qiushui’s mind, astonishing her greatly.
"Go and prepare."
Ding Ling resolved the emperor’s dilemma.
The emperor nodded submissively, yet was scared out of his wits.

Even though he had made preparations and gathered the most martial-skilled guards in the palace within the Imperial Study to protect himself, they were of no use at all, and Ding Ling easily finished off all the guards!
Recalling the scene of a general with blood bursting into the Imperial Palace and shouting loudly.
The emperor only felt as if he had fallen instantly into a sinister and chilling abyss ice cave.
Earlier he thought the general’s report was somewhat exaggerated.
But now it seemed quite likely to be true.
Ten thousand strong army.
And thousands of elite defense army at the city gates.
Over ten thousand Imperial Palace death warriors!
All were easily slaughtered by Ding Ling!
Ding Ling’s actions were too swift, from his breach into the Imperial City, then the Imperial Palace, to capturing Li Qiushui and mastering all the secret manuals, drinking all the wine.
It didn’t take long.
Just because his current power was so high, his eyesight so strong, far surpassing the past! So reading and drinking speed was beyond imagination.
Precisely because of this.
The emperor didn’t even have time to deploy more forces to protect himself.
Of course.
It was also because Ding Ling was too ruthless in his killing.

The emperor couldn’t find many masters to protect him, by the time he had just finished deploying, Ding Ling had arrived, and witnessed with his own eyes how his mother, revered like a divine being, groveled before Ding Ling, the impact of this scene was ten times more intense than Ding Ling instantaneously killing guards!
What kind of person was Li Qiushui?
Nobody knew better than the emperor; he also greatly feared her and dared not disobey or disregard her orders.
But now such a formidable woman was utterly submissive and humble before Ding Ling!
The emperor, to spare his own life, was indeed intimidated by Ding Ling’s actions and solemnly expressed full cooperation.
In the blink of an eye.
A day passed.
The next day.
The news that Emperor Li Qianshun of Western Xia would abdicate in favor of Ding Ling spread across every corner of the Imperial City.
Natives were astonished, players in uproar.
"Whoa! Ding Ling finally became emperor!"

"I knew he was going to start with the three palaces, six courtyards, and seventy-two consorts! This Celestial Dragon World has too many beauties, Ding Ling seems to want to capture all the beauties in one fell swoop!"

"So true. He has this ability. Yesterday, I was among the city wall guards, witnessing Ding Ling instantly kill hundreds of elite guards in a single move! It almost scared me to death! Too terrifying."
"You call that terrifying? You didn’t participate in the battle where ten thousand elite surrounded Ding Ling, that was truly terrifying..."
Players discussed fervently.
From yesterday to today, through their embellishment, viral-like terror spread.
Almost everyone in the Imperial City knew about Ding Ling’s deeds in the Lower Realm, in this realm, and fear and reverence for Ding Ling penetrated deep into their bones.
Don’t believe it?
The crushed ten thousand elites were clear proof!
These elites now obey Ding Ling’s orders, during the search for Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu, they had contacted some natives, detailing Ding Ling’s astonishingly high combat power.
One spreads to ten, ten to a hundred.
Naturally, everyone knew.
Initially, the persuasion of players was insufficient.
But all the natives said so.
Then no one disbelieved.

Especially some people who went to inspect the scene firsthand, after witnessing the battlefield’s brutality, were shocked and, upon returning, immediately canceled activities such as intercepting, assassinating, or poisoning Ding Ling.
Of course.
Some still refused to accept fate, they infiltrated the Imperial Kitchen that same day, attempting to poison Ding Ling’s food to kill him.
However, what sort of person was Ding Ling?
He ate the poisoned food without changing his expression.
As the suspect gleefully returned to report the situation to his master.
Helian Tieshu followed tightly behind and swept away the nine clans of these officials!
The charge: Poisoning the New Emperor!
Ding Ling acted decisively and straightforwardly, whenever concrete evidence of plots against him emerged, execution of the nine clans followed!
In just over three days.
Western Xia eradicated over ten prominent families!

Causing political upheaval, increasing dissatisfaction, with over a thousand assassination teams conducting activities such as poisoning, assassination, shooting, and burning against Ding Ling that very night.
To no avail, Ding Ling was immune to all poisons!
Even the Intoxicating Bee could not harm him! Other poisons couldn’t affect him at all.
As for shooting?
Once Star Shifting was activated, arrows shot at him automatically rebounded back!
In a moment.
All assassins perished!
The next day.
Ding Ling ordered an investigation into the assassins’ backgrounds.
Once clues were found, he immediately eradicated the three clans of a Western Xia prince!

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 535: Ascending the Throne as Emperor! Empress and Imperial Consorts (Part 2)
paragraphs: This move caused the ministers of Western Xia to be terrified, no longer daring to entertain any rebellious thoughts.
The new Emperor.
Cannot be poisoned.
Cannot be killed.
With unmatched lightweight skill, he’s naturally hard to burn or drown.
They had no way to deal with Ding Ling.
Ding Ling had many ways to kill them.
Helplessly.
Even for the sake of their clans and families, these ministers could only comply.
They complied.
But Ding Ling didn’t care for it.
On the day he ascended the throne.
A selection examination was held in the Main Hall.
Only those who met his criteria could continue to hold office in Western Xia.
There was a written test.
And an interview!

The written test assessed knowledge of state governance, people’s livelihood, military strategy, Mo Family, Legalist School, and diplomatic strategies among others, covering a wide range of topics, totaling 500 points.
Only those who passed could continue being officials.
The interview.
Was where Ding Ling would use the Observing People Skill, acting, and psychology to discern if a person harbored any intent to kill or betray him.
Only those without such tendencies could remain.
After such a round of screening.
Fewer than twenty or thirty percent of the officials remained.
The court suddenly felt empty.
Li Qiushui, Li Qianshun, and Li Qinglu were dazzled and dumbfounded, completely stunned by Ding Ling’s series of actions!
They never imagined Ding Ling would act this way!
Moreover, their loyal ministers were all screened out without exception, and the opportunistic flatterers were all cleared out!
Now the court was filled with elite individuals, and although fewer in number, the scene was much more pleasing to the eye!
Xiaoo Feng was in awe like seeing a celestial being!

Jiu Mozhi was full of admiration. He too wanted to do this, but he lacked the ability. Just by looking at the test paper Ding Ling issued, he was already dazzled, not to mention scoring 500 points. Scoring 300 would be impressive for him.
And these remaining officials scored above 200 points, clearly showing they were truly talented and knowledgeable.
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing were also secretly delighted, feeling proud of Ding Ling.
After a part of the court officials were appointed.
Then came the appointments in the harem.
The Chief Eunuch held the Holy Decree, reading it aloud:
"Zhong Ling is appointed as Empress!"
"Mu Wanqing and Li Qinglu as Imperial Consorts..."
During these days.

Li Qinglu, following the requests of Li Qiushui and Li Qianshun, knelt persistently outside Ding Ling’s chamber, enduring wind, sun, and rain, regardless of the elements. When Zhong Ling asked what she wanted to do.
She said if Hero Ding wouldn’t marry her or accept her, she would kneel until the end of time, kneel until death.
Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t indulge her, let her kneel as long as she wanted!
How could he be a man manipulated or threatened by a woman?

But Zhong Ling had a soft heart, seeing Li Qinglu kneel genuinely for three days and nights, her face turning pale and her body swaying weakly, barely clinging to life, she couldn’t help but plead for her.

She was optimistic, innocent, and kind-hearted, already having some fondness for the beautiful and stubborn Li Qinglu. Seeing her indeed not eat or drink and not get up for three days and nights, she was astonished as well.
She couldn’t help but plead for her repeatedly.
Mu Wanqing saw this and, although quite unwilling, to avoid being seen as a jealous woman in Ding Ling’s eyes, could only swallow her bitterness and join in pleading for Li Qinglu.

Ding Ling, seeing them plead several times and noticing Li Qinglu being exposed to the scorching sun for several days and then battered by a torrential rain, while she hadn’t used inner power to protect herself, and being inherently frail as a woman, realized she was indeed at her limit.
He was quite moved as well.
He was also a man, with a heart of flesh. Li Qinglu did all this for the sake of saving Li Qianshun and others’ lives, but her filial piety and sincerity could not be ignored by Ding Ling.
Upon the repeated pleas from Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing, he went with the flow and accepted her.
When Li Qinglu received the news from Zhong Ling, she breathed a sigh of relief and kowtowed heavily in the direction of Ding Ling:
"This servant thanks Your Majesty! Long live Your Majesty!"
Having said this.
Perhaps due to the relaxation of her tense emotions or having already reached her limit, upon loosening up, she felt the world spinning as she fell over.
With weak breaths and fading vitality.
More than three days without food or water.
Exposed to the elements, wind, sun, and rain, her body had already succumbed to illness, burning with fever, now unable to endure any longer.
Ding Ling’s medical expertise was exceptional; as long as there was a breath and medicine, he could save people from the grasp of the Death God.
Li Qinglu’s illness and injury naturally were nothing for him.
She was saved on the same day.
Once she regained consciousness, she forced her weak body to kneel by the bed again, continuing to express gratitude to His Majesty and wishing him long life.
Ding Ling sighed upon hearing this, said nothing more, and walked away.
Even though Li Qinglu was desperate to marry him.
And he agreed.
However, her father, Li Qianshun, could live.
But her grandmother, Li Qiushui, was destined to die.
Ding Ling told her the truth.
Li Qinglu’s face fell at first, then she said: "For Your Majesty to show kindness is already a rare gesture, this servant dares not ask for more."
It was clear she had already prepared for the worst.
For Ding Ling to accept her.
To spare most of her clan from the fate of death.
And only to kill Li Qiushui.
It genuinely was an act of mercy.
How could Li Qinglu not be content?
Precisely because Li Qinglu had already earned the approval of Zhong Ling and the others.
This led to her becoming an Imperial Consort.
"Appoint Xiaoo Feng as Grand General of the Western Xia"
’Jiu Mozhi as Western Xia Mage’
’Appoint Ling Yanqiu as Commander of the Imperial Guard’
Once all appointments were complete.
Everyone knelt on the ground, expressing gratitude for the imperial grace.
Despite being an emperor for the first time.
Ding Ling was skilled in his duties, having not served as a Prince in multiple worlds for nothing.
