chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 535: Ascending the Throne! Empress and Imperial Consorts (Part 3)
paragraphs: Handling some simple matters is easy to do at one’s convenience.
And to prepare for the future.
Ding Ling handed over all the great army to Xiao Feng to command, instructing him to conquer Tubo.

Xiao Feng had deep discussions with Ding Ling throughout the night and, realizing Ding Ling’s grand ambitions and given Ding Ling helped him kill Murong Fu and seek Murong Bo, coupled with Ding Ling’s sincere invitation, Xiao Feng couldn’t refuse and agreed to assist Ding Ling in uniting Jiuzhou.
However, he is a Khitan, so it wasn’t appropriate for him to target the Liao Kingdom, and having vowed not to kill Han people, he naturally refrained from attacking the Great Song.
Therefore, he led the great army to charge towards Tubo.
Jiu Mozhi wore a bitter expression as he was Tubo’s Kingdom Guardian Dharma King!
Yet he personally witnessed Ding Ling shattering a ten-thousand-strong army.
Naturally understanding Tubo couldn’t possibly withstand Ding Ling.
He proactively volunteered to lead the way, preparing to persuade Tubo to surrender to Ding Ling.
If they refuse to surrender, they could fight later.
Xiao Feng was naturally delighted at this prospect; conquering Tubo without losing a single soldier? That couldn’t be better!
As for Ding Ling becoming the Emperor of Western Xia.
Through the dissemination and embellishment by players.
The news had already spread across the Jiuzhou Land.
For a while.
Various countries’ reactions differed.
Some scornfully doubted Ding Ling could defy the heavens thus;
Some directly sent people to investigate;
Others simply killed those spreading rumors...
The myriad of human attitudes varied endlessly.
However, it was undeniable that Ding Ling, through this battle, had utterly sparked well-known fame.
His mission 3 progress thus surged ahead without obstacle.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane World experts: 28/20.]
Previously it was 15.
Then defeated Helian Tieshu, Li Qiushui, and others, raising it to 28.
Because there were over ten First-class experts in the army, Imperial City, and Imperial Palace.
Ding Ling had successively found excuses to spar with and defeat them over these few days.
[3: You must make your World’s Number One name resonate throughout the entire Plane World. 53%/100%.]
Undeniably.
After becoming an Emperor.
Mission 3’s progress visibly skyrocketed.
This was much faster than seeking out individuals one by one for challenge.
Even winning against someone, time was required for fermentation.
The speed was far behind the means Ding Ling now employed.
After becoming an emperor.
Ding Ling also initiated the Imperial Examination.
Indicating that anyone from Jiuzhou Land could come to take the exam.

Players who admired him, Natives who feared him, or Natives passionate about being officials, or those living at the social bottom, talented but unfortunate, all came to participate in this Imperial Examination.
Ding Ling was decisive and clean in his execution.
He eliminated those families who had attempted assassination on him in one go.
These families.
Without exception.
In Western Xia, these were families of great influence, deeply rooted, capable of covering the sky with one hand.
Their oppression of good citizens was innumerable.
Ding Ling annihilated these few families.
Winning immense support from the common people.
Numerous cheering, tearfully joyful citizens expressed gratitude.
Evident these families’ evil deeds were truly countless!
Ding Ling never expected his casual deed would invoke such profound fondness from the masses, also attracting quite a few genuine talents thereby.

These talents were all upright, resplendent, seeking true ambition fulfillment, unwilling to collude with those familial powers, previously marginalized, oppressed, later, overwhelmed and resigned from office.
Or having heard of court affairs, simply refraining from serving as officials!
Now knowing Ding Ling’s character and deeds, they all came forth to try.

Although Ding Ling was erudite and learned, his wisdom was far inferior to Zhuge Liang, yet all his skills in Music, Chess, Calligraphy, Painting, Military Strategy, Confucian School, Military School were Full Level!
His question-setting and evaluation were smooth like flowing water, naturally fitting.
This Imperial Examination indeed discovered quite a few talents, promptly promoted!
Due to these talents joining.
Western Xia became increasingly vigorous, as if entering a rapid, bright development channel in an instant.
With these talents assisting.
After spending a little over a month in Western Xia.
Seeing the court stabilize.
He seized Li Qiushui and flew towards Lingjiu Palace.
During this period, Li Qiushui was imprisoned alone in a room.
She knew she was destined to die.
Over these days, her demeanor was very Zen-like.
Not sure if she hoped Ding Ling could spare her, or she truly saw through life.
She even expressed some words to Ding Ling:

"Your Majesty, these past few months, I introspect daily, now realizing how absurdly I’ve lived before. I merely wish to see my husband Wuya Zi one last time before I die, thus I would die without regrets."
"Wuya Zi is already dead."
Ding Ling replied.
"But, I heard from the Alien he wasn’t dead."
"He wasn’t dead earlier. But on my journey to Western Xia, he imparted all his power to someone else and died."
Li Qiushui fell silent, sighed, and said nothing more.
Ding Ling shook his head, did not console her.
Li Qiushui was extremely fierce, merciless, highly skillful; Ding Ling couldn’t keep her in Western Xia, for Zhong Ling and others’ sake.
But just handing her over to Heavenly Mountain Granny?
Ding Ling considered the replies sent by Western Xia’s commander during this time.
Ding Ling personally penned an invitation letter to Heavenly Mountain Granny inviting her to Western Xia Imperial City.
He was refused.
Ding Ling was not surprised.
Evidently, Heavenly Mountain Granny was deeply wary of him.
But if she refused when he brings Li Qiushui to see her?
Ding Ling didn’t mind sparring a bit with her.
Although this Granny was quite kind to her own, she was ruthless to outsiders.
Especially against men, she resorted to all sorts of torture! It’s said her twisted nature reached its zenith.
Ordinary men rescuing her would likely be killed by her.
The original Xuzhwu survived only because he was related to Wuya Zi, whom she cherished, besides, Xuzhwu lacked scheming, earning Heavenly Mountain Granny’s favor and trust.
Ding Ling had clear knowledge of this. It was due to receiving increasing information about Heavenly Mountain Granny recently.
Knowing she currently hated men intensely.
Female players visiting Celestial Mountain Piaomiao Peak was acceptable.

Male players visiting would be one hundred percent killed or cursed with Life and Death Talisman, facing fates worse than death, ending up committing suicide for relief, and after resurrection, dare not visit Piaomiao Peak again. Staying far away from Heavenly Mountain Granny.
On this day.
Ding Ling arrived at Tian Mountain Lingjiu Palace.
He flew up the mountain using Lightweight Skill, seeing people from Thirty-Six Caves and Seventy-Two Islands kneeling all over, with heads chopped off.
Lingjiu Palace’s entrance was a river of blood.
Listening closely.
He heard the Lingjiu Palace folks saying there was a rebellion among these people.
Turns out Heavenly Mountain Granny’s powers depleted recently, requiring retraining, incited by players, the Cave Masters, Island Masters, stormed Illusory Peak.
Unbeknownst to them, a female player joined Piaomiao Peak, warning the Granny.

sentences.text: Handling some simple matters is easy to do at one’s convenience.
And to prepare for the future.
Ding Ling handed over all the great army to Xiao Feng to command, instructing him to conquer Tubo.

Xiao Feng had deep discussions with Ding Ling throughout the night and, realizing Ding Ling’s grand ambitions and given Ding Ling helped him kill Murong Fu and seek Murong Bo, coupled with Ding Ling’s sincere invitation, Xiao Feng couldn’t refuse and agreed to assist Ding Ling in uniting Jiuzhou.
However, he is a Khitan, so it wasn’t appropriate for him to target the Liao Kingdom, and having vowed not to kill Han people, he naturally refrained from attacking the Great Song.
Therefore, he led the great army to charge towards Tubo.
Jiu Mozhi wore a bitter expression as he was Tubo’s Kingdom Guardian Dharma King!
Yet he personally witnessed Ding Ling shattering a ten-thousand-strong army.
Naturally understanding Tubo couldn’t possibly withstand Ding Ling.
He proactively volunteered to lead the way, preparing to persuade Tubo to surrender to Ding Ling.
If they refuse to surrender, they could fight later.
Xiao Feng was naturally delighted at this prospect; conquering Tubo without losing a single soldier?
That couldn’t be better!
As for Ding Ling becoming the Emperor of Western Xia.
Through the dissemination and embellishment by players.
The news had already spread across the Jiuzhou Land.
For a while.
Various countries’ reactions differed.
Some scornfully doubted Ding Ling could defy the heavens thus;
Some directly sent people to investigate;
Others simply killed those spreading rumors...
The myriad of human attitudes varied endlessly.
However, it was undeniable that Ding Ling, through this battle, had utterly sparked well-known fame.
His mission 3 progress thus surged ahead without obstacle.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane World experts: 28/20.]
Previously it was 15.
Then defeated Helian Tieshu, Li Qiushui, and others, raising it to 28.
Because there were over ten First-class experts in the army, Imperial City, and Imperial Palace.
Ding Ling had successively found excuses to spar with and defeat them over these few days.
[3: You must make your World’s Number One name resonate throughout the entire Plane World.
Undeniably.
After becoming an Emperor.
Mission 3’s progress visibly skyrocketed.
This was much faster than seeking out individuals one by one for challenge.
Even winning against someone, time was required for fermentation.
The speed was far behind the means Ding Ling now employed.
After becoming an emperor.
Ding Ling also initiated the Imperial Examination.
Indicating that anyone from Jiuzhou Land could come to take the exam.

Players who admired him, Natives who feared him, or Natives passionate about being officials, or those living at the social bottom, talented but unfortunate, all came to participate in this Imperial Examination.
Ding Ling was decisive and clean in his execution.
He eliminated those families who had attempted assassination on him in one go.
These families.
Without exception.
In Western Xia, these were families of great influence, deeply rooted, capable of covering the sky with one hand.
Their oppression of good citizens was innumerable.
Ding Ling annihilated these few families.
Winning immense support from the common people.
Numerous cheering, tearfully joyful citizens expressed gratitude.
Evident these families’ evil deeds were truly countless!
Ding Ling never expected his casual deed would invoke such profound fondness from the masses, also attracting quite a few genuine talents thereby.

These talents were all upright, resplendent, seeking true ambition fulfillment, unwilling to collude with those familial powers, previously marginalized, oppressed, later, overwhelmed and resigned from office.
Or having heard of court affairs, simply refraining from serving as officials!
Now knowing Ding Ling’s character and deeds, they all came forth to try.

Although Ding Ling was erudite and learned, his wisdom was far inferior to Zhuge Liang, yet all his skills in Music, Chess, Calligraphy, Painting, Military Strategy, Confucian School, Military School were Full Level!
His question-setting and evaluation were smooth like flowing water, naturally fitting.
This Imperial Examination indeed discovered quite a few talents, promptly promoted!
Due to these talents joining.
Western Xia became increasingly vigorous, as if entering a rapid, bright development channel in an instant.
With these talents assisting.
After spending a little over a month in Western Xia.
Seeing the court stabilize.
He seized Li Qiushui and flew towards Lingjiu Palace.
During this period, Li Qiushui was imprisoned alone in a room.
She knew she was destined to die.
Over these days, her demeanor was very Zen-like.

"He wasn’t dead earlier.

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 536: Heavenly Mountain Granny! All Divine Skills at Full Level
paragraphs: These cave masters and island masters attacked the mountain.
Much like turtles in a jar.
They were entirely broken up by the Nine Celestial Nine Divisions, who had already laid an ambush. Some managed to escape, but many were caught.
As for these people.
Heavenly Mountain Granny did not say much, only said "kill them"!
Hence, the scenes unfolded as they are now.
No matter how the island masters begged for mercy, the Nine Celestial Nine Divisions ignored them. With a sword swing, heads fell to the ground one after another.
Ding Ling only watched for a while, then turned his body, utilizing Spiral Nine Shadows and Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, ascending several dozen feet, flying away like a gust of Xun Wind.

His speed was incredibly fast, like thunder and lightning, and amidst the swishing sounds, he advanced more than a hundred feet. Ordinary people could hardly detect his figure, only hearing a wind sound and upon looking around, failing to see anyone, thinking it was an illusion or just the sound of the wind.
Thus, as Ding Ling advanced unknowingly, he arrived deep within the Lingjiu Palace and saw a young girl practicing martial arts in a courtyard.
This young girl had delicate and pretty features and a petite figure.
Though she seemed young, she was naturally gifted with beauty and elegance, akin to a painting; if not flawed in growth, she would certainly become a peerless beauty in the future.
"Senior Sister."
Li Qiushui couldn’t help but softly call out.

As she walked along, gripped by Ding Ling, she dared not speak much. Now, upon seeing this young girl and recognizing it was Heavenly Mountain Granny, she couldn’t resist, realizing that Heavenly Mountain Granny had exhausted her power and was now recovering. If she struck now, Heavenly Mountain Granny would surely die.
But realizing she was just a sacrificial pawn in Ding Ling’s grasp, possibly to be slaughtered at any moment, depression seized her heart, and the previously surging kill intention faded away.
"Hmm?!
Heavenly Mountain Granny abruptly opened her eyes, revealing a pair akin to glass jade.

She surveyed her surroundings, her gaze swiftly freezing on Li Qiushui. Seeing it was indeed her nemesis Li Qiushui, she was startled, a flash of fear passing through her eyes; however, seeing Li Qiushui’s indifferent and calm demeanor, bewildered and shaken, her gaze involuntarily turned to Ding Ling, examining him with increasing caution:
"This young brother must be the current Emperor of Western Xia, Ding Ling?"
Her voice was hoarse and old, akin to rough paper being vigorously scraped against iron, sounding quite grating and unpleasant.
Ding Ling, unaware, simply nodded and said:
"You must be the Palace Master of Lingjiu Palace, Heavenly Mountain Granny.
"Exactly."
Heavenly Mountain Granny took a deep breath and stood up.
Despite being no taller than five feet, standing before the tall and handsome Ding Ling, she resembled a child.
Yet, with her aura fully unleashed, a fierce and violent energy swirled around her, making her appear as if she were an unparalleled Venerable!
She lifted her head to look at Ding Ling and said:
"I am Heavenly Mountain Granny. Why have you come, Ding Ling?"
"You already know, don’t you?"
Ding Ling said:
"I sent you a message a long time ago."
"So you’re here now to exchange that wretch Li Qiushui with me for true martial arts?"
"What do you think?"
"Alright."
Heavenly Mountain Granny hesitated for only a few breaths before agreeing:
"Once I recover all my power, I will teach you my unique Supreme Skill."
"How long will it take?"
"Eighty days."
Ding Ling gazed deeply at Heavenly Mountain Granny, shook his head, and said:
"Grandma Tong, honest people don’t speak evasively. I have come this time with sincerity. If you play games with me, there’s no need for further discussion."
Heavenly Mountain Granny’s heart tightened; her intention was to buy time, but Ding Ling saw through it instantly, making her laugh heartily:
"I’m afraid that if I teach you true martial arts, you’ll break your promise and crush me with a palm.
She boldly circled around, her eyes blazing as she looked at Ding Ling:
"You can see my current power deficiency, unable to withstand even a casual move from you."
"Even if you fully recover your power, you can’t withstand even one move from him."
Li Qiushui couldn’t contain herself, sneering:
"Senior sister, your power at Great Perfection may be greater than mine, but it is unquestionably far inferior to Hero Ding. The gap between you two is a Celestial Abyss.
In my view, it’s better for you to teach Hero Ding the Divine Skill now to avoid angering Hero Ding, who might really slap you to death."
"Haha..."
Heavenly Mountain Granny laughed thrice, her face suddenly dark, she swept a glance at Li Qiushui, and sneered:
"You wretch wish me dead; I simply won’t heed you or believe you."
"It doesn’t matter if you don’t believe me."
Li Qiushui retorted mockingly:
"But Hero Ding’s Divine Skill is unparalleled in the world, undeniably real. If you dare to confront Hero Ding head-on, you are courting death."
"Wretch. There is no place for you to speak here."
Heavenly Mountain Granny coldly glared at Li Qiushui:
"You yourself are a prisoner, yet still have the nerve to argue with me here? Who gives you the courage and boldness?"
Li Qiushui was rendered speechless.
Ding Ling frowned, saying:
"Since Grandma Tong is unwilling to cooperate, then forget it."

After speaking, Ding Ling kicked the ground, his whole body soaring several dozen feet, his figure splitting then merging in midair, transforming into nine figures, which vanished in the blink of an eye.
He too disappeared without a trace.
"Such masterful Lightness Skill, such speed!"
Heavenly Mountain Granny was shaken, employing Lightweight Skill to leap up, surveying all around, but where could she find Ding Ling’s figure?

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 536: Heavenly Mountain Granny! All Divine Skills Full Level (2)
paragraphs: Such unparalleled lightweight body technique.
For the first time, Heavenly Mountain Granny saw it, and her heart began to tremble, her Heart Lake was stirred into endless waves of terror:
"That wretch might not have deceived me this time, Ding Ling’s skill is absolutely beyond my Great Perfection state. I am no match for him."
Thinking of this.
Heavenly Mountain Granny couldn’t help but feel anxious and uneasy.
"What if Ding Ling plans to lead a great army to sweep away my Lingjiu Palace?"
Then she thought of Ding Ling’s feat of crushing a hundred thousand elites all at once and shook her head, denying:
"If he wants to sweep away my Lingjiu Palace, he should be able to do it alone."
She took a deep breath, her heart and spirit in unrest, unable to calm down:
’I originally thought those were all just rumors, that it was Ding Ling and that wretch Li Qiushui performing a double act. Now it seems, I was too naive.
From Ding Ling and Li Qiushui’s words and actions just now.
Li Qiushui indeed has become a prisoner. This makes Ding Ling’s feats of crushing ten thousand troops and breaking through the Imperial City true.’
The clearer she thought.
The heavier Heavenly Mountain Granny’s heart became:
"Boundless ferocity has reached such an extent. I just rejected him, and I don’t know if it’s fortune or disaster. I must prepare for the future."
Then she went out to call the Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum, and said to them:
"The Emperor of Western Xia just came here."
"What?!"
Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum were shocked, terrified, instinctively gripping their sword hilts, scanning around nervously and vigilantly:
"Where is he?"
"Gone."
Heavenly Mountain Granny sighed deeply:
"His skill is absolutely world-shocking. If he were to turn against our Lingjiu Palace, our palace might be drenched in blood from his massacre."
"This, this...
The Four Swordswomen didn’t know what to do.
"Therefore, I hope you will go to Western Xia now and represent our Lingjiu Palace in negotiating with Ding Ling."

Heavenly Mountain Granny grew more and more regretful, blaming herself, because Ding Ling is a man, and she deeply hates men, especially since Ding Ling is with Li Qiushui. Driven by instinctive hatred and hostility, she hadn’t even considered collaborating with Ding Ling.
Until Ding Ling demonstrated his skills in front of her.
She realized the vast difference between them, leading to a turbulent heart that could no longer remain calm.
Thus arose other thoughts.
She is not a foolish person; she would never pursue something she knows is impossible. Even for the women of Lingjiu Palace’s Nine Heavens Nine Departments, she must leave a way out.

She has already formed attachments with many women among the Nine Heavens Nine Departments, naturally not wishing for them to die without reason. And since Ding Ling personally came to Lingjiu Palace, she remained arrogant. If she angered Ding Ling, and he retaliated, the consequences would be unimaginable.
No matter how likely this is.
Since she confirmed the rumors to be true, Ding Ling’s battle power is undoubtedly genuine.
Heavenly Mountain Granny does not want to be adversarial with such terrifying enemy, especially since Ding Ling even overturned Li Qiushui’s lair, vented her anger, and could be regarded as an ally.
Thinking of this.
Heavenly Mountain Granny increasingly regretted, speaking more firmly and solemnly to the Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum:
"Take half of my ’Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme’ and go. If Ding Ling agrees to cooperate, hand over the other half."
"Yes, Venerable Lord!"
The Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum, exchanged glances, filled with great curiosity about the legendary Ding Ling.
Walking through Lingjiu Palace as if on flat ground.
Yet none of them detected even a hint.
Does this mean.
He could kill anyone in Lingjiu Palace without leaving a trace?
Thinking of it, the Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum couldn’t help but break into a sweat, their scalps tingling, subconsciously feeling a sense of awe for Ding Ling.
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Heavenly Mountain Granny]

[Note: Your inadvertently revealed unparalleled lightweight skill, like a deity walking among the clouds, fleeting like an immortal escaping the world, left Heavenly Mountain Granny in the dust, making her truly fearful and cautious of you from the heart!
Unless something unexpected happens, she will not choose to oppose you, but will choose to cooperate with you.]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Plum Sword]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Orchid Sword]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Bamboo Sword]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Chrysanthemum Sword]
[Note: Having heard Heavenly Mountain Granny’s evaluation and your deeds, they are curious about you, admiring and in awe of you!]
"Oh?"
Ding Ling felt quite surprised upon hearing the notification sound.
He had already abandoned the idea of collaborating with Heavenly Mountain Granny, yet suddenly hearing the notification, there was a turn.
He smiled slightly and thought: if cooperation is possible, nothing could be better. But the immediate priority is to find the murals here and discuss other matters.
He glanced at Li Qiushui in his hand.
This woman was no longer useful, better to leave her here in Lingjiu Palace, let her fend for herself.
Thinking so, Ding Ling absorbed the last bit of Li Qiushui’s inner strength, tossing her into a courtyard, and floated away.
Li Qiushui’s inner strength was exhausted.
Without inner strength from Small Faceless Skill to protect her.
She wouldn’t live long.
And being in Lingjiu Palace, discovered by Heavenly Mountain Granny, how could she live in peace?

For a ruthless and promiscuous woman like Li Qiushui, Ding Ling would not trust her. Furthermore, with his Full Level Observing People Skill and acting skills, he had long seen through that Li Qiushui was temporarily subdued, behaving passively. Should she gain power, she would inevitably return to a vicious and cold-blooded state.
She is someone comparable to Heavenly Mountain Granny in terms of brutality.
How could Ding Ling keep such a person around?

He could kill anyone in Lingjiu Palace without leaving a trace?
Thinking of it, the Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum couldn’t help but break into a sweat, their scalps tingling, subconsciously feeling a sense of awe for Ding Ling.
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Heavenly Mountain Granny]

[Note: Your inadvertently revealed unparalleled lightweight skill, like a deity walking among the clouds, fleeting like an immortal escaping the world, left Heavenly Mountain Granny in the dust, making her truly fearful and cautious of you from the heart!
Unless something unexpected happens, she will not choose to oppose you, but will choose to cooperate with you.]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Plum Sword]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Orchid Sword]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Bamboo Sword]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Intimidated Chrysanthemum Sword]
[Note: Having heard Heavenly Mountain Granny’s evaluation and your deeds, they are curious about you, admiring and in awe of you!]
"Oh?"
Ding Ling felt quite surprised upon hearing the notification sound.
He had already abandoned the idea of collaborating with Heavenly Mountain Granny, yet suddenly hearing the notification, there was a turn.
He smiled slightly and thought: if cooperation is possible, nothing could be better.
But the immediate priority is to find the murals here and discuss other matters.
He glanced at Li Qiushui in his hand.
This woman was no longer useful, better to leave her here in Lingjiu Palace, let her fend for herself.
Thinking so, Ding Ling absorbed the last bit of Li Qiushui’s inner strength, tossing her into a courtyard, and floated away.
Li Qiushui’s inner strength was exhausted.
Without inner strength from Small Faceless Skill to protect her.
She wouldn’t live long.
And being in Lingjiu Palace, discovered by Heavenly Mountain Granny, how could she live in peace?
For a ruthless and promiscuous woman like Li Qiushui, Ding Ling would not trust her.
Furthermore, with his Full Level Observing People Skill and acting skills, he had long seen through that Li Qiushui was temporarily subdued, behaving passively.
Should she gain power, she would inevitably return to a vicious and cold-blooded state.
She is someone comparable to Heavenly Mountain Granny in terms of brutality.
How could Ding Ling keep such a person around?

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - 536: Heavenly Mountain Granny! All Divine Skills at Full Level_3
paragraphs: Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling’s lightweight skill was outstanding.
His expertise in Mechanical Skill, Stargazing Skill, and Mo Family skills were all at full level, and he quickly discerned something in the back garden of Lingjiu Palace.
Seeing a few disciples guarding, he casually pointed.
One Yang Finger!
He hit their Sleeping Acupoint.
Once they collapsed to the ground.
Ding Ling walked straight ahead, fumbled for a bit, and activated a switch. With a crunching sound, an artificial mountain shifted aside, revealing a cave.
Ding Ling floated in like the wind.
Upon focusing his eyes.

He saw the cave walls indeed covered with countless circles approximately a foot in diameter, each circle containing patterns, either human figures, animal shapes; fragmented texts, or some symbols and lines...
Taking a rough glance.
There were at least eight or nine hundred circles.
Ding Ling clicked his tongue inwardly.
With his keen vision, he immediately saw that these circles contained profound and mysterious supreme skills.
The further they went, the more unfathomable they became.
"It doesn’t matter much if Heavenly Mountain Granny doesn’t exchange with me."
"Learning all the supreme skills here is perhaps far more formidable than learning the Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme."
Ding Ling began examining from Armor Map One and Armor Map Two.
These patterns were recorded in great detail.
The heart techniques and moves were etched clearly.
After reading the initial parts of the Armor Map.
[Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand Full Level]
[Defense +0.2]
Power reached the world’s limit and couldn’t be increased anymore.
All energy was poured into defense.
"Is this the Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand?!"
Ding Ling carefully comprehended, quite moved.
This Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand was truly remarkable, in its intricacies, it did not lose to the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, and its potential was limitless.
Its heart technique comprised only eighty-four words.
Yet, it covered a vast range, exceedingly complex, with only six paths of moves, three palm techniques, and three grappling techniques.
It seemed straightforward.
But for an ordinary person, looking at these images and heart techniques would be like reading celestial script, leaving them utterly confused.
The difficulty of cultivation was as high as reaching the heavens; without profound foundational cultivation, without peerless talent, achieving a full level in this skill was absolutely impossible.

Yet, for Ding Ling, leveling to full in an instant, with a flip of his wrist, his right hand transformed instantly, integrating various sword techniques, spear techniques, saber techniques, claw techniques, whip techniques, palm techniques he had learned before...
Truly reaching the pinnacle of profundity and mystery.
"What a magnificent Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand."
Ding Ling inwardly praised:
"Such a cultivation technique is genuinely rare in the world; I wonder who invented and created it."
It could be said that the most suitable martial arts for Ding Ling was the Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand.
He had learned too many skills in the past.

Now all were assimilated into the Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand, with a single palm’s turn, revealing Qing Frost Swordsmanship, Human Emperor Fist, Human Emperor Spear Technique, Warm Jade Swordsmanship, Moon Shadow Swordsmanship, Breaking Army Spear Skill, Howling Moon Sword Technique, Slaughter Void Saber Technique...
All the past learnings displayed within one palm, at one moment, revealing sword qi all around, at another moment, spear shadows flickering, palm power surging, saber light gleaming...
When Ding Ling reached a certain level of proficiency in the Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand, he moved on to examine the next martial art.
It was the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm.
He had learned it.
He continued onto the next book.
It was actually an extraordinary Medical Dao.
This contained secret techniques for changing eyes.
"Amazing. Even though my Medical Dao is divine, there’s absolutely no way I could smoothly change someone’s eyes, yet the Medical Dao here can."
Ding Ling was moved.
With a rough glance over the first few hundred patterns.
As expected.
The range of content was incredibly vast, truly all-encompassing, encompassing Medical Dao, Array Dao, craftsmanship, and mechanical skills, everything present.
Ding Ling, for a moment, became captivated by what he saw.
[Medical Dao Full Level]
[Array Dao Full Level]
He looked through them one by one.
Each skill reached full level as a result.
The level of his Medical Dao and other skills instantly surged to a very high point.
If he had divine proficiency in Medical Dao before, he was now touching the edge of the Land Medical God, truly possessing some skills and divine techniques of a Medical God.
He could perfectly perform eye changes, organ, and limb replacements!
And due to reaching full level, he could even ensure no aftereffects!
This kind of medical technique.
Was enough to leave modern medicine in the dust, astonishing as a Celestial Being!
Because when changing limbs, etc., even if the bloodlines didn’t match, he could perfectly swap them!
This breathtaking medical skill truly left one awestruck, even Ding Ling himself was amazed, marveling at the high level of skills here, completely beyond his imagination.
It was as if not intended for mortal learning.
Skills like changing eyes and limbs.
Couldn’t be learned without a century of pure power.
Ding Ling thought of how Xuzhu in the original novel learned just a smattering and could change Azi’s eyes; it must have been due to the depth of his inner strength.
Besides Medical Dao.
His Array Dao also reached a high tier! One after another, extremely complex and mysterious, Ding Ling examined them all, achieving full level.
In a short time.
He understood over a dozen high-tier arrays.
Ding Ling continued quickly.
Eventually.
He naturally also encountered techniques like the Life and Death Talisman.
[Life and Death Talisman Full Level]
[Defense +0.2]

This technique could be considered a top-notch hidden weapon skill, using alcohol, water, etc., reversing True Qi, transforming Masculine Energy into Yin-Soft, causing the liquid in hand to solidify into ice, then employing various special methods of Qi Force, the thin ice shards turned into hidden weapons to shoot out.
Once this ice shard entered the body, it was shapeless and tasteless, making it extremely difficult to detect and expel.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 536: Heavenly Mountain Granny! All Divine Skills at Full Level_4
paragraphs: Only when the Life and Death Talisman is activated does one feel extreme torment, feeling that life is worse than death.
"Incredible."
After carefully contemplating for a moment, Ding Ling was moved:
"Compared to this full-level Life and Death Talisman, the methods I used to torment Cloud Crane in the past can only be considered trivial."
Once the Life and Death Talisman reaches full level, its power is unimaginable to ordinary people. Once hit by Ding Ling’s Life and Death Talisman,
unless one’s skill can match his and one also knows martial arts like the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, there is no solution!
Ding Ling nodded secretly, having acquired this new hidden weapon.
Walking the Jianghu in the future will be even more secure.
He continued to look down.
[Profound Ice Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.1]
This is a technique that allows forming ice with one’s palm out of thin air, even under the scorching sun.
It is already comparable to some immortal techniques.
After reaching the full level, Ding Ling indeed grabbed out of thin air, and shards of ice formed in his hand.
[Ice Collection Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.1]
This is a technique that complements the Profound Ice Skill. Once at full level, it works effortlessly with the Profound Ice Skill to grasp ice shards out of thin air.
[Beast Taming Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.1]
This initial-tier Beast Taming Skill, once learned, allows control over ordinary horses, eagles, and similar animals.
It also enables basic communication with these animals.
Master one technique after another.
Reaching the last one.
[Soaring in the Void Full Level]
[Defense +0.4]
This is an unparalleled lightweight skill surpassing Spiral Nine Shadows, Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, Ripple Step.
After reaching full level.
As Ding Ling slightly activated this lightweight skill, his whole body floated up like a breeze, rising higher and higher until he reached the top of the cave, then stopped.
"Remarkable."
Ding Ling was shocked.
"This Soaring in the Void is probably no different from ordinary immortal skills."
As long as Ding Ling activated this technique,
he needed no external support,
creating wind out of thin air,
as if some wind force was lifting him up!
Just how high could he float out of thin air?
Ding Ling had never tried.
But without question, with this lightweight skill,
it shouldn’t be a problem for Ding Ling to fly several hundred to a thousand miles in one go in the future.
"What’s the difference between this and being a true immortal?"
Ding Ling was greatly moved and very satisfied.
This trip to Lingjiu Palace,
has indeed been incredibly rewarding!
He never expected that within this mountain wall, there would be so many Treasure Manuals! Secret Manuals!
And each one is top-notch.
Ordinary people simply cannot understand them, nor can they possibly learn them!
Ding Ling estimated that even the Heavenly Mountain Granny had certainly not mastered these subsequent techniques.
Especially the Soaring in the Void.
Ding Ling discovered that at least a Middle Tier Grandmaster’s cultivation was required to qualify for practicing this technique.

It was because, without such cultivation, the True Qi within the body was insufficient to form a perfect interaction cycle with the external spiritual mechanism and primordial Qi, naturally making it impossible to accomplish the feat of floating oneself up!
"Heavenly Mountain Granny’s cultivation is estimated to be around the late stage of Innate, at most a Half-Step Grandmaster, but still lacking the possibility to cultivate such a lightweight skill."
Ding Ling glanced at the mountain wall.
The quality of the Martial Arts Secret Manuals within this mountain wall was too high.
After seeing them,
the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body suddenly jumped by a whopping 8 percent points.
From 7% up to 15%.
Realizing this.
How could Ding Ling not understand that if the quality of the Secret Manuals he reads later is high enough, the progress of the Martial Arts Furnace will inevitably advance by leaps and bounds.
"Li Qiushui’s Secret Manual Collection is already the best of the best. The collection here can be called Saint-Grade!"
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
After carefully sensing and exploring for a moment,

finding no other hidden paths or secret doors, he turned around and floated out of the cave, closed the cave door, released the disciple’s acupuncture points, and then activated Soaring in the Void, gracefully floating away.
This time activating Soaring in the Void, Ding Ling’s figure floated higher and higher, soaring to a height of a hundred zhang in one breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - 537: Soaring in the Void! Ding Chunqiu’s Whereabouts
paragraphs: At this height.
Ding Ling looked down on the Earth Realm below.

He felt the majestic mountains and lush forests, with one glance seeing the green waves surging, the towering trees competing for prominence, eagles striking through the long skies, deer leaping across ravines, all kinds of creatures competing freely under the frost sky.
Ding Ling’s mood instantaneously became much more broad and clear.

He let out a hearty, long laugh and in Soaring in the Void, his entire body shot out like a beam of lightning, instantly covering several hundred meters, so fast that the naked eye struggled to discern.
With the ability to explosively drive the full level of Soaring in the Void by ten times the Fusion Qi, saying Ding Ling is a Martial Dao God in terms of speed is not an exaggeration!
Not to mention first-class experts, even regular Innate experts would find it difficult to trace his shadow.
Coming without a trace, leaving without a shadow.
The saying of seeing the head of a Divine Dragon but not the tail.
Describes him perfectly at this moment.
Below in the Earth Realm, Heavenly Mountain Granny vaguely heard a bold and hearty laugh, looking upward, but besides seeing the blue sky and white clouds, perceived nothing.
"Just now that voice..."
Heavenly Mountain Granny’s pupils constricted, her face full of disbelief.
The voice sounded very familiar.
But the voice seemed to come from Outer Heaven.
As if from beyond the cosmic star river.
"How is this possible?!"
A person, how could they leap that high?
And then disappear in just a moment?!
But thinking of Ding Ling’s unfathomable lightweight skill.
Heavenly Mountain Granny’s heart skipped a beat, her face began to change color accordingly.

She, clearly appearing as a beautiful fairy-like child, her face darkened suddenly, making one seem to face a tyrannical, irritable demon child who might destroy heaven and earth anytime, just at this moment, there was a report saying someone had knocked out her people in the back garden.
Heavenly Mountain Granny’s brows jumped, thinking of something bad, she immediately went to the back garden to check.
Upon checking.
Indeed found that someone had been to the cave inscribed with martial arts.
"How long has it been?"
"He actually found this stone wall, and then left? Judging from the laugh just now, could it be..."
Heavenly Mountain Granny rushed to the stone wall containing Soaring in the Void, and sure enough, the originally emerald green stone wall seemed dimmer.

"Master once said, this Soaring in the Void is comparable to Immortal Family methods, if it reaches great success, one could leap a hundred yards at a time, fly a hundred miles, akin to a Land God. Could Ding Ling have already mastered it?!"
Heavenly Mountain Granny was shocked and unsure.

"Master said this stone carving of Soaring in the Void was imprinted through special means, containing three unperceivable channels of Essence, Qi, and Spirit. Each person can only absorb one. Now one is missing. Seems it was absorbed by Ding Ling."
Heavenly Mountain Granny was astounded.
"So Ding Ling truly learned Soaring in the Void? How could this be?! He’s so young!"
"I and my martial brothers have never had the qualification to practice Soaring in the Void. He actually mastered it?!"
She couldn’t believe it.
But the facts were right before her.
Only mastering Soaring in the Void would dim this emerald stone carving some, after three people learn it, this stone carving would automatically vanish.
Such a method, unfathomable as ghost and god.
Exactly the work of her revered master.
"If Ding Ling truly mastered Soaring in the Void, then other methods..."
She glanced around, involuntarily drawing a cold breath.
Unimaginable!
Unbelievable!
But from Ding Ling’s arrival and rapid departure, Ding Ling definitely remembered it, even if not mastered.
"So young, such talent, truly remarkable. Lingjiu Palace making enemies with him would no doubt end up like Li Qiushui, the same outcome."
Heavenly Mountain Granny thought secretly:
"I most certainly don’t want to end up imprisoned like that wretch, with no freedom, might as well die right away."
Thinking this.

Heavenly Mountain Granny left the cave immediately and urged the Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum to head to the Western Xia Imperial City to seek cooperation with Ding Ling.
What she could offer were the Life and Death Talisman, Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand and other techniques.

However, this stone wall, aside from not engraved with North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme and those peerless inner power skills, and other techniques only Li Qiushui and Wuya Zi would know, other martial arts she performed were all basically engraved on this stone wall.
She truly had no trump cards now.
Therefore, looking at the Four Swordswomen, she stated sternly:
"You must ensure Ding Ling agrees to cooperate with us."
The Four Swordswomen answered the order.
Immediately prepared, and went down the mountain together.

Ding Ling traveled by Soaring in the Void, never borrowing power midway, lightly pointing at the void, Xun Wind was born from the soles of his feet, lifting him several more yards, giving him enough strength to continue flying forward.
Such mystical lightweight skill was truly peerless!
Ding Ling flew over a hundred miles in a breath, seeming like a mortal immortal.
Though he could only fly a hundred yards at his maximum, the height decreased gradually, estimating flying seven or eight hundred miles wouldn’t be a problem.
Mastering Soaring in the Void.

Grandmaster’s True Qi cultivation combined with the Breathing Technique’s vigorous qi directly allowed Ding Ling to fly eight hundred miles in a single breath, estimating a thousand miles wouldn’t be a problem if going full strength.
How it truly was.
Ding Ling hadn’t tried it, he didn’t know, he only knew roughly his limits after flying over a hundred miles.
His heart couldn’t help but secretly praise:

"With this lightweight skill, even entering a regular Xianxia World, there’s no need to back down! They have Sword Control Skill, my capability of Soaring in the Void, to some extent, is in no way inferior to Sword Control Skill, and might even say has certain advantages!"

Heavenly Mountain Granny’s heart skipped a beat, her face began to change color accordingly.

She, clearly appearing as a beautiful fairy-like child, her face darkened suddenly, making one seem to face a tyrannical, irritable demon child who might destroy heaven and earth anytime, just at this moment, there was a report saying someone had knocked out her people in the back garden.
Heavenly Mountain Granny’s brows jumped, thinking of something bad, she immediately went to the back garden to check.
Upon checking.
Indeed found that someone had been to the cave inscribed with martial arts.
"How long has it been?"
"He actually found this stone wall, and then left?
Judging from the laugh just now, could it be..."
Heavenly Mountain Granny rushed to the stone wall containing Soaring in the Void, and sure enough, the originally emerald green stone wall seemed dimmer.
"Master once said, this Soaring in the Void is comparable to Immortal Family methods, if it reaches great success, one could leap a hundred yards at a time, fly a hundred miles, akin to a Land God.
Could Ding Ling have already mastered it?!"
Heavenly Mountain Granny was shocked and unsure.
"Master said this stone carving of Soaring in the Void was imprinted through special means, containing three unperceivable channels of Essence, Qi, and Spirit.
Each person can only absorb one.
Now one is missing.
Seems it was absorbed by Ding Ling."
Heavenly Mountain Granny was astounded.
"So Ding Ling truly learned Soaring in the Void?
How could this be?!
He’s so young!"
"I and my martial brothers have never had the qualification to practice Soaring in the Void.
He actually mastered it?!"
She couldn’t believe it.
But the facts were right before her.
Only mastering Soaring in the Void would dim this emerald stone carving some, after three people learn it, this stone carving would automatically vanish.
Such a method, unfathomable as ghost and god.
Exactly the work of her revered master.
"If Ding Ling truly mastered Soaring in the Void, then other methods..."
She glanced around, involuntarily drawing a cold breath.
Unimaginable!
Unbelievable!
But from Ding Ling’s arrival and rapid departure, Ding Ling definitely remembered it, even if not mastered.
"So young, such talent, truly remarkable.
Lingjiu Palace making enemies with him would no doubt end up like Li Qiushui, the same outcome."
Heavenly Mountain Granny thought secretly:
"I most certainly don’t want to end up imprisoned like that wretch, with no freedom, might as well die right away."
Thinking this.

Heavenly Mountain Granny left the cave immediately and urged the Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum to head to the Western Xia Imperial City to seek cooperation with Ding Ling.
What she could offer were the Life and Death Talisman, Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, Celestial Mountain Plum-Bending Hand and other techniques.

However, this stone wall, aside from not engraved with North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme and those peerless inner power skills, and other techniques only Li Qiushui and Wuya Zi would know, other martial arts she performed were all basically engraved on this stone wall.
She truly had no trump cards now.
Therefore, looking at the Four Swordswomen, she stated sternly:
"You must ensure Ding Ling agrees to cooperate with us."
The Four Swordswomen answered the order.
Immediately prepared, and went down the mountain together.

Ding Ling traveled by Soaring in the Void, never borrowing power midway, lightly pointing at the void, Xun Wind was born from the soles of his feet, lifting him several more yards, giving him enough strength to continue flying forward.
Such mystical lightweight skill was truly peerless!
Ding Ling flew over a hundred miles in a breath, seeming like a mortal immortal.
Though he could only fly a hundred yards at his maximum, the height decreased gradually, estimating flying seven or eight hundred miles wouldn’t be a problem.
Mastering Soaring in the Void.

Grandmaster’s True Qi cultivation combined with the Breathing Technique’s vigorous qi directly allowed Ding Ling to fly eight hundred miles in a single breath, estimating a thousand miles wouldn’t be a problem if going full strength.
How it truly was.
Ding Ling hadn’t tried it, he didn’t know, he only knew roughly his limits after flying over a hundred miles.
His heart couldn’t help but secretly praise:
"With this lightweight skill, even entering a regular Xianxia World, there’s no need to back down!
They have Sword Control Skill, my capability of Soaring in the Void, to some extent, is in no way inferior to Sword Control Skill, and might even say has certain advantages!"

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 537: Soaring in the Void! Ding Chunqiu’s Whereabouts (2)
paragraphs: "Very well."

"If the Martial Arts Melting Furnace is fully manifested, and it refines the Soaring in the Void, Ripple Step, Spiral Nine Shadows, Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique and other body techniques, what kind of Lightweight Secret Skill will be produced?"
Ding Ling was full of anticipation.
Developing like this.
Becoming a Human Martial God is just a matter of time.
"The Celestial Dragon Eight Books World should be ending."
Ding Ling had only stayed in this world for a few months.
He spent the most time in Western Xia.
And he became an emperor.
Clearing flatterers, selecting capable officials, conducting imperial examinations, stabilizing the court, and other things took up a lot of his time.
Although his wisdom couldn’t match Zhuge Liang and others, he had improved many times and surpassed ordinary people by much.
Additionally, his memory and analytical ability were also greatly enhanced, and he was versatile; while managing state affairs not with effortless ease, he handled them quite smoothly.
The main reason was still because the capable officials he selected helped him share various responsibilities, allowing him to free himself up to do other things.
He is someone who knows how to delegate authority.
The primary reason is still because he might not be emperor for long, so naturally, he has to think long-term.
"Once I return, I’ll punch through the Liao Kingdom."

As Ding Ling thought this, the Fusion Qi accelerated by a tenfold increase, and boom! The Soaring in the Void exploded, creating two extremely noticeable gusts beneath Ding Ling, propelling him forward like a cannonball, resembling a lightning bolt slicing across the sky, disappearing into the distance in the blink of an eye.
A few female players were riding to Lingjiu Palace, and one of them unintentionally looked up to see this scene, and couldn’t help but scream.
Her companion asked her what was wrong.
She looked shocked, pointed to the direction where Ding Ling had gracefully disappeared, and stammered:
"God! God! A celestial! I...I saw a celestial!"
Her tongue got tied, showing how turbulent her heart was.
"Big sister, this is the Martial World, not the Xianxia World."
The companion rolled her eyes:
"A celestial? I might as well be the Ghost King!"
"B-b-but, I...I really saw it!"
The female player swallowed hard and straightened her tongue, widening her lovely apricot eyes, saying crisply:

"Besides, why can’t there be celestials in the Martial World! In the Three Kingdoms Historical Plane, weren’t Demon Dao Zuo Ci and Martial God Ding Ling there! When they fought outside Chang’an City, they flew to the sky and tunneled through the earth, even ghosts appeared. And in the more advanced Martial Hero Plane, why can’t there be celestials!"
"Now everyone knows the Historical Plane is blessed with Celestial Might."
The companion continued:
"When Demon Dao Zuo Ci went to The Deer and the Cauldron, Romantic Swordsman and other worlds, he performed average, not as amazing as in the Three Kingdoms World!"
"What about Ding Ling then? How do you explain Ding Ling? He’s been sweeping through, and it’s said he recently defeated ten thousand elite Western Xia soldiers and became an emperor!"
"He’s special. How can Zuo Ci compare with him? Just think about it, how many years has this game been open? Can you find another like Ding Ling?!"
The several female players argued all the way, discussing Ding Ling’s deeds, almost nonstop.
The admiration in their words was obvious to anyone who heard it.
They even talked about how if they learned martial arts and made a name for themselves at Lingjiu Palace, they would certainly want to shake hands with Ding Ling and have a chat up close!
Ding Ling didn’t know about these things.
He flew swiftly back to Western Xia.
He flew for eight hundred miles before landing at the top of a tree, then soared into the air again.
It proved that.
He truly could fly eight hundred miles in one breath.
This fact brought Ding Ling great joy.
With this ability, he wouldn’t be powerless in future worlds.
Returning to the Western Xia Imperial City.
After handling some accumulated matters in the Imperial Study of the Palace, he saw Li Qinglu personally bringing some pastries.
She was as beautiful as the morning glow and as bright as the warm sun.
With peachy cheeks and apricot face, charming posture and beauty too much like Wang Yuyan.
However, their temperaments were completely different.
Wang Yuyan was more silent, whereas she was radiant, and her face had a faint beauty mark.
This differed from Wang Yuyan.
Every time Ding Ling saw Li Qinglu, he marveled at the Creator’s wonder, how in an era, four identical women could appear simultaneously.
Li Qiushui, Li Qingluo, Li Qinglu, Wang Yuyan.
Grandmother, mother, granddaughter.
Almost indistinguishable.
With such extraordinary genes, Ding Ling even had reason to suspect they were descents of gods, otherwise why so unique.
"Your Majesty."
Li Qinglu knelt to one side, personally poured tea for Ding Ling and offered pastries:
"You’ve been busy for a while, time to rest."
"Hmm."
Ding Ling noncommittally took the pastries, glanced at Li Qinglu, saw her staring at him with her apricot eyes unblinkingly, his mind moved, and he asked:
"Do you have something to say?"
"Yes."
Li Qinglu looked straight at Ding Ling, originally clear and pure like water, but now blushing, appearing a bit coquettish:
"I want to ask Your Majesty, do you need Qinglu to attend to you tonight?"
She used to be a maidservant.
Now she was an Imperial Consort.
Naturally, she couldn’t use maidservant’s words anymore.
Ding Ling was taken aback, looked Li Qinglu over twice.
Li Qinglu not only did not shy away but raised her swan neck slightly, seeming to let Ding Ling see more clearly.
"...Fine. I will come to you tonight."
"Thank you, Your Majesty."
Li Qinglu was overjoyed, hurriedly knelt down to thank him.
"You may leave."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Li Qinglu respectfully thanked again, and then retreated.
Why did she do this?
Ding Ling knew clearly in his heart.
Simply wanting a child, perhaps in the future the child could rise because of the mother, stepping ahead of Zhong Ling and others, letting the child become Crown Prince, etc.
But Ding Ling currently did not want children.
He wouldn’t consider giving birth right now.
Soon after Li Qinglu left.
Someone reported.
They discovered the whereabouts of Ding Chunqiu and Murong Bo.
But Western Xia soldiers were not their match, many were wounded or killed.
After listening to the report in detail.
He quickly handled all affairs.
Then flew out of the palace, heading straight to where Ding Chunqiu and others were.
They were hiding at the border between Western Xia and Great Song, Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu jointly repelled Xiaoo Yuanshan’s attacks several times.
Even Western Xia soldiers couldn’t do anything to them for a while.
Because Murong Bo, Ding Chunqiu had defected to Great Song, using Great Song soldiers to engage in defensive and offensive battles against Western Xia soldiers.
For now, the back-and-forth battle between the two sides was intense.
Because Great Song had Murong Bo acting as War General.
Ding Chunqiu poisoning.
Several small-scale battles between Western Xia and Great Song resulted in crushing defeat each time.
Ding Ling originally intended to deal with Great Liao first.
Since Great Song was the first to invade.
Then deal with Great Song first, and then Great Liao.
It’s essentially the same.
Ding Ling set off that day.
By evening he had arrived at the Great Song and Western Xia border.
"Greetings, Your Majesty."
When Helian Tieshu and his forces saw Ding Ling, they were invigorated and ecstatic.
In Helian Tieshu’s view.
With Ding Ling in Western Xia, all enemies would be easily vanquished.
This is why, despite several defeats, he still remained enthusiastic.
With Ding Ling as a backing.
Helian Tieshu had no fear.
Even if poisoned, Ding Ling could detoxify him, what reason did he have to be afraid?
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling merely gave Helian Tieshu a slight glance, then headed straight toward the Great Song border.
Helian Tieshu immediately led his troops to follow.
Ding Ling had made a strict agreement with them:
"Once inside Song Realm, do not harm the people, do not deceive or rob... If I find anyone doing so, Helian Tieshu, bring your own head to see me."
Upon hearing this.

Helian Tieshu broke out in a cold sweat, promptly responded that he would abide, while ordering the unruly soldiers to stay behind in Western Xia to guard the supplies, taking only disciplined elites to follow.
Boom!
The force of over ten thousand cavalry was tremendous, detected by the Great Song soldiers before they got close, and they signaled the alarm fires.
Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu heard the commotion and immediately donned armor and rode out.

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 538: Murong Bo! Xiao Yuanshan
paragraphs: Murong Bo, with greying temples, appeared aged, but his face, sharply chiseled like a knife’s edge and eyebrows as if painted with ink, projected an imposing presence, still resembling a graceful middle-aged man, handsome as ever.
Ding Chunqiu had long, flowing hair, with rosy lips and white teeth, holding a feathered fan in hand.
Their temperaments and appearances were distinct from each other.
However, without exception, their contours were deep, with defined features, faintly revealing the unparalleled grace of their youth.
At this moment, the two donned armor and rode their horses to the outskirts of the city.
A glance revealed it all.
Indeed, the Western Xia army galloped towards them like a surging tide, with an overwhelming and majestic aura.
The two exchanged a glance, able to see the unwavering battle spirit in each other’s eyes.
They led the Great Song army, easily subduing and defeating the Western Xia forces several times, yet still held Helian Tieshu in low regard.
Murong Bo thought further:

"If I, Murong Bo, could seize power, who among the great generals of the world could be my match? By then, sweeping across the world, restoring the nation and ascending the throne, wouldn’t it be as easy as turning my hand? Alas, alas, to completely control the military power of Great Song is extremely challenging.
I have laid low for decades across Great Song and Great Liao, developing countless spies.
But merely relying on spies isn’t enough to form a climate.
We must let Western Xia and Great Song engage in a thorough war, so I can seize a good opportunity within.
It would be best to drag Great Liao into it as well."
While pondering how to stir up a multi-nation war to seize military power for the restoration of his country,
Suddenly, Ding Chunqiu’s face drastically changed. He leaped off his horse, turned around, and fled.

Murong Bo was stunned, instinctively looking forward. Upon seeing the figure at the forefront, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath and then spun around to run wildly, even faster than Ding Chunqiu.
"Ding Ling, as an emperor of a nation, instead of being a good emperor, is obsessed with beauties in the harem. Why has he suddenly appeared at the border from far away?"
Murong Bo couldn’t understand it at all.
It had only been a few months since Ding Ling became emperor.
He must be dealing with a myriad of issues every day!
Why would he suddenly appear at the border without apparent reason?
This was one thing, but more importantly, wasn’t Ding Ling supposed to be far away in the Tian Mountain region?!

If he had known Ding Ling would come, Murong Bo would never have publicly appeared. He was forced by Xiao Yuanshan and the Western Xia troops, having no other choice but to seek the help of Great Song to counter Xiao Yuanshan and the Western Xia army.
Though he was very strong, he couldn’t withstand the various assassination, poisoning, and ambush attempts by the Western Xia First-Grade Hall.
He was no Ding Ling!

Although Western Xia First-Grade Hall was destroyed by Ding Ling, under Ding Ling’s support, it selected the best and became powerful again. This Western Xia First-Grade Hall recruited many martial arts practitioners, who, along with Western Xia’s elite soldiers, conducted archery killings, assassinations, etc., extremely skillfully.

Even though Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu were formidable, they were often ambushed and poisoned, which left them apprehensive, knowing that continuing like this would inevitably lead to death, hence they took the risk of a desperate struggle.
In retrospect, it was indeed a risky endeavor!
They had unknowingly brought out Ding Ling!
Was it worth it?!
It was just a small-scale conflict!
He hadn’t even brought Great Liao’s troops into the fray, yet suddenly, a great rush ensued, leaving Murong Bo very panic-stricken.
"Why didn’t the spies report any information on Ding Ling?!"
Murong Bo sprinted into the city, glancing sideways at Ding Chunqiu.
"I’m puzzled too."
Ding Chunqiu shook his head, turned his head for a glance, saw that Ding Ling wasn’t chasing, and heaved a sigh of relief even as he ran faster:
"I’ve deployed a large number of spies and secret agents around the Western Xia Imperial City, especially near the Imperial Palace. These people don’t have to do anything else, just watch Ding Ling.
I also heard from them that Ding Ling had gone to Lingjiu Palace on Illusory Peak of Tian Mountain.
That was the only reason I dared to venture out so openly.
Logically speaking.

The Tian Mountain is at least over a thousand miles from the Imperial City, even riding horses, it would take several days. After all, the mountains are tall, waters long, many mountain ranges along this route, horses can’t climb mountains and ridges, some terrains can only be traversed by foot.
Considering all this, a round trip of a month was plausible.
But for Ding Ling’s round trip?
It took only less than a day or two?! How fast was that?! Simply unbelievable!"
Murong Bo agreed deeply.

He also knew the great distance between the Imperial City and Celestial Mountain Piaomiao Peak, and the numerous tough mountain roads. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have taken advantage of Ding Ling’s distant travel, hurriedly to emerge and proceed with his plans.
However, despite all calculations.
What he did not expect was that Ding Ling would unexpectedly appear on the battlefield, frightening him to the core!
"Murong Bo!"

Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu quickly exchanged various intelligence, gaining clarity about the situation, yet feeling increasingly bewildered and confused. Just as they ran out from the heavily stationed border town and were preparing to delve into the Great Song territory, a robust man towering at eight chi, with thick brows and big eyes, a high nose, and a wide mouth, charged in from the side, rushing towards Murong Bo:
"Prepare to die!"
"Xiao Yuanshan!
Upon seeing the intruder, Murong Bo’s face changed slightly, anger surged:
"Enough already! My son was killed by your son. Yet, you still pursue me relentlessly, isn’t that going too far!!"
"The enmity for killing my wife is irreconcilable. Murong Bo, you old thief, I, Xiao Yuanshan, will not rest until you’re dead. Prepare to die!"
Xiao Yuanshan bolted near, violently striking, slamming a palm towards Murong Bo’s chest.
Ding Chunqiu, eyes rolling, turned away from Murong Bo, detouring and running rapidly.
"Ding Chunqiu!"
Murong Bo’s pupils contracted, a fury erupted within him:
"Weren’t we supposed to face the enemy together? How can you just flee like that?"
"Murong Bo, my apologies. Ding Ling’s martial arts are far beyond my reach, I’m a bit afraid of him. Our roads will cross again with the flow of time and distance!"
Swoosh!
With those words, Ding Chunqiu was already leaping into a vast forest nearby, disappearing without a trace within a few leaps.
Murong Bo was so angry his face turned red and his neck swelled, yet he knew now wasn’t the time for distractions, immediately gathered his spirit, and confronted Xiao Yuanshan.
Both were peerless masters.
A punch, a palm.
Both carried infinite might. The ongoing explosions echoed without cease, wildly displaying the tenfold exploding power of their Fusion Qi.
Clear to see.
Both had mastered the Breathing Technique!
Boom!
Both simultaneously used a move of Great Vajra Palm, upon hearing the massive explosion, both were blown uncontrollably backward more than ten zhang.
Seizing the chance, Murong Bo turned and dashed into the Thorn Ridge on one side, fleeing wildly.
"Murong Bo, stop!"
Xiao Yuanshan quickly pursued.

He didn’t have the same connections as Murong Bo, nor had he developed so many spies, thus couldn’t approach the higher echelons of Great Song’s military, naturally not daring to enter this stronghold, to avoid being caught in a trap.
Opting to wait outside, seeking an opportunity.
To his surprise, he originally thought he would have to wait for a long time, but within a mere day or two, Murong Bo had suddenly fled out of the stronghold in panic.
