"If I, Murong Bo, could seize power, who among the great generals of the world could be my match?
By then, sweeping across the world, restoring the nation and ascending the throne, wouldn’t it be as easy as turning my hand?
Alas, alas, to completely control the military power of Great Song is extremely challenging.
I have laid low for decades across Great Song and Great Liao, developing countless spies.
But merely relying on spies isn’t enough to form a climate.
We must let Western Xia and Great Song engage in a thorough war, so I can seize a good opportunity within.
It would be best to drag Great Liao into it as well."
While pondering how to stir up a multi-nation war to seize military power for the restoration of his country,
Suddenly, Ding Chunqiu’s face drastically changed.
He leaped off his horse, turned around, and fled.
Murong Bo was stunned, instinctively looking forward.
Upon seeing the figure at the forefront, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath and then spun around to run wildly, even faster than Ding Chunqiu.
"Ding Ling, as an emperor of a nation, instead of being a good emperor, is obsessed with beauties in the harem.
Why has he suddenly appeared at the border from far away?"
Murong Bo couldn’t understand it at all.
It had only been a few months since Ding Ling became emperor.
He must be dealing with a myriad of issues every day!
Why would he suddenly appear at the border without apparent reason?
This was one thing, but more importantly, wasn’t Ding Ling supposed to be far away in the Tian Mountain region?!
If he had known Ding Ling would come, Murong Bo would never have publicly appeared.
He was forced by Xiao Yuanshan and the Western Xia troops, having no other choice but to seek the help of Great Song to counter Xiao Yuanshan and the Western Xia army.
Though he was very strong, he couldn’t withstand the various assassination, poisoning, and ambush attempts by the Western Xia First-Grade Hall.
He was no Ding Ling!
Although Western Xia First-Grade Hall was destroyed by Ding Ling, under Ding Ling’s support, it selected the best and became powerful again.
This Western Xia First-Grade Hall recruited many martial arts practitioners, who, along with Western Xia’s elite soldiers, conducted archery killings, assassinations, etc., extremely skillfully.

Even though Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu were formidable, they were often ambushed and poisoned, which left them apprehensive, knowing that continuing like this would inevitably lead to death, hence they took the risk of a desperate struggle.
In retrospect, it was indeed a risky endeavor!
They had unknowingly brought out Ding Ling!
Was it worth it?!
It was just a small-scale conflict!
He hadn’t even brought Great Liao’s troops into the fray, yet suddenly, a great rush ensued, leaving Murong Bo very panic-stricken.
"Why didn’t the spies report any information on Ding Ling?!"
Murong Bo sprinted into the city, glancing sideways at Ding Chunqiu.
"I’m puzzled too."
Ding Chunqiu shook his head, turned his head for a glance, saw that Ding Ling wasn’t chasing, and heaved a sigh of relief even as he ran faster:
"I’ve deployed a large number of spies and secret agents around the Western Xia Imperial City, especially near the Imperial Palace.
These people don’t have to do anything else, just watch Ding Ling.
I also heard from them that Ding Ling had gone to Lingjiu Palace on Illusory Peak of Tian Mountain.
That was the only reason I dared to venture out so openly.
Logically speaking.
The Tian Mountain is at least over a thousand miles from the Imperial City, even riding horses, it would take several days.
After all, the mountains are tall, waters long, many mountain ranges along this route, horses can’t climb mountains and ridges, some terrains can only be traversed by foot.
Considering all this, a round trip of a month was plausible.
But for Ding Ling’s round trip?
It took only less than a day or two?!
How fast was that?!
Simply unbelievable!"
Murong Bo agreed deeply.
He also knew the great distance between the Imperial City and Celestial Mountain Piaomiao Peak, and the numerous tough mountain roads.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have taken advantage of Ding Ling’s distant travel, hurriedly to emerge and proceed with his plans.
However, despite all calculations.
What he did not expect was that Ding Ling would unexpectedly appear on the battlefield, frightening him to the core!
"Murong Bo!"
Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu quickly exchanged various intelligence, gaining clarity about the situation, yet feeling increasingly bewildered and confused.

Just as they ran out from the heavily stationed border town and were preparing to delve into the Great Song territory, a robust man towering at eight chi, with thick brows and big eyes, a high nose, and a wide mouth, charged in from the side, rushing towards Murong Bo:
"Prepare to die!"
"Xiao Yuanshan!
Upon seeing the intruder, Murong Bo’s face changed slightly, anger surged:
"Enough already!
My son was killed by your son.
Yet, you still pursue me relentlessly, isn’t that going too far!!"
"The enmity for killing my wife is irreconcilable.
Murong Bo, you old thief, I, Xiao Yuanshan, will not rest until you’re dead.
Prepare to die!"
Xiao Yuanshan bolted near, violently striking, slamming a palm towards Murong Bo’s chest.
Ding Chunqiu, eyes rolling, turned away from Murong Bo, detouring and running rapidly.
"Ding Chunqiu!"
Murong Bo’s pupils contracted, a fury erupted within him:
"Weren’t we supposed to face the enemy together?
How can you just flee like that?"
"Murong Bo, my apologies.
Ding Ling’s martial arts are far beyond my reach, I’m a bit afraid of him.
Our roads will cross again with the flow of time and distance!"
Swoosh!
With those words, Ding Chunqiu was already leaping into a vast forest nearby, disappearing without a trace within a few leaps.
Murong Bo was so angry his face turned red and his neck swelled, yet he knew now wasn’t the time for distractions, immediately gathered his spirit, and confronted Xiao Yuanshan.
Both were peerless masters.
A punch, a palm.
Both carried infinite might.
The ongoing explosions echoed without cease, wildly displaying the tenfold exploding power of their Fusion Qi.
Clear to see.
Both had mastered the Breathing Technique!
Boom!
Both simultaneously used a move of Great Vajra Palm, upon hearing the massive explosion, both were blown uncontrollably backward more than ten zhang.
Seizing the chance, Murong Bo turned and dashed into the Thorn Ridge on one side, fleeing wildly.
"Murong Bo, stop!"
Xiao Yuanshan quickly pursued.

He didn’t have the same connections as Murong Bo, nor had he developed so many spies, thus couldn’t approach the higher echelons of Great Song’s military, naturally not daring to enter this stronghold, to avoid being caught in a trap.
Opting to wait outside, seeking an opportunity.
To his surprise, he originally thought he would have to wait for a long time, but within a mere day or two, Murong Bo had suddenly fled out of the stronghold in panic.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 539: The Heartland of Great Song
paragraphs: Although Xiaoo Yuanshan was truly bewildered, it didn’t affect his speed of pursuing Murong Bo in the slightest.
His Lightweight Skill was also quite remarkable, relentlessly chasing Murong Bo without letting go, battling all the way, delving deeper and deeper into the Song Realm.
Just like that, a few hours passed.
Suddenly, Xiaoo Yuanshan saw a figure appear high above in the sky.
This person appeared too abruptly, yet perfectly integrated with this world, as if he naturally belonged to this realm of sky and earth.
"Who is this person?!"
While Xiaoo Yuanshan’s heart and spirit trembled, Murong Bo couldn’t help but shout: ’Ding Ling!’
It turned out to be Ding Ling!
Xiaoo Yuanshan took a breath and instinctively bowed deeply to Ding Ling, respectfully saying:
"Grass citizen Xiaoo Yuanshan greets Your Majesty, long live Your Majesty!"
His son was the Grand General under Ding Ling.
So naturally, he followed his son and called Ding Ling Emperor!
"Hmm. Rise."
The newcomer was Ding Ling indeed.
He had just taken less than a quarter of an hour.
To conquer the frontier towns of the Great Song.
The leading Grand General was annihilated by him.
The Deputy General led tens of thousands of Song soldiers to surrender, now joining forces with the Western Xia cavalry, charging towards the Great Song Imperial City.

Ding Ling, with his extraordinary vision, had long spotted Murong Bo and Ding Chunqiu. He hadn’t met the two of them before, so he didn’t know who they were. Later, prompted by someone from the Western Xia First-Grade Hall, he realized the two old folks who fled were actually those two.
He then instructed the people from the Western Xia First-Grade Hall to keep an eye on them.
Not long ago, someone from the Western Xia First-Grade Hall reported discovering Murong Bo’s whereabouts, so Ding Ling used his Soaring in the Void skill and sped over.

He merged his Vigorous Qi with a tenfold amplification, causing waves of wind under his feet, akin to the child of the wind, soaring easily upwards into the sky. Helian Tieshu and his group, including the recently surrendered Song soldiers, stared in shock and awe, deeming him a Divine Being!
The previously respectful surrendering generals were now utterly convinced, not daring to harbor any other thoughts.
To pit mortals against such a Martial God?
Isn’t that courting death?

Surrendering to the Martial God doesn’t seem shameful. The Song soldiers initially doubted Ding Ling’s ability to crush ten thousand elite troops. But just recently, Ding Ling breached a major town alone, struck down with a single palm, effortlessly slaughtering hundreds of people. He casually picked up a long spear and, with a flying thrust, pierced through the General’s body!
Every action displayed the majesty of an Overlord, earning awe and reverence! A person like this.
No wonder he could single-handedly crumble Western Xia and become Emperor.

Everyone was suddenly enlightened, especially knowing what Ding Ling did in Western Xia, and their resistance towards him softened considerably. Ding Ling, being a native of the Central Plains, was compassionate to the people, continuously exercising benevolent governance. Unable to defeat Ding Ling and unwilling to die, they had no choice but to join him.
What comforted them was the thought that perhaps Ding Ling could lead them to establish a truly great empire?
Ding Ling casually pointed at Murong Bo, piercing through his knee, making him kneel on the ground.
A dignified Innate Expert.
Yet before Ding Ling, utterly powerless to resist!
Murong Bo was astounded.
Xiaoo Yuanshan was wide-eyed and tongue-tied. For the first time, he felt the gap between them.

Especially seeing Ding Ling perform Soaring in the Void, standing two zhang high in the air without sinking, lightly standing in the void. This miraculous Lightweight Skill technique left Xiaoo Yuanshan and Murong Bo utterly shocked.
[Achievement Medal won: Intimidating Murong Bo]

[Note: Murong Bo had already heard of your prowess. Now seeing it first-hand and experiencing it, he is left not just shocked but in utter despair. The Murong Clan facing such a person? They’ve hit a streak of bad luck for eight generations! The one he hates most now is Li Qingluo for dragging the Murong Clan into this mess! Without her, you and the Murong Clan might have become friends.]
[Achievement Medal won: You’ve gained Xiaoo Yuanshan’s high admiration.]
[Note: Xiaoo Yuanshan has never admired anyone this much in his life. You are the only one!]
After collecting two Achievement Medals,
Ding Ling didn’t linger any longer and flew away:
"Xiaoo Yuanshan, Murong Bo is left to you to handle. After you’ve dealt with him, remember to come to the army and report to me. I hope you can be a General like your son."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Xiaoo Yuanshan’s voice was high and resounding, full of vigor:
"I will definitely go!"
The great revenge was near.
Xiaoo Yuanshan felt a profound sense of relief and delight surged through him from head to toe looking at Murong Bo kneeling defeated on the ground, laughing heartily thrice:
"Old thief, did you ever think you’d end up like this?!"
"Hmph."
Murong Bo sneered mockingly:

"If my Murong Clan hadn’t been unlucky and dragged into this, forming a vendetta with Ding Ling, it’s likely Ding Ling would have been my friend. Then you’d be the one dead, and I’d be the one laughing!"
"Victory belongs to the king and defeat to the invader. Such is fate and destiny. Old thief, it just means your fortune was scant, unworthy of this blessing; meet your end!"
Xiaoo Yuanshan struck a palm, ending Murong Bo, then turned and strode towards the Western Xia military.
Now with his great vengeance fulfilled,
he felt entirely unburdened.
The rest of his life was now for himself, for his son.
Joining the ranks under Ding Ling.
To become one of Ding Ling’s formidable generals, waging campaigns north and south, unifying the world.
A hundred years later, the Xiaoo Family.
Perhaps would become a top-tier family!
Thinking of all this.
Xiaoo Yuanshan became more and more exhilarated.
His recognition and admiration for Ding Ling surged exponentially.
What filled him with even more pride and satisfaction was.
His son was friends with Ding Ling!
Just this alone was enough to surpass countless others.
"My son truly has deep fortune! Just on this point, the old Murong thief is far behind."
Xiaoo Feng being valued by Ding Ling and selected as Grand General.
Xiaoo Yuanshan felt deeply honored, very gratified, and thrilled!
And now.
He too was being valued by Ding Ling!
This further stirred his once dormant heart into a frenzy of excitement!
"My emperor, avenged my blood feud, values my son, how could I, Xiaoo Yuanshan, not be devoted beyond reason?!"
With Ding Ling’s relentless advance.
He personally took action.
Crushing and conquering all obstacles along the way.
His momentum unstoppable!
Very effortlessly, he captured one formidable city after another, reaching the Great Song Imperial City.
With his own strength alone.
Employing Soaring in the Void, he ignored the dense rain of arrows shot from the towers on the Imperial City walls.
Charging into the city tower.
Striking down with one hand.
Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
Dark Clouds Without Rain!
A deluge of Dragon-shaped Qi shadows burst forth with mighty force, with endless roaring explosions, severed limbs flying everywhere, and a bloody rain descending from the sky.
In an instant,
he had crushed over a thousand men!
The killing was too swift.
The blood scattered and poured down like ’rain’ from the sky.
Such scenes terrified Song officers and soldiers, making them tremble and wail.
Ding Ling’s actions were simply meant to intimidate the Song soldiers.

And so, after one strike, he refrained from further action, employing Soaring in the Void once again, launching forward with wind waves surging from his feet, bursting towards the Great Song Imperial Palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 540: Breaking Through Great Liao
paragraphs: No one dared to stop Ding Ling along the way.
Anyone who tried was roared at by Ding Ling, their eardrums shattered, collapsing in pain.
Ding Ling’s speed was incredibly fast, like a meteor streaking across the sky, or a lightning bolt descending from heaven. One moment he was outside the Imperial City.
The next moment.
He was already inside the Imperial Palace.
"How is this possible?!"
The officials were shocked.
The Imperial Guards, terrified and enraged, rushed towards Ding Ling.
"Roar!"

Ding Ling did not move directly, he only used the Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind and Lion’s Roar, roaring in their direction. With Fusion Qi activated, the power of these two Sound Wave Skills was infinitely magnified.
In an instant, the air was filled with piercing, sharp roars.
Among them were sounds like the roar of lions and tigers!

The thousands of Imperial Guards and eunuchs charging towards Ding Ling bore the brunt, their eardrums shattered by the sound waves and gas waves, their pupils filled with blood, brains buzzing, as if struck by heavy hammers.
They involuntarily fell to the ground, rolling and screaming in agony.
In just a moment.
Thousands of masters had fallen, at least eighty percent of them.
In the remaining twenty percent were many peerless masters.
They looked at each other in fear, but thinking of the emperor and the officials behind them, they could only grit their teeth and charge.
However, even if they blocked Ding Ling’s Sound Wave Skills, they couldn’t block Ding Ling’s casual Canhe Finger.
The Canhe Finger was formless, invisible, and traceless. One finger down.
No matter who it was.
They would instantly be dead or knocked down, unable to move.

Ding Ling walked leisurely, seemingly slow, yet advancing incredibly quickly. In just a few blinks, he arrived at the Imperial Palace Main Hall, facing the Emperor of the Great Song and the officials.
"You, you, you..."
The Emperor of the Great Song was shocked, trembling, unable to imagine such a divine being as Ding Ling existed.

"Will you surrender after I overthrow the court, or will I kill you and then you surrender? Or maybe just surrender directly and ensure the safety of your nine clans? Live the rest of your life as a wealthy man?"
Ding Ling’s face was calm, his voice indifferent, surveying the scene, and no one dared meet his gaze.
Even those who bravely glared at him were immediately knocked down by Ding Ling’s light hum!
Ding Ling’s Sound Wave Skill had reached the Transformation Realm.
He could roar down ten thousand soldiers.
Or precisely roar one person unconscious.
"Do I have a choice?"
The Emperor of the Great Song smiled bitterly.
He had witnessed Ding Ling ignoring the rain of arrows and with a roar, nearly six thousand elites were roared down. Ding Ling was unharmed along the way, while the Great Song suffered heavy losses!
Such a character?
Could he be a god?!
The Emperor of the Great Song’s expression was dazed, his gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly.
In the following time.
He cooperated with Ding Ling on the abdication process.
The throne of the Great Song Imperial Emperor was originally illegitimately acquired, now left in such a state, viewed by many as ’cause and effect, a reincarnation!’
Fortunately, Ding Ling kept his word, not killing the Emperor of the Great Song, but instead making all royal family members prepare to move to Luoyang, like the royal family of Western Xia.
As for Luoyang not yet conquered?
Ding Ling had already crushed the Great Song Imperial City Kaifeng, would a mere Luoyang not be easily conquered?
Ding Ling’s pace was swift.
He was displeased with Helian Tieshu’s slow actions, casually selecting outstanding generals, flying with them to Luoyang and other places, preparing to gather surrendered soldiers.
These generals were discovered when he reviewed the officials’ roster after the Emperor of the Great Song’s abdication.
In short.
The Great Song did not lack skilled ministers and officials, nor did it lack famous generals.
It lacked a stage for these generals to showcase their talents.
Ding Ling now provided them with that stage.
He swiftly advanced into Luoyang and other places, easily crushing one military group after another, then let these generals gather surrendered soldiers.
And flew to the next location.
He flew on a rope, flying dozens of meters into the sky, carrying dozens of generals.
These generals had never experienced such a spectacle?
Initially, they were somewhat unconvinced by Ding Ling.

But after flying several hundred miles, seeing Ding Ling’s face neither red nor breathless, they were astonished by his divine prowess! Showing utmost respect to Ding Ling, naturally requiring no further explanation.
Ding Ling already acquired the throne of the Great Song.
Now Ding Ling demonstrated his divine Lightweight Body Technique, how could they possibly not be convinced?

Later, seeing Ding Ling unleash his divine might, ignoring the rain of arrows, casually striking down a thousand soldiers, grabbing a large knife from the air and, with a single throw, hurling it over a thousand meters, easily ’shooting dead’ a leading general!
These and many more.
Enough to overwhelm.
The generals were dazzled, admired, and shocked beyond belief!
Unable to believe anyone like this existed.
[Achievement Medal: One person crushed ten cities]
[E-level Achievement Medal: Acquired the throne of the Great Song]
[Achievement Medal: One person crushed three hundred thousand troops!]
[Achievement Medal...]
Ding Ling swiftly flew away.
From south to north.
All the way to the Liao Kingdom.
The accompanying generals both excited and terrified, blood boiling and thrilled.
They also wanted to conquer Great Liao.
But lacked the ability.
Now Ding Ling, merely carrying them, broke into one strong city after another in Great Liao, too formidable!
The Martial God descended!
Roar!

When they witnessed Ding Ling break into the Imperial City of Great Liao, disregarding the rain of arrows and blades, wielding the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, amidst the myriad dragon roars, countless soldiers were knocked flying, some bodies shattered instantly, others spat blood and flew ten meters, some had broken legs, ruined arms...
Ding Ling alone, forcefully demonstrated the unstoppable, peerless power of one person leading a million troops into the Imperial City of Great Liao!
Xiaoo Yuanshan was among this group of generals, watching in amazement, marveling:
"Incredible, truly incredible. Martial prowess pushed to the limit. How could one be so powerful?! A revelation, a revelation. It seems I must practice more diligently in the future!"
Other generals couldn’t help but nod.
They were all historical figures, famous generals.
With exceptional insight and broad vision.
But when had they ever witnessed such extraordinary talent?
Shock, speechlessness, followed by admiration, longing, and the thought ’if I were as incredible, I would be invincible’?

Anyone witnessing Ding Ling alone penetrate the Liao Kingdom’s depths, forcefully breaking through tens of thousands of soldiers, crushing Liao’s defense system, single-handedly capturing the Liao Emperor from mid-air, would have their mind racing, unable to remain calm.
"Should I kill you and you surrender, or will you voluntarily surrender?"
Ding Ling asked the Liao Emperor.
This emperor was the original character Xiaoo Feng’s sworn brother, Emperor Daozong of Liao, Yelv Hongji, a formidable and audacious hero.
Even when threatened, he dared to kill his wife and children!
Such a strong heart, tenacious temperament, ruthless methods, evident at a glance.

In just a moment.
Thousands of masters had fallen, at least eighty percent of them.
In the remaining twenty percent were many peerless masters.
They looked at each other in fear, but thinking of the emperor and the officials behind them, they could only grit their teeth and charge.
However, even if they blocked Ding Ling’s Sound Wave Skills, they couldn’t block Ding Ling’s casual Canhe Finger.
The Canhe Finger was formless, invisible, and traceless.
One finger down.
No matter who it was.
They would instantly be dead or knocked down, unable to move.
Ding Ling walked leisurely, seemingly slow, yet advancing incredibly quickly.
In just a few blinks, he arrived at the Imperial Palace Main Hall, facing the Emperor of the Great Song and the officials.
"You, you, you..."
The Emperor of the Great Song was shocked, trembling, unable to imagine such a divine being as Ding Ling existed.
"Will you surrender after I overthrow the court, or will I kill you and then you surrender?
Or maybe just surrender directly and ensure the safety of your nine clans?
Live the rest of your life as a wealthy man?"
Ding Ling’s face was calm, his voice indifferent, surveying the scene, and no one dared meet his gaze.
Even those who bravely glared at him were immediately knocked down by Ding Ling’s light hum!
Ding Ling’s Sound Wave Skill had reached the Transformation Realm.
He could roar down ten thousand soldiers.
Or precisely roar one person unconscious.
"Do I have a choice?"
The Emperor of the Great Song smiled bitterly.
He had witnessed Ding Ling ignoring the rain of arrows and with a roar, nearly six thousand elites were roared down.
Ding Ling was unharmed along the way, while the Great Song suffered heavy losses!
Such a character?
Could he be a god?!
The Emperor of the Great Song’s expression was dazed, his gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly.
In the following time.
He cooperated with Ding Ling on the abdication process.
The throne of the Great Song Imperial Emperor was originally illegitimately acquired, now left in such a state, viewed by many as ’cause and effect, a reincarnation!’
Fortunately, Ding Ling kept his word, not killing the Emperor of the Great Song, but instead making all royal family members prepare to move to Luoyang, like the royal family of Western Xia.
As for Luoyang not yet conquered?
Ding Ling had already crushed the Great Song Imperial City Kaifeng, would a mere Luoyang not be easily conquered?
Ding Ling’s pace was swift.
He was displeased with Helian Tieshu’s slow actions, casually selecting outstanding generals, flying with them to Luoyang and other places, preparing to gather surrendered soldiers.
These generals were discovered when he reviewed the officials’ roster after the Emperor of the Great Song’s abdication.
In short.
The Great Song did not lack skilled ministers and officials, nor did it lack famous generals.
It lacked a stage for these generals to showcase their talents.
Ding Ling now provided them with that stage.
He swiftly advanced into Luoyang and other places, easily crushing one military group after another, then let these generals gather surrendered soldiers.
And flew to the next location.
He flew on a rope, flying dozens of meters into the sky, carrying dozens of generals.
These generals had never experienced such a spectacle?
Initially, they were somewhat unconvinced by Ding Ling.
But after flying several hundred miles, seeing Ding Ling’s face neither red nor breathless, they were astonished by his divine prowess!
Showing utmost respect to Ding Ling, naturally requiring no further explanation.
Ding Ling already acquired the throne of the Great Song.
Now Ding Ling demonstrated his divine Lightweight Body Technique, how could they possibly not be convinced?

Later, seeing Ding Ling unleash his divine might, ignoring the rain of arrows, casually striking down a thousand soldiers, grabbing a large knife from the air and, with a single throw, hurling it over a thousand meters, easily ’shooting dead’ a leading general!
These and many more.
Enough to overwhelm.
The generals were dazzled, admired, and shocked beyond belief!
Unable to believe anyone like this existed.
[Achievement Medal: One person crushed ten cities]
[E-level Achievement Medal: Acquired the throne of the Great Song]
[Achievement Medal: One person crushed three hundred thousand troops!]
[Achievement Medal...]
Ding Ling swiftly flew away.
From south to north.
All the way to the Liao Kingdom.
The accompanying generals both excited and terrified, blood boiling and thrilled.
They also wanted to conquer Great Liao.
But lacked the ability.
Now Ding Ling, merely carrying them, broke into one strong city after another in Great Liao, too formidable!
The Martial God descended!
Roar!

When they witnessed Ding Ling break into the Imperial City of Great Liao, disregarding the rain of arrows and blades, wielding the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, amidst the myriad dragon roars, countless soldiers were knocked flying, some bodies shattered instantly, others spat blood and flew ten meters, some had broken legs, ruined arms...
Ding Ling alone, forcefully demonstrated the unstoppable, peerless power of one person leading a million troops into the Imperial City of Great Liao!
Xiaoo Yuanshan was among this group of generals, watching in amazement, marveling:
"Incredible, truly incredible.
Martial prowess pushed to the limit.
How could one be so powerful?!
A revelation, a revelation.
It seems I must practice more diligently in the future!"
Other generals couldn’t help but nod.
They were all historical figures, famous generals.
With exceptional insight and broad vision.
But when had they ever witnessed such extraordinary talent?
Shock, speechlessness, followed by admiration, longing, and the thought ’if I were as incredible, I would be invincible’?

Anyone witnessing Ding Ling alone penetrate the Liao Kingdom’s depths, forcefully breaking through tens of thousands of soldiers, crushing Liao’s defense system, single-handedly capturing the Liao Emperor from mid-air, would have their mind racing, unable to remain calm.
"Should I kill you and you surrender, or will you voluntarily surrender?"
Ding Ling asked the Liao Emperor.
This emperor was the original character Xiaoo Feng’s sworn brother, Emperor Daozong of Liao, Yelv Hongji, a formidable and audacious hero.
Even when threatened, he dared to kill his wife and children!
Such a strong heart, tenacious temperament, ruthless methods, evident at a glance.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 541: Great Ming Kingdom
paragraphs: At this moment.
Yelv Hongji heard Ding Ling’s words and glanced around.
He saw that the hundreds of thousands of elite troops of the Liao Kingdom were completely subdued by Ding Ling.
Those who dared openly resist and attempt to kill Ding Ling were all exterminated by Ding Ling, leaving the warriors who were bewildered, astonished, and fearful as they looked at him.
Some warriors even looked at him with a gaze of expectation, as if hoping he would surrender.
In his anger, Yelv Hongji also felt a chill in his heart. He looked at Ding Ling and said, deeply convinced:

"You, by your own power, swept away Western Xia, became the Emperor of Western Xia, and now, by your own power, successively destroyed Song and Liao. Looking throughout history, there has never been such a shocking, earth-shattering extraordinaire. You are the first, and perhaps the last."
"Will you surrender?"
Ding Ling frowned and asked:
"I don’t want to drag things out too much with you."
Yelv Hongji felt a blockage in his chest, uncomfortable, as he used to have others flatter and fawn over him, now he actively sought to befriend Ding Ling but was rejected!
This feeling was very unpleasant, considering he was at least an emperor of a country! Yet he fell to such a state.
The only thing that consoled him.
He was the third emperor, following the Emperor of Western Xia and the Emperor of Great Song, and not the first one, being the first one to be defeated is more embarrassing and shameful!
Calculating this way, his Great Liao seemed to have the best treatment?!
Yelv Hongji could only think positively, otherwise, he feared his mentality would collapse, thus after calming himself, he said:
"I surrender!"
Yelv Hongji saw the chilling killing intention in Ding Ling’s eyes!
If he dared hesitate or deny, he dared wager that he and his whole clan would be killed.
Where there’s life, there’s hope!
Once dead, everything is gone.
Surrendering allows for a chance to rise again.
Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill and acting were at full level, he understood Yelv Hongji’s thoughts with just one look, but he did not expose him.
To quickly garner surrendered soldiers and generals and unify Jiuzhou, Ding Ling would not slaughter those who surrendered, as this would be detrimental to governance.
And as Yelv Hongji voluntarily spoke of surrender.
The Great Liao completely collapsed!
In just a few days.
The Great Liao transformed.
Too sudden and unexpected.
Many citizens of the Great Liao were still bewildered when they heard the eye-popping news.
Great Song, Great Liao, Western Xia, three kingdoms merged!
Becoming the Great Ming Kingdom!
Capital set in Luoyang.
From then on, the people of the three kingdoms became one family and no longer had to suffer the turmoil of war.
This naturally was worth celebrating for the common folks.
The vast majority of people disliked war.
Because war meant death!
Hence.
Once the news spread.
Celebration all around, cheering and spreading the news, a considerable number doing so!
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Successfully obtained the imperial position of the Liao Kingdom]
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Single-handedly collapsed three nations!]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: You broke through the imperial city of the Great Liao]
Ding Ling walked all along.
Collected 5 E-level Achievement Medals.
More than thirty ordinary Achievement Medals.
Currently.
His medal status:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 77, E-level 18]
The strength of four-dimensional attributes exchanged back to reality, consumed 25 Achievement Medals.
The exchange for True Power Value expended 30.
To exchange one point of True Power Value required 3 ordinary Achievement Medals.
Exchange of four-dimensional attributes is 3 points per medal.
Nowadays.
Ding Ling’s power status in the real world is exactly the same as in the Game World.
He can soar in the void, traverse hundreds of miles.
So now in the real world, he travels untraceably, making it difficult for ordinary people to spot his presence.
Moreover, lifespan is equally extended, reaching several hundred years.
The surge in power boosted Ding Ling’s sense of security significantly.
But it’s still not enough.
His goal is to withstand nuclear bombs, live eternally, and be invincible across the heavens!
After the unification of the three kingdoms.
Ding Ling personally took a trip to Tubo.
Easily broke through the Tubo army still deadlocked with Xiaoo Feng’s great army.
Xiaoo Feng was speechless, shocked, and ashamed, sighed:
"Your Majesty is extraordinary. With one move, directly settled it. Compared to Your Majesty, I feel utterly useless!"
Jiu Mozhi comforted:
"Your Majesty is a Divine Being, naturally not comparable to us mortals."
Having heard what Ding Ling did in Jiuzhou.
Jiu Mozhi’s eyes nearly bulged out in shock, but considering Ding Ling could collapse Western Xia, naturally he could collapse Great Song and Great Liao as well.
Though these two countries were great.
For Ding Ling to break through them so easily, Jiu Mozhi couldn’t stay calm. Too strong! Unbelievably strong, beyond the skies, naturally leaving him somewhat puzzled.
Boom!

Ding Ling arrived at the Tubo Royal City, struck a palm, and sent flying the hundreds of guards clustered on the city walls, then charged all the way into the Royal City core, in full view, caught the Tubo king in mid-air.
Asked if he would surrender.
The Tubo king in bewilderment showed fear, fright, reluctance to believe!
He certainly had heard of Ding Ling’s deeds.
But he always thought it was exaggerated rumor, had even killed the aliens spreading such claims to avoid public panic.
Now Ding Ling personally came to kill.
He then realized his foolishness!
He also sensed the overwhelming killing intent in Ding Ling’s eyes, frightened to the point of trembling, who dared to utter ’no’?
Thus.
Tubo was also naturally incorporated into the territory of the Great Ming Kingdom.
The speed.
Made Great Ming officials speechless, at a loss for words.
More were excited, exhilarated, joyful.
Being able to serve as officials under such an emperor truly was an immense honor.
And some Great Ming Military Generals could only follow Ding Ling behind, accepting batch after batch of surrendered troops.
Other than helplessness, they could only respect and worship Ding Ling even more!
Single-handedly collapsing multiple nations!
Such a Great Emperor!
Never before seen in ancient times!
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Obtained the imperial position of Tubo.]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: Breaking through Tubo Royal City]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: You intimidated the Tubo Prince Zongzan]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: You intimidated Tubo officials]
An E-level.
Seven ordinary Achievement Medals
Ding Ling was quite satisfied with this.
After breaking through Tubo, he asked the Tubo king and his three tribes to move to Luoyang, then returned to the heartland of the Central Plains.
As for Xiaoo Feng?
Being a Great General of the Great Ming, he had to stay behind to handle the aftermath.
Once the appointment of Tubo generals and civil ministers was completed, and Tubo relatively stabilized, he would return to the Great Ming court.
The deeds of Ding Ling consecutively breaking through multiple nations.
Triggered an uproar and explosion in the real-world network.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had done such things many times before, after the uproar, people became used to it, carrying on as usual.
But it was undeniable that Ding Ling’s fame grew even higher, his reputation even greater.
Causing some businesses to drool even more over Ding Ling’s traffic, countless merchants openly calling on the internet to collaborate with Ding Ling, and their numbers were uncountable.
